monsters.languages: Deep Speech, Giant, telepathy 60 ft., Undercommon

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The ceremorph has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ceremorph makes one Slam attack and one Tentacles attack. The ceremorph can replace one of the attacks with a Mind Bolt attack, if available.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 22 (4d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. 15 (2d10 + 4) psychic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it has the grappled condition (escape 14) and must succeed on a 15 Intelligence saving throw or have the stunned condition until this grapple ends.

actions.name: Extract Brain
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated Humanoid grappled by the ceremorph. 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the ceremorph kills the target by extracting and devouring its brain.

actions.name: Mind Bolt (3/Day)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. 17 (2d12 + 4) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a 15 Intelligence saving throw or have the stunned condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Death Curse
traits.desc:
When the fensir starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate, it releases a curse on those around it. Each creature within 30 feet of the fensir when it dies must succeed on a 13 Charisma saving throw or be cursed for the next 24 hours.
While cursed in this way, an affected creature gains no benefit from finishing a short or long rest. At the end of every hour, the creature must succeed on a 13 Charisma saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The fensir regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it isn't in sunlight. If the fensir takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the fensir's next turn. The fensir dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.desc: When the fensir starts its turn in sunlight, it must succeed on a 15 Constitution saving throw or have the petrified condition until the fensir is no longer in sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fensir makes two attacks, using Rend, Boulder, or a combination of them.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 21 (3d10 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Boulder
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. 18 (2d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 16 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition. After the fensir throws the boulder, roll a d6; on a roll of 4 or lower, the fensir has no more boulders to throw.

monsters.name: Fensir Skirmisher

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The fensir regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it isn't in sunlight. If the fensir takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the fensir's next turn. The fensir dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.desc: When the fensir starts its turn in sunlight, it must succeed on a 15 Constitution saving throw or have the petrified condition until the fensir is no longer in sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fensir makes three Battleaxe attacks or two Magic Stone attacks.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Magic Stone
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. 15 (2d12 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 13 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Mud to Stone (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The fensir lobs a magical mass of mud that splashes all creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the fensir can see within 60 feet of itself. Each non-fensir creature in that area must succeed on a 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage and have the restrained condition as the mud begins to turn to stone. An affected creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the effect ends on the creature. On a failed save, the creature has the petrified condition for 24 hours.

spells: The fensir casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability:

spells.1/day each: create or destroy water, detect magic, pass without trace

monsters.name: Firbolg Primeval Warden

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The firbolg makes two Spear or Fire Lance attacks.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Lance
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 14 (2d10 + 3) fire damage.

bonus_actions.name: Hidden Step (2/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The firbolg magically turns invisible until the start of its next turn, until it makes an attack roll, or until it forces someone to make a saving throw.

spells: The firbolg casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 13):

spells.At will: entangle, speak with animals, speak with plants

spells.1/day each: commune with nature (as an action), detect magic, disguise self

monsters.name: Firbolg Wanderer

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The firbolg makes two attacks using Longsword, Bewitching Bolt, or a combination of them.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage.

actions.name: Bewitching Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. 10 (2d6 + 3) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a 14 Charisma saving throw or have the charmed condition until the start of the target's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Duplicitous Movement (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc:
The firbolg projects an illusory duplicate of itself in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of itself. The firbolg can then swap places with the illusion. The illusion vanishes after 1 minute, if the firbolg is incapacitated, or if the illusion is more than 120 feet from the firbolg.
As a bonus action on later turns, the firbolg can move the illusion up to 30 feet and can then swap places with it.

spells: The firbolg casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 14):

spells.At will: mage hand, minor illusion, Tasha's hideous laughter

spells.1/day each: detect magic, disguise self, dispel magic, polymorph

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Fire Rune
traits.desc:
The giant has a fire rune inscribed on a medallion or some other object in its possession. While holding or wearing the object bearing the rune, the giant can use its Magma Wave action and Furnace Armor bonus action.
The object bearing the rune has AC 15; 40 hit points; and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The object regains all its hit points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 hit points or when the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe a fire rune on an object in its possession when it finishes a short or long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes three Forge Hammer attacks or two Heated Rock attacks.

actions.name: Forge Hammer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 24 (5d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage. {@hom}The giant can cause the hammer to emit a burst of heat in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the target. Metal objects in that area glow red-hot until the start of the giant's next turn. Any creature in physical contact with a heated object at the start of its turn must make a 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 10 (3d6) fire damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn unless it has immunity to fire damage. The hammer can emit heat in this way only once per turn.

actions.name: Heated Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +13 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 19 (3d12) fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 21 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition. After the giant throws the rock, roll a d6; on a roll of 3 or lower, the giant has no more rocks to throw.

actions.name: Magma Wave (Requires Fire Rune)
actions.desc: The giant emits a wave of magma from its fire rune in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (8d8) fire damage and has the restrained condition. As an action, a creature can make a 19 Strength (Athletics) check, freeing itself or a creature within its reach from the rock on a success. The rock restraining each creature has AC 17; 20 hit points; and immunity to fire, poison, and psychic damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Furnace Armor (Requires Fire Rune)
bonus_actions.desc: The giant causes smoke and cinders to billow from its armor, filling a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the giant. While the armor is billowing smoke, the giant has Cover. The armor stops billowing smoke after 1 minute, when the giant dies, when the giant uses a bonus action to end the effect, or when the giant's fire rune is destroyed.

traits.name: Shrapnel Explosion
traits.desc: When the giant drops to 0 hit points, its armor explodes, destroying the giant's body and scattering the armor as shrapnel. Creatures within 10 feet of the giant when its armor explodes must make a 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two Searing Scepter attacks or two Bolt of Imix attacks.

actions.name: Searing Scepter
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage, and the target is magically branded. While branded in this way, the target becomes visible if it's invisible, can't become invisible, and sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius. The brand disappears after 24 hours, or it can be removed from a creature or an object by any spell that ends a curse.

actions.name: Bolt of Imix
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 20 (3d10 + 4) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a 16 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until the end of the target's next turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The hellion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Soul Taker
traits.desc: A Giant or a Humanoid that is reduced to 0 hit points by the hellion dies, and its soul rises as a lemure (see the Monster Manual) on Avernus, one of the Nine Hells, in 1d4 hours. If the creature isn't revived before then, it can be restored to life only by a wish spell or by killing the lemure and casting true resurrection on the creature's original body.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hellion makes two Morningstar attacks.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) fire damage. If the target is a creature, it can't regain hit points until the start of the hellion's next turn.

actions.name: Infernal Orb
actions.desc: The hellion hurls a magical ball of fire that explodes in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the hellion can see within 120 feet of itself. The sphere spreads around corners. Each creature in that area must make a 17 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 18 (4d8) fire damage and 18 (4d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Fire Blood
traits.desc: Whenever a creature within 5 feet of the firegaunt hits the firegaunt with a melee attack that deals piercing or slashing damage, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The firegaunt makes two Heated Maul attacks.

actions.name: Heated Maul
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. The firegaunt can cause the maul to erupt with crimson flames, and the target must succeed on a 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) fire damage and 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The maul can erupt with flames in this way only once per turn.

actions.name: Crimson Rays (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The firegaunt emits beams of fire from its eyes, mouth, and wounds in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a success or failure, that creature catches fire. Until the burning creature or another creature that can reach it takes an action to extinguish the fire, the burning creature can't regain hit points and takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

monsters.name: Flesh Colossus
monsters.damage_immunities: lightning, poison, psychic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Berserk
traits.desc: If the core inside the colossus is destroyed, the colossus goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the colossus attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the colossus attacks an object. Once the colossus goes berserk, it remains berserk until it is destroyed.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The colossus is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The colossus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The colossus deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The colossus makes two Fist attacks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit (with advantage if the colossus is berserk), reach 20 ft., one target. 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is pulled up to 15 feet toward the colossus, it has the grappled condition (escape 17), and it has the restrained condition until this grapple ends. The colossus can have up to two creatures grappled this way at a time.

actions.name: Elemental Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc:
The colossus exhales a cloud swirling with elemental energy in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 40 (9d8) damage of a type of the colossus's choosing: acid, cold, fire, or lightning. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.
At the same time as the colossus releases this exhalation, creatures inside the colossus's chest cavity take 40 (9d8) force damage from churning elemental energy.

bonus_actions.name: Bite
bonus_actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature grappled by the colossus. 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the creature is swallowed. A swallowed creature has the restrained condition, has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the colossus, and takes 10 (3d6) force damage at the start of each of the colossus's turns.
The colossus's chest cavity can hold up to two creatures at a time. Inside its chest cavity is its core, which is a Large object with AC 16 that is immune to lightning, poison, and psychic damage. It has 140 hit points and sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius. If the core is destroyed, the colossus regurgitates all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the colossus and has the prone condition, and the colossus can no longer swallow a creature. If the colossus dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting with the prone condition.

traits.name: Contortionist
traits.desc: The fomorian can enter a space large enough for a Large creature without squeezing.

traits.name: Crawling Stance
traits.desc: While the fomorian has the prone condition, crawling does not cost it extra movement. In addition, the prone condition does not grant advantage on attack rolls against the fomorian.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The fomorian can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fomorian makes two Slam attacks and uses Crawling Hex if it is available.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Crawling Hex (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: The fomorian targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 31 (7d8) psychic damage, have the prone condition, and become cursed for 1 hour. While cursed this way, the target can't stand up and end the prone condition on itself.

monsters.name: Fomorian Noble

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fomorian makes three Rod attacks.

actions.name: Rod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) force damage.

bonus_actions.name: Beguiling Presence
bonus_actions.desc: The fomorian targets a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 17 Wisdom saving throw or have the charmed condition for 1 minute. An affected target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target becomes immune to all fomorians' Beguiling Presence for the next 24 hours.

spells: The fomorian casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 17):

spells.At will: mage armor (self only), mage hand, prestidigitation

spells.1/day each: chain lightning, cone of cold (6th-level version), fireball (6th-level version), fly, plane shift (self only)

monsters.name: Fomorian Warlock of the Dark

traits.name: Blood Rune
traits.desc:
The fomorian has a blood rune inscribed on an effigy or some other object in its possession. While holding or wearing the object bearing the rune, the giant can use its Corrupting Hex action and Poisoning Rebuke reaction.
The object bearing the blood rune has AC 15; 30 hit points; and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The object regains all its hit points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 hit points or when the fomorian dies. If the rune is destroyed, the fomorian can inscribe a blood rune on an object in its possession when it finishes a short or long rest.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the fomorian's darkvision.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the fomorian fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fomorian makes three Greatclub attacks. If the fomorian has its blood rune, it can replace one of these attacks with a use of Corrupting Hex.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Corrupting Hex (Requires Blood Rune)
actions.desc: The fomorian targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 16 Charisma saving throw or take 27 (6d8) necrotic damage and become cursed for 24 hours. While cursed this way, the target's speed is reduced by half, and if it tries to cast a spell, it must first succeed on a 16 Intelligence check or the spell fails and is wasted.

actions.name: Eldritch Burst
actions.desc: Magical energy explodes in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the fomorian can see within 120 feet of itself. Each creature in that area must make a 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 32 (5d12) force damage and has the prone condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Creeping Gloom (Recharge 6)
bonus_actions.desc: The fomorian momentarily conjures grasping darkness in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point it can see within 120 feet of itself. Each creature in that area must succeed on a 16 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) necrotic damage and have the blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Poisoning Rebuke (Requires Blood Rune)
reactions.desc: In response to being damaged by a creature the fomorian can see within 60 feet of itself, the fomorian forces that creature to make a 16 Constitution saving throw; on a failed save, the creature has the poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

spells: The fomorian casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 16):

spells.At will: detect magic, levitate, mage hand, prestidigitation

traits.name: Frost Rune
traits.desc:
The giant has a frost rune inscribed on a chunk of ice or some other object in its possession. While holding or wearing the object bearing the rune, the giant can use its Ice Wolves action and Ice Armor reaction.
The object bearing the rune has AC 16; 40 hit points; and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The object regains all its hit points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 hit points or when the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe a frost rune on an object in its possession when it finishes a short or long rest.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes three attacks using Greataxe, Freezing Ray, or a combination of them.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 22 (3d10 + 6) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Freezing Ray
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 17 (3d8 + 4) cold damage, and the target must make a 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the restrained condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Ice Wolves (Requires Frost Rune)
actions.desc: The giant magically summons 1d4 wolves made of ice (use the winter wolf stat block in the Monster Manual to represent them, but they are Elementals instead of Monstrosities). The wolves appear in unoccupied spaces the giant can see within 30 feet of itself. The wolves take their turn immediately after the giant on the same initiative count, and they obey the giant's commands. The wolves gain a +6 bonus to their attack and damage rolls while they are within 30 feet of the giant. The wolves disappear after 1 minute, when the giant dies, or when the giant uses this action again.

reactions.name: Ice Armor (Requires Frost Rune)
reactions.desc: When a creature the giant can see makes an attack roll against it, the giant can form a coat of ice around itself, granting it a +6 bonus to its AC against that attack. After the attack hits or misses, the ice shatters, and each creature within 5 feet of the giant must succeed on a 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (3d8) cold damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The giant can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two Battleaxe attacks and one Harpoon attack.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 19 (3d8 + 6) slashing damage, or 22 (3d10 + 6) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Harpoon
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +7 to hit, range 50/200 ft., one creature. 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage, and the target has the grappled condition (escape 16). While the target is grappled this way, its speed isn't reduced, but it can't move farther from the giant. The target takes 5 (1d10) slashing damage if it escapes from the grapple or if it tries and fails. The giant can grapple only one target at a time with its harpoon.

bonus_actions.name: Reel In
bonus_actions.desc: The giant pulls the target grappled by its Harpoon up to 20 feet toward itself.

monsters.name: Frostmourn
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The frostmourn makes one Freezing Touch attack and one Icy Axe attack. It can replace one of these attacks with a Polar Ray attack.

actions.name: Freezing Touch
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 18 (4d8) cold damage plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage. If this damage would reduce the target to 0 hit points, the target drops to 1 hit point instead and has the petrified condition, turning into a frozen statue.
If the statue takes bludgeoning damage, it shatters, killing the frozen creature. If the statue would take fire damage, it instead takes no damage and thaws, ending the petrification.

actions.name: Icy Axe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 19 (3d8 + 6) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Polar Ray
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 31 (5d10 + 4) cold damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Blizzard Escape
reactions.desc: Immediately after a creature the frostmourn can see hits it with an attack roll, the frostmourn momentarily dissolves into a blizzard, reducing the damage to itself by half. The frostmourn can then magically teleport to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of itself.

traits.name: Chilling Aura
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the fury must succeed on a 20 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) cold damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The fury has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fury makes two Fist or Rock attacks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage, or 17 (5d6) cold damage if the target took damage from the fury's Chilling Aura since the end of the fury's last turn.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +13 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

bonus_actions.name: Charge
bonus_actions.desc: The fury can move up to its speed toward an enemy it can see.

traits.name: Weird Aura
traits.desc: At the start of each of the gargantua's turns, each creature of the gargantua's choice within 30 feet of it must make a 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target sees the gargantua as a manifestation of the target's worst fears; it takes 17 (5d6) psychic damage and has the frightened condition until the start of the target's next turn. On a successful save, a target is immune to this gargantua's Weird Aura for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gargantua makes two Slam or Rock attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 27 (3d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +15 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

bonus_actions.name: Baleful Hex
bonus_actions.desc: The gargantua curses one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 19 Wisdom saving throw or have the incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Teleport
bonus_actions.desc: The gargantua teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space that it can see within 120 feet of itself.

reactions.name: Flick
reactions.desc: Immediately after the gargantua takes damage from a Large or smaller creature it can see within 20 feet of itself, it attempts to flick the creature away. The target must succeed on a 23 Strength saving throw, or the target takes 18 (3d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage, is pushed horizontally up to 100 feet away from the gargantua, and has the prone condition.

reactions.name: Spell Mimicry (1/Day)
reactions.desc: Immediately after a creature the gargantua can see casts a spell of 5th level or lower, the gargantua tries to copy the spell. That creature must succeed on a 19 Charisma saving throw, or the gargantua immediately casts the same spell at the same level (+11 to hit with spell attacks, spell save 19), requiring no material components and choosing the spell's targets.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Giant Goose
monsters.languages: understands Giant and Sylvan but can't speak

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The goose makes one Beak attack and two Wing attacks.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Wing
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d10 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a 12 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Thunderous Honk (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The goose honks with ear-splitting volume. Each other creature within 30 feet of the goose must make a 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 16 (3d10) thunder damage and has the deafened condition until the start of the goose's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. The honk can be heard within 300 feet.

traits.name: Lynx's Sight (1/Day)
traits.desc: The lynx can cast clairvoyance, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Woodland Camouflage
traits.desc: The lynx has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in undergrowth or snowy terrain.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage. If the lynx moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target must succeed on a 12 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition. If the target has the prone condition, the lynx can make another Claws attack against it as a bonus action.

monsters.name: Giant Ox
monsters.languages: understands Giant and Sylvan but can't speak

traits.name: Beast of Burden
traits.desc: The ox is considered to be one size larger for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage. If the ox moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage, and it must succeed on a 16 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The ram has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Ram
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) force damage. If the ram moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target must succeed on a 14 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Force Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +4 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. 7 (2d6) force damage.

reactions.name: Absorbent Fleece (Recharge 6)
reactions.desc: Immediately after the ram succeeds on a saving throw against a spell or a spell's attack misses it, the ram can make one Force Bolt attack.

actions.name: Proboscis
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the tick attaches to the target. While attached, the tick can't make Proboscis attacks. The tick can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. As an action, a creature within reach of the tick can try to detach the tick, doing so with a successful 13 Strength check.

actions.name: Blood Drain
actions.desc: The tick deals 10 (2d6 + 3) necrotic damage to one creature it is physically attached to, provided that creature isn't a Construct or an Undead, or 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage if the creature is a Giant. The tick regains hit points equal to the damage dealt.

traits.name: Spell-Resistant Carapace
traits.desc: The gigant has advantage on saving throws against spells, and any creature that makes a spell attack against the gigant has disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gigant makes one Mandibles attack and two Talons attacks.

actions.name: Mandibles
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage, and the target has the grappled condition (escape 17). Until the grapple ends, the target takes 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage at the start of each of the gigant's turns. While the gigant is grappling a target, it can't use Mandibles against other targets.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 17 (3d6 + 7) slashing damage, and the target is pulled 10 feet straight toward the gigant.

actions.name: Scale Dust (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The gigant releases magical dust from its wings in a 30-foot cube. Each creature in that area must make a 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a success or failure, the creature has the poisoned condition for 1 hour. While poisoned this way, the creature can't regain hit points.

bonus_actions.name: Drone
bonus_actions.desc: The gigant produces a horrid droning sound by rapidly beating its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the gigant must succeed on a 19 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) thunder damage and have the incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn. The gigant can then fly up to half its flying speed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The goliath makes two Spear attacks.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

bonus_actions.name: Giant's Strikes (Recharge 5-6)
bonus_actions.desc: Until the end of its turn, the goliath's melee attacks each deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage of a type determined by the goliath's giant community: cold (frost giant), fire (fire giant), force (stone giant), lightning (storm giant), piercing (hill giant), or thunder (cloud giant).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The grinning cat has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage. If the grinning cat was invisible before it attacked, the target must succeed on a 12 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition. If the target has the prone condition, the cat can make a Bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Fade Away
actions.desc: The grinning cat magically becomes invisible for 1 hour or until it attacks, gradually fading away over the course of its turn. It can choose to leave part of its body visible, such as its tail, its head, or its grinning mouth. Any equipment the cat wears or carries is invisible with it.

bonus_actions.name: Fade Back
bonus_actions.desc: The grinning cat becomes visible or makes part of its body visible. Any equipment the cat wears or carries on a visible part of its body also becomes visible.

bonus_actions.name: Grinning Step
bonus_actions.desc: The grinning cat teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

monsters.name: Hill Giant Avalancher

traits.name: Hill Rune
traits.desc:
The giant has a hill rune inscribed on a rock or some other object in its possession. While holding or wearing the object bearing the rune, the giant can use its Stone Avalanche action and Hill Rebuff reaction.
The object bearing the rune has AC 15; 20 hit points; and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The object regains all its hit points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 hit points or when the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe a hill rune on an object in its possession when it finishes a short or long rest.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes one Greatclub attack and uses Stone Bolas.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) thunder damage.

actions.name: Stone Bolas
actions.desc: The giant conjures three stone balls connected by lines of magical force and throws them at one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must make a 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the restrained condition until the start of the giant's next turn, and the stones erupt in a burst of thunderous energy that deals 14 (4d6) thunder damage to the target and each creature within 10 feet of the target. On a successful save, the stones vanish without erupting.

actions.name: Stone Avalanche (Requires Hill Rune)
actions.desc:
The giant conjures a hail of rocks in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point on the ground it can see within 120 feet of itself. Each creature in that area must make a 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage and has the prone condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.
The rocks turn the ground in that area into difficult terrain until the start of the giant's next turn, when the rocks vanish.

reactions.name: Hill Rebuff (Requires Hill Rune)
reactions.desc: Immediately after the giant takes damage from a creature it can see within 10 feet of itself, that creature must succeed on a 16 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) force damage and be pushed horizontally 10 feet away from the giant.

spells: The giant casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 16):

monsters.name: Lightning Hulk
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, thunder, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: The lightning hulk sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

traits.name: Lightning Form
traits.desc: The lightning hulk can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time the lightning hulk enters a creature's space on a turn, or if it begins its turn in a creature's space, that creature takes 7 (2d6) lightning damage. The hulk can also move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. A creature that touches the lightning hulk or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) lightning damage.

actions.name: Arc Lightning
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 18 (4d8) lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it can't take reactions until the start of its next turn, and lightning jumps from the target to another creature of the lightning hulk's choice that it can see within 30 feet of the target. The second creature must succeed on a 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) lightning damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The maw has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The maw makes two Bite or Fang Fling attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fang Fling
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +10 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. 11 (1d10 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Gorging Charge (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The maw moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks and can move through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures. Each time the maw enters a creature's space for the first time during this move, that creature must succeed on a 18 Strength saving throw or take 25 (3d12 + 6) piercing damage and have the grappled condition (escape 16); if a creature is already grappled this way, it has the prone condition. Until this grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition. The maw can have only one creature grappled in this way at a time.

reactions.name: Fanged Rebuke
reactions.desc: In response to taking damage, the maw makes one Bite attack against a random creature within 10 feet of itself. If no creature is within reach, the maw can make two Fang Fling attacks.

traits.name: Air Form
traits.desc: The mist hulk can enter another creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.desc: When the mist hulk dies, it bursts in a wave of water. Each creature within 10 feet of it must make a 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage and has the prone condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mist hulk makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 16 (2d10 + 5) cold damage.

actions.name: Hideous Wailing (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The mist hulk releases a wail infused with magical anguish. Each creature within 30 feet of it must make a 14 Wisdom saving throw. A creature in the mist hulk's space has disadvantage on the saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage and has the incapacitated condition for 1 minute. The affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The mud hulk can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

traits.name: Sticky Mud
traits.desc: The ground within 15 feet of the mud hulk is difficult terrain for other creatures.

actions.name: Enveloping Slam
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 9 (1d12 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 13 Strength saving throw or be pulled into the mud hulk's space and be engulfed by the mud hulk. While engulfed, the target can't breathe, has the restrained condition, and takes 6 (1d12) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. When the mud hulk moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The mud hulk can have only one target engulfed at a time. While a creature is engulfed, the mud hulk can't use its Amorphous trait.
An engulfed target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save, the target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space.

actions.name: Mud Splash
actions.desc: The mud hulk lobs a mass of mud that splashes in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 30 feet of the mud hulk. Each creature in that area must make a 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The affected area is difficult terrain until the start of the mud hulk's next turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The regisaur has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The regisaur makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack. The regisaur can't target the same creature with both attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 47 (6d12 + 8) piercing damage, and the target has the grappled condition (escape 18). Until this grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the regisaur can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 26 (4d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

bonus_actions.name: Swallow
bonus_actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Huge or smaller creature grappled by the regisaur. The regisaur swallows the target, and the grapple ends. A swallowed creature has the blinded and restrained conditions, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the regisaur, and it takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. The regisaur can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time.
If the regisaur takes 25 damage or more on a single turn from a swallowed creature, the regisaur must succeed on a 16 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within 5 feet of the regisaur and has the prone condition; the creature no longer has the blinded and restrained conditions.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.desc: When the rime hulk dies, it explodes in a 10-foot-radius sphere of frigid air and frost centered on itself. Each creature in that area must succeed on a 15 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The rime hulk makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Trail of Frost (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The rime hulk moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks and can move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature. Each time the rime hulk enters another creature's space for the first time during this move, that creature must make a 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 22 (4d10) cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the rime hulk's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

monsters.name: Runic Colossus
monsters.damage_immunities: poison, psychic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The colossus is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The colossus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The colossus deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The colossus makes two Slam attacks and then uses Stomp.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 26 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 22 Dexterity saving throw or have the prone condition. Until the colossus uses its Stomp again or moves, the creature has the restrained condition. The restrained creature or another creature within 5 feet of it can use its action to make a 22 Strength check. On a successful check, the affected creature relocates to an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 feet of the colossus and is no longer restrained.

actions.name: Arcane Beam (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The colossus fires a beam of magical force from its chest, hands, or head in a 150-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 58 (9d12) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Spell Reflection (2/Day)
reactions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +14 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature casting a spell of 5th level or lower. 26 (4d12) force damage, and the target must succeed on a 15 Intelligence saving throw or the spell fails and has no effect.

monsters.name: Scion of Grolantor
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (6/Day)
traits.desc: If the scion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The scion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The scion deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The scion makes one Great Tree Club attack and two Slam attacks, or it makes three Boulder attacks.

actions.name: Great Tree Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 23 Strength saving throw or be pushed horizontally up to 100 feet straight away from the scion and have the prone condition.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 26 (4d8 + 8) force damage.

actions.name: Boulder
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +15 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. 27 (3d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Inhale (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc:
The scion inhales a vortex of air in a 120-foot line that is 15 feet wide. Each creature in that area that is Huge or smaller must succeed on a 23 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 120 feet straight toward the scion and be swallowed. A swallowed creature has the restrained condition, has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the scion, and takes 24 (7d6) force damage at the start of each of the scion's turns.
The scion's stomach can hold up to two creatures at a time. If the scion takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the scion must succeed on a 17 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the scion and has the prone condition. If the scion dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting with the prone condition.

bonus_actions.name: Earth-Shaking Movement
bonus_actions.desc: The scion moves up to its speed and then sends a shock wave through the ground in a 60-foot-radius circle centered on itself. Each creature on the ground in that area that is {@status concentration||concentrating} must succeed on a 23 Constitution saving throw or lose {@status concentration}.

reactions.name: Feed
reactions.desc: Immediately after taking damage, if it has at least one creature swallowed, the scion deals 10 (3d6) force damage to each swallowed creature and regains 10 hit points.

monsters.name: Scion of Memnor
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The scion doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (6/Day)
traits.desc: If the scion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The scion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The scion deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The scion makes one attack using Cloud Morningstar or Wind Javelin, as well as two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Cloud Morningstar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 32 (4d10 + 10) force damage plus 22 (4d10) thunder damage.

actions.name: Wind Javelin
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +18 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. 42 (5d12 + 10) thunder damage, and the target must succeed on a 26 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 28 (4d8 + 10) force damage.

actions.name: Thunderous Vortex (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The scion magically creates a vortex of wind in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on a point it can see within 120 feet of itself. Each creature in the sphere must succeed on a 24 Strength saving throw or be pulled straight toward the sphere's center, ending in an unoccupied space as close as possible to the center. Then a burst of thunder erupts in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the same point. Each creature in that area takes 52 (8d12) thunder damage and must succeed on a 24 Constitution saving throw or have the stunned condition until the end of its next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Fog of Deception
bonus_actions.desc: The scion conjures a magical cloud that fills a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point it can see within 90 feet of itself. Each creature in that area must make a 24 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has the charmed condition until the end of its next turn. While it has the charmed condition, the creature must use its action to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself of the scion's choice. If no creature is within its reach, the affected creature makes a ranged attack against a creature of the scion's choice, throwing its weapon if necessary. On a successful save, a creature is immune to the scion's Fog of Deception for the next 24 hours.

monsters.name: Scion of Skoraeus
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
