traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The scion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The scion deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The scion makes one Crystal Club attack and two Slam attacks, then uses Entombing Grasp if available. Alternatively, the scion makes two Runic Boulder attacks.

actions.name: Crystal Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +16 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 35 (4d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage. {@hom}The scion can cause the club to flare with bright light, and the target must succeed on a 22 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) radiant damage and have the blinded condition until the start of the scion's next turn.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 31 (4d10 + 9) force damage.

actions.name: Runic Boulder
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +16 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. 27 (4d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage. {@hom}The boulder explodes. The target and each creature within 30 feet of it must make a 22 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 19 (3d12) force damage and has the prone condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

actions.name: Entombing Grasp (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The scion wreathes its hand in petrifying magic and touches one Huge or smaller creature it can see within 20 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 24 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) force damage and have the grappled condition (escape 19). At the start of the scion's next turn, if the target is still grappled, the target has the petrified condition.

bonus_actions.name: Earth-Shaking Movement
bonus_actions.desc: The scion moves up to its speed and then sends a shock wave through the ground in a 60-foot radius circle centered on itself. Each creature on the ground in that area that is {@status concentration||concentrating} must succeed on a 24 Constitution saving throw or lose {@status concentration}.

monsters.name: Scion of Stronmaus
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, fire, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, prone

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The scion doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (6/Day)
traits.desc: If the scion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The scion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The scion deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The scion makes one attack using Lightning Sword or Hailstone, as well as two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Lightning Sword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 36 (4d12 + 10) force damage plus 22 (4d10) lightning damage.

actions.name: Hailstone
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +18 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. 32 (4d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a 26 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 36 (4d12 + 10) force damage.

bonus_actions.name: Vengeful Storm (Recharge 6)
bonus_actions.desc:
The scion conjures a churning storm cloud in a 30-foot-radius, 10-foot-tall cylinder centered on a point within 120 feet of itself. The cloud's area is heavily obscured. The cloud lasts for 1 minute, until the scion dies, or when the scion uses this bonus action again.
When the cloud appears, and as a bonus action on later turns, the scion can move the cloud up to 30 feet and cause one of the following effects in a 30-foot-radius, 120-foot-high cylinder directly below it; the scion can't choose the same effect two rounds in a row:

bonus_actions.name: Acid Rain
bonus_actions.desc: The cloud rains acid. Each creature in the cylinder must succeed on a 25 Constitution saving throw or be covered in acid for 1 minute or until a creature uses its action to remove the acid from itself or another creature. A creature covered in the acid takes 26 (4d12) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

bonus_actions.name: Freezing Storm
bonus_actions.desc: Shards of ice pelt down, and freezing wind fills the area. Each creature in the cylinder must succeed on a 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) cold damage and be hindered by ice formations for 1 minute or until it or another creature within reach of it uses an action to break away the ice. A creature hindered by ice has its speed reduced to 0.

bonus_actions.name: Lightning Bolts
bonus_actions.desc: Bolts of lightning strike down. Each creature in the cylinder must succeed on 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) lightning damage and have the stunned condition until the end of its next turn.

monsters.name: Scion of Surtur
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, lightning, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (6/Day)
traits.desc: If the scion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The scion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The scion deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The scion makes one attack using Lava Blade or Lava Ball, as well as two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Lava Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 32 (4d10 + 10) slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Lava Ball
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +18 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. 29 (3d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a 26 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 28 (4d8 + 10) force damage.

actions.name: Lava Wave (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The scion emits a wave of lava from its blade, hands, or mouth in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 25 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 60 (11d10) fire damage and has the restrained condition from being embedded in hardening rock. A creature can make a 25 Strength (Athletics) check as an action, freeing itself or a creature within reach from the rock on a success. The rock has AC 17 and 40 hit points, and it is immune to fire, poison, and psychic damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Earth-Shaking Movement
bonus_actions.desc: The scion moves up to its speed and then sends a shock wave through the ground in a 60-foot-radius circle centered on itself. Each creature on the ground in that area that is {@status concentration||concentrating} must succeed on a 26 Constitution saving throw or lose {@status concentration}.

bonus_actions.name: Incendiary Smoke
bonus_actions.desc: The scion causes smoke and white-hot embers to billow from its skin, filling a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on itself that moves with it. While the scion's skin billows smoke, ranged attacks against the scion are made with disadvantage. A creature that moves into the smoke for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a 25 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) fire damage. The scion's skin stops billowing smoke after 1 minute, when the scion dies, or when the scion uses this bonus action to stop the smoke.

monsters.name: Scion of Thrym
monsters.damage_resistances: fire, lightning, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (6/Day)
traits.desc: If the scion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The scion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The scion deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The scion makes one Ice Axe and two Slam attacks, or it makes two Glacier Throw attacks.

actions.name: Ice Axe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +17 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 36 (4d12 + 10) force damage plus 18 (4d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 32 (4d10 + 10) force damage.

actions.name: Glacier Throw
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +17 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. 36 (4d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a 25 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Glacial Upheaval (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc:
The scion digs its hands into the ground at a point it can see within 30 feet of itself and launches a magically conjured mass of ice into the air. Each creature other than the scion in a 30-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must make a 25 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (8d8) bludgeoning damage plus 19 (3d12) cold damage and is pushed vertically to the top of the cylinder, at which point the creature falls. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space outside the cylinder with no additional effects.
At the start of the scion's next turn, a mass of ice plummets to the ground on a point the scion can see within 60 feet of the point the scion dug its hands into. Each creature in a 30-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must succeed on a 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) cold damage.

bonus_actions.name: Earth-Shaking Movement
bonus_actions.desc: The scion moves up to its speed and sends a shock wave through the ground in a 60-foot-radius circle centered on itself. Each creature on the ground in that area that is {@status concentration||concentrating} must succeed on a 25 Constitution saving throw or lose {@status concentration}.

monsters.name: Spectral Cloud
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Blurred Form
traits.desc: Attack rolls against the spectral cloud are made with disadvantage unless the attacker is within 15 feet of the spectral cloud or the spectral cloud is incapacitated.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The spectral cloud can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spectral cloud makes two Spectral Touch attacks.

actions.name: Spectral Touch
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 20 (3d8 + 7) force damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 20 Constitution saving throw, or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.
A Humanoid slain by this attack immediately rises as a miniature spectral cloud (use the specter stat block in the Monster Manual). The miniature spectral cloud acts as an ally of its creator but isn't under its control.

actions.name: Chilling Winds (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc:
The spectral cloud emits intensely cold wind in a 60-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 38 (7d10) cold damage and has the incapacitated condition for 1 minute. The affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.
If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, that creature is immune to this spectral cloud's Chilling Winds for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The lion has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the lion's allies is within 5 feet of the target and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage. If the lion moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target must succeed on a 16 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition. If the target has the prone condition, the lion can make another Rend attack against it as a bonus action.

monsters.name: Stalker of Baphomet

traits.name: Labyrinthine Recall
traits.desc: The stalker can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The stalker has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The stalker makes two Glaive attacks or two Rock attacks.

actions.name: Glaive
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 18 (2d10 + 7) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +11 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 19 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition. After the stalker throws the rock, roll a d6; on a roll of 3 or lower, the stalker has no more rocks to throw.

actions.name: Erupting Horns (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc:
The stalker causes the earth to churn at a point on the ground it can see within 60 feet of itself. Six horn-shaped stones erupt in a 30-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinder centered on that point and then crumble to dust.
Each creature in that area must make a 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 33 (6d10) piercing damage and is pushed up to 30 feet upward and then falls. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

spells: The stalker casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 15):

spells.1/day each: meld into stone, stone shape, wall of stone

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two Thundering Stone Club or Boulder attacks in any combination.

actions.name: Thundering Stone Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. The giant can cause the club to emit a burst of thunderous energy that deals 10 (3d6) thunder damage to each creature, other than the giant, within 30 feet of the target. The club can emit a burst this way only once per turn.

actions.name: Boulder
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a 18 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition. After the giant throws the boulder, roll a d6; on a roll of 3 or lower, the giant has no more boulders to throw.

reactions.name: Unyielding
reactions.desc: In response to failing a saving throw to avoid being moved, having the prone condition, or both, the giant succeeds instead.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Stone Rune
traits.desc:
The giant has a stone rune inscribed on a mineral object in its possession. While holding or wearing the object bearing the rune, the giant can use its Prismatic Rays action.
The object bearing the rune has AC 18; 30 hit points; and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The object regains all its hit points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 hit points or when the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe a stone rune on an object in its possession when it finishes a short or long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes three Prism Staff attacks.

actions.name: Prism Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Exploding Geode
actions.desc: The giant throws a geode at a point within 60 feet of itself, and the geode explodes in a dazzling flash. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 13 (3d8) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage and has the blinded condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. After the giant throws the geode, roll a d6; on a roll of 4 or lower, the giant has no more geodes to throw.

actions.name: Prismatic Rays (Requires Stone Rune)
actions.desc: The giant's stone rune emits beams of light that form a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 17 Dexterity saving throw. For each creature in that area, roll a d6 to determine what ray affects it:

actions.name: 1-2: Blazing Red
actions.desc: On a failed save, the creature takes 35 (10d6) radiant damage and has the blinded condition until the end of the giant's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

actions.name: 3-4: Dreadful Blue
actions.desc: On a failed save, the creature takes 35 (10d6) necrotic damage and has the frightened condition until the end of the giant's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

actions.name: 5-6: Sapping Green
actions.desc: On a failed save, the creature takes 35 (10d6) force damage and has the incapacitated condition until the end of the giant's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The crab can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The crab makes two Claw attacks and one Stinger attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape 16). The crab has four claws, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a 17 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned and paralyzed conditions for 1 minute. The affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending both the poisoned and paralyzed conditions on itself on a success.

actions.name: Water Jet (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The crab exhales water in a 150-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage, is pushed up to 30 feet from the crab, and has the prone condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

monsters.name: Storm Giant Tempest Caller

traits.name: Alert
traits.desc: The giant can't be surprised, and it has advantage on initiative rolls.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The giant can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Scrying (Requires Storm Rune)
traits.desc: The giant can use its crystal ball to cast the scrying spell (save 17).

traits.name: Storm Rune
traits.desc:
The giant has a storm rune inscribed on a crystal ball. While the object bearing the rune is embedded in its body, the giant can use its Tempest Call action and its Scrying trait.
The object bearing the storm rune has AC 17; 50 hit points; and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The object regains all its hit points at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 hit points or when the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe a storm rune on another crystal ball in its possession when it finishes a short or long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes three Lightning Blade or Lightning Lance attacks.

actions.name: Lightning Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 22 (3d8 + 9) slashing damage plus 16 (3d10) lightning damage.

actions.name: Lightning Lance
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +13 to hit, range 500 ft., one target. 39 (5d12 + 7) lightning damage.

actions.name: Tempest Call (Requires Storm Rune)
actions.desc: The giant creates an elemental vortex that fills a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature in that area other than the giant must make a 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 43 (8d8 + 7) damage of a type of the giant's choosing: cold, lightning, or thunder. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

spells: The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 21, +13 to hit with spell attacks):

spells.1/day each: control water, control weather (as an action), dispel magic, plane shift, sending, time stop

monsters.name: Storm Herald

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The herald can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The herald has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The herald makes one Claw attack, one Tentacles attack, and one Trident attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 18 (3d6 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape 18). It also has the restrained condition and takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns until this grapple ends. The herald can have only one creature grappled this way at a time.

actions.name: Trident
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 18 (3d6 + 8) piercing damage or 21 (3d8 + 8) piercing damage if used with two hands, plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage.

actions.name: Psychic Wave (Recharge 6)
actions.desc:
The herald unleashes a blast of psionic energy into the minds of up to three creatures it can see within 90 feet of itself. Each target must make a 21 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 23 (3d10 + 7) psychic damage and has the stunned condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
If a creature is reduced to 0 hit points by this psychic damage, it dies and its head explodes if it has one.

spells: The herald casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 21):

spells.At will: detect magic, detect thoughts, mage hand (the hand is invisible)

spells.1/day each: control water, control weather (as an action), sending

monsters.name: Tempest Spirit
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, necrotic, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The spirit takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the spirit fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spirit makes two Lightning Fist or Hailstone attacks in any combination.

actions.name: Lightning Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 25 (4d8 + 7) lightning damage.

actions.name: Hailstone
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +12 to hit, range 90/180 ft., one target. 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Death Bolt (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The spirit hurls a magical lightning bolt in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) lightning damage plus 16 (3d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a success or failure, an affected creature's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The creature dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

bonus_actions.name: Hailstorm (Recharge 4-6)
bonus_actions.desc: The spirit conjures a hailstorm in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point it can see within 120 feet of itself. Each creature in that area must make a 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage and has the prone condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

traits.name: Beast of Burden
traits.desc: The titanothere is considered to be one size larger for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the titanothere moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a 18 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition if it is a creature.

monsters.name: Troll Amalgam
monsters.damage_resistances: poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the amalgam fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The amalgam has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The amalgam regains 15 hit points at the start of its turn. If the amalgam takes acid or fire damage, it regains only 5 hit points at the start of its next turn. The amalgam dies only if it takes 20 or more acid or fire damage while it has 0 hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The amalgam makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 25 (4d8 + 7) slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Fling Limb (3/Day)
bonus_actions.desc:
Ranged Weapon Attack +13 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. 11 (1d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the limb hits a Medium or smaller creature, that creature has the grappled condition (escape 17). The limb has the statistics of a troll amalgam, except for the following: it is Medium, it has 45 hit points, its speed is 30 ft., it doesn't have a challenge rating or Legendary Resistance, and the only action it can take is the Attack action, which it can use only to grapple.
Until this grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition and takes 25 (4d8 + 7) slashing damage at the start of each of its turns. If the limb is not destroyed within 24 hours of being flung, roll a d12; on a roll of 12, the limb regenerates into a troll (see the Monster Manual). Otherwise, the limb withers away.

traits.name: Mutation
traits.desc: When the troll mutate is created, it gains one of four possible body mutations at random: 1, Elastic Body; 2, Psionic Mirror; 3, Spell Scarred; or 4, Winged Form. This mutation determines certain traits in this stat block.

traits.name: Amorphous (Elastic Body Only)
traits.desc: The mutate can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

traits.name: Magic Resistance (Spell Scarred Only)
traits.desc: The mutate has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Psychic Rebuke (Psionic Mirror Only)
traits.desc: If the mutate takes psychic damage, each creature within 20 feet of it takes that damage as well.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The mutate regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the mutate takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the mutate's next turn. The mutate dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate. If the mutate starts its turn with 0 hit points and regenerates, it randomly gains a mutation it doesn't already have (up to a maximum of four mutations).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mutate makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. (or 15 ft. if the mutate has the Elastic Body mutation), one target. 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.

actions.name: Psychic Burst (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The mutate unleashes a wave of psychic energy. Each creature within 30 feet of the mutate must make a 14 Intelligence saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monsters.name: Ambitious Assassin
monsters.languages: Common, thieves' cant, plus any one language

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: If the assassin fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The assassin makes two Poison Blade attacks.

actions.name: Poison Blade
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: When an attacker the assassin can see hits the assassin with an attack, the assassin halves the attack's damage against it.

legendary_actions.name: Cunning
legendary_actions.desc: The assassin escapes nonmagical restraints and ends the grappled condition on itself, then moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Stab (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The assassin makes one Poison Blade attack.

legendary_actions.name: Vanishing Escape (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The assassin creates a sudden distraction, such as a cloud of disorienting smoke or flash of dazzling light, filling a 10-foot cube within 5 feet of the assassin. Each creature of the assassin's choice in that area takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage, and the assassin has the invisible condition. This invisibility lasts until the end of the assassin's next turn.

traits.name: Hunger of the Void
traits.desc: When the aspirant is reduced to 0 hit points, its body and everything it is wearing or carrying, except for magic items, are sucked into a void and destroyed. Creatures in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on the aspirant must make a 11 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and is pulled 10 feet straight toward the aspirant's space. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

traits.name: Sinister Devotion
traits.desc: The aspirant has advantage on saving throws against the charmed and frightened conditions.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

monsters.name: Asteria

traits.name: Guardian Aura
traits.desc: Whenever a creature of Asteria's choice within 30 feet of her makes a saving throw, Asteria can give the creature advantage on the saving throw (no action required). This trait doesn't function if Asteria has the incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Asteria fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Asteria wears Winged Boots, which grant her a flying speed (included in her statistics). She also carries one half of a pair of Sending Stones; the other half of the pair is held by Euryale.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Asteria makes two Radiant Blade attacks and uses Bursting Benediction.

actions.name: Radiant Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Bursting Benediction
actions.desc: Asteria causes a burst of magical energy to envelop one creature she can see within 60 feet of herself. The target must make a 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 40 (9d8) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Asteria or another creature that she can see within 60 feet of herself then regains 10 hit points.

bonus_actions.name: Empowering Aegis (Recharge 4-6)
bonus_actions.desc: Asteria summons a spectral version of her shield, which orbits and bolsters one creature of Asteria's choice that she can see within 60 feet of herself. The spectral shield lasts until the start of Asteria's next turn. While the shield is orbiting the creature, the creature has Cover, is immune to the frightened condition, and makes weapon attack rolls with advantage.

legendary_actions.name: Brazen Strike
legendary_actions.desc: Asteria makes one Radiant Blade attack.

legendary_actions.name: Nimble Sprint
legendary_actions.desc: Asteria moves up to her speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Asteria uses Spellcasting.

spells: Asteria casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 19):

spells.2/day each: Bless, Freedom of Movement, Greater Restoration, Plane Shift (self only), Protection from Evil and Good, Revivify

monsters.name: Aurnozci
monsters.damage_immunities: acid, fire, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Heat Regeneration
traits.desc: If the temperature around it is 100 degrees Fahrenheit or higher, Aurnozci regains 15 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes cold or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. Aurnozci dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Aurnozci fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Aurnozci has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Aurnozci makes one Bite attack and two Tail attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 21 (2d12 + 8) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Mucus Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Aurnozci sprays mucus in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that cone must make a 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: Aurnozci moves up to its speed.

legendary_actions.name: Tail
legendary_actions.desc: Aurnozci makes one Tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Aurnozci uses Spellcasting.

legendary_actions.name: Conflagration (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Flames momentarily surround Aurnozci. Each creature within 15 feet of Aurnozci must make a 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells: Aurnozci casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 20):

spells.2/day each: Darkness, Dispel Magic, Hold Person

monsters.name: Boss Augustus
monsters.speed: 40 ft. in wolf or hybrid form
monsters.languages: Common, Thieves' cant (can't speak in wolf form)

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Augustus regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes damage from a silver weapon, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Augustus dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Augustus wields a +2 Longsword.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Augustus makes any combination of two Bite, Claw, or Magic Longsword attacks.

actions.name: Bite (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 26 (5d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a 15 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with lycanthropy. While cursed in this way, the target retains its alignment, languages, and equipment but otherwise uses the werewolf stat block, excluding actions that require equipment the target doesn't have. During any night when there's a full moon in the sky, the target becomes an NPC under the DM's control and remains so until the night ends. A Remove Curse spell or similar magic ends this curse.

actions.name: Claw (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 21 (5d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 16 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Magic Longsword (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 28 (4d10 + 6) slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: Augustus polymorphs into a wolf-humanoid hybrid, a wolf, or his humanoid form. His statistics, other than his speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. He reverts to his humanoid form if he dies.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.desc: Augustus takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

monsters.name: Boss Delour
monsters.speed: 30 ft. in rat or hybrid form
monsters.languages: Common, Thieves' cant (can't speak in rat form)

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If Delour is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if he fails, provided he doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Nimbleness
traits.desc: Delour can move through the space of a Medium or larger creature.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Delour regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes damage from a silver weapon, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Delour dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Delour makes any combination of three Bite, Shortsword, or Hand Crossbow attacks.

actions.name: Bite (Rat or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 26 (5d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a 14 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with lycanthropy. While cursed in this way, the target retains its alignment, languages, and equipment but otherwise uses the wererat stat block, excluding actions that require equipment the target doesn't have. During any night when there's a full moon in the sky, the target becomes an NPC under the DM's control and remains so until the night ends. A Remove Curse spell or similar magic ends this curse.

actions.name: Shortsword (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: Delour polymorphs into a rat-humanoid hybrid, a Medium giant rat, or his humanoid form. His statistics, other than his size and speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. He reverts to his humanoid form if he dies.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.desc: Delour takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

monsters.name: Breath Drinker
monsters.damage_resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The breath drinker can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Radiant Absorption
traits.desc: When the breath drinker is subjected to radiant damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the radiant damage dealt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The breath drinker makes two Enervating Claw attacks. It can also use Drink Breath.

actions.name: Enervating Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 12 (2d6 + 5) necrotic damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the grappled condition (escape 18). The target must succeed on a 18 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: Drink Breath
actions.desc: The breath drinker targets a creature that has the incapacitated condition or that the breath drinker is grappling and that isn't a Construct or an Undead. The target must make a 18 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 36 (8d8) necrotic damage, and its Charisma score is reduced by 1d6. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. If this reduces the target's Charisma to 0, the target dies. Until the breath drinker dies, the dead target can't be returned to life by any means short of divine intervention. On a successful save, the target takes half as much necrotic damage only. On a successful or failed save, the breath drinker regains a number of hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: The breath drinker has the invisible condition. This invisibility ends immediately after the breath drinker hits or misses with an attack roll or uses Drink Breath.

monsters.name: Brusipha

traits.name: Demonic Ritual
traits.desc: Brusipha can spend 3 hours performing a ritual that summons 1d3 + 1 barlguras or 1 hezrou. She must sacrifice a Medium or larger living creature to Baphomet during this ritual, and the ritual can be performed only at night. The demons vanish at dawn.

traits.name: Labyrinthine Recall
traits.desc: Brusipha can perfectly recall any path she has traveled.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Brusipha makes two Eldritch Blast attacks.

actions.name: Eldritch Blast
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 8 (1d10 + 3) force damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage. If Brusipha moved at least 10 feet straight toward the target immediately before she hit, the target takes an extra 4 (1d8) piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet from Brusipha and have the prone condition.

actions.name: Incite the Hunters (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: Brusipha allows each ally within 30 feet of herself that has the Unerring Tracker trait to make one weapon attack as a reaction against the target of that ally's Unerring Tracker.

bonus_actions.name: Unerring Tracker
bonus_actions.desc: Brusipha magically creates a psychic link with one creature she can see. For the next hour, Brusipha knows the current distance and direction to the target if it is on the same plane of existence. The link ends if Brusipha has the incapacitated condition or uses this ability on a different target.

reactions.name: Baphomet's Blessing
reactions.desc: When Brusipha reduces a hostile creature to 0 hit points, she gains 8 temporary hit points.

spells: Brusipha casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 13):

spells.1/day each: Bestow Curse, Command, Crown of Madness

monsters.name: Deck Defender
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (can't see beyond this radius), passive Perception 10
monsters.languages: understands one of your languages but can't speak

traits.name: Allied Knight
traits.desc: Some of the deck defender's statistics are based on the character who drew the Knight card. Where the deck defender stat block refers to "you," it refers to that character.

traits.name: Folded Versatility
traits.desc: After finishing a long rest, you can refold the deck defender's shape, changing it to acrobat form, berserker form, or guardian form.

traits.name: Fragile
traits.desc: If the deck defender is reduced to 0 hit points, it collapses into a haphazard pile of nonmagical playing cards and can't be resurrected or reconstructed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The deck defender makes a number of attacks equal to half its proficiency bonus (rounded down).

actions.name: Paper Cut
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack PB + +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Reckless Strike (Berserker Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack PB + +3 to hit (with advantage), reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage, and attacks made against the deck defender until the start of its next turn have advantage.

bonus_actions.name: Swift Step (Acrobat Form Only)
bonus_actions.desc: The deck defender takes the Dash or Disengage action.

reactions.name: Protection (Guardian Form Only)
reactions.desc: When a creature the deck defender can see attacks a target other than the deck defender and is within 5 feet of the deck defender, the deck defender imposes disadvantage on the attack roll.

monsters.name: Enchanting Infiltrator
monsters.languages: Common, thieves' cant, plus any one language

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the infiltrator fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Veiled Presence
traits.desc: The infiltrator's AC includes its Wisdom modifier, and the infiltrator can't be targeted by divination magic or features that would read its mind or determine its creature type.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The infiltrator makes two Poison Blade attacks and can use Beguiling Whisper.

actions.name: Poison Blade
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) poison damage.

actions.name: Beguiling Whisper
actions.desc: The infiltrator magically whispers to a creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 17 Wisdom saving throw or have the stunned condition due to fear or delight (the infiltrator's choice) until the end of the target's next turn, after which the target is immune to this Beguiling Whisper for 24 hours.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: When an attacker the infiltrator can see hits the infiltrator with an attack, the infiltrator halves the attack's damage against it.

legendary_actions.name: Cunning
legendary_actions.desc: The infiltrator escapes nonmagical restraints and ends the grappled condition on itself, then moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Stab (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The infiltrator makes one Poison Blade attack.

legendary_actions.name: Misdirecting Escape (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The infiltrator magically has the invisible condition and creates an illusory duplicate of itself in its space, then teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space within 15 feet of itself. The image flings illusory blades at two creatures of the infiltrator's choice within 20 feet of the image. Each target must make a 17 Wisdom saving throw, taking 13 (3d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The invisibility lasts until the end of the infiltrator's next turn.

monsters.name: Euryale
monsters.speed: 30 ft., 50 ft. in serpent form, climb 0 ft., climb 50 ft. in serpent form
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Euryale fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Euryale carries one half of a pair of Sending Stones; the other half of the pair is held by Asteria.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Euryale makes three attacks. If she is in serpent form, only one of these attacks can be Constrict.

actions.name: Constrict (Serpent Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target has the grappled condition (escape 19). Until this grapple ends, the target takes 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns, and Euryale can't constrict another target.

actions.name: Snake Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a 18 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition until the start of Euryale's next turn.

actions.name: Verdant Bolt (Medusa Form Only)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 18 (4d8) acid damage.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: Euryale changes shape into her Huge serpent form or back into her Medium medusa form. Euryale's game statistics are the same in each form except where noted in this stat block. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. Euryale reverts to her medusa form if she dies.

bonus_actions.name: Petrifying Gaze (Recharge 4-6)
bonus_actions.desc: Euryale unleashes petrifying magic from her eyes in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 18 Constitution saving throw if it doesn't have the blinded condition. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature has the petrified condition. Otherwise, on a failed save, the creature takes 14 (4d6) force damage, begins to turn to stone, and has the restrained condition. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a failed save, it has the petrified condition, and on a successful save, the effect ends on it, The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the Greater Restoration spell or other magic A creature can use its reaction, if available, to shut its eyes to avoid the saving throw. If the creature does so, it has the blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: Euryale moves up to her speed.

legendary_actions.name: Venomous Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Euryale makes one Snake Bite attack. If the target has the poisoned condition, the attack deals an extra 16 (3d10) poison damage.

spells: Euryale casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 19):

spells.2/day each: Goodberry, Lesser Restoration, Locate Creature, Move Earth, Transport via Plants

monsters.name: Fate Hag

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: If the hag fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Trace the Threads (1/Day)
traits.desc: The hag can cast the Legend Lore spell, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hag makes two Shears attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Shears
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) force damage. If the target is a creature, it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of the hag's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Destined Jaunt
legendary_actions.desc: The hag magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of itself.

legendary_actions.name: Tangle Threads
legendary_actions.desc: The hag magically tangles a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself in spectral silver threads. The creature must succeed on a 14 Strength saving throw, or its speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Destiny Curse (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The hag magically curses a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The creature must make a 14 Wisdom saving throw, and the creature has disadvantage on this save if it has damaged the hag within the last minute. On a failed save, the creature has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the curse ends. Once per turn, when the cursed creature fails one of those d20 rolls, it takes 7 (2d6) force damage. The curse ends after 1 minute; when the creature succeeds on a total of three ability checks, attack rolls, or saving throws in any combination; or when the hag uses this action again.

spells: While holding its shears, the hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 14):

spells.1/day each: Bane, Bestow Curse, Divination, Scrying (as an action)

monsters.name: Gremorly's Ghost
monsters.damage_resistances: acid, fire, lightning, thunder, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.desc: Gremorly can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when he is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: Gremorly can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. He takes 5 (1d10) force damage if he ends his turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Gremorly fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Gremorly makes three Withering Strike attacks.

actions.name: Withering Strike
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 19 (3d12) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Fell Necromancy
actions.desc: Gremorly targets one creature he can see within 60 feet of himself. The target must make a 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 61 (7d8 + 30) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, Gremorly regains 9 (2d8) hit points.

actions.name: Possession (Recharge 6)
actions.desc:
One Humanoid Gremorly can see within 5 feet of himself must succeed on a 15 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by him; Gremorly disappears, and the target has the incapacitated condition and loses control of its body. Gremorly can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn Undead, and he retains his alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to the charmed and frightened conditions. He otherwise uses the target's game statistics, but Gremorly doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.
The possession lasts until the target drops to 0 hit points, Gremorly ends it as a bonus action, or Gremorly is turned or forced out by an effect like the Dispel Evil and Good spell. When the possession ends, Gremorly reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target. The target is immune to this Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

bonus_actions.name: Ethereal Step (Recharge 4-6)
bonus_actions.desc: Gremorly teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

spells: Gremorly casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 16):

spells.2/day each: Bestow Curse, Dispel Magic

monsters.name: Grim Champion of Bloodshed
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, stunned, unconscious

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the champion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The champion makes four Blazing Morningstar attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with Blade Storm, if available.

actions.name: Blazing Morningstar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Blade Storm (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The champion conjures a churning storm of spectral blades that fills a 20-foot cube centered on a point it can see within 120 feet of itself. The storm lasts until the start of the champion's next turn. While the storm is active, the area of the storm is difficult terrain. Whenever a creature enters the storm for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) slashing damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Furious Pursuit
legendary_actions.desc: The champion moves up to its speed or commands its mount to move up to its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Induce Violence
legendary_actions.desc: The champion targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 19 Wisdom saving throw or immediately make one melee weapon attack against another creature of the champion's choice that is within the target's reach. If no creature is within the target's reach or if the target has the incapacitated condition, the target instead takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

legendary_actions.name: Menace (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The champion chooses any number of creatures it can see within 30 feet of itself. Each target must succeed on a 19 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

monsters.name: Grim Champion of Desolation
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, stunned, unconscious

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the champion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The champion makes two Leeching Blade attacks and uses Hollow Void.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 33 (6d10) cold damage, and the champion regains 10 hit points.

actions.name: Hollow Void
actions.desc: The champion summons a hungering rift around a creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The creature must make a 22 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 49 (11d8) force damage and has the stunned condition until the start of the champion's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. If a creature is reduced to 0 hit points by this effect, the creature dies, and its body crumbles to dust.

bonus_actions.name: Step into Nothing (Recharge 4-6)
bonus_actions.desc: The champion, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, has the invisible condition and teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of itself. The champion remains invisible until the start of its next turn or immediately after it deals damage.

legendary_actions.name: Crush
legendary_actions.desc: The champion unleashes a burst of crushing force on a creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. The creature must succeed on a 22 Strength saving throw or take 14 (4d6) force damage and have the prone condition.

legendary_actions.name: Fearsome Pursuit
legendary_actions.desc: The champion moves up to its speed or commands its mount to move up to its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Nullify (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The champion emits a magic wave in a 60-foot cone. Every spell of 5th level or lower ends on creatures and objects of the champion's choice in that area.

monsters.name: Grim Champion of Pestilence
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, stunned, unconscious

traits.name: Halo of Pestilence
traits.desc: The champion is surrounded by an aura of deadly magic that takes the form of a host of glowing white insects. Each creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the champion must succeed on a 18 Constitution saving throw or have the incapacitated condition until the start of its next turn, as the insects ravage its body.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the champion fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The champion makes two Blight Staff attacks, two Plague Bolt attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: Blight Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Plague Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 23 (4d8 + 5) poison damage, and the target has the poisoned condition until the start of the champion's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: The champion makes one Blight Staff or Plague Bolt attack.

legendary_actions.name: Furious Pursuit
legendary_actions.desc: The champion moves up to its speed or commands its mount to move up to its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The champion uses Spellcasting.

spells: The champion casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 18):

spells.2/day each: Blight, Blindness/Deafness

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Plane Shift (2/Day)
actions.desc: The hawk casts Plane Shift on itself, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

bonus_actions.name: Shadow Dash
bonus_actions.desc: When the hawk is in dim light or darkness, it teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see that is also in dim light or darkness. The hawk then has advantage on the first melee attack it makes before the end of the turn.

monsters.name: Harrow Hound
monsters.damage_resistances: necrotic, psychic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.languages: Blink Dog, understands Sylvan but can't speak it

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The hound has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the hound's allies is within 5 feet of the target and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Supernatural Tracker
traits.desc: The hound knows the distance to and direction of any creature that has come within 30 feet of it, even if that creature is on a different plane of existence. If the creature being tracked by the hound dies, the hound knows.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 13 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

bonus_actions.name: Shadow Step (Recharge 4-6)
bonus_actions.desc: The hound magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

monsters.name: Hierophant Medusa
monsters.languages: Common plus any three languages (Abyssal, Celestial, Druidic, or Infernal recommended)

traits.name: Devotion's Call (1/Day)
traits.desc: The medusa can cast the Resurrection spell, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.desc: If the medusa fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The medusa makes one Constrict attack, one Final Blade attack, and one Snake Hair attack. Alternatively, it makes two Wrathful Strike attacks.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape 20). Until this grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the medusa can't constrict another creature.

actions.name: Final Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) force damage. If the target has at least one head and the medusa rolled a 20 on the attack roll, the target is decapitated and dies if it fails a 20 Constitution saving throw and can't survive without that head. A target is immune to this effect if it takes none of the damage, has legendary actions, or is Huge or larger. Such a creature takes an extra 28 (8d6) force damage from the hit.

actions.name: Snake Hair
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (1d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.

actions.name: Wrathful Strike
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. 22 (3d10 + 6) radiant damage, and the target has the blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Petrifying Gaze (Recharge 4-6)
bonus_actions.desc:
The medusa unleashes petrifying magic from its eyes in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 18 Constitution saving throw if it doesn't have the blinded condition. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature has the petrified condition. Otherwise, on a failed save, the creature takes 10 (3d6) force damage, begins to turn to stone, and has the restrained condition. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a failed save, it has the petrified condition, and on a successful save, the effect ends on it. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the Greater Restoration spell or other magic.
A creature can use its reaction, if available, to shut its eyes to avoid the saving throw. If the creature does so, it has the blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: The medusa moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Wrathful Blast (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The medusa makes one Wrathful Strike attack.

legendary_actions.name: Final Slash (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The medusa makes one Final Blade attack with advantage.

spells: The medusa casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 20):

spells.2/day each: Mass Cure Wounds (cast at 8th level)

monsters.name: Hierophant of the Comet
monsters.languages: Common plus any two languages, telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Comet's Voice (1/Day)
traits.desc: The hierophant can cast Contact Other Plane, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The hierophant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Thought Shield
traits.desc: The hierophant's thoughts can't be read by any means unless the hierophant allows it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hierophant makes two Herald's Axe attacks or three Comet Blast attacks.

actions.name: Herald's Axe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (1d12 + 5) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Comet Blast
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +9 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 16 (2d10 + 5) force damage.

actions.name: All-Consuming Star (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The hierophant conjures a manifestation of the All-Consuming Star: brilliant light and haunting screams that fill a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the hierophant can see within 60 feet of itself. Each creature within the sphere has the blinded and deafened conditions. Each creature that enters the sphere for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage and has the incapacitated condition until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. The manifestation persists until the hierophant dies, has the incapacitated condition, uses a bonus action to end the effect, or uses this action again.

bonus_actions.name: Star's Hunger
bonus_actions.desc: The hierophant targets one creature within 30 feet of the center of its All-Consuming Star. The target must succeed on a 17 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 30 feet toward the center of the All-Consuming Star.

spells: The hierophant casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 17):

monsters.name: Hulgaz
monsters.damage_resistances: acid, cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Hulgaz fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Hulgaz has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Intoxicating Sting
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a 17 Wisdom saving throw or have the charmed condition until the start of Hulgaz's next turn.

actions.name: Brimstone Vapor (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Hulgaz exhales a 30-foot cone of noxious, scorching-hot vapor. Each creature in that area must succeed on a 17 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, a creature takes 31 (7d8) fire damage at the start of each of its turns and has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws. A target can repeat the Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Hulgaz makes one Claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: Charm
legendary_actions.desc: Hulgaz uses Spellcasting to cast Charm Person.

legendary_actions.name: Curdle Heart (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Hulgaz sours the good feelings of her charmed victims. She chooses any number of creatures she can see who are charmed by her. Each target takes 17 (5d6) psychic damage as the charmed condition applied by Hulgaz ends on it.

spells: Hulgaz casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 18):

spells.2/day each: Dispel Magic, Fog Cloud

monsters.name: Initiate of the Comet

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The initiate has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The initiate makes two Comet Strike attacks.

actions.name: Comet Strike
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 14 (2d10 + 3) force damage.

reactions.name: Moment of Foresight (1/Day)
reactions.desc: When hit by an attack roll, the initiate can force the attacker to reroll it and use the new roll, possibly causing the attack to miss.

spells: The initiate casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 13):

monsters.name: Living Portent

traits.name: Brilliance (True Form Only)
traits.desc: The living portent sheds bright light for 30 feet and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The living portent makes two Radiant Strike attacks.

actions.name: Radiant Strike
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 9 (1d12 + 3) radiant damage.

actions.name: Prophetic Blessing
actions.desc: The living portent magically infuses the power of its prophecy into another willing creature the living portent can see within 30 feet of itself. The target's hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 7 (1d8 + 3), and it gains a prophecy die, a d8. Once during each of the creature's turns, when it fails an ability check or saving throw or misses an attack roll, it can roll the prophecy die and add the number rolled to the total, potentially changing the outcome. The blessing ends after 1 hour or when the living portent ends the blessing (no action required) or uses this action again.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: The living portent magically transforms into a Humanoid while retaining its game statistics (other than its size and Brilliance trait). The transformation ends if the living portent is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

reactions.name: Price of Defiance
reactions.desc: When the living portent is damaged by a creature that it can see within 120 feet of itself, radiant power sears the creature. The creature must make a 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells: The living portent casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability:

spells.2/day each: Cure Wounds

monsters.name: Malaxxix
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

actions.name: Whip
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 30 ft., one creature. 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage, and the target has the restrained condition for 1 minute. The restrained target can make a 20 Strength saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Only one creature can be restrained by the whip at a time.

actions.name: Mezzoloth Vortex (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Malaxxix summons a vortex of whirling mezzoloths at a point it can see within 90 feet of itself. The vortex is a 30-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on that point. Each creature other than Malaxxix in that area must make a 20 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 35 (10d6) force damage and has the restrained condition while within the cylinder. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space outside the cylinder. The vortex lasts until the start of Malaxxix's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Fiendish Stride
legendary_actions.desc: Malaxxix moves up to its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. When Malaxxix moves within 5 feet of a creature during this movement, that creature takes 5 (1d10) lightning damage. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

legendary_actions.name: Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Malaxxix makes one Forge Hammer or Whip attack.

traits.name: Labyrinthine Recall
traits.desc: The minotaur can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.

If the minotaur moved at least 10 feet straight toward the target immediately before it hit, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) piercing damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 11 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet from the minotaur and have the prone condition.

traits.name: Labyrinthine Recall
traits.desc: The minotaur can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.
