If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet from the minotaur and have the prone condition.

actions.name: Mattock
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 10 (1d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage, or 17 (2d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage while enlarged. If the target is a creature and the minotaur is enlarged, the target must succeed on a 14 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Enlarge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: For 1 minute, the minotaur magically increases in size, along with anything it is wearing or carrying. While enlarged, the minotaur is Large, doubles its damage dice on Strength-based weapon attacks (included in the attacks), and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If the minotaur lacks the room to become Large, the minotaur doesn't change size.

bonus_actions.name: Unerring Tracker
bonus_actions.desc: The minotaur magically creates a psychic link with one creature it can see. For the next hour, the minotaur knows the current distance and direction to the target if it is on the same plane of existence. The link ends if the minotaur has the incapacitated condition or uses this ability on a different target.

monsters.name: Oddlewin

traits.name: Fortune Teller
traits.desc: Oddlewin can cast the Augury spell as a ritual, using cards as the material component.

traits.name: Nilbogism
traits.desc:
Any creature that attempts to damage Oddlewin must first succeed on a 12 Charisma saving throw or have the charmed condition until the end of the creature's next turn. The creature must use its action praising Oddlewin.
Oddlewin can't regain hit points, including through magical healing, except through his Reversal of Fortune reaction.

actions.name: Fool's Scepter
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Cloud of Cards
actions.desc: Oddlewin conjures magical cards that slash at the air in a 5-foot cube within 60 feet of Oddlewin until the start of Oddlewin's next turn. A creature that starts its turn in the cube or that enters that area for the first time on a turn takes 10 (4d4) slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.desc: Oddlewin takes the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Reversal of Fortune
reactions.desc: In response to another creature dealing damage to Oddlewin, Oddlewin reduces the damage to 0 and regains 9 (2d8) hit points.

spells: Oddlewin casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 12):

traits.name: Alien Mind
traits.desc: Magic and other features can't determine the corrupter's creature type. If a creature tries to read the corrupter's thoughts, that creature must succeed on a 20 Intelligence saving throw or have the stunned condition for 1 minute. The stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the corrupter fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The corrupter can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The corrupter makes three Whispering Blade attacks and can use Debilitating Touch.

actions.name: Whispering Blade
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) psychic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 20 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to speak until the start of the corrupter's next turn.

actions.name: Debilitating Touch
actions.desc: The corrupter's squirming tentacle lashes out at a creature the corrupter can see within 30 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 20 Constitution saving throw or have the paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn, after which the target is immune to this Debilitating Touch for 24 hours.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: The corrupter magically transforms into any creature that is Small or Medium, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size). This transformation ends if the corrupter is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: When an attacker the corrupter can see hits the corrupter with an attack, the corrupter halves the attack's damage against it.

legendary_actions.name: Cunning
legendary_actions.desc: The corrupter escapes nonmagical restraints and ends the grappled and restrained conditions on itself, then moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Stab (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The corrupter makes one Whispering Blade attack.

legendary_actions.name: Amorphous Escape (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The corrupter dissolves into a shifting mass of flesh, tentacles, eyes, claws, and mouths. Up to two creatures the corrupter can see within 20 feet of itself must make a 20 Intelligence saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This transformation lasts until the end of the corrupter's next turn. While transformed, the corrupter has advantage on attack rolls, attack rolls made against it have disadvantage, and it can move through spaces at least 1 inch wide without squeezing.

monsters.name: Pazrodine

traits.name: Guardian of the Market

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) radiant damage.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.desc: Pazrodine uses one of the following breath weapons:

actions.name: Moonlight Breath
actions.desc: Pazrodine exhales a beam of moonlight in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 60 (11d10) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells.2/day each: Calm Emotions, Dispel Magic, Invisibility

monsters.name: Reaper Spirit

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes 1d10 force damage for every 5 feet shunted.

bonus_actions.name: Haunt Creature

While the target is haunted, you and the spirit sense the direction and distance to the target if it is on the same plane of existence as you. Additionally, if the target starts its turn within 10 feet of the spirit, the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the frightened condition until the start of the target's next turn. The target remains haunted until it dies, the spirit disappears, or the spirit uses this action again.

traits.name: Card Sense
traits.desc: The riffler can smell the presence of magical cards, including Decks of Many Things and other magical decks, within 1 mile of itself. It knows the direction to any such cards in that range. Effects that protect a target from divination magic block this sense.

traits.name: Riffling Step
traits.desc: The riffler can burrow through any nonmagical material that isn't iron, shuffling the substance through which the riffler moves aside like cards to form a tunnel that closes behind the riffler.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The riffler makes two Spectral Card attacks.

actions.name: Spectral Card
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 8 (1d10 + 3) force damage plus 5 (1d10) damage that is radiant if the d10 roll is an even number and necrotic if it's odd.

actions.name: Card Spray (Recharge 5-6)

traits.name: Ruinous Acid

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Sense

traits.name: Web Walker

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spider makes two Ruinous Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Web.

In addition, if the target is a creature wearing nonmagical armor, the armor takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an Armor Class of 10 is destroyed.

actions.name: Web (Recharge 5-6)

As an action, a restrained target can make a 13 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a successful check. The webbing can also be destroyed (AC 10; 5 hit points; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to acid, bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

actions.name: Multiattack

monsters.name: Solar Bastion Knight

On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (4d10) radiant damage and has the blinded condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. If the item is a potion or scroll, it becomes nonmagical instead.

actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 10 (1d6 + 7) piercing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 22 Charisma saving throw, or on its next turn, it can either move or take an action, but not both.

actions.name: Revelation
actions.desc: The veiled presence reveals a glimpse of its otherworldly nature to a creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 22 Wisdom saving throw or have the paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn, after which the target is immune to this Revelation for 24 hours.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: When an attacker the veiled presence can see hits the veiled presence with an attack, the veiled presence halves the attack's damage against it.

legendary_actions.name: Flash Step
legendary_actions.desc: The veiled presence magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space that it can see.

legendary_actions.name: Stab (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The veiled presence makes one Blade of Judgment attack.

legendary_actions.name: Searing Radiance (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The veiled presence magically emanates dazzling light in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on itself until the end of its next turn, during which time attack rolls against it have disadvantage and it has advantage on attack rolls. The sphere moves with the veiled presence. When another creature starts its turn in the light or enters the light for the first time on its turn, that creature must make a 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monsters.name: Werevulture
monsters.speed: 30 ft., 10 ft. in vulture form, 30 ft. in hybrid form, fly 0 ft., fly 60 ft. in vulture or hybrid form

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The werevulture regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the werevulture takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the werevulture's next turn. The werevulture dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The werevulture makes two Talon attacks, or it makes a Beak attack and a Talon attack.

actions.name: Beak (Vulture or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a 13 Constitution saving throw or be cursed until targeted by the Remove Curse spell or a similar effect. If the cursed target drops to 0 hit points, it becomes a werevulture under the DM's control and regains 10 hit points.

actions.name: Talon
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (4d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: The werevulture polymorphs into a vulture-humanoid hybrid, into a vulture, or back into its humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.

monsters.name: Animated Broom
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone
monsters.senses: blindsight 120 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 7

traits.name: False Object
traits.desc: If the broom is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the broom move or act, that creature must succeed on a 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to discern that the broom is animate.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The broom doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The broom makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Broomstick
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Animated Chained Library
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone
monsters.senses: blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 7

traits.name: False Object
traits.desc: If the library is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the library move or act, that creature must succeed on a 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to discern that the library is animate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The library makes two attacks.

actions.name: Chained Book
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape 12).

monsters.name: Arrant Quill

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Quill makes two attacks with his dagger and uses Supreme Mockery.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Quill's Fable (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Quill utters a short fable while targeting up to five creatures within 30 feet of him that he can see. Each target that can hear Quill's magical fable must make a 17 Wisdom saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Supreme Mockery
actions.desc: Quill hurls a string of insults laced with enchantments at a creature he can see within 60 feet of him. If the creature can hear Quill (though it need not understand him), it must succeed on a 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 66 (12d10) psychic damage and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

spells: Quill casts one of the following spells using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (save 17):

spells.3/day each: detect magic, dispel magic, faerie fire, hold monster

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: If Bak Mei fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Bak Mei carries a staff of striking with 10 charges.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.desc: While Bak Mei is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, his AC includes his Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Bak Mei attacks three times: twice with Thunder Strike and once with his staff of striking.

actions.name: Thunder Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 15 (2d10 + 4) thunder damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 17 Constitution saving throw or be deafened and stunned until the start of Bak Mei's next turn.

actions.name: Staff of Striking
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands, and Bak Mei can expend up to 3 of the staff's charges. For each expended charge, the target takes an extra 1d6 force damage.

actions.name: Heal Self (Recharges after a Long Rest)
actions.desc: Bak Mei regains 2d8 + 4 hit points, and all levels of exhaustion end on him.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.desc: Bak Mei takes the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Deflect Missile
reactions.desc: In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, Bak Mei deflects the missile. The damage he takes from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + 12. If the damage is reduced to 0, Bak Mei catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and Bak Mei has a hand free.

legendary_actions.name: Crane Dance
legendary_actions.desc: Bak Mei moves up to 20 feet. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Thunder Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Bak Mei uses Thunder Strike.

monsters.name: Canopic Golem
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Limited Spell Immunity
traits.desc: The golem automatically succeeds on saving throws against spells of 7th level or lower, and the attack rolls of such spells always miss it.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem makes two attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 27 (4d10 + 5) force damage.

actions.name: Crystal Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) force damage.

reactions.name: Spell Deflection
reactions.desc: In response to a spell attack missing the golem, it causes that spell to hit another creature within 120 feet of it that it can see.

monsters.name: Chwinga

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The chwinga doesn't require air, food, or drink. When it dies, it turns into a handful of flower petals, a cloud of pollen, a stone statuette resembling its former self, a tiny sphere of smooth stone, or a puddle of fresh water (your choice).

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: When the chwinga is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

actions.name: Magical Gift (1/Day)
actions.desc: The chwinga targets a humanoid it can see within 5 feet of it. The target gains a {@filter supernatural charm|rewards|type=charm} of the DM's choice. See {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Other Rewards} of the Dungeon Masters Guide for more information on supernatural charms.

actions.name: Natural Shelter
actions.desc: The chwinga magically takes shelter inside a rock, a living plant, or a natural source of fresh water in its space. The chwinga can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect while inside this shelter, and the shelter doesn't impair the chwinga's blindsight. The chwinga can use its action to emerge from a shelter. If its shelter is destroyed, the chwinga is forced out and appears in the shelter's space, but is otherwise unharmed.

spells: The chwinga's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material or verbal components:

spells.At will: druidcraft, guidance, pass without trace, resistance

monsters.name: Cloud Giant Ghost
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.desc: The ghost can see 120 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The ghost regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the ghost takes radiant damage or damage from a magic weapon, this trait doesn't function at the start of the ghost's next turn. The ghost dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ghost makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Spectral Weapon
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 21 (3d8 + 8) force damage.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.desc: The ghost enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

actions.name: Wind Howl (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The ghost emits a dreadful howl that summons a cold, biting wind. This wind engulfs up to three creatures of the ghost's choice that it can see within 60 feet of it. Each target is pulled up to 20 feet toward the ghost and must make a 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells: The ghost casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability and requiring no material components:

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The commoner doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep, and it gains no benefit from finishing a short or long rest. When it drops to 0 hit points, it becomes a lifeless object.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The avatar makes two attacks: one with its hooves and one with its horn.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 32 (8d6 + 4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Horn
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 32 (8d6 + 4) necrotic damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a 13 Wisdom saving throw or be transformed into a wolf under the avatar's control. This transformation lasts for 1 hour, or until the target drops to 0 hit points or dies. The target's game statistics are replaced by the wolf's statistics, but it retains its hit points. The target is limited in the actions it can perform by the nature of its wolf form, and it can't speak, cast spells, or take any other action that requires hands or speech. The target's gear melds into the new form, and it can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Faerl has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Faerl adds 2 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, he must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monsters.name: Fungal Servant
monsters.damage_immunities: necrotic, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The fungal servant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: A destroyed fungal servant gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the fungal servant's heart.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fungal servant can use its Dreadful Glare and makes one attack with its rotting fist.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 16 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to spores. The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or other magic.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.desc: The fungal servant targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can see the fungal servant, it must succeed on a 16 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened until the end of the fungal servant's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all fungal servants for the next 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: The fungal servant makes one attack with its rotting fist or uses its Dreadful Glare.

legendary_actions.name: Blinding Spores
legendary_actions.desc: Blinding spores swirls magically around the fungal servant. Each creature within 5 feet of the fungal servant must succeed on a 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the creature's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Blasphemous Word (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The fungal servant utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of the fungal servant that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the fungal servant's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Channel Negative Energy (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The fungal servant magically unleashes negative energy. Creatures within 60 feet of the fungal servant, including ones behind barriers and around corners, can't regain hit points until the end of the fungal servant's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Whirlwind of Spores (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The fungal servant magically transforms into a whirlwind of spores, moves up to 60 feet, and reverts to its normal form. While in whirlwind form, the fungal servant is immune to all damage, and it can't be grappled, petrified, knocked prone, restrained, or stunned. Equipment worn or carried by the fungal servant remain in its possession.

spells: The fungal servant is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The fungal servant has the following cleric spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): sacred flame, thaumaturgy

spells.1st level (4 slots): command, guiding bolt, shield of faith

monsters.name: Gingwatzim
monsters.speed: 30 ft., fly 30 ft. (hover) in its true form only
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 10

traits.name: Alternate Forms
traits.desc: The gingwatzim has two alternate forms, both of which are chosen by its creator when the gingwatzim comes into being. One form is an exact duplicate of a Tiny nonmagical object (such as a book, dagger, or gemstone) that its creator is carrying or wearing when the gingwatzim is conjured. The other form can be any Tiny beast. Once these alternate forms are chosen, they can't be changed.

actions.name: Energy Drain (True Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 16 (4d6 + 2) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a 12 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of exhaustion. When the target finishes a short or long rest, the target loses every level of exhaustion gained from this attack.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: The gingwatzim changes from its true form—a 3-foot-diameter sphere of luminous ectoplasm—into one of its two alternate forms, or from one of those forms back into its true form. In object form, it can't move or make attacks but otherwise retains its statistics, and it is indistinguishable from the thing it is imitating. In beast form, it retains its hit points but otherwise uses the stat block of the beast it is imitating. When it dies, the gingwatzim reverts to its true form and then vanishes.

monsters.name: Grippli Warrior
monsters.languages: Grippli plus one other language (usually Common, Draconic, or Primordial)

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: The grippli can hold its breath for 20 minutes.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.desc: The grippli can leap 30 feet horizontally or 20 feet vertically from a standing position.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The grippli makes one attack with its tongue. If this attack hits, the grippli can make a melee attack using its trident against the same target.

actions.name: Tongue
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. The target is grappled (escape 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the grippli can't grab another creature.

actions.name: Trident
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 2 (1d4) piercing damage if the grippli had advantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, plus 2 (1d4) piercing damage if the grippli had advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.desc: While the monk is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The monk makes two attacks.

actions.name: Force Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) force damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 14 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.desc: While Jade Tigress is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, her AC includes her Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Jade Tigress makes three attacks.

actions.name: Force Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) force damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of Jade Tigress's next turn.

actions.name: Poisoned Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a 15 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of exhaustion.

actions.name: Heal Self (Recharges after a Long Rest)
actions.desc: Jade Tigress regains 2d8 + 2 hit points, and all levels of exhaustion end on her.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.desc: Jade Tigress takes the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Deflect Missile
reactions.desc: In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, Jade Tigress deflects the missile. The damage she takes from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + 9. If the damage is reduced to 0, Jade Tigress catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and Jade Tigress has a hand free.

monsters.name: K'Tulah

traits.name: Feline Agility
traits.desc: When K'Tulah moves on her turn in combat, she can double her speed until the end of the turn. Once she uses this ability, K'Tulah can't use it again until she moves 0 feet on one of her turns.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +2 to hit (+4 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 2 (1d4) slashing damage.

spells: K'Tulah is a 4th-level spellcaster. K'Tulah's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). K'Tulah has the following druid spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): druidcraft, produce flame, shillelagh

spells.1st level (4 slots): entangle, longstrider, speak with animals, thunderwave

monsters.name: Kiddywidget
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, deafened, exhaustion, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The kiddywidget doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kiddywidget makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled by the kiddywidget (escape 8).

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) lightning damage.

monsters.name: Lichen Lich
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed lich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The lich makes four attacks.

actions.name: Poisonous Touch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. 17 (5d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a 19 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Wither
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +9 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Fire Storm (7th-Level Spell; 1/Day)
actions.desc: The lich fills up to ten 10-foot cubes with fire. Every cube must be within 150 feet of the lich and occupy a space the lich can see, and each cube must have at least one face adjacent to the face of another cube. Each creature in the area must make a 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 38 (7d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried. If the lich chooses, plant life in the area is unaffected by the spell.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: The lich makes an attack.

legendary_actions.name: Poison Prick (Cost 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The lich targets one poisoned creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a 19 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious until the poisoned condition ends on it.

legendary_actions.name: Sap Life (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The lich targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a 19 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. The lich regains a number of hit points equal to the amount of damage that the creature takes.

spells: The lich casts one of the following spells using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (save 19):

spells.3/day each: detect magic, fog cloud, pass without trace

spells.1/day each: antilife shell, dispel magic, speak with plants, transport via plants

monsters.name: Lightning Golem
monsters.damage_immunities: lightning, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
monsters.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Berserk
traits.desc:
Whenever the golem starts its turn with 40 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points.
The golem's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The golem must be able to hear its creator, who must take an action to make a 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check. If the check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk. If it takes damage while still at 40 hit points or fewer, the golem might go berserk again.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.desc: Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) lightning damage.

monsters.name: Master Sage

actions.name: Shocking Grasp (Cantrip)
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +8 to hit (with advantage if the target is wearing armor made of metal), reach 5 ft., one creature. 13 (3d8) lightning damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Lightning Eruption (3/Day)
actions.desc: The sage creates an eruption of magical lightning centered on a point it can see within 150 feet of it. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Shield (1st-Level Spell; 3/Day)
reactions.desc: When the sage is hit by an attack or targeted by a magic missile spell, it calls forth an invisible barrier of magical force that protects it. Until the start of its next turn, the sage has a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and it takes no damage from magic missile.

spells: The sage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (save 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks):

spells.3/day each: comprehend languages, detect magic, dispel magic, identify, levitate, locate object, Tenser's Floating Disk, unseen servant

spells.1/day each: banishment, contact other plane, Drawmij's instant summons, legend lore, locate creature, planar binding, polymorph, protection from evil and good, scrying, sending, true seeing

monsters.name: Miirym
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft.; see also "x-ray vision" below, passive Perception 26

traits.name: Bound to Candlekeep
traits.desc: Miirym can't leave Candlekeep and is immune to any effect that would place her in a location outside it, including an extradimensional space. If she dies, Miirym regains her form and all her hit points after 1d10 days, reappearing in the location where she died or in the nearest unoccupied space.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Miirym regains 40 hit points at the start of her turn. If Miirym takes damage from a magic weapon or a spell, this trait doesn't function at the start of Miirym's next turn. Miirym dies only if she starts her turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: Miirym can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. She takes 5 (1d10) force damage if she ends her turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Miirym fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: X-Ray Vision
traits.desc: Miirym can see through solid matter out to a range of 60 feet. To her, opaque creatures, objects, and obstacles within that distance appear transparent and don't prevent light from passing through them. This vision can penetrate 5 feet of stone, 3 inches of common metal, and up to 10 feet of wood or dirt. Thicker substances block this vision, as does a thin sheet of lead.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 34 (9d6 + 3) force damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapon (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Miirym uses one of the following breath weapons:

actions.name: Cold Breath
actions.desc: Miirym exhales an icy blast in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 21 Constitution saving throw, taking 67 (15d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Necrotic Breath
actions.desc: Miirym exhales a bolt of necrotic energy in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 82 (15d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Paralyzing Breath
actions.desc: Miirym exhales paralyzing gas in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a 21 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of Miirym's choice that is within 120 feet of her and aware of her must succeed on a 21 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Miirym's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Bite
legendary_actions.desc: Miirym makes a bite attack.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Miirym magically teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

spells: Miirym casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (save 21) and requiring no material components:

spells.3/day each: detect magic, detect thoughts, dispel magic, locate creature

spells.1/day each: dispel evil and good, wall of force

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The mimic can use its action to polymorph into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
traits.desc: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic is also grappled by it (escape 10). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

traits.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
traits.desc: While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.desc: The mimic has advantage on attack rolls against any creature grappled by it.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the mimic is in object form, the target is subjected to its Adhesive trait.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage.

monsters.name: Naiad

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The naiad can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Invisible in Water
traits.desc: The naiad is invisible while fully immersed in water.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The naiad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The naiad makes two psychic touch attacks.

actions.name: Psychic Touch
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (1d10 + 4) psychic damage.

spells: The naiad's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

monsters.name: Nintra Siotta

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Nintra fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Nintra makes two attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d4 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shard of Shadow
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 10 (1d6 + 7) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 20 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Storm of Shattered Glass (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Nintra targets a point she can see within 60 feet of her and creates a 20-foot-radius sphere of swirling glass shards centered on that point. Each creature in the sphere must make a 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful save. If Nintra is in the sphere, the shards deal no damage to her.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Nintra makes one attack.

legendary_actions.name: Fey Step
legendary_actions.desc: Nintra teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet of her.

legendary_actions.name: Shadow Strikes (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Provided she is in bright or dim light, Nintra causes her shadow to attack a creature within 10 feet of her. Her shadow makes two claw attacks, each attack identical to Nintra's claw attack except that it deals psychic damage instead of piercing damage.

spells: Nintra casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (save 20) and requiring no material components:

spells.3/day each: dispel magic, faerie fire, mirror image

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The behir makes two attacks: one with its bite and one to constrict.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage. The target is grappled (escape 16) if the behir isn't already constricting a creature, and the target is restrained until this grapple ends.

actions.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The behir exhales a line of lightning that is 20 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc:
The behir makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the behir, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns. A behir can have only one creature swallowed at a time.
Any creature swallowed by a parasite-infested behir must succeed on a 19 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the behir's turns or be feasted upon by blood parasites, taking 36 (8d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful save. This damage is in addition to the damage caused by the behir's digestive acids.
If the behir takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the behir must succeed on a 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the behir. If the behir dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

monsters.name: Ram Sugar

traits.name: Dark Devotion
traits.desc: Ram Sugar has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ram Sugar makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapon (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: Ram Sugar exhales fire in a 30-foot-long line that is 5 feet wide. Any creature in the line must make a 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells: Ram Sugar is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 11, +3 to hit with spell attacks). Ram Sugar has the following cleric spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy

spells.1st level (4 slots): command, inflict wounds, shield of faith

monsters.name: Sage

actions.name: Shocking Grasp (Cantrip)
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +6 to hit (with advantage if the target is wearing armor made of metal), reach 5 ft., one creature. 9 (2d8) lightning damage, and the target can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Shield (1st-Level Spell; 3/Day)
reactions.desc: When the sage is hit by an attack or targeted by a magic missile spell, it calls forth an invisible barrier of magical force that protects it. Until the start of its next turn, the sage has a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and it takes no damage from magic missile.

spells: The sage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (save 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks):

spells.1/day each: dispel magic, levitate, locate object, see invisibility, sending, tongues, unseen servant

monsters.name: Sapphire Sentinel
monsters.damage_immunities: poison, psychic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Slow (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The golem targets one or more creatures it can see within 10 feet of it. Each target must make a 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic. On a failed save, a target can't use reactions, its speed is halved, and it can't make more than one attack on its turn. In addition, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. These effects last for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Sapphire
actions.desc: The sapphire has 3 charges. As an action, the golem can expend 1 charge to cast dispel magic (as a 9th-level spell) from the sapphire using Constitution as its spellcasting ability. The sapphire ceases to glow if all its charges are expended, but it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn and glows again once it has 1 or more charges.

monsters.name: Shemshime
monsters.damage_resistances: acid, bludgeoning, fire, lightning, piercing, slashing, thunder
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Crushing End
traits.desc: If damage reduces Shemshime to 0 hit points, Shemshime instead drops to 1 hit point unless the damage is the result of Shemshime being crushed by an object weighing at least 1,000 pounds.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: Shemshime can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Maddening Touch
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 17 (4d6 + 3) psychic damage.

actions.name: Whispers of Violence
actions.desc: Shemshime chooses up to two creatures it can see within 60 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a 13 Wisdom saving throw, or that target takes 7 (1d8 + 3) psychic damage and must use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack against one creature it can reach (Shemshime's choice) that Shemshime can see.

actions.name: Howling Babble (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Shemshime targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The creature must make a 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 21 (4d8 + 3) psychic damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

monsters.name: Skitterwidget
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, deafened, exhaustion, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.desc: Whenever the skitterwidget is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The skitterwidget doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The skitterwidget makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled by the skitterwidget (escape 13).

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) lightning damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Good Parent
reactions.desc: The skitterwidget imposes disadvantage on one attack roll made against a kiddywidget it can see within 5 feet of it.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.desc: While Steel Crane is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, his AC includes his Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Steel Crane makes three attacks.

actions.name: Force Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) force damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the start of Steel Crane's next turn.

actions.name: Whip
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage or, if the target is a creature, Steel Crane can grapple the target instead (escape 15). Steel Crane can't make attacks with the whip while using it to grapple a creature. Anytime on his turn, he can release a creature grappled by the whip (no action required).

actions.name: Heal Self (Recharges after a Long Rest)
actions.desc: Steel Crane regains 2d8 + 4 hit points, and all levels of exhaustion end on him.

reactions.name: Deflect Missile
reactions.desc: In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, Steel Crane deflects the missile. The damage he takes from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + 10. If the damage is reduced to 0, Steel Crane catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and Steel Crane has a hand free.

reactions.name: Slow Descent (3/Day)
reactions.desc: When Steel Crane falls, he can slow his descent, taking no damage from the fall.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two attacks with its greatsword or hurls two rocks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 30 (6d6 + 9) slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 60/240 ft., one target. 35 (4d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Lightning Strike (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The giant hurls a magical lightning bolt at a point it can see within 500 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 (12d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monsters.name: Swarm of Animated Books
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 10

traits.name: False Objects
traits.desc: If the swarm is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the swarm move or act, that creature must succeed on a 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to discern that the swarm is animate.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a 1-foot-tall, 8-inch-wide, 2-inch-thick object. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Book Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. 6 (2d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage if the swarm has half its hit points or fewer.

monsters.name: Valin Sarnaster
monsters.damage_immunities: necrotic, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Valin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: While her heart remains in Alessia's body, Valin re-forms inside her sarcophagus, regaining all her hit points and becoming active again.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Valin can use her Dreadful Glare and makes one attack with her rotting fist.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 16 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to dust. The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or other magic.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.desc: Valin targets one creature she can see within 60 feet of her. If the target can see Valin, it must succeed on a 16 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened until the end of Valin's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all mummies and mummy lords for the next 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Valin makes one attack with her rotting fist or uses her Dreadful Glare.

legendary_actions.name: Blinding Dust
legendary_actions.desc: Blinding dust and sand swirls magically around Valin. Each creature within 5 feet of Valin must succeed on a 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of her next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Blasphemous Word (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Valin utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of Valin that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of Valin's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Channel Negative Energy (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Valin magically unleashes negative energy. Creatures within 60 feet of Valin, including ones behind barriers and around corners, can't regain hit points until the end of Valin's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Whirlwind of Sand (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Valin magically transforms into a whirlwind of sand, moves up to 60 feet, and reverts to her normal form. While in whirlwind form, Valin is immune to all damage, and it can't be grappled, petrified, knocked prone, restrained, or stunned. Equipment worn or carried by Valin remain in her possession.

spells: Valin Sarnaster is a 10th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). Valin has the following cleric spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): sacred flame, thaumaturgy

spells.1st level (4 slots): command, guiding bolt, shield of faith

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Varnyr has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Varnyr to sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Varnyr makes two attacks.

actions.name: Cane
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Varnyr adds 2 to their AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Varnyr must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monsters.name: Zikzokrishka
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 24

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Zikzokrishka fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Zikzokrishka has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Zikzokrishka can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) lightning damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of Zikzokrishka's choice that is within 120 feet of the Zikzokrishka and aware of it must succeed on a 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the Zikzokrishka's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Zikzokrishka exhales lightning in a 90-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Detect
legendary_actions.desc: Zikzokrishka makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary_actions.name: Tail Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Zikzokrishka makes a tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Zikzokrishka beats its tattered wings. Each creature within 10 feet of Zikzokrishka must succeed on a 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (2d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. After beating its wings this way, Zikzokrishka can fly up to half its flying speed.

monsters.name: Abigor
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monsters.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Abigor's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Abigor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Abigor makes four attacks using its Warhammer, Throwing Hammer, or a combination of the two.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) thunder damage.

actions.name: Throwing Hammer
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +15 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) thunder damage. Hammers thrown this way fall and stick into the ground after hitting their target and a new hammer appears in Abigor's hand.

actions.name: Thunderous Slam (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Abigor causes all its hammers left on the battlefield to bristle with thunderous energy, exploding outwards with a roar. All creatures within a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on each hammer must make a 22 Constitution saving throw. Targets take 26 (4d12) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If a creature is within multiple spheres, it must make the save multiple times, taking damage from each source.

legendary_actions.name: Throw Hammer
legendary_actions.desc: Abigor makes a Throwing Hammer attack.

legendary_actions.name: Call Thunder (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Abigor targets a hammer that it can see within 60 feet to let out a thunderous roar. Creatures within a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on the hammer must make a 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 26 (4d12) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Aeshma makes two attacks using his Shortsword, Hand Crossbow, or a combination of the two.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning
bonus_actions.desc: Aeshma takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

monsters.name: Affliction Devil (Kocrachon)
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the kocrachon's darkvision.

traits.name: Infernal Rot
traits.desc: A creature afflicted with this disease has the poisoned condition until the disease ends. While diseased, creatures gain no benefits from a long rest, gaining exhaustion when necessary. If a creature dies while afflicted with Infernal Rot, its corpse transforms into a newborn kocrachon after 4 (1d8) days.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The kocrachon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Sadism
traits.desc: The kocrachon gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls for each different creature it damaged on its previous turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kocrachon makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with a Proboscis attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Proboscis
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage. Creatures damaged by this attack must succeed on a 16 Constitution saving throw or suffer the Infernal Rot disease.

monsters.name: Anacreda
monsters.damage_immunities: cold, fire, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.senses: darkvision 120 ft., truesight 10 ft., passive Perception 19

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Anacreda makes two Claw attacks. She can replace one of the attacks with a Crushing Hug attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Crushing Hug
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 51 (8d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, Anacreda grabs it with both arms. The target has the grappled condition (escape 18). Until the grapple ends, the target takes 73 (12d10 + 7) necrotic damage at the start of each of Anacreda's turns. Anacreda can't make attacks while grappling a creature in this way.

actions.name: Spinewall
actions.desc: Anacreda causes a 50-foot-long, 5-foot-wide row of bones to pierce the earth at a point within 120 feet of her. She chooses the direction of the line. The bones rise 10 feet into the air and form a solid wall. A 5-foot section of bone has an AC of 20 and 10 hit points.

actions.name: Shattering Shriek (1/Day)
actions.desc: Anacreda shrieks loud enough to shatter stone and bone alike. Each creature within a 50-foot-radius sphere centered on Anacreda must make a 18 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 55 (10d10) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Unworked stone, exposed bone, and similar materials in the radius are shattered and turned into difficult terrain.

monsters.name: Anagwendol
monsters.damage_resistances: radiant, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Anagwendol has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Anagwendol makes two attacks using her Defending Greatsword, Longbow, or a combination of the two.

actions.name: Defending Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 19 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 22 (5d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage damage plus 22 (5d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Healing Touch (2/Day)
actions.desc: Anagwendol touches another creature. The target magically regains 30 (6d8 + 3) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

bonus_actions.name: Defensive Sword-work
bonus_actions.desc: Anagwendol can forgo attacking with her Defending Greatsword on this turn and gain a +3 to her armor class. She can still attack with her Longbow.

monsters.name: Animated Furniture
monsters.damage_immunities: cold, fire, poison, psychic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

monsters.name: Asmodeus
monsters.damage_immunities: fire, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned
monsters.senses: darkvision 120 ft., truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 29

traits.name: Antimagic Aura
traits.desc: Asmodeus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. Spells of level 4 or lower can't damage Asmodeus.

traits.name: Fiendish Regeneration
traits.desc: Asmodeus regains 40 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Asmodeus dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate. If Asmodeus dies, his body regenerates, returning to life 13 (2d12) days later.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Asmodeus fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Submission Aura
traits.desc: When a creature moves to be within 120 feet of Asmodeus, they must succeed on a 24 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until they leave the aura. While frightened, creatures kneel before Asmodeus, taking no actions unless he commands otherwise. If Asmodeus deals damage to a kneeling creature, the creature's frightened condition ends. A creature that succeeds the saving throw is immune to this effect for 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Asmodeus makes four attacks using Ruby Rod, Chilling Gaze, or a combination of the two. He can replace one of the attacks with Hellish Smite.

actions.name: Ruby Rod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +21 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 21 (2d8 + 12) necrotic damage, which also reduces the target's hit point maximum by the damage taken. This damage can't reduce a target's hit point maximum below 1. Any effect that removes a disease allows a creature's hit point maximum to return to normal.

actions.name: Chilling Gaze
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +16 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. 18 (2d10 + 7) cold damage, and the target has a-1 penalty to all attack rolls they make until the end of their next turn. This penalty can stack.

actions.name: Hellish Smite
actions.desc: Asmodeus targets a creature he can see within 300 feet of him, calling down a bolt of hellish lightning. The target must make a 24 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) lightning damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Infernal Word: Stun (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Asmodeus targets a creature he can see within 120 feet of him. The target must make a 24 Intelligence saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that failed the save is stunned for up to 1 minute. The stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success, but taking the damage again on a failed save.

actions.name: Hell-Lord's Suggestion (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Asmodeus targets a creature he can see within 120 feet of him. The target must make a 24 Charisma saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that failed the save has the charmed condition for up to 1 minute. While charmed, a creature is controlled by Asmodeus, performing only actions that he suggests. A charmed creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success, but taking the damage again on a failed save.

actions.name: Fires of the Nine Hells (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Asmodeus chooses a point he can see within 500 feet of him, which explodes into a roaring inferno. All creatures within a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a 24 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Ruby Absorption
reactions.desc:
As a reaction to being the sole target of a spell, Asmodeus can attempt to absorb the spell into the Ruby Rod.
Asmodeus rolls (1d20 + 2), and if the result is higher than (10 + spell level), the spell is absorbed into the rod and has no effect.

legendary_actions.name: Channel Ruby Rod
legendary_actions.desc: The Ruby Rod has 66 charges. Asmodeus may spend its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, with a spell save DC of 20: Lesser Restoration (3 charges), Wall of Force (7 charges), Greater Restoration (12 charges), Chain Lightning (15 charges), Prismatic Spray (23 charges), Globe of Invulnerability (33 charges)

legendary_actions.name: Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Asmodeus makes a Ruby Rod attack.

legendary_actions.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Asmodeus summons an allied pit fiend in an unoccupied space that he can see.

spells: Asmodeus casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 27):

spells.At will: Bane, Bestow Curse, Command, Cure Wounds, Darkness, Lesser Restoration, Remove Curse

spells.1/day each: Antimagic Field, Earthquake, Flame Strike, Gate, Heal, Mass Heal, Wish

monsters.name: Avatar of Baalzebul
monsters.damage_resistances: acid, cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Stench of the Slug
traits.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the avatar must succeed on a 19 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition until the start of their next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to this stench for 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The avatar makes four Sickening Claw attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with Insect Gorge (if available).

actions.name: Sickening Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) acid damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by the acid damage taken. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: Insect Gorge (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: The avatar disgorges a swarm of biting flies at a point it can see within 300 feet of itself. Each creature within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a 19 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 55 (10d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The biting flies persist for 1 minute or until the avatar is slain. A creature must also make this saving throw when it enters the insects' area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.

actions.name: Caustic Slimepool (1/Day)
actions.desc: The avatar causes caustic slime to emanate from itself, covering a 15-foot-radius circle. Each creature within the slime must succeed on a 19 Dexterity saving throw or have the grappled condition (escape 17). A grappled creature takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of its turn.

monsters.name: Awful Fisher
monsters.senses: blindsight 120 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 16

traits.name: Flammable Blood
traits.desc: If the fisher drops below 200 hit points, it gains vulnerability to fire damage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the fisher fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The fisher can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fisher makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 20 (4d6 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Retract Filament
actions.desc: One Huge or smaller creature grappled by the fisher's Adhesive Filament must make a 20 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the fisher, and the fisher makes one Claw attack against it with advantage. Anyone else who was attached to the filament is released. Until the grapple ends on the target, the fisher can't use Adhesive Filament.

bonus_actions.name: Adhesive Filament
bonus_actions.desc: The fisher extends a sticky filament up to 90 feet in a straight line, which adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature the filament adheres to has the grappled condition (escape 20), and ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage. The filament can be attacked (AC 16; 25 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage).
