A weapon that fails to sever it becomes stuck to it, requiring an action and a successful 20 Strength check to pull free. Destroying the filament deals no damage to the fisher. The filament crumbles away if the fisher takes this bonus action again.

legendary_actions.name: Slash
legendary_actions.desc: The fisher makes a Claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: Spit
legendary_actions.desc: The fisher uses Adhesive Filament.

legendary_actions.name: Reel In
legendary_actions.desc: The fisher uses Retract Filament.

monsters.name: Ayperobo Swarm
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned
monsters.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 15

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the ayperobo swarm's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The ayperobo swarm has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The ayperobo swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The ayperobo swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ayperobo swarm makes three Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. 27 (8d4 + 7) piercing damage, or 17 (4d4 + 7) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points (65) or fewer.

actions.name: Burrow (Recharge 6)
actions.desc:
The ayperobo swarm makes a Bite attack. On a hit, the swarm burrows inside the creature, dealing an additional 35 (10d6) necrotic damage and taking control of the creature. At the start of each of its turns, the target may make a 17 Constitution saving throw, expelling the ayperobo swarm and taking 14 (4d6) piercing damage on a success.
While burrowed inside a creature, the ayperobo swarm has Cover against attacks targeting them, and no longer acts on their own initiative. Instead, they take total control over their host, gaining all of its abilities, attacks, and equipment.
They act during the host's turn, taking actions based on their host. If a host dies while the ayperobo swarm is burrowed, they leave the host at the end of the host's turn, rolling initiative if necessary. Creatures acting as hosts to the ayperobo swarm are fully aware of their actions and surroundings, but are incapable of physically operating their body.

monsters.name: Baalzebul
monsters.damage_resistances: acid, cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.senses: darkvision 120 ft., tremorsense 10 ft., passive Perception 17

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Baalzebul's darkvision.

traits.name: Fiendish Regeneration
traits.desc: Baalzebul regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Baalzebul dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Lord of Flies
traits.desc: Insects don't attack Baalzebul, and he can issue orders to them.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Baalzebul fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Baalzebul has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Stench of the Slug
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of Baalzebul must succeed on a 21 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature is immune to this stench for 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Baalzebul uses Heart of Pestilence (if available), then makes three Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 19 (3d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Pungent Eruption (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Baalzebul causes refuse and caustic liquid to spill from the ground at a point he can see within 300 feet. Each creature in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a 21 Constitution saving throw. Targets take 36 (8d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Creatures that fail the save have the poisoned condition for 1 minute.

actions.name: Heart of Pestilence (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Baalzebul channels pestilence into his body, sickening creatures within 50 feet that can see him. Sickened creatures must make a 21 Charisma saving throw, followed by a 21 Constitution saving throw. Failing the Charisma save makes a creature have the frightened condition, while failing the Constitution save makes a creature weak. While weakened, a creature deals half damage on melee attacks. Both effects last for 1 minute or until a greater restoration spell or similar is cast.

bonus_actions.name: Displace
bonus_actions.desc: Baalzebul magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

legendary_actions.name: Pummel
legendary_actions.desc: Baalzebul makes a Slam attack.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport
legendary_actions.desc: Baalzebul uses Displace.

legendary_actions.name: Insect Gorge (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Baalzebul disgorges a swarm of biting flies at a point he can see within 300 feet of himself. Each creature within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a 21 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 44 (8d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The biting flies persist for 1 minute, or until Baalzebul uses this ability again. Creatures that enter the flies' area or end their turn inside it must repeat the saving throw.

legendary_actions.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Baalzebul summons an allied bone devil in an unoccupied space that he can see.

spells: Baalzebul casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 24):

spells.At will: animate dead, darkness, detect evil and good, detect magic, dispel evil and good, hallow, hold monster, suggestion, teleport, true seeing

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Barachiel makes three Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 22 (5d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Purifying Flames (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Barachiel wreathes his sword in white flame, then makes a Greatsword attack. On a hit, the target takes an additional 45 (7d12) fire damage plus 45 (7d12) radiant damage. The target must succeed on a 18 Charisma saving throw or have the stunned condition until the end of their next turn.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Barachiel adds 5 to his AC against one attack. To do so, Barachiel must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monsters.name: Belial
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monsters.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Deep Wounds
traits.desc: All damage dealt by Belial can only be restored through magical means.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Belial's darkvision.

traits.name: Fear Aura
traits.desc: When a creature starts their turn within 120 feet of Belial, they must succeed on a 22 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until they leave the aura. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to this effect for 1 hour.

traits.name: Fiendish Regeneration
traits.desc: Belial regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Belial dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Belial fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Belial has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Belial makes three attacks using his Ranseur of Torture.

actions.name: Ranseur of Torture
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage, and the target must make a 23 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's movement speed is reduced by 5 feet until the end of their next turn. This penalty can stack.

actions.name: Walls of Phlegethos
actions.desc: Belial creates a wall of fire on a solid surface within 120 feet of him. The wall is 20 feet high and 1 foot thick, and Belial can make the wall up to 60 feet long or create a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter. The wall is opaque and lasts until Belial dismisses it. When the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that ends its turn inside the wall, or within 5 feet of it, must repeat the save.

actions.name: Symbol of Insanity (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Belial draws a magic symbol at a point he can see within 120 feet of him. All creatures within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the symbol must make a 25 Intelligence saving throw. Targets take 45 (10d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures that fail the save immediately use their reaction to make a melee attack against a random creature within their reach, then move their full movement in a random direction.

reactions.name: Pleasure in Pain
reactions.desc: As a reaction to taking damage, Belial immediately regenerates half the damage he took.

legendary_actions.name: Ranseur
legendary_actions.desc: Belial makes a Ranseur of Torture attack.

legendary_actions.name: Eruption (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Belial causes molten stone to erupt from a point he can see within 90 feet of him. All creatures within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a 23 Dexterity saving throw. Targets take 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Belial summons an allied horned devil in an unoccupied space that he can see.

monsters.name: Brother Adramalech
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monsters.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Adramalech's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Adramalech has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Unbreakable Bond
traits.desc: If Adramalech is reduced to 0 hit points while Brother Morax still lives, Adramalech regenerates 50 hit points at the start of his next turn. This regeneration is interrupted if Brother Morax is reduced to 0 hit points before the start of Adramalech's turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Adramalech makes four attacks using Mental

actions.name: Barrage
actions.desc: He can replace one of the attacks with Brain Freeze or Cone of Madness (if available).

actions.name: Mental Barrage
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60/120 ft., one target. 25 (4d8 + 7) psychic damage.

actions.name: Brain Freeze
actions.desc: Adramalech attempts to overload the brain of a creature he can see within 60 feet of him. The target must make a 22 Intelligence saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Creatures that fail the saving throw have the stunned condition for up to 1 minute. A stunned creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Cone of Madness (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Adramalech unleashes visions in a 30-foot cone in front of him. All creatures in the cone must make a 22 Wisdom saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. For up to 1 minute, creatures that failed the save can't take reactions and each turn must use their action to make a melee attack against the nearest creature. Creatures may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Conjure Effigy (Recharge 6)
bonus_actions.desc: Adramalech targets a creature, reading its thoughts and creating an effigy of a loved one in an unoccupied space that he can see within 60 feet of Adramalech. The effigy has 55 (10d10) hit points, an AC of 10, and ability scores of 10. It occasionally shouts for help, but otherwise takes no actions. While the effigy is alive, the target creature has disadvantage on attacks targeting Adramalech and any time the effigy takes damage, the target creature also takes an equal amount as psychic damage. If the effigy is killed, the target creature gains a level of exhaustion. If Adramalech is killed while effigies exist, they harmlessly melt into a warm sludge.

legendary_actions.name: Barrage
legendary_actions.desc: Adramalech makes a Mental Barrage attack.

legendary_actions.name: Mental Blocker
legendary_actions.desc: Adramalech fortifies the mind of a creature he can see within 60 feet of him, or himself. The target benefits as if the Greater Restoration spell has been cast on them and is granted resistance to psychic damage until the end of Adramalech's next turn.

monsters.name: Brother Morax
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monsters.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Brittle Spine
traits.desc: For each Brittle Spine a creature has, the creature takes 3 (1d6) poison damage at the start of each of their turns, and when Morax activates Burrow or Deep Burrow. Spines can only be removed by a Regeneration spell or similar, or by killing Morax.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Morax's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Morax has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spined Hide
traits.desc: Whenever Morax is hit with a melee attack, the attacker takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage and gains 1 Brittle Spine.

traits.name: Unbreakable Bond
traits.desc: If Morax is reduced to 0 hit points while Brother Adramalech still lives, Morax regenerates 50 hit points at the start of his next turn. This regeneration is interrupted if Brother Adramalech is reduced to 0 hit points before the start of Morax's turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Morax makes four attacks using his Claw, Spine Fling, or a combination of the two.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 17 (3d6 + 7) slashing damage, and the target gains 1 Brittle Spine.

actions.name: Spine Fling
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +13 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. 12 (1d12 + 6) piercing damage, and the target gains 1 Brittle Spine.

actions.name: Deep Burrow
actions.desc: Morax immediately deals Brittle Spine ongoing damage to all creatures that have at least one Brittle Spine that he can see.

actions.name: Bone Spikes (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Morax shoves an arm into the ground, rapidly growing bones that erupt at a point he can see within 100 feet of him. Each creature in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures that fail the save gain 2 Brittle Spines, while creatures that succeed only gain 1 Brittle Spine.

legendary_actions.name: Claw
legendary_actions.desc: Morax makes a Claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: Bone Splinters (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Morax gestures at a creature he can see that has at least 1 Brittle Spine. That creature must succeed on a 21 Constitution saving throw or the number of Brittle Spines it has doubles.

legendary_actions.name: Burrow (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Morax bristles the spines within a creature that he can see. The target immediately takes Brittle Spine ongoing damage.

monsters.name: Buer
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monsters.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Contractually Obligated
traits.desc: Buer has advantage to hit creatures under an infernal contract and when she hits such creatures she delivers an additional 9 (2d8) damage of a type the target is most vulnerable to. A creature bound under an infernal contract also makes all saving throws against effects originating from Buer with disadvantage.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Buer's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Buer has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Buer makes three attacks using her Claw. She can replace two of the attacks with a Cleansing Bite attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 22 (3d10 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Cleansing Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 19 (2d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage, healing Buer for an amount equal to the damage dealt.

actions.name: Spectral Reaping (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Buer focuses her ethereal form, dashing up to 50 feet in a straight line through the ethereal plane. Any creatures in the line must make a 21 Constitution saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Buer may reappear at any unoccupied space along the line. For 1 minute after using Spectral Reaping, Buer is empowered by ethereal essence. Her Cleansing Bite attack now deals force damage instead of bludgeoning.

bonus_actions.name: Defensive Trip (Recharge 5-6)
bonus_actions.desc: Buer attempts to slow the actions of a creature she can see within 60 feet of her. The target must succeed on a 18 Wisdom saving throw or be slowed until the end of its next turn. A slowed creature's speed is halved, it takes a-2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws, and it can't use its reactions. Regardless of the slowed creature's abilities or magic items, it can't make more than one melee or ranged attack during its turn.

reactions.name: Soul Exchange
reactions.desc: When Buer is subjected to a spell targeting only her, she can attempt to swap places with a creature she damaged on her last turn. The creature must make a 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature and Buer swap positions, and the spell now targets the creature instead of Buer.

legendary_actions.name: Teamwork
legendary_actions.desc: Buer or one other devil within 60 feet of Buer makes a melee weapon attack against a target of Buer's choosing.

legendary_actions.name: Backdoor Clause
legendary_actions.desc: Buer wreathes energy around a creature she can see within 60 feet of her. Until the end of Buer's next turn, the target is covered in fire or cold energy, Buer's choice. Each time the target is struck with a melee attack, the attacker takes 9 (2d8) fire or cold damage.

legendary_actions.name: Refresh Souls (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Buer devours a Soul Coin, instantly refreshing one Recharge ability of any devil within 60 feet, including herself.

monsters.name: Corruption Devil (Paeliryon)
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monsters.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 12

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the paeliryon's darkvision.

traits.name: Keen Eyes
traits.desc: The paeliryon scores a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The paeliryon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The paeliryon makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with Draining Grasp (if available).

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Draining Grasp (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: The paeliryon makes a Claw attack. On a hit, the target's Charisma score is reduced by 2 (1d4). This reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. A creature whose Charisma is reduced to 3 or less because of this ability, has the stunned condition for 1 minute.

spells: The paeliryon casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 17):

spells.At will: Bestow Curse, Command, Darkness, Hold Monster, Major Image

spells.1/day each: Antilife Shell, Incendiary Cloud, Scrying, Weird

monsters.name: Devorastus
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, fire, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 8

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Devorastus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Ooze Cube
traits.desc: Devorastus takes up its entire space. Other creatures can enter the space, but a creature that does so is subjected to Engulf and has disadvantage on the saving throw. Creatures inside the cube can be seen but have Cover. A creature within 5 feet of the cube can take an action to pull a creature or object out of the cube. Doing so requires a successful 21 Strength check, and the creature making the attempt takes 35 (10d6) acid damage. The cube can hold only one Huge creature or up to six Large or smaller creatures inside it at a time.

traits.name: Sticky
traits.desc: Devorastus can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Transparent
traits.desc: Even when Devorastus is in plain sight, it takes a successful 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to spot Devorastus if it has neither moved nor attacked. A creature that tries to enter Devorastus' space while unaware of Devorastus is surprised by it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Devorastus makes four attacks using its Pseudopod, Spit, or a combination of the two.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 42 (12d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Spit
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +8 to hit, range 100/200 ft., one target. 28 (8d6) acid damage. A target hit by this attack must make a 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the prone condition.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.desc: Devorastus moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever Devorastus enters a creature's space, the creature must make a 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of Devorastus. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw. On a failed save, Devorastus enters the creature's space, the creature takes 35 (10d6) acid damage, and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, has the restrained condition, and takes 42 (12d6) acid damage at the start of each of Devorastus' turns. When Devorastus moves, the engulfed creature moves with it. An engulfed creature can try to escape by making a 21 Strength check as an action. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of Devorastus.

monsters.name: Dispater
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monsters.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Dispater's darkvision.

traits.name: Fear Aura
traits.desc: When a creature starts their turn within 120 feet of Dispater, they must succeed on a 22 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until they leave the aura. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to this effect for 1 hour.

traits.name: Fiendish Regeneration
traits.desc: Dispater regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Dispater dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and is unable to regenerate.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Dispater fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Dispater has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Rust Metal
traits.desc: Any nonmagical weapon or ammunition made of metal that hits Dispater corrodes. After its hit, the weapon or ammunition is destroyed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Dispater makes four attacks using his Wrought- Iron Tower, Iron Column, or a combination of the two. He can replace one of the attacks with Superheat Metal (if available).

actions.name: Wrought-Iron Tower
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +20 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 21 (2d8 + 12) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. Dispater may replace the bludgeoning damage with damage of a type that the target is vulnerable to instead.

actions.name: Iron Column
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +15 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. 21 (2d8 + 12) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. Dispater may replace the bludgeoning damage with damage of a type that the target is vulnerable to instead.

actions.name: Superheat Metal (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Dispater targets a metal object he can see within 90 feet of him. The metal glows white-hot, burning all that touches it. If the object was held by a creature, the creature must succeed on a 23 Dexterity saving throw to drop the object or take 45 (10d8) fire damage. If the object is attached to a creature, or they couldn't feasibly drop it, they automatically fail the save. The object returns to room temperature at the end of Dispater's turn.

actions.name: Nail Spray (2/Day)
actions.desc: Dispater conjures a storm of iron nails and launches them forward in a 90-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line. All creatures within the line must make a 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 40 (16d4) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Nails launched from this ability stick into soft surfaces or fall to the ground after the attack finishes.

legendary_actions.name: Staff
legendary_actions.desc: Dispater makes a Wrought-Iron Tower attack.

legendary_actions.name: Flesh to Iron (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 40 (6d10 + 7) force damage, and the target must make a 23 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's flesh begins to harden, and the creature's movement speed is halved for 1 minute. If the creature is harmed by Flesh to Iron again, while still partly iron, the rest of the creature also turns to iron, killing them.

legendary_actions.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Dispater summons an allied erinyes in an unoccupied space that he can see.

traits.name: Avoidance
traits.desc: If the displacer fiend is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Displacement
traits.desc: The displacer fiend projects a magical illusion that makes it appear to be standing near its actual location, causing attack rolls against it to have disadvantage. If it is hit by an attack, this trait is disrupted until the end of its next turn. This trait is also disrupted while the displacer fiend is incapacitated or has a speed of 0.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The displacer fiend makes three Tentacle attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with a Bite attack.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 23 (3d12 + 4) piercing damage, and the target's Dexterity score is reduced by 2 (1d4). The target is killed if this reduces its Dexterity to 0. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

bonus_actions.name: Shadowhop
bonus_actions.desc: While in dim light or darkness, the displacer fiend can teleport up to 60 feet, provided its destination is also in dim light or darkness.

monsters.name: Ekengarik
monsters.damage_resistances: acid, lightning, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 13

traits.name: Hive Mind
traits.desc: All fiendish formians within 1 mile of Ekengarik can telepathically communicate with each other and Ekengarik.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Ekengarik regenerates 10 hit points at the start of her turn, unless she took radiant damage in the last round.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ekengarik makes three Bite attacks. She can replace one of the attacks with an Acid Spray (if available) attack or a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage and the target must make a 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's Strength score is reduced by 2 (1d4). The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

actions.name: Acid Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Ekengarik spits acid at one creature within 60 feet of her, or two creatures within 60 feet of her and 5 feet of each other. Targets must make a 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 33 (6d10) acid damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much on a successful one.

reactions.name: Hardened Carapace (Recharge 4-6)
reactions.desc: When hit with an attack, Ekengarik temporarily hardens her carapace, reducing her speed to 0 and increasing her AC by 5 until the start of her next turn.

spells: Ekengarik casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 18):

spells.At will: Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Heroism, Magic Missile

spells.1/day each: Evard's Black Tentacles, Cone of Cold, Confusion, Dimension Door, Geas, Invisibility, Prismatic Wall, Slow

monsters.name: Eriflamme
monsters.damage_immunities: fire, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the Eriflamme fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The Eriflamme has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Eriflamme makes four Claw attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with a Bite attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 20 (3d6 + 10) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 24 (4d6 + 10) piercing damage plus 33 (6d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Reform
actions.desc: All the Eriflamme's fire elementals vanish and the Eriflamme reappears in one of their spaces. The Eriflamme's hit points are equivalent to the combined hit points of the fire elementals.

reactions.name: Split (2/Day)
reactions.desc: As a reaction to taking damage, the Eriflamme can split into fire elementals and reduce the damage to 0. The Eriflamme can form up to 10 fire elemental, splitting its remaining hit points between them. The fire elementals appear in spaces adjacent to or within the Eriflamme's old location, and all act on the Eriflamme's initiative. They gain a +5 bonus to attack rolls and have the Eriflamme's Reform action.

legendary_actions.name: Slam
legendary_actions.desc: The Eriflamme makes a Claw attack, which deals force damage instead of slashing damage if it hits.

legendary_actions.name: Fireglide
legendary_actions.desc: The Eriflamme moves up to half its speed. It can fly during this movement.

legendary_actions.name: Chomp (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The Eriflamme makes a Bite attack with advantage.

monsters.name: Fiendish Formian
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Hive Mind
traits.desc: All fiendish formians within 1 mile of Ekengarik can telepathically communicate with each other and Ekengarik.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fiendish formian makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage and the target must make a 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's Strength score is reduced by 1. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

monsters.name: Fierna
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monsters.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Fear Aura
traits.desc: When a creature starts their turn within 120 feet of Fierna, they must succeed on a 22 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until they leave the aura. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to this effect for 1 hour.

traits.name: Fiendish Regeneration
traits.desc: Fierna regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn. If she takes radiant damage this trait doesn't function at the start of her next turn. Fierna dies only if she starts her turn with 0 hit points and is unable to regenerate.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Fierna fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Fierna has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Princess of Hellfire
traits.desc: Fire conjured by Fierna becomes Hellfire. It ignores resistances and immunities to fire damage, deals double damage to creatures vulnerable to fire or necrotic damage, can't be extinguished through any means, and is capable of melting stone or igniting inflammable objects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Fierna makes three attacks using Flame Blade, Mote of Flame, or a combination of the two.

actions.name: Flame Blade
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +20 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 23 (4d6 + 9) fire damage.

actions.name: Mote of Flame
actions.desc: Fierna targets a creature she can see within 90 feet of her. The target must make a 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (3d8 + 9) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Wreath of Flames
reactions.desc: When hit by a melee attack and Fierna can see her attacker, she covers herself in Hellfire, and the attacker takes 13 (3d8) fire damage.

legendary_actions.name: Blade
legendary_actions.desc: Fierna makes a Flame Blade attack.

legendary_actions.name: Conjure Hellfire (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Fierna chooses a point she can see within 150 feet of her. All creatures in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Fierna summons an allied spined devil in an unoccupied space that she can see.

monsters.name: Fire Kraken
monsters.damage_immunities: fire, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.languages: understands Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, and Primordial but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Freedom of Movement
traits.desc: The kraken ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or grapples.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kraken makes two attacks using its Tentacle, Fling, or a combination of the two.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 18 (3d6 + 8) piercing damage and 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature grappled by the kraken, the creature is swallowed and the grapple ends. While swallowed, a creature has the blinded and restrained conditions, has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and takes 42 (12d6) fire damage at the start of the kraken's turns. If the kraken takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a 23 Constitution saving throw or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall into a space within 10 feet of the kraken and now have the prone condition. If the kraken dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting with the prone condition.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 13 (2d4 + 8) fire damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape 16). While grappled, the target also has the restrained condition. Any target that starts its turn grappled by the kraken takes 5 (2d4) fire damage. The kraken has five tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Fling
actions.desc: One Large or smaller object or creature grappled by the kraken is thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction, and now has the prone condition. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at a creature, that creature must succeed on a 16 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked down with the prone condition.

legendary_actions.name: Appendage
legendary_actions.desc: The kraken makes a Fling attack.

legendary_actions.name: Fire Breath (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The kraken exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monsters.name: Frozen Golem
monsters.damage_immunities: cold, fire, poison, psychic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

monsters.name: Glasya
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, necrotic, radiant, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 25
monsters.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Charm Aura
traits.desc: When a creature moves to be within 120 feet of Glasya, they must succeed on a 23 Wisdom saving throw or have the charmed condition, treating Glasya as an ally, until they leave the aura. A creature that succeeds the saving throw is immune to this effect for 1 hour. Whenever a charmed creature takes damage, they may repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

traits.name: Dominating Presence
traits.desc: Glasya deals an additional 13 (2d12) psychic damage when attacking a charmed creature, and her attacks don't break charms.

traits.name: Fiendish Regeneration
traits.desc: Glasya regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn. If she takes radiant damage this trait doesn't function at the start of her next turn. Glasya dies only if she starts her turn with 0 hit points and is unable to regenerate. If Glasya is killed, her body slowly regenerates, returning to life 9 (2d8) weeks later.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Glasya fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Glasya has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Glasya makes four attacks using Scourge of Shadow, Necrotic Grasp, or a combination of the two. She can replace one of the attacks with Mesmerizing Gaze.

actions.name: Scourge of Shadow
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +20 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 19 (3d4 + 12) slashing damage, plus 5 (2d4) necrotic damage. This attack scores a critical on a roll of 18, 19, or 20.

actions.name: Necrotic Grasp
actions.desc: Glasya summons necrotic hands to grope and claw at a creature she can see within 90 feet of her. The target must make a 25 Constitution saving throw, taking 20 (2d10 + 9) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Mesmerizing Gaze
actions.desc: Glasya focuses her gaze in a 60-foot cone in front of her. Each creature of her choice within the cone must make a 23 Charisma saving throw or have the charmed condition until the end of their next turn. While charmed, creatures automatically fail saving throws from abilities used by Glasya and move to be as close to her as possible.

actions.name: Deathly Exclamation (1/Day)
actions.desc: Glasya targets a creature she can see within 60 feet of her. The target must make a 25 Constitution saving throw, taking 61 (7d8 + 30) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A Humanoid killed by this ability rises at the start of Glasya's next turn as a zombie permanently under her command.

legendary_actions.name: Whip
legendary_actions.desc: Glasya makes a Scourge of Shadow attack.

legendary_actions.name: Disorient (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Glasya casts Confusion (30-foot-radius, spell save 25), but only lasting until the end of Glasya's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Glasya summons an allied erinyes in an unoccupied space that she can see.

monsters.name: Greater Tyrant Shadow
monsters.damage_immunities: necrotic, poison, psychic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Empath
traits.desc: The shadow uses telepathy to sense nearby creatures. The shadow can see a creature if that creature has thoughts and is within the range of the shadow's telepathy. The shadow can't see creatures immune to telepathy.

traits.name: Undying Connection
traits.desc: The shadow was originally spawned from a specific devil and, if the shadow is slain, it returns to life in 10 (1d20) days within 1 mile of that devil. The shadow is killed permanently only if its progenitor devil is slain first.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The shadow makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with Shadows of Death (if available).

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 21 (4d6 + 7) necrotic damage, plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Cloak of Shadows
actions.desc: The shadow bends darkness around itself, and now has the invisible condition for 1 minute. The invisibility ends if the shadow is subjected to a Daylight spell or similar.

actions.name: Empathic Link
actions.desc: The shadow attempts to form a link between itself and a creature it can see. The target must make a 22 Intelligence saving throw, taking 26 (4d12) psychic damage on a success. On a failed save, the creature and the shadow are linked. While linked, every time the shadow is damaged, the creature takes half of that damage as psychic damage. The creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 26 (4d12) psychic damage on a failed save, or ending the effect on a successful one.

actions.name: Shadows of Death (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The shadow discharges inky-black shadows in a 90-foot-radius sphere around itself. Creatures in the shadows must succeed on a 22 Wisdom saving throw or take 36 (8d8) necrotic damage and have the frightened condition for 1 minute. A frightened creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a successful save, but taking the damage again on a failed save.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: The shadow transforms into a Beast, Humanoid or Fiend that it has an Empathic Link with, or back into its true form. In a new form, the shadow retains its alignment, hit points, hit dice, telepathy, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features, lair actions, or legendary actions of that form.

legendary_actions.name: Shadow Blink
legendary_actions.desc: The shadow surrounds itself in black mist, then teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space that it can see.

legendary_actions.name: Shapeshift
legendary_actions.desc: The shadow uses its Change Shape ability.

legendary_actions.name: Mind Spike (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +14 to hit, range 300 ft., one target. 23 (3d10 + 7) psychic damage.

traits.name: Adaptive Fangs
traits.desc: The halog magically alters its fangs to inflict more damage on the creatures it hits (included in the attack).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The halog has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The halog gains advantage on attacks targeting creatures adjacent to one or more of the halog's conscious allies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The halog makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (3d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) damage of a type that the target is most vulnerable to.

reactions.name: Adaptive Hide
reactions.desc: After taking damage, the halog is now invulnerable to the damage type of the damage it just took, and any future damage of that type instead heals the halog by the damage amount. These benefits last until the halog uses this reaction again.

monsters.name: Hellcat (Bezekira)
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered, damage from spells
monsters.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 16

traits.name: Darkness Dweller
traits.desc: Attacks made against a bezekira in bright or dim light have disadvantage.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the bezekira's darkvision.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bezekira makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with a Bite attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. The bezekira deals an extra 28 (8d6) fire damage when it hits a target with an attack and has advantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage, grasping the target with its mouth. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape 17). The bezekira can't make a Bite attack while a creature is grappled in this way.

monsters.name: Jenevere
monsters.damage_resistances: radiant, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Jenevere has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Jenevere makes three Radiant Touch attacks.

actions.name: Radiant Touch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 33 (6d8 + 6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Forgiveness (2/Day)
actions.desc: Jenevere selects a target within 10 feet. The target is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness. If the target is a Fiend, it must succeed on a 21 saving throw or have disadvantage on all attack rolls for 24 hours.

spells: Jenevere casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 21):

spells.2/day each: Commune, Heal, Legend Lore, Raise Dead, Scrying

monsters.name: Koh Tam

actions.name: Arbiter's Touch
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) radiant damage.

actions.name: Judgement
actions.desc: Koh Tam judges a creature within 60 feet of him. The target must succeed on a 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 50 (10d8 + 5) radiant damage. If the target had fewer hit points than their maximum prior to this attack, the creature takes 70 (10d12 + 5) radiant damage instead.

actions.name: Arbiter's Light (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +9 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 70 (10d12 + 5) radiant damage, and the target has the blinded condition until the start of Koh Tam's next turn.

spells: Koh Tam casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 17):

spells.At will: False Life, Gentle Repose, Lesser Restoration, Protection from Evil and Good, Speak with Dead

spells.1/day each: Antilife Shell, Blight, Death Ward, Dispel Evil and Good, Greater Restoration, Raise Dead, Regenerate, Revivify, Spiritual Weapon

monsters.name: Lesser Tyrant Shadow
monsters.damage_immunities: necrotic, poison, psychic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Empath
traits.desc: The shadow uses telepathy to sense nearby creatures. The shadow can see a creature if that creature has thoughts and is within the range of the shadow's telepathy. The shadow can't see creatures immune to telepathy.

traits.name: Undying Connection
traits.desc: The shadow was originally spawned from a specific devil and, if the shadow is slain, it returns to life in 10 (1d20) days within 1 mile of that devil. The shadow is killed permanently only if its progenitor devil is slain first.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The shadow makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) necrotic damage, plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Cloak of Shadows
actions.desc: The shadow bends darkness around itself, and now has the invisible condition for 1 minute. The invisibility ends if the shadow is subjected to a Daylight spell or similar.

actions.name: Empathic Link
actions.desc: The shadow attempts to form a link between itself and a creature it can see. The target must make a 16 Intelligence saving throw, taking 6 (1d12) psychic damage on a success. On a failed save, the creature and the shadow are linked. While linked, every time the shadow is damaged, the creature takes half of that damage as psychic damage. The creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 6 (1d12) psychic damage on a failed save, or ending the effect on a successful one.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: The shadow transforms into a Beast, Humanoid or Fiend that it has an Empathic Link with, or back into its true form. In a new form, the shadow retains its alignment, hit points, hit dice, telepathy, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features, lair actions, or legendary actions of that form.

monsters.name: Levistus
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monsters.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 1,000 ft.

traits.name: Armor of Ice
traits.desc: Levistus is always entombed in ice. The ice provides 100 temporary hit points. While Levistus has these temporary hit points, he has vulnerability to fire damage. If Levistus starts his turn with no temporary hit points from the ice, he regains 100 temporary hit points.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Levistus's darkvision.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Levistus fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Levistus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Sub-zero
traits.desc: Cold damage dealt by Levistus ignores resistances and immunities.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Levistus makes three Touch of Stygia or Ice Bolt attacks. He can replace one of the attacks with Blizzard (if available).

actions.name: Touch of Stygia
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 20 (3d8 + 7) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a 23 Intelligence saving throw or have the stunned condition for 1 minute. The target may repeat the saving throw at the end of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to this effect for 1 hour.

actions.name: Ice Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +15 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 23 (3d10 + 7) cold damage.

actions.name: Blizzard (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Levistus chooses a point he can see within 300 feet of him. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must make a 23 Dexterity saving throw. Targets take 13 (3d8) force damage plus 13 (3d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Counterspell
reactions.desc: As a reaction to a creature he can see casting a spell, Levistus can attempt to prevent the casting. Levistus makes an Intelligence check (+7) against a DC of (10 + spell level). On a success, the creature's spell fails and has no effect.

legendary_actions.name: Amnesia
legendary_actions.desc: Levistus selects a stunned creature that he can see. The creature must succeed on a 23 Charisma saving throw or Levistus erases a specific memory from the target. The memory must be one that the target experienced in the last 24 hours and that lasted no more than 10 minutes. The memory can only be restored with a Remove Curse or a Greater Restoration spell.

legendary_actions.name: Froststrike
legendary_actions.desc: Levistus makes an Ice Bolt attack. On a hit, the target falls and has the prone condition.

legendary_actions.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Levistus summons an allied ice devil in an unoccupied space that he can see.

spells: Levistus casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 23):

spells.At will: Cone of Cold, Darkness, Ice Storm, Wall of Ice

monsters.name: Maelephant Nomad
monsters.damage_resistances: acid, fire, lightning, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 18

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The maelephant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Regenerative
traits.desc: At the start of its turn, if the maelephant has less than half its hit points, it regenerates 20 hit points. This trait doesn't function if the maelephant starts its turn with less than 1 hit point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The maelephant makes two attacks using its Claw, Trunk, or a combination of the two.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Trunk
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 16 (3d6 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape 18). Until this grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition. While it is grappling a creature, the maelephant can't use its Trunk attack against other creatures.

actions.name: Noxious Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The maelephant releases a cloud of noxious gas. All creatures in a 30-foot cone in front of the maelephant must make a 16 Constitution saving throw. Targets take 42 (12d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, on a failed save, the creature's Intelligence and Charisma scores become 1. The creature can't cast spells, activate magic items, understand language, or communicate in any intelligible way. The creature can, however, identify its friends, follow them, and even protect them. A feebled creature can repeat the save every minute, ending the effect on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Reckless Charge
bonus_actions.desc: The maelephant moves up to 40 feet towards a creature it can see and if it moves at least 20 feet in a straight line, it may make a Claw attack. On a hit, the target takes an additional 14 (4d6) force damage and has the prone condition.

reactions.name: Defensive Stance
reactions.desc: As a reaction to taking damage, the maelephant enters a defensive stance until the end of its next turn. While in a defensive stance, the maelephant moves at half speed and can't take bonus actions, but its AC increases by 5.

monsters.name: Mammon
monsters.damage_resistances: acid, cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monsters.senses: darkvision 120 ft., truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 17
monsters.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Mammon's darkvision.

traits.name: Fiendish Regeneration
traits.desc: Mammon regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Mammon only dies if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and is unable to regenerate.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Mammon fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Mammon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Mammon uses Fearful Gaze, then makes four attacks using Tail Swipe, Constrict, or a combination of the two.

actions.name: Tail Swipe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 31 (4d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape 21). While grappled, the creature also has the restrained condition, and Mammon can't make Tail Swipe attacks.

actions.name: Fearful Gaze
actions.desc: Mammon focuses his gaze in a 90-foot cone in front of him. Each creature of his choice within the cone must make a 23 Wisdom saving throw, taking 19 (3d12) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures that fail the save have the frightened condition until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Mammon tightens his grip around a creature he has grappled. The target takes 35 (4d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Golden Gaze (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Mammon attempts to turn one creature he can see within 60 feet of him into solid gold. The target must make a 23 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's flesh begins to harden, and it has the restrained condition. A restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of each turn. If it successfully saves three times, the effect ends. If it fails three times, it turns to gold and now has the petrified condition. Successes and failures don't need to be consecutive.

reactions.name: Pain Tax
reactions.desc: As a reaction to taking damage, Mammon causes the attacker's valuables to glow red hot. This deals 3 (1d6) fire damage to the attacker for every 100 gold (or equivalent in gems, jewelry, and other coinage) that it currently carries.

legendary_actions.name: Change Form
legendary_actions.desc: Mammon changes his form into that of a pit fiend, maintaining his statistics but losing his actions. He gains the actions and mobility of a pit fiend, including its weapon, and maintains his legendary actions and lair actions. Mammon's serpentine abilities can still recharge while he is in pit fiend form. If Mammon is already a pit fiend, this action changes him back into his serpentine form.

legendary_actions.name: Golden Touch (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Mammon recharges Golden Gaze.

legendary_actions.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Mammon summons an allied horned devil in an unoccupied space that he can see.

monsters.name: Mephistopheles
monsters.damage_resistances: acid, cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Mephistopheles' darkvision.

traits.name: Fiendish Regeneration
traits.desc: Mephistopheles regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Mephistopheles only dies if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and is unable to regenerate.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: Mephistopheles doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when he flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Hellfire Mastery
traits.desc: Fire damage that Mephistopheles inflicts ignores resistances and immunities. Mephistopheles is immune to this effect.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Mephistopheles fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Mephistopheles has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Mephistopheles makes three Ranseur attacks. He can replace one of the attacks with Hellfire Lash (if available).

actions.name: Ranseur, +3
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 20 (2d10 + 9) piercing plus 18 (4d8) fire or cold damage (Mephistopheles' choice).

actions.name: Hellfire Implosion (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: A bright streak of Hellfire appears at a point that Mephistopheles can see within 150 feet of him. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a 22 Dexterity saving throw. Targets take 31 (9d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Hellfire Lash (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Mephistopheles unleashes a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide lash of Hellfire that ignites a 5-foot-radius sphere around where it strikes. Any targets in the area of effect must make a 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

bonus_actions.name: Ashen Teleport
bonus_actions.desc: Mephistopheles' body and any equipment he is wearing or carrying turns to ash, then he magically teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see and reforms.

legendary_actions.name: Hellfire Wings
legendary_actions.desc: Mephistopheles uses his wings to generate a burst of heat. Each creature within 10 feet of him must succeed on a 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage. Creatures that failed the save also have the prone condition.

legendary_actions.name: Hellfire Storm (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Mephistopheles creates a rain of Hellfire at a point he can see within 150 feet. Each creature within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a 24 Dexterity saving throw. Targets take 38 (7d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Mephistopheles summons an allied horned devil in an unoccupied space that he can see.

spells: Mephistopheles casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 26):

spells.At will: darkness, detect evil and good, detect magic, dispel magic, geas (duration 1 year), greater restoration, hallow, hold monster, locate creature, locate object, major image, resurrection, scrying, suggestion, wall of fire

monsters.name: Miasmorne
monsters.damage_immunities: acid, fire, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Acidic Attacks
traits.desc: If a creature takes acid damage from the miasmorne and that creature is wearing nonmagical metal armor, that armor is destroyed.

traits.name: Acidic Hide
traits.desc: After a nonmagical metal weapon hits the miasmorne that weapon melts and is destroyed. Likewise, nonmagical metal ammunition that hits the miasmorne is destroyed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The miasmorne makes three attacks using Bite, Flechette or a combination of the two.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape 18). The miasmorne can't make Bite attacks while a creature is grappled in this way.

actions.name: Flechette
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +11 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. 16 (3d6 + 6) acid damage.

actions.name: Flechette Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The miasmorne launches flechettes from its fins in a 90-foot cone in front of it. All creatures in the cone must make a 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Acidic Secretion (1/Day)
actions.desc: The miasmorne secretes an acidic solution, then sprays it around itself. All creatures in a 20-foot-radius sphere, centered on the miasmorne, must make a 19 Dexterity saving throw. Targets take 26 (4d12) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. All nonmagical metals within the radius that aren't being carried, as well as nonmagical metal items carried or worn by creatures that failed the save, are destroyed.

monsters.name: Oneirovore
monsters.damage_resistances: fire, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 16 (2d12 + 3) force damage.

actions.name: Realize Nightmares (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: The oneirovore manipulates the perception of nearby creatures, sending them into a panic. Creatures of the oneirovore's choice that it can see within 60 feet must make a 19 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the charmed condition, their vision distorted such that they view their allies as creatures of pure fear and hatred. While charmed, a creature will use their actions to attack their allies with intent to kill. A charmed creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Warning Cry (1/Day)
actions.desc: The oneirovore lets out an earsplitting shriek, calling for infernal reinforcements. Creatures that are not Fiends that are within 120 feet of the oneirovore must make a 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Any lesser devils within a 1-mile-radius, centered on the oneirovore, are required by contract to come to its aid upon hearing its Warning Cry. Higher ranking devils may investigate if they desire, but the call holds no magical sway over them.

monsters.name: Pain Devil (Excruciarch)
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Aura of Torment
traits.desc: Any creature hostile to the excruciarch that starts its turn within 20 feet of the excruciarch takes 10 (4d4) slashing damage, unless the excruciarch is incapacitated.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the excruciarch's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The excruciarch has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Sadism
traits.desc: The excruciarch gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls for each creature it damaged on its previous turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The excruciarch makes two Scourge attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with Storm of Steel (if available).

actions.name: Scourge
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Storm of Steel (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: The excruciarch swings its scourge wildly around itself. All creatures within 15 feet of the excruciarch must make a 16 Dexterity saving throw. Targets take 31 (6d8 + 4) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Vulnerable Gaze
reactions.desc: As a reaction to a creature resisting damage dealt by the excruciarch, it turns its gaze on that creature, negating any resistances and immunities that creature has until the start of the excruciarch's next turn.

monsters.name: Ramius
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks, damage from spells

traits.name: Aura of Protection
traits.desc: Ramius and any ally that starts their turn within 30 feet of him have a +4 bonus to all saving throws and resistance to nonmagical damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ramius makes two Longsword attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. 10 (1d8 + 6) slashing damage or 11 (1d10 + 6) if wielded in two hands, plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage. If the target is an evil creature, it must succeed on a 17 Charisma saving throw or take an additional 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Divine Wave (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Ramius strikes the ground and causes holy energy to radiate outwards. Each creature of his choice within 30 feet of him must make a 17 Constitution saving throw. Targets take 21 (6d6) thunder damage plus 21 (6d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures that fail the save are knocked down (have the prone condition).

reactions.name: Healing Touch
reactions.desc: As a reaction to Ramius or an adjacent creature taking 50 points or more of damage, Ramius reaches out and channels divine energy, healing 13 (2d8 + 4) hit points.

spells: Ramius casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 17):

spells.1/day each: Aura of Purity, Compelled Duel, Crusader's Mantle, Death Ward, Dispel Evil and Good, Find Steed, Lesser Restoration, Remove Curse, Revivify, Shield of Faith

monsters.name: Rimmon
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monsters.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Contractually Obligated
traits.desc: Rimmon has advantage to hit creatures under an infernal contract and when he hits such creatures he delivers an additional 9 (2d8) damage of a type the target is most vulnerable to. A creature bound under an infernal contract also makes all saving throws against effects originating from Rimmon with disadvantage.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Rimmon's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Rimmon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Rimmon makes four Sharpened Tongue or Wordplay attacks.

actions.name: Sharpened Tongue
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 11 (3d4 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Wordplay
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +14 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. 35 (6d8 + 8) psychic damage.

actions.name: Connected Clauses (1/Day)
actions.desc: Rimmon emits a burst of energy that arcs towards a creature he can see within 150 feet of him. Three bolts then leap from that target to as many as three other targets, each of which must be within 30 feet of the first target. A target must make a 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (14d8) damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The damage type inflicted is of a type the first target is most vulnerable to.

traits.name: Charge
traits.desc: If the rothé moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Sarevok

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Sarevok has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: If Sarevok is killed he gains a new body in 24 hours, regaining all his hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears on the altar of the temple of Bhaal beneath Baldur's Gate. This ability ceases to function if a cleric of good alignment casts Hallow on the altar in the temple of Bhaal.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Sarevok makes two Longsword attacks. He may replace one of the attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage or 10 (1d10 + 5) if wielded in two hands. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 16 Constitution saving throw or be cursed by Bhaal. The cursed target can't regain hit points. The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or other magic.

actions.name: Assassin's Strike
actions.desc: Sarevok makes a Longsword attack. If he hits the target and has advantage on the attack roll, then he deals an additional 21 (6d6) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 16 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition for 10 minutes.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Sarevok makes a Longsword attack.

legendary_actions.name: Unholy Flame
legendary_actions.desc: Sarevok casts sacred flame.

legendary_actions.name: Channel Bhaal's Hate (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Sarevok unleashes Bhaal's power. Creatures within 30 feet of Sarevok, including ones behind barriers and around corners, can't regain hit points until the end of Sarevok's next turn.

spells: Sarevok casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 16):

spells.1/day each: animate dead, command, contagion, dispel magic, divination, harm, hold person, silence

monsters.name: Shredwing
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, fire, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Merged
traits.desc: After using the Burrow ability, if the shredwing is merged with another creature, any damage dealt to the shredwing is split evenly between it and the merged creature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The shredwing makes three Talon attacks.

actions.name: Talon
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Burrow (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc:
On a hit, the creature takes an additional 32 (5d12) slashing damage as the wings merge with it. While merged, the creature moves with the shredwing, takes 19 (3d12) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turn, and has the grappled condition. The shredwing can unmerge at any time, leaving the creature and dropping it if airborne. The only other way to end the merge is to kill the shredwing.
If the merged creature dies while merged, the shredwing permanently takes over its body. It gains the merged creature's hit dice, natural armor, possessions, and languages. If any of the merged creature's statistics are higher than the shredwing, it inherits those statistics as well. A creature permanently merged by the shredwing can only be resurrected through a Wish spell or similar.

bonus_actions.name: Aggressive
bonus_actions.desc: The shredwing can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

monsters.name: Slayer
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.desc: During its first turn, the Slayer has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the Slayer scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the Slayer's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The Slayer has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Slayer makes four Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage. The Slayer deals an extra 14 (4d6) slashing damage when it has advantage on the attack roll and hits the target.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Stygian Wasting
traits.desc: Creatures afflicted with this disease are incapable of regaining hit points in any way until the disease is cured. Additionally, as their flesh starts to rot, a creature with this disease takes 36 (8d8) necrotic damage after each long rest they finish.

traits.name: Styx Dweller
traits.desc: The dragon is immune to all negative effects from the River Styx.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks using its Bite, Tail, or a combination of the two. It can replace one of the attacks with Constrict.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage, and the target must make a 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target contracts Stygian Wasting.

actions.name: Tail
