actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape 22). The dragon can't make a Tail attack while a creature is grappled in this way.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: The dragon tightens its grip on a creature grappled by its tail. The creature takes 27 (3d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage, has the restrained condition until the start of the dragon's next turn, and must make a 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target contracts Stygian Wasting.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon must succeed on a 18 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Stygian Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The dragon exhales poisonous Styx water in a 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide line. Each creature in that line must make a 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 (12d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Creatures that fail the save contract Stygian Wasting.

legendary_actions.name: Detect
legendary_actions.desc: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary_actions.name: Tail Attack
legendary_actions.desc: The dragon makes a Tail attack. If a creature is already grappled, the dragon may use Constrict instead.

legendary_actions.name: Death Throw (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: If the dragon has successfully restrained a creature with the Constrict ability, it may throw them up to 100 feet away. When it lands, the creature takes 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and must make a 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the unconscious condition for 10 minutes.

monsters.name: Tiax

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.desc: Tiax has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Tiax wears a Ring of Resistance that grants him resistance to radiant damage.

actions.name: Touch of Decay
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 37 (6d10 + 4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Unholy Firebolt
actions.desc: Tiax causes unholy fire to flare up in a creature's space within 60 feet of him. The target must succeed on a 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) necrotic damage plus 18 (4d8) poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Heal (2/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: Tiax heals 70 hit points.

spells: Tiax casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 16):

spells.At will: Bane, Disguise Self, Dispel Magic, Mage Armor, Mirror Image, Thaumaturgy

spells.1/day each: Bestow Curse, Blindness/Deafness, Blink, Charm Person, Contagion, Dimension Door, Dominate Person, Hold Person, Pass Without Trace, Polymorph, Teleport

monsters.name: Tyrant Shadow
monsters.damage_immunities: necrotic, poison, psychic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Empath
traits.desc: The shadow uses telepathy to sense nearby creatures. The shadow can see a creature if that creature has thoughts and is within the range of the shadow's telepathy. The shadow can't see creatures immune to telepathy.

traits.name: Undying Connection
traits.desc: The shadow was originally spawned from a specific devil and, if the shadow is slain, it returns to life in 10 (1d20) days within 1 mile of that devil. The shadow is killed permanently only if its progenitor devil is slain first.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The shadow makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with Shadows of Death (if available).

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 16 (3d6 + 6) necrotic damage, plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Cloak of Shadows
actions.desc: The shadow bends darkness around itself, and now has the invisible condition for 1 minute. The invisibility ends if the shadow is subjected to a Daylight spell or similar.

actions.name: Empathic Link
actions.desc: The shadow attempts to form a link between itself and a creature it can see. The target must make a 19 Intelligence saving throw, taking 13 (2d12) psychic damage on a success. On a failed save, the creature and the shadow are linked. While linked, every time the shadow is damaged, the creature takes half of that damage as psychic damage. The creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 13 (2d12) psychic damage on a failed save, or ending the effect on a successful one.

actions.name: Shadows of Death (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The shadow discharges inky-black shadows in a 90-foot-radius sphere around itself. Creatures in the shadows must succeed on a 19 Wisdom saving throw or take 27 (6d8) necrotic damage and have the frightened condition for 1 minute. A frightened creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a successful save, but taking the damage again on a failed save.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: The shadow transforms into a Beast, Humanoid or Fiend that it has an Empathic Link with, or back into its true form. In a new form, the shadow retains its alignment, hit points, hit dice, telepathy, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features, lair actions, or legendary actions of that form.

legendary_actions.name: Shadow Blink
legendary_actions.desc: The shadow surrounds itself in black mist, then teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space that it can see.

legendary_actions.name: Shapeshift
legendary_actions.desc: The shadow uses its Change Shape ability.

legendary_actions.name: Mind Spike (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +11 to hit, range 300 ft., one target. 16 (2d10 + 5) psychic damage.

monsters.name: Vorvolaka
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Fear Aura
traits.desc: Any hostile creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the vorvolaka must succeed on a 18 Wisdom saving throw or have frightened condition until the start of the creature's next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, they're immune to the vorvolaka's Fear Aura for the next 24 hours. This ability does not function if the vorvolaka is unconscious.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The vorvolaka has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vorvolaka regains 15 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. If the vorvolaka takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vorvolaka's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vorvolaka makes two Talon attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with Rend Armor (if available).

actions.name: Talon
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Rend Armor (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: The vorvolaka makes a Talon attack against a creature. On a hit, the creature's AC is reduced by 2 for 1 minute. Creatures not wearing armor are immune to this effect, and the total reduction can't bring a creature below an AC of 10.

monsters.name: Waeloquay
monsters.damage_resistances: acid, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Waeloquay has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Waeloquay fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Water Form
traits.desc: Waeloquay can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Waeloquay makes three Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 26 (4d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Whelm (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Each creature in Waeloquay's space must make a 22 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If it is Large or smaller, it also has the grappled condition (escape 20). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and unable to breathe, unless it can breathe water. If the save is successful, the target is pushed out of Waeloquay's space. Waeloquay can grapple one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures at one time. At the start of each of Waeloquay's turns, each target grappled by it takes 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage. A creature within 5 feet of Waeloquay can pull a creature or object out of it by taking an action to make a 22 Strength check and succeeding.

legendary_actions.name: Flow
legendary_actions.desc: Waeloquay moves up to its speed.

legendary_actions.name: Crush (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: One creature that Waeloquay is grappling takes 44 (8d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

legendary_actions.name: Pummel (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Waeloquay makes a Slam attack with advantage.

monsters.name: War Devil
monsters.damage_immunities: fire, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the war devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Fear Aura
traits.desc: Any hostile creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the war devil must succeed on a 18 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until the start of the creature's next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to the war devil's Fear Aura for the next 24 hours. This ability doesn't function if the war devil is unconscious.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The war devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The war devil makes two attacks using its Cold- Iron Ranseur, Claws, or a combination of the two.

actions.name: Cold-Iron Ranseur
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 23 (3d10 + 7) force damage plus 14 (4d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 20 (3d8 + 7) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape 20). While a creature is grappled, the war devil can't make Claws attacks.

monsters.name: Zagum
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monsters.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Contractually Obligated
traits.desc: Zagum has advantage to hit creatures under an infernal contract and when he hits such creatures he delivers an additional 9 (2d8) damage of a type the target is most vulnerable to. A creature bound under an infernal contract also makes all saving throws against effects originating from Zagum with disadvantage.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Zagum's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Zagum has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Zagum makes three attacks with Disarming Tongue or Oration.

actions.name: Disarming Tongue
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 10 (3d4 + 3) slashing damage. A target hit by this attack has vulnerability to psychic damage until the start of their next turn.

actions.name: Oration
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +14 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. 35 (6d8 + 8) psychic damage.

actions.name: Legal Jargon (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc:
Zagum chooses a point he can see within 90 feet of him. All creatures within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a 22 Wisdom saving throw. Creatures that fail the save are confused for up to 1 minute and must roll a d10 at the start of each of their turns.
On a 1, a creature moves in a random direction then ends their turn. On a 2-6, a creature can't use actions this turn. On a 7-8, a creature must use their action to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within their reach that is not a Fiend. On a 9-10, a creature can move and act normally.
A confused creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.

monsters.name: Zariel
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, fire, radiant, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Zariel's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Zariel's weapon attacks are magical. When she hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 36 (8d8) fire damage (included in the weapon attacks below).

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Zariel fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Zariel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Zariel regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn. If she takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of her next turn. Zariel dies only if she starts her turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Zariel attacks twice with her longsword or with her javelins. She can substitute Horrid Touch for one of these attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 36 (8d8) fire damage, or 19 (2d10 + 8) slashing damage plus 36 (8d8) fire damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +16 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. 15 (2d6 + 8) piercing damage plus 36 (8d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Horrid Touch (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Zariel touches one creature within 10 feet of her. The target must succeed on a 26 Constitution saving throw or take 44 (8d10) necrotic damage and be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the target is also blinded and deafened. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: Zariel magically teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

legendary_actions.name: Immolating Gaze (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Zariel turns her magical gaze toward one creature she can see within 120 feet of her and commands it to combust. The target must succeed on a 26 Wisdom saving throw or take 22 (4d10) fire damage.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport
legendary_actions.desc: Zariel uses her Teleport action.

spells: Zariel's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 26). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spells.At will: alter self (can become Medium when changing her appearance), detect evil and good, fireball, invisibility (self only), wall of fire

spells.3/day each: blade barrier, dispel evil and good, finger of death

monsters.name: Zythan
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks (from Stoneskin), damage from spells
monsters.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Infernal, Primordial

traits.name: Battlemage
traits.desc: Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on Zythan's ranged attack rolls.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Zythan has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Zythan makes three Dagger or Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 27 (4d10 + 5) radiant damage.

actions.name: Spirit Fissure (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Zythan causes a disruption in arcane energies in a 300-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 65 (10d12) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Portent (3/Day)
reactions.desc: As a reaction to a creature Zythan can see making an attack roll, a saving throw, or an ability check, Zythan rolls a d20 and chooses whether to use that roll in place of the original roll.

spells: Zythan casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 18).

spells.At will: Arcane Eye, Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Fly, Light, Locate Object, Mage Armor, Mage Hand, Message, Prestidigitation

spells.1/day each: Cone of Cold, Foresight, Stoneskin, Rary's telepathic bond, True Seeing

actions.name: Halberd
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d10 + 1) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Baba Lysaga

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: Baba Lysaga can use an action to polymorph into a swarm of insects (flies), or back into her true form. While in swarm form, she has a walking speed of 5 feet and a flying speed of 30 feet. Anything she is wearing transforms with her, but nothing she is carrying does.

traits.name: Blessing of Mother Night
traits.desc: Baba Lysaga is shielded against divination magic, as though protected by a nondetection spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Baba Lysaga makes three attacks with her quarterstaff.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands.

actions.name: Summon Swarms of Insects (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: Baba Lysaga summons 1d4 swarms of insects. A summoned swarm appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Baba Lysaga and acts as her ally. It remains until it dies or until Baba Lysaga dismisses it as an action.

spells: Baba Lysaga is a 16th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). Baba Lysaga has the following wizard spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): acid splash, fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation

spells.1st level (4 slots): detect magic, magic missile, sleep, witch bolt

spells.2nd level (3 slots): crown of madness, enlarge/reduce, misty step

monsters.name: Baba Lysaga's Creeping Hut
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, prone
monsters.senses: blindsight 120 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 6

traits.name: Constructed Nature
traits.desc:
An animated object doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.
The magic that animates an object is dispelled when the construct drops to 0 hit points. An animated object reduced to 0 hit points becomes inanimate and is too damaged to be of much use or value to anyone.

traits.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
traits.desc: The hut is incapacitated while the magic gem that animates it is in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the hut must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The hut deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hut makes three attacks with its roots. It can replace one of these attacks with a rock attack.

actions.name: Root
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Pitchfork
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Barovian Witch

actions.name: Claws (Requires Alter Self)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage. This attack is magical.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

spells: The witch is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). The witch has the following wizard spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): mage hand, prestidigitation, ray of frost

spells.1st level (4 slots): ray of sickness, sleep, Tasha's hideous laughter

monsters.name: Broom of Animated Attack
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone
monsters.senses: blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 7

traits.name: Constructed Nature
traits.desc:
An animated object doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.
The magic that animates an object is dispelled when the construct drops to 0 hit points. An animated object reduced to 0 hit points becomes inanimate and is too damaged to be of much use or value to anyone.

traits.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
traits.desc: The broom is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the broom must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the broom remains motionless and isn't flying, it is indistinguishable from a normal broom.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The broom makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Broomstick
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Animated Attack
reactions.desc: If the broom is motionless and a creature grabs hold of it, the broom makes a Dexterity check contested by the creature's Strength check. If the broom wins the contest, it flies out of the creature's grasp and makes a melee attack against it with advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Snake-Swollen
traits.desc: When a corpse is reduced to 0 hit points, it splits open, disgorging a swarm of poisonous snakes. The snakes are hungry and fight until slain.

monsters.name: Exethanter
spells: The lich is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks). The lich has the following wizard spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): mage hand, prestidigitation, ray of frost

monsters.name: Ezmerelda d'Avenir

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: In addition to her magic armor and weapons, Ezmerelda has two potion of greater healing, and three wooden stakes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ezmerelda makes three attacks: two with her +1 rapier and one with her +1 handaxe or her silvered shortsword.

actions.name: Rapier +1
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Handaxe +1
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Silvered Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Curse (Recharges after a Long Rest)
actions.desc: Ezmerelda targets one creature that she can see within 30 feet of her. The target must succeed on a 14 Wisdom saving throw or be cursed. While cursed, the target has vulnerability to one type of damage of Ezmerelda's choice. The curse lasts until ended with a greater restoration spell, a remove curse spell, or similar magic. When the curse ends, Ezmerelda takes 3d6 psychic damage.

actions.name: Evil Eye (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: Ezmerelda targets one creature that she can see within 10 feet of her and casts one of the following spells on the target (save 14), requiring neither somatic nor material components to do so: animal friendship, charm person, or hold person. If the target succeeds on the initial saving throw, Ezmerelda is blinded until the end of her next turn. Once a target succeeds on a saving throw against this effect, it is immune to the Evil Eye power of all Vistani for 24 hours.

spells: Ezmerelda is a 7th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). Ezmerelda has the following wizard spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation

spells.1st level (4 slots): protection from evil and good, magic missile, shield

monsters.name: Guardian Portrait
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
monsters.languages: Common, plus up to two other languages

traits.name: Constructed Nature
traits.desc:
An animated object doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.
The magic that animates an object is dispelled when the construct drops to 0 hit points. An animated object reduced to 0 hit points becomes inanimate and is too damaged to be of much use or value to anyone.

traits.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
traits.desc: The portrait is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the portrait must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or become unconscious for 1 minute.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the figure in the portrait remains motionless, the portrait is indistinguishable from a normal painting.

spells: The portrait's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 12). The portrait can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spells.3/day each: counterspell, crown of madness, hypnotic pattern, telekinesis

traits.name: Brute
traits.desc: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when Izek hits with it (included in the attack).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Izek makes two attacks with his battleaxe.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 15 (2d10 + 4) when used with two hands.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. 10 (3d6) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it catches fire.

monsters.name: Kasimir Velikov
spells: Kasimir is a 9th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). Kasimir has the following wizard spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation

traits.name: Extraordinary Feature
traits.desc:
The mongrelfolk has one of the following extraordinary features, determined randomly by rolling a d20 or chosen by the DM:
1–3: Amphibious. The mongrelfolk can breathe air and water.
4–9: Darkvision. The mongrelfolk has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.
10: Flight. The mongrelfolk has leathery wings and a flying speed of 40 feet.
11–15: Keen Hearing and Smell. The mongrelfolk has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
16–17: Spider Climb. The mongrelfolk can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
18–19: Standing Leap. The mongrelfolk's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.
20: Two-Headed. The mongrelfolk has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.desc: The mongrelfolk can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful 12 Wisdom (Insight) check.

As a bonus action, Rahadin can force all creatures that can hear the screams to make a 16 Wisdom saving throw. Each creature takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Rahadin has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

traits.name: Mask of the Wild
traits.desc: Rahadin can attempt to hide even when he is only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

actions.name: Poisoned Dart

monsters.name: Strahd von Zarovich
monsters.damage_resistances: necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.languages: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Giant, Infernal

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc:
If Strahd isn't in running water or sunlight, he can use his action to polymorph into a Tiny bat, a Medium wolf, or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into his true form.
While in bat or wolf form, Strahd can't speak. In bat form, his walking speed is 5 feet, and he has a flying speed of 30 feet. In wolf form, his walking speed is 40 feet. His statistics, other than his size and speed, are unchanged. Anything he is wearing transforms with him, but nothing he is carrying does. He reverts to his true form if he dies.
While in mist form, Strahd can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. He is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and he can't pass through water. He has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and he is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage he takes from sunlight.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Strahd fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Misty Escape
traits.desc:
When Strahd drops to 0 hit points outside his coffin, he transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that he isn't in running water or sunlight. If he can't transform, he is destroyed.
While he has 0 hit points in mist form, he can't revert to his vampire form, and he must reach his coffin within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in his coffin, he reverts to his vampire form. He is then paralyzed until he regains at least 1 hit point. After 1 hour in his coffin with 0 hit points, he regains 1 hit point.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Strahd regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point and isn't in running water or sunlight. If he takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: Strahd can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without having to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.desc: Strahd has the following flaws:

traits.name: Forbiddance
traits.desc: He can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

traits.name: Harmed by Running Water
traits.desc: He takes 20 acid damage if he ends his turn in running water.

traits.name: Stake to the Heart
traits.desc: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into his heart while he is incapacitated in his coffin, he is paralyzed until the stake is removed.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, Strahd takes 20 radiant damage at the start of his turn, and he has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks

actions.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: Strahd makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire or Wolf Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, Strahd can grapple it (escape 18) instead of dealing the slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by Strahd, incapacitated, or restrained. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Strahd regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Strahd's control.

actions.name: Charm
actions.desc:
Strahd targets one humanoid he can see within 30 feet of him. If the target can see Strahd, the target must succeed on a 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed. The charmed target regards Strahd as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. The target isn't under Strahd's control, but it takes Strahd's requests and actions in the most favorable way and lets Strahd bite it.
Each time Strahd or his companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Strahd is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

actions.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
actions.desc: Strahd magically calls 2d4 swarm of bats rounds, acting as allies of Strahd and obeying his spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until Strahd dies, or until he dismisses them as a bonus action.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: Strahd moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Unarmed Strike
legendary_actions.desc: Strahd makes one unarmed strike.

legendary_actions.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Strahd makes one bite attack.

spells: Strahd is a 9th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): mage hand, prestidigitation, ray of frost

spells.1st level (4 slots): comprehend languages, fog cloud, sleep

spells.2nd level (3 slots): detect thoughts, gust of wind, mirror image

monsters.name: Strahd Zombie
monsters.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Loathsome Limbs
traits.desc:
Whenever the zombie takes at least 5 bludgeoning or slashing damage at one time, roll a d20 to determine what else happens to it:
1–8: One leg is severed from the zombie if it has any legs left.
9–16: One arm is severed from the zombie if it has any arms left.
17–20: The zombie is decapitated.
If the zombie is reduced to 0 hit points, all parts of it die. Until then, a severed part acts on the zombie's initiative and has its own action and movement. A severed part has AC 8. Any damage it takes is subtracted from the zombie's hit points.
A severed leg is unable to attack and has a speed of 5 feet.
A severed arm has a speed of 5 feet and can make one claw attack on its turn, with disadvantage on the attack roll. Each time the zombie loses an arm, it loses a claw attack.
If its head is severed, the zombie loses its bite attack and its body is blinded unless the head can see it. The severed head has a speed of 0 feet. It can make a bite attack, but only against a target in its space.
The zombie's speed is halved if it's missing a leg. If it loses both legs, it falls prone. If it has both arms, it can crawl. With only one arm, it can still crawl, but its speed is halved. With no arms or legs, its speed is 0 feet, and it can't benefit from bonuses to speed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The zombie makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

traits.name: Constructed Nature
traits.desc:
An animated object doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.
The magic that animates an object is dispelled when the construct drops to 0 hit points. An animated object reduced to 0 hit points becomes inanimate and is too damaged to be of much use or value to anyone.

traits.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
traits.desc: The armor is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the armor must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the armor remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal suit of armor.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The armor makes two melee attacks or uses Shocking Bolt twice.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) lightning damage.

actions.name: Shocking Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +4 to hit (with advantage on the attack roll if the target is wearing armor made of metal), range 60 ft., one target. 10 (3d6) lightning damage.

Cutting the root doesn't hurt the blight, but ends the grapple.

bonus_actions.name: Bite
bonus_actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature grappled by the blight. 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Vladimir Horngaard
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Vladimir regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes fire or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Vladimir's body is destroyed only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: When Vladimir's body is destroyed, his soul lingers. After 24 hours, the soul inhabits and animates another corpse on the same plane of existence and regains all its hit points. While the soul is bodiless, a wish spell can be used to force the soul to go to the afterlife and not return.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Vladimir wields a +2 greatsword with a hilt sculpted to resemble silver dragon wings and a pommel shaped like a silver dragon's head clutching a black opal between its teeth.

traits.name: Turn Immunity
traits.desc: Vladimir is immune to effects that turn undead.

traits.name: Vengeful Tracker
traits.desc: Vladimir knows the distance to and direction of Strahd, even if Strahd and Vladimir are on different planes of existence. If Strahd is destroyed, Vladimir knows.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Strahd, the target of Vladimir's sworn vengeance, takes an extra 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, Vladimir can grapple the target (escape 14) provided the target is Large or smaller.

actions.name: Greatsword +2
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 20 (4d6 + 6) slashing damage. Against Strahd, Vladimir deals an extra 14 (4d6) slashing damage with this weapon.

actions.name: Vengeful Glare
actions.desc: Vladimir can target Strahd within 30 feet provided he can see Strahd. Strahd must make a 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, Strahd is paralyzed until Vladimir deals damage to him, or until the end of Vladimir's next turn. When the paralysis ends, Strahd is frightened of Vladimir for 1 minute. Strahd can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of his turns, with disadvantage if he can see Vladimir, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success.

traits.name: Amphibious

traits.name: Mucous Cloud
traits.desc: While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by a cloud of sticky mucus. A creature that touches the aboleth or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must succeed on a 14 Strength saving throw or be restrained until the end of the aboleth's next turn.

traits.name: Probing Telepathy
traits.desc: If a creature the aboleth can see communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature's greatest desires.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Tail

bonus_actions.name: Enslave (Recharge 4-6)
bonus_actions.desc:
The aboleth targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the aboleth until the aboleth dies or until it is on a different plane of existence from the target. The charmed target is under the aboleth's control and can't take reactions, and the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance.
The charmed target can repeat the saving throw whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on itself on a success. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can repeat the saving throw when it is at least 1 mile away from the aboleth.

legendary_actions.name: Tail Swipe
legendary_actions.desc: The aboleth makes one Tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: Psychic Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: One creature charmed by the aboleth takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, and the aboleth regains hit points equal to the damage dealt.

monsters.name: Alyxian the Absolved

traits.name: Divinely Blessed
traits.desc: Alyxian can't be {@status surprised} and can't be changed into another form against his will.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: If Alyxian fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Force Wave (1/Day)
actions.desc: Alyxian strikes the ground, creating a burst of energy that ripples outward. Each creature he chooses within a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on himself must succeed on a 17 Constitution saving throw or take 35 (10d6) force damage and be knocked prone. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.

reactions.name: Parry

legendary_actions.name: Arch Heart's Strike
legendary_actions.desc: Alyxian makes one Spear attack, and all damage from this attack is radiant.

legendary_actions.name: Change Bringer's Dance
legendary_actions.desc: Alyxian moves up to his speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

spells.1/day each: lesser restoration, remove curse, water breathing

traits.desc: When Alyxian the Callous drops to 0 hit points, his body dies and sheds its wings, and he rises to his feet in his third form, Alyxian the Dispossessed. His initiative count doesn't change.

traits.name: Divinely Blessed
traits.desc: Alyxian can't be {@status surprised} and can't be changed into another form against his will.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: If Alyxian fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Radiant Spear
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 15 (2d8 + 6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Blinding Teleport
actions.desc: Alyxian teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space he can see within 120 feet of himself. Each creature within 5 feet of his new location must succeed on a 17 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Heavenly Destruction (1/Day)
actions.desc: Alyxian releases divine energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature of his choice in that area must make a 17 Constitution saving throw. One humanoid that Ebondeath can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a 20 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by Ebondeath; Ebondeath then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Ebondeath now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Ebondeath can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, including gaining access to the target's knowledge, class features, and proficiencies.
The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, Ebondeath ends it as a bonus action, or Ebondeath is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, Ebondeath reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to Ebondeath Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) lightning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape 15). The drone has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Crystalline Spit (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The drone spits crackling gel in a line 5 feet wide and 20 feet long. Each creature in the line must make a 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 14 (4d6) lightning damage and is restrained by the gel, which hardens into crystal. The creature is restrained until the crystal is destroyed. The crystal has AC 15, 15 hit points, immunity to poison and psychic damage, and vulnerability to thunder damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't restrained.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The soldier makes two Longsword attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands.

reactions.name: Hold the Line
reactions.desc: If an ally within 5 feet of the soldier must make a saving throw, the soldier encourages the ally, granting advantage on the roll.

monsters.name: Kansaldi Fire-Eyes

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Kansaldi has a glowing ruby embedded in her left eye socket. The gem functions as her eye and grants her truesight (included above). The gem can't be removed while Kansaldi is alive. When she dies, a creature can remove the gem as an action. The gem then functions as a gem of seeing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Kansaldi makes two Pike attacks and uses Flame Burst.

actions.name: Pike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Flame Burst
actions.desc: Kansaldi hurls magical flames at a creature she can see within 60 feet of herself. The target must make a 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 11 (2d10) fire damage and catches fire; until a creature takes an action to put out the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and doesn't catch fire.

bonus_actions.name: Dragon Queen's Favor
bonus_actions.desc: Kansaldi or one creature she can see within 60 feet of herself magically regains 17 (2d12 + 4) hit points.

spells: Kansaldi casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 16):

spells.1/day each: blade barrier, dispel magic, flame strike, lesser restoration, revivify

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.desc: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, it dissolves into acid that splashes on those around it. Each creature within 5 feet of the draconian must succeed on a 12 Dexterity saving throw or be covered in acid for 1 minute. A creature covered in the acid takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can use its action to scrape or wash the acid off itself or another creature.

traits.name: Glide
traits.desc: When the draconian falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 100 feet from the fall when calculating the fall's damage, and it can move up to 2 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it descends.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The draconian makes two Dagger attacks. If both attacks hit the same creature, the target must succeed on a 12 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned until the end of the target's next turn. While poisoned in this way, the target is also paralyzed.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Hoopak
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 40/160 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage if the kender used the hoopak's sling to make a ranged attack.

actions.name: Taunt
actions.desc: The kender launches a barrage of insults at a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. If the target can hear the kender, the target must succeed on a 12 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Elusive
bonus_actions.desc: The kender takes the Disengage or Hide action.

monsters.name: Leedara
monsters.damage_resistances: acid, fire, lightning, thunder, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
monsters.languages: Any languages she knew in life

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.desc: Leedara can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when she is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: Leedara can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. She takes 5 (1d10) force damage if she ends her turn inside an object.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.desc: Leedara enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. She is visible on the Material Plane while she is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet she can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

actions.name: Horrifying Visage
actions.desc: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of Leedara that can see her must succeed on a 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to Leedara's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

actions.name: Possession (Recharge 6)
actions.desc:
One humanoid that the ghost can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by Leedara; Leedara then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Leedara now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Leedara can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and she retains her alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. She otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.
The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, Leedara ends it as a bonus action, or Leedara is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, Leedara reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to Leedara's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: Leedara magically assumes the appearance she had in life, and her creature type changes to Humanoid, while retaining her other game statistics. This transformation ends if Leedara is reduced to 0 hit points or uses an action to end it.

monsters.name: Lesser Death Dragon
monsters.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14
monsters.languages: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The dragon doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. one target. 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The dragon has two claws, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Cataclysmic Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The dragon exhales a wave of ghostly purple flames in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature dies if the breath reduces it to 0 hit points. Additionally, any Medium or smaller Humanoid killed by the breath's damage, as well as every corpse of such a creatures within the cone, becomes a zombie (see the Monster Manual) under the dragon's control. The zombie acts on the dragon's initiative but immediately after the dragon's turn. Absent any other command, the zombie tries to kill any non-Undead creature it encounters.

traits.name: Bonus Proficiencies
traits.desc: Levna is proficient with simple and martial weapons, shields, and all armor.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: Levna has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of her allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

reactions.name: Protection
reactions.desc: When a creature Levna can see within 5 feet of her is targeted by an attack, she can impose disadvantage on the attack roll if she can see the attacker and she is wielding a melee weapon.

monsters.name: Lohezet

traits.name: Toxic Mastery
traits.desc: Lohezet ignores a creature's resistance to poison damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Lohezet makes three Withering Blast attacks and uses Miasma if it's available. He can replace one of the attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Withering Blast
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 18 (2d12 + 5) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Miasma (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Lohezet magically conjures a billowing cloud of purple fog in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 120 feet of himself. The area within the sphere is heavily obscured, and when a creature starts its turn in the sphere or enters the sphere for the first time on a turn, it must make a 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 39 (6d12) poison damage and is poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned. The cloud lasts for 1 minute, until Lohezet ends it early (no action required), or until Lohezet uses this action again. A strong wind disperses the cloud.

reactions.name: Noxious Rebuke (3/Day)
reactions.desc: When a creature within 60 feet of Lohezet damages him, Lohezet magically retaliates with a spray of foul, purple mist. The creature must make a 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (2d10 + 5) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells: Lohezet casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 17):

spells.2/day each: dimension door, mage armor

spells.1/day each: arcane eye, dominate person, wall of force

monsters.name: Lord Soth

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Soth fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Soth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Marshal Undead
traits.desc: Unless Soth is incapacitated, he and Undead creatures of his choice within 60 feet of him are immune to features that turn Undead.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: Soth doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Soth makes three Forsaken Brand attacks.

actions.name: Forsaken Brand
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it can't regain hit points until the start of Soth's next turn.

actions.name: Cataclysmic Fire (1/Day)
actions.desc:
Soth hurls a magical ball of fire that explodes at a point he can see within 120 feet of himself. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a 19 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 35 (10d6) fire damage and 35 (10d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Additionally, any Medium or smaller Humanoid killed by this damage, as well as every corpse of such a creature within the sphere, becomes a skeleton (see the Monster Manual) under Soth's control. The skeleton acts on Soth's initiative but immediately after his turn. Absent any other command, the skeleton tries to kill any non-Undead creature it encounters.

actions.name: Word of Death (1/Day)
actions.desc: Soth points at a creature he can see within 60 feet of himself and magically commands it to die. The target must make a 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 100 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target dies.

legendary_actions.name: Implacable Maneuver
legendary_actions.desc: Soth moves up to his speed or commands a mount he is riding to move up to its speed. The movement from this action doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. If he or his mount moves within 5 feet of a creature during this movement, he can force the creature to make a 20 Strength saving throw. The creature is knocked prone unless it succeeds on the saving throw.

legendary_actions.name: Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Soth makes one Forsaken Brand attack.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Soth uses Spellcasting.

spells: Soth casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 19):

spells.2/day each: dispel magic, hold person (cast at 3rd level)

traits.name: Draconic Devotion
traits.desc: While Red Ruin can see a Dragon that isn't hostile to her, she has advantage on attack rolls.

traits.name: Mounted Combat Master
traits.desc: When Red Ruin is mounted and a creature targets her mount with an attack, Red Ruin can cause the attack to target her instead.

traits.name: Mounted Evasion
traits.desc: When Red Ruin or her mount makes a Dexterity saving throw to take half damage from an effect, they take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Ember Lance
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 16 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

actions.name: Explosive Hand Crossbow (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Red Ruin fires an explosive crossbow bolt at a point she can see within 120 feet of herself. When the bolt reaches that point, or if it hits an object early, it detonates in a 20-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that area must make a 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
traits.desc: The scout has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: The scout has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

traits.name: Child of the Sea
traits.desc: The scout can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The scout makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.desc: When the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points by a creature that is Large or smaller, the draconian crumbles into dust that then forms a spectral, shrieking image of the creature that killed it. The image lasts for 1 minute. Each creature hostile to the draconian within 10 feet of the image must succeed on a 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the spectral image for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The draconian makes two Serrated Sword attacks and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Serrated Sword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Shape Theft
reactions.desc: After the draconian kills a Medium or smaller Humanoid, the draconian magically cloaks itself in an illusion to look and feel like that creature while retaining the draconian's game statistics (other than its size). This transformation lasts until the draconian dies or uses a bonus action to end it.

monsters.name: Skeletal Knight
monsters.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.desc: If damage reduces the skeletal knight to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is bludgeoning or from a critical hit. On a success, the skeletal knight drops to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The skeletal knight doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The skeletal knight makes three Enervating Blade or Throwing Axe attacks in any combination.

actions.name: Enervating Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 15 (3d6 + 5) necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it can't regain hit points until the start of the skeletal knight's next turn.

actions.name: Throwing Axe
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Tem Temble

traits.name: Bonus Proficiencies
traits.desc: Tem is proficient with simple weapons and light armor.

actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 40/160 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, or 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage if Tem used the hoopak's sling to make a ranged attack.

actions.name: Taunt
actions.desc: Tem launches an infuriating barrage of insults at a creature she can see within 60 feet of her. If the target can hear Tem, it must succeed on a 12 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Elusive
bonus_actions.desc: Tem takes the Disengage or Hide action.

spells: Tem's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 12, +4 to spell attacks). She has the following druid spells prepared:

monsters.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 13
monsters.languages: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The dragonnel doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragonnel makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Acid Spit
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. 20 (5d6 + 3) acid damage.

monsters.name: Wersten Kern

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.desc: If damage reduces Wersten to 0 hit points, she must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is bludgeoning or from a critical hit. On a success, Wersten drops to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: Wersten doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Wersten makes three Banner Pike attacks and uses Terrifying Litany if it's available.

actions.name: Banner Pike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a 16 Charisma saving throw or be cursed. The curse lasts until it is lifted by remove curse or similar magic. Black, thorny rose stems sprout from the creature's body while it is cursed, imposing disadvantage on the creature's ability checks and attack rolls and halving its speed. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw against the curse is immune to it for 24 hours.

actions.name: Terrifying Litany (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Wersten recites names of souls slain by Soth and his company, channeling their mortal terror. Each creature that isn't an Undead within 30 feet of her must make a 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage and is frightened of Wersten for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't frightened. At the end of each of its turns, a frightened creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spells: Wersten casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 16):

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The absorber has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.desc: If the absorber moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits its claws attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the absorber can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The absorber makes three attacks: one with its bite or Mind Bolt and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) force damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) force damage.

actions.name: Mind Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. 22 (4d10) psychic damage.

reactions.name: Tail Ray
reactions.desc: When the absorber takes damage from a spell, the absorber takes only half the triggering damage. If the spellcaster is within 60 feet of the absorber, the absorber can force the caster to make a 16 Dexterity saving throw. Unless the save succeeds, the caster takes the other half of the damage.

monsters.name: Aeorian Nullifier

traits.name: Horrid Gnashing
traits.desc: The nullifier's mouths gnash incoherently while it can see any enemies. Each creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the nullifier and can hear it must make a 16 Wisdom saving throw. Unless the save succeeds, the creature rolls a d8 to determine what it does during the current turn:
The creature is stunned until the end of the turn.
The creature is frightened until the end of the turn and uses its movement to get as far as possible from the nullifier.
The creature doesn't move, and it uses its action to make one melee attack against a random creature (other than itself) if one is within reach. It otherwise does nothing

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The nullifier has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The nullifier makes three attacks: one with its bites and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bites
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 17 (2d12 + 4) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) force damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) force damage, and the target is grappled (escape 16) if it's a creature. The nullifier has two claws, each of which can grapple one creature.

reactions.name: Counterspell
reactions.desc: The nullifier attempts to interrupt a creature that it can see within 60 feet in the process of casting a spell. If the creature is casting a spell of 3rd level or lower, its spell fails and has no effect. If it is casting a spell of 4th level or higher, the nullifier makes a Charisma check with a DC equal to 10 + the spell's level. On a success, the creature's spell fails and has no effect.

spells: The nullifier's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spells.At will: counterspell (see "Reactions" below), detect magic, dispel magic, see invisibility

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, range 5 ft., one creature. 11 (1d12 + 5) piercing damage plus 6 (1d12) force damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) force damage.

reactions.name: Reversal
reactions.desc: When a creature the reverser can see within 30 feet of it regains hit points, the reverser reduces the number of hit points regained to 0, and the reverser deals 13 (3d8) force damage to the creature.

traits.desc: As a bonus action, the blood hunter targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.desc: The blood hunter has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The blood hunter has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Eldritch Blast (Cantrip)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +4 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. 7 (1d10 + 2) force damage.

legendary_actions.name: Incorporeal Dash
legendary_actions.desc: Bol'bara moves up to her speed. She can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. She takes 5 (1d10) force damage if she ends her turn inside an object.

legendary_actions.name: Zone of Calamity (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: A 15-foot-radius sphere of magical confusion extends from a point Bol'bara can see within 60 feet of her and spreads around corners. Each creature that starts its turn in that area is treated as if targeted by the confusion spell (save 12). The sphere lasts as long as Bol'bara maintains {@status concentration}, up to 1 minute (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell).

spells: Bol'bara's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spells.At will: eldritch blast, false life, mage armor, mage hand

spells.1/day each: charm person, hex, hold person, invisibility

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.desc: The moorbounder's long jump is up to 40 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Claw

actions.name: Eye Ray
actions.desc: Belashyrra shoots one of the following magical eye rays of its choice, targeting one creature it can see within 120 feet of it:

actions.name: 1. Psyche-Reconstruction Ray
actions.desc: The target must make a 22 Wisdom saving throw, taking 49 (9d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it dies and transforms into a spectator under Belashyrra's control and acts immediately after Belashyrra in the initiative order. The target can't be returned to its original form by any means short of a wish spell.

actions.name: 2. Domination Ray
actions.desc: The target must succeed on a 22 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by Belashyrra for 1 minute or until the target takes damage. Belashyrra can issue telepathic commands to the charmed creature (no action required), which it does its best to obey.

actions.name: 3. Mind-Weakening Ray
actions.desc: The target must succeed on a 22 Intelligence saving throw or take 36 (8d8) psychic damage and be unable to cast spells or activate magic items for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: 4. Blinding Ray
actions.desc: The target and each creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a 22 Constitution saving throw or take 19 (3d12) radiant damage and be blinded for 1 minute. Until this blindness ends, Belashyrra can see through the blinded creature's eyes. The blinded creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.desc:
One humanoid that the quori can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a 16 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the quori; the quori then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The quori now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The quori can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.
The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the quori ends it as a bonus action, or the quori is forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the quori reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. Whenever the dracohydra takes 30 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the dracohydra dies.
At the end of its turn, the dracohydra grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken radiant damage since its last turn. The dracohydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown this way.

The object uses the shard's AC, and any damage dealt to the object applies to the shard's hit points. The shard inhabits the object until it uses an action to leave; until it is turned; until it is reduced to 0 hit points; or until an effect that ends possession, such as a dispel evil and good spell, is used on it. When it leaves the object, it reappears in the nearest unoccupied space.
While inhabited, the object becomes a magic item if it wasn't already, and a Tiny cracked gemstone matching the kind of gem dragon the shard was in life appears somewhere on the object. The shard can cause the object to fly using the shard's own flying speed, use its senses, speak verbally or telepathically, cast spells, and use its legendary actions.
If a creature wears or carries the inhabited object, the shard can grant the creature the following benefits:
Each of the creature's attacks deals an extra 1d8 force damage on a hit.
The creature gains resistance to psychic damage.

While charmed in this way, the target becomes the shard's puppet, acting and moving in accordance with its telepathic commands. While under the shard's control, the target can take only the Attack (shard chooses the target) or Dash action on its turn.

When the period of unconsciousness ends, the creature transforms into a mind flayer (see the Monster Manual) with all its hit points. Casting a wish spell on the unconscious creature rids it of the infestation and prevents it from turning into a mind flayer.

actions.name: Claw

actions.name: Terrifying Breath (Recharge 6)

The ghost dragon exhales shadowy mist in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 40 (9d8) cold damage and is frightened of the ghost dragon for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't frightened.

If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to this ghost dragon's Terrifying Breath for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)

actions.desc: Isperia chooses up to three creatures she can see within 90 feet of her. monsters.name: Lazav
