traits.desc: The ravager's Claw, Bite, and Spines attacks are magical.

traits.name: Spiked Hide
traits.desc: At the start of each of its turns, the ravager deals 16 (3d10) piercing damage to any creature grappling it or being grappled by it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ravager makes one Bite attack and then either two Claw attacks or two Spines attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 22 (3d8 + 9) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 21 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this attack reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 25 (3d10 + 9) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 21 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this attack reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or other magic. Large or smaller creatures damaged by this attack are grappled (escape 20) and the ravager can't make another Bite attack until this grapple ends.

actions.name: Spines
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +14 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. 17 (3d6 + 7) piercing damage. If the target fails a 19 Constitution saving throw, they are stunned until the end of their next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Detect
legendary_actions.desc: The ravager makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary_actions.name: Spiky Carapace
legendary_actions.desc: The ravager flares its numerous spines and they elongate. Any creature within 5 feet of the ravager must make a 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (5d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Smash (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The ravager smashes downwards with great force, causing a violent implosion. Any creature within 10 feet of the ravager must make a 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures that fail the saving throw are also pulled 5 feet towards the ravager. The noise produced by this attack can be heard up to 1 mile away.

monsters.name: Bhaal, Slayer
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, incapacitated, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, stunned, unconscious

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.desc: During its first turn, the slayer has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the slayer scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the slayer's darkvision.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The slayer is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form, except for its Ravager Form ability.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: If the slayer fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The slayer has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The slayer's claw attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The slayer makes four Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 19 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this attack reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

bonus_actions.name: Prey
bonus_actions.desc: The slayer focuses on a single creature it can see within 60 feet. Afterwards, the first time each turn that the slayer hits that creature, the slayer does an additional 7 (2d6) damage.

legendary_actions.name: Savage Disengage
legendary_actions.desc: The slayer disengages without provoking opportunity attacks. If it moves within 5 feet of a creature it makes a Claw attack against the creature.

legendary_actions.name: Finish (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The slayer attacks a creature that has been marked by its Prey ability. If this attack hits and the creature has less than 40 hit points remaining after the attack, the creature is reduced to 0 hit points.

legendary_actions.name: Ravager Form (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: If the slayer has killed a creature of CR/level 5 or greater that it previously marked with its Prey ability in the last minute, it can transform into its Bhaal, Ravager. The form lasts until dawn (minimum 1 hour).

monsters.name: Bodhi Irenicus
monsters.damage_resistances: necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical weapons

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Bodhi fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Bodhi regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn if she has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight. If she takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of her next turn.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: If Bodhi is destroyed, her body immediately appears in her resting place. She is paralyzed until she regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 24 hours in her resting place with 0 hit points, she regains 1 hit point. While paralyzed in this manner, if a creature within 60 feet says her name 9 times, Bodhi is permanently destroyed.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: Bodhi deals an extra 28 (8d6) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Bodhi that isn't incapacitated and Bodhi doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: Bodhi can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Summoned By Name (1/Day)
traits.desc: If a creature says Bodhi Irenicus's full name 9 times in a row, Bodhi hears her name and becomes aware of the creature. Bodhi knows the exact location and name of the creature that spoke her name. She can then choose, as a free action, to teleport to a location adjacent to the creature. She must choose to do this within 1 minute of hearing her name. This power works even if the creature is on a different plane of existence. 1 minute after teleporting, Bodhi teleports back to where she was located when she heard her name spoken. This occurs even if Bodhi is unwilling and even if she is in an antimagic effect.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.desc: Bodhi Irenicus has the following flaws:

traits.name: Elvish Song
traits.desc: Bodhi can't abide a song performed in the elvish language. A creature that can speak the elvish language can use an action to sing an elven song. If Bodhi is within 60 feet of the singer and can hear the song, she has disadvantage on attacks and saving throws.

traits.name: Stake to the Heart
traits.desc: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Bodhi's heart while she is incapacitated in her resting place, Bodhi is paralyzed until the stake is removed.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.desc: Bodhi takes 20 radiant damage when she starts her turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, she has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

actions.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: Bodhi makes three Unarmed Strike attacks, one of which can be a Bite attack instead.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, Bodhi can grapple a Medium-sized or smaller target (escape 18).

actions.name: Bite (Panther or Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Bodhi regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Bodhi's control.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: If Bodhi isn't in sunlight, she can polymorph into a Medium panther or back into her true form. While in panther form, Bodhi Irenicus can't speak, her walking speed is 40 feet, and she has a climb speed of 30 feet. Her statistics, other than her size and speed, are unchanged. Anything she is wearing transforms with her, but nothing she is carrying does. She reverts to her true form if she dies.

actions.name: Charm
actions.desc: Bodhi targets one Humanoid she can see within 30 feet of her. If the target can see Bodhi, the target must succeed on a 17 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by Bodhi. The charmed target regards Bodhi as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under Bodhi's control, it takes Bodhi's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can. Each time Bodhi or her allies do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Bodhi is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: Bodhi moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Unarmed Strike
legendary_actions.desc: Bodhi makes one Unarmed Strike.

legendary_actions.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Bodhi makes one Bite attack.

monsters.name: Borivik Windheim

traits.name: Bolts of Undead Slaying
traits.desc: Borivik has a half-dozen bolts of undead slaying. If he strikes an Undead creature with one of these magic bolts, it must make a 17 Constitution saving throw, taking an extra 33 (6d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much extra damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Borivik makes two Shortsword attacks or two Heavy Crossbow attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +9 to hit, ranged 100/400 ft., one target. 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Crossbow Expert
bonus_actions.desc: Borivik adds 1d10 to his next attack or damage roll with his Heavy Crossbow attack.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.desc: Borivik can take the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Enduring Response
reactions.desc: When Borivik takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, he gains immunity to that damage type until the start of his next turn. Also, the first time he hits with a Shortsword attack on his next turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) of the triggering damage type.

spells: Borivik casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 15):

spells.2/day each: cordon of arrows, daylight, lesser restoration, nondetection

monsters.name: Cornelius Watson
monsters.languages: Celestial, Common, Dwarvish, Gnomish, Halfling, Infernal

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Doc Watson has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Portent (Recharge 6)
traits.desc: When Doc Watson or a creature he can see makes an attack roll, a saving throw, or an ability check, Doc Watson can roll a d20 and choose to use this roll in place of the attack roll, saving throw, or ability check. This trait recharges after using the Spellcasting action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Doc Watson makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 32 (5d10 + 5) lightning damage.

spells: Doc Watson casts one of the following spells using Intelligence as his spellcasting ability (spell save 17):

spells.At will: detect magic, identify, mage armor, Rary's telepathic bond

spells.2/day each: clairvoyance, locate object, scrying

monsters.name: Cryonax
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone

traits.name: Cold Aura
traits.desc: At the start of each of Cryonax's turns, each creature within 10 feet of him takes 21 (6d6) cold damage. A creature also takes 21 (6d6) cold damage if they touch or hit Cryonax. Nonmagical weapons that hit Cryonax are frozen immediately after dealing damage to Cryonax. If used again and they hit any creature, the weapon shatters. The freezing effect disappears after an hour.

traits.name: Empowered Attacks
traits.desc: Cryonax's Slam attacks are treated as magical for the purpose of bypassing resistance and immunity to nonmagical weapons.

traits.name: Ice Walker
traits.desc: No ability checks are required when Cryonax walks or climbs across icy surfaces and difficult snow or ice terrain does not cost him extra movement.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Cryonax fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Cryonax has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Cryonax makes two Slam attacks with his tentacles or two Ice Spear attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 27 (3d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape 20). Cryonax can grapple up to two targets but any tentacle that is grappling can't be used to make a Slam or Ice Spear attack.

actions.name: Ice Spear
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 36 (6d10 + 3) cold damage.

actions.name: Summon Frost Horde (1/Day)
actions.desc: Cryonax summons two young white dragon. The summoning costs Cryonax 50 hit points. The summoned creatures have maximum hit points and appear within 100 feet of Cryonax.

legendary_actions.name: Smash
legendary_actions.desc: Cryonax slams a grappled target against the ground, dealing 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage to it.

legendary_actions.name: Tentacle Freeze
legendary_actions.desc: Cryonax's tentacle freezes a grappled target. If the target fails a 22 Constitution saving throw they are paralyzed and Cryonax releases them from its tentacle. They remain frozen indefinitely but can attempt the Constitution saving throw at the end of each of their turns. Success means they are no longer frozen.

legendary_actions.name: Ice Shroud (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: With a gesture Cryonax targets a frozen creature (see Tentacle Freeze) that is within 30 feet of him. The target is encased instantly in a hard shell of crushing ice. The target receives no saving throw and takes 22 (5d8) cold damage immediately and at the start of each of their turns. The target is considered stunned but is partly protected by the shroud and resistant to all damage. The shroud disappears if Cryonax removes it, Cryonax dies, the shroud takes 100 hit points of damage or another character uses their action and succeeds on a 22 Strength check to remove the trapped ally.

spells: Cryonax casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 21, +13 to hit with spell attacks):

spells.At will: ice storm, sleet storm, wall of ice

spells.2/day each: cone of cold, otiluke's freezing sphere (45 (13d6) damage)

monsters.name: Dagryn

traits.name: Draconic Transformation
traits.desc: When Dagryn drops to 0 hit points, instead of falling unconscious, he transforms into his dragon form. He immediately gains all the statistics of an adult black dragon with the exception that his size is Medium, and has the stunned condition. At the start of his next turn, he grows to Large size, but remains stunned. At the start of his subsequent turn, Dagryn grows to Huge size and is no longer stunned. Dagryn remains in his dragon form for 24 hours whereupon he reverts to this stat block.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.desc: Dagryn has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, and illusions, as well as to resist being charmed or paralyzed.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Eruption
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 14 (2d10 + 3) acid damage.

bonus_actions.name: Invisibility (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
bonus_actions.desc: Dagryn magically turns invisible for 1 hour or until he attacks or casts a spell. Any equipment Dagryn wears or carries turns invisible with him.

spells: Dagryn casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 13):

spells.At will: alter self, disguise self, levitate, major image, vicious mockery

spells.2/day each: bane, fear, hold monster, misty step

monsters.name: Darien
monsters.languages: Aquan, Auran, Common, Elvish, Giant, telepathy 30 ft.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Darien can see normally in darkness, both magical and nonmagical, to a distance of 120 feet

traits.name: Eldritch Mind
traits.desc: Darien has advantage on Constitution saving throws that she makes to maintain {@status concentration} on a spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Darien makes two War Pick attacks.

actions.name: War Pick
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 4 necrotic damage.

actions.name: Eldritch Blast
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +8 to hit, range 300 ft., three targets. 9 (1d10 + 4) force damage.

actions.name: Create Thrall
actions.desc: Darien touches an incapacitated Humanoid. That creature is then charmed by her until a remove curse spell is cast on it, the charmed condition is removed from it, or she uses this feature again. Darien can communicate telepathically with the charmed creature as long as the two of them are on the same plane of existence.

actions.name: Summon War Pick
actions.desc: Darien creates a magical war pick in her empty hand. The war pick counts as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage. The war pick has a +1 bonus to attack and damage (already factored into Darien's attacks).

reactions.name: Shield of Cryonax (1/Day)
reactions.desc: When Darien takes damage, she can entomb herself in ice, which melts away at the end of her next turn. She gains 150 temporary hit points, which take as much of the triggering damage as possible. Immediately after she takes the damage, she gains vulnerability to fire damage, her speed is reduced to 0, and she is incapacitated. These effects, including any remaining temporary hit points, all end when the ice melts.

spells: Darien casts one of the following spells, requiring no material component and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks):

spells.At will: alter self, blade ward, chill touch, disguise self, false life, invisibility, mage armor (self only), silent image

spells.2/day each: armor of Agathys, cone of cold, darkness, fear, hallucinatory terrain, hold person, hypnotic pattern, major image, mirror image, mislead, sleet storm

spells.1/day each: dream, feeblemind, mass suggestion, project image

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The deep spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Sense
traits.desc: While in contact with a web, the deep spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.desc: The deep spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The deep spider makes one Bite attack and two Foreleg attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must make a 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and has the paralyzed condition while poisoned in this way.

actions.name: Foreleg
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 19 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Dread Doppelganger

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.desc: The dread doppelganger has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The dread doppelganger can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium Humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.desc: If the dread doppelganger surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 17 (5d6) damage from the attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dread doppelganger makes three Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. 10 (1d8 + 6).

actions.name: Read Thoughts
actions.desc: The dread doppelganger magically reads the surface thoughts of one creature within 60 feet of it. The effect can penetrate barriers, but 3 ft. of wood or dirt, 2 feet of stone, 2 inches of metal, or a thin sheet of lead blocks it. While the target is in range, the dread doppelganger can continue reading its thoughts, as long as the dread doppelganger's Concentration isn't broken (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). While reading the target's mind, the doppelganger has advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, and Persuasion) checks against the target.

spells: The dread doppelganger casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 14):

spells.2/day each: phantasmal killer

monsters.name: Edwin Odesseiron
monsters.languages: Abyssal, Aquan, Auran, Common, Ignan, Infernal, Terran, Thayan

traits.name: Contingency
traits.desc: If Edwin has the incapacitated, paralyzed, or stunned condition, a contingency spell triggers, casting dispel magic at 6th level, targeting Edwin. He also has a body created by the clone spell stored in a cavern one mile beneath the city of Baldur's Gate.

traits.name: Simulacrum
traits.desc: Edwin is always accompanied by a simulacrum of himself. The copy is identical to him in all respects except that it has 58 hit points, does not have the staff of power and can only cast the 'at will' spells available in Edwin's Spellcasting feature.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Edwin wields a staff of power. While held the staff grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and a +2 bonus to armor class, saving throws, and spell attack rolls (all factored into Edwin's statistics).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Edwin makes a Staff of Power attack or uses Spellcasting or Staff Spellcasting. He then makes two Elemental Blast attacks.

actions.name: Staff of Power
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands. Edwin can expend one of the staff's charges to deal an extra 14 (4d6) force damage on a hit.

actions.name: Elemental Blast
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 38 (6d10 + 5) acid, cold, lightning, or fire damage.

actions.name: Edwin's Choking Cloud (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Edwin creates a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous fog centered on a point within 120 feet. The cloud spreads around corners but lasts only until the start of Edwin's next turn. When a creature enters the cloud's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must make a 18 Constitution saving throw. The creature takes 45 (10d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures are affected even if they hold their breath or don't need to breathe.

bonus_actions.name: Summon Hell Hounds
bonus_actions.desc: Edwin magically summons three hell hound. The summoned hell hounds appear in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Edwin, and act as Edwin's allies. They remain for 10 minutes, until they or Edwin dies, or until Edwin dismisses them as an action.

reactions.name: Edwin's Evasive Footwork
reactions.desc: As a reaction to taking damage, Edwin teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that he can see.

spells: Edwin casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 18):

spells.At will: mage armor, mirror image, shield, unseen servant

spells.2/day each: contingency, counterspell, dispel magic, fireball, simulacrum, scrying

spells: While holding the staff of power, Edwin casts one of the following spells (spell save 18, +12 to hit with spell attacks). These spells require charges; the staff has 20 charges, and it regains 2d8 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. 1 charge each: magic missile, ray of enfeeblement 2 charges: levitate 5 charges each: cone of cold, fireball (5th level), hold monster, lightning bolt (5th level), wall of force 6 charges: globe of invulnerability

monsters.name: Eo Ashmajiir
monsters.languages: Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, Undercommon

traits.name: Lightning Affinity
traits.desc: When Eo uses Spellcasting to cast a spell that deals lightning damage, that spell deals an additional 5 damage. When Eo casts a spell that deals a type of damage from the following list, she can change that damage type to lightning: acid, cold, fire, poison, thunder.

actions.name: Twinned Orbs
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft., two targets. 27 (5d8 + 5) acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or thunder damage (Eo's choice).

actions.name: Twinned Spell
actions.desc: Eo uses Spellcasting to cast banishment, dominate person, finger of death, or power word stun. This spell targets a second creature in range.

actions.name: Discharge (1/Day)
actions.desc: Eo emits a thin green ray at a creature within 60 feet. The target must make a 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save the target takes 89 (14d6 + 40) force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, it is disintegrated. A disintegrated creature and everything it is wearing and carrying, except magic items, are reduced to a pile of fine gray dust. The creature can be restored to life only by means of a true resurrection or a wish spell.

reactions.name: Shocking Rebuke
reactions.desc: As a reaction to taking damage, Eo surrounds her attacker with a coil of lightning. The target must make a 17 Dexterity saving throw. It takes 16 (2d10 + 5) lightning damage on a failed save, half as much damage on a successful one.

spells: Eo casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks):

spells.At will: detect magic, detect thoughts, light, mage hand, magic missile, prestidigitation, shield, shocking grasp

spells.2/day each: banishment, counterspell, dominate person, fireball, lightning bolt, mirror image, misty step

spells.1/day each: chain lightning, finger of death, power word stun, teleport, wish*

monsters.spellsNotes: * Eo uses wish to ensure she has a simulacrum of herself at all times.

monsters.name: Faldorn

traits.name: Staff of the Woodlands
traits.desc: This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it and grants Faldorn a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls (already factored into Faldorn's attacks). The staff has 10 charges. It regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges each dawn. Faldorn can use an action to expend 1 or more of the staff's charges to cast one of the following spells from it, with a spell save DC of 14:

traits.name: 1 charge each: animal friendship, speak with animals
2 charges each: barkskin, locate animals or plants

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Faldorn makes two Staff of the Woodlands attacks and uses Spellcasting. Or she uses Spellcasting and then Change Shape if available.

actions.name: Staff of the Woodlands
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Shadowlight (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: A beam of dim light emerges from Faldorn in a 5-foot-wide, 300-foot-long line. Each creature in the line must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 27 (6d8) radiant damage and is blinded until Faldorn's next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't blinded.

actions.name: Change Shape (2/Day)
actions.desc: Faldorn magically polymorphs into a Beast or Elemental with a challenge rating of 6 or less, and can remain in this form for up to 9 hours. Faldorn reverts to her true form if she dies or falls unconscious. She can revert to her true form using a bonus action on her turn. While in a new form, Faldorn retains her game statistics and ability to speak, but her AC, movement modes, Strength, and Dexterity are replaced by those of the new form, and she gains any special senses, proficiencies, traits, actions, and reactions (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that she lacks. She can cast her spells with verbal or somatic components in her new form. The new form's attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistances and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

spells: Faldorn casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 18):

spells.2/day each: entangle, locate creature, speak with animals, stoneskin, tree stride, water breathing

monsters.name: Farastu Stalker
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, fire, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Adhesive Slime
traits.desc: The farastu secretes a thick, tar-like slime and it can choose to use this slime to secure enemies that it has grappled or to make weapons become attached to it. It is able to end the adhesion with a bonus action, causing all items and creatures secured to it to be released. The adhesion also ends after the farastu dies.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the farastu's darkvision.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The farastu has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The farastu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The farastu's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.desc: At the start of its turn, the farastu can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The farastu makes one Bite attack and two Claws attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage. The target is held fast by the farastu's adhesive slime (grappled condition, escape 15) if the farastu isn't already grappling a creature.

reactions.name: Adhesive Hide
reactions.desc: After taking damage from a melee weapon, the farastu uses its reaction to attach the weapon to its hide. The attacker must make a 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the weapon becomes attached to the farastu's adhesive hide until the farastu dies or releases the weapon. A creature can also use an action to make a 15 Strength check, prying the weapon free from the farastu, if successful.

monsters.name: Flimp Shagglecran

traits.name: Battle Smith
traits.desc: Flimp uses his Intelligence modifier for attack and damage rolls with his weapons.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.desc: Flimp has advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws against magic.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Flimp wears a cloak of the manta ray, a cloak of protection, +2 plate armor, and winged boots. Flimp wields a +2 warhammer. These items vanish 4 days after Flimp dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Flimp makes two Magic Warhammer attacks.

actions.name: Magic Warhammer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) force damage.

actions.name: Hurl Acid (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Flimp hurls a vial of acid at a location within 60 feet. Every creature within 10 feet of the target location must succeed on a 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Summon Steel Defender (1/Day)
actions.desc: Flimp summons a Steel Defender to aid him in combat. The panther has 24 hit points and is immune to poison damage and the poison and charmed conditions.

reactions.name: Flash of Genius
reactions.desc: When Flimp or another creature he can see within 30 feet of him makes an ability check or a saving throw, Flimp can use his reaction to add +4 to the roll.

spells: Flimp casts one of the following spells using Intelligence as his spellcasting ability (spell save 16):

spells.2/day each: aid, blur, cure wounds, shield

traits.name: Aversion to Fire
traits.desc: If the gibberling takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Incessant Gibberish
traits.desc: Any non-gibberling that is within 30 feet of the gibberling and doesn't have the deafened condition has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain {@status concentration} on spells and similar effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Hamadryad

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The hamadryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
traits.desc: The hamadryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

traits.name: Tree Stride
traits.desc: Once on her turn, the hamadryad can use 10 feet of her movement to step magically into one living tree within her reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large in size or bigger.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hamadryad makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

spells: The hamadryad casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 12):

spells.2/day each: entangle

spells.1/day each: barkskin, grasping vine, pass without trace

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If Imoen is subjected to an effect that allows her to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, Imoen instead takes no damage if she succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if she fails.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: Imoen deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Imoen that isn't incapacitated and Imoen doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: Imoen can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, Imoen has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Imoen makes two Shortsword attacks and one Hand Crossbow attack.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +7 to hit, range 30/210 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.desc: Imoen takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

monsters.name: Jaheira

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Jaheira has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Jaheira to sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Jaheira makes three Quarterstaff attacks.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) thunder damage.

actions.name: Cleansing Plague (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Jaheira targets a creature she can see within 60 feet and causes a swarm of flying insects to cover the creature. The creature must make a 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target fails their saving throw they are also blinded until the end of their next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Mighty Summons (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: Jaheira summons three CR 2 Beasts or six CR 1 Beasts. These summoned creatures have maximum hit points and the damage they inflict is considered magical for the purpose of overcoming immunity and resistance to nonmagical attacks and damage.

spells: Jaheira casts ones of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 18):

spells.At will: barkskin, druidcraft, poison spray, produce flame, shillelagh

spells.2/day each: animal messenger, commune with nature (as an action), entangle, speak with animals

monsters.name: Jon Irenicus
monsters.damage_immunities: poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.languages: Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Elvish, Infernal, Sylvan

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Jon Irenicus fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: If he has a phylactery and he is destroyed, Jon Irenicus gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all his hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Jon Irenicus carries a rod of lordly might. He can use a bonus action to switch it between its Mace attacks.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.desc: Jon Irenicus has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns Undead.

actions.name: Multiattack (only useable with Transformation)
actions.desc: Jon Irenicus makes two Flame Tongue attacks or two Mace attacks. Each attack is made with advantage and does an additional 13 (2d12) force damage if it hits.

actions.name: Flame Tongue (Rod of Lordly Might)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (1d8 + 7) slashing damage and 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Mace (Rod of Lordly Might)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (1d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Breath of Death (1/Day)
actions.desc: Jon Irenicus emits a 90-foot cone of necrotic energy. Each creature in the effects area must make a 21 saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Draining Counterspell
reactions.desc: Jon Irenicus interrupts a creature he can see that is casting a spell. If the spell is 3rd level or lower, it fails and has no effect. If the spell is 4th level or higher, Jon Irenicus makes an Intelligence check (10 + the spell's level). On a success, the spell fails and has no effect. Whatever the spell's level, the caster takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage if the spell fails.

legendary_actions.name: Drain Life (1/Day)
legendary_actions.desc: Jon Irenicus makes a drain life attack with his rod of lordly might. If he hits a creature with his rod, the creature must make a 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes an extra 14 (4d6) necrotic damage, and Jon regains a number of hit points equal to half that necrotic damage.

legendary_actions.name: Paralyze (1/Day)
legendary_actions.desc: Jon Irenicus makes a paralyze attack with his rod of lordly might. If he hits a creature with his rod, the creature must make a 17 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the paralyzed condition for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Jon Irenicus uses Spellcasting.

legendary_actions.name: Transformation (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Jon Irenicus becomes endowed with endurance and martial prowess for 1 minute or until he ends this effect by using a bonus action. While transformed, he gains 50 temporary hit points, proficiency in Strength and Constitution saving throw, adds his Multiattack feature, and loses his Draining Counterspell reaction and Spellcasting action.

spells: Jon Irenicus casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 21, +13 to hit with spell attacks):

spells.At will: Melf's acid arrow, detect magic, detect thoughts, invisibility, magic missile, mage hand, mirror image, prestidigitation, ray of frost, shield

spells.2/day each: animate dead, dimension door, dispel magic, fireball, scrying

spells.1/day each: disintegrate, dominate monster, finger of death, power word kill, power word stun, time stop

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Kagain wields a +3 greataxe. While Kagain is attuned to this weapon, his hit point maximum increases to 178. Whenever a hostile creature damages Kagain while the axe is in his possession, he must succeed on a 15 Wisdom saving throw or go berserk. He can choose to fail this saving throw. While berserk, Kagain gains advantage on all melee attacks and attacks made against him are made with advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Kagain makes three attacks with his Berserking Greataxe.

actions.name: Berserking Greataxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (1d12 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

legendary_actions.name: Weapon Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Kagain makes a Berserking Greataxe attack.

legendary_actions.name: Berserk Whirlwind (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Kagain makes a Berserking Greataxe attack against every creature within 5 feet of him.

monsters.name: Kelubar Consul
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, fire, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the kelubar's darkvision.

traits.name: Freedom of Movement
traits.desc: The kelubar is unaffected by difficult terrain, and spells and other magical affects don't reduce its speed or cause it to be paralyzed or restrained. If the kelubar spends 5 feet of movement is automatically escapes from nonmagical restraints or a creature that has it grappled. It is also able to move underwater with no movement or attack penalties.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The kelubar has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The kelubar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The kelubar's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.desc: At the start of its turn, the kelubar can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: The kelubar deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 ft. of an ally of the kelubar that isn't incapacitated and the kelubar doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Stench
traits.desc: Any creature that is not a demodand and starts its turn within 30 feet of the kelubar must succeed on a 16 Constitution saving throw or or have the poisoned condition for 1 minute. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of this kelubar for 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kelubar makes one Bite attack and three Claws attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

bonus_actions.name: Summon Demodand (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The kelubar rolls a d6. A result of 1-2 summons in two allied farastu stalker.

reactions.name: Impossible Dodge
reactions.desc: When an attacker that the kelubar can see hits it with an attack, the kelubar can use its reaction to halve the attack's damage.

spells: The kelubar casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 16):

spells.At will: clairvoyance, detect magic, fear, invisibility (self only), spider climb, tongues

spells.2/day each: dispel magic, fog cloud

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Kivan has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Kivan to sleep.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
traits.desc: Kivan has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Kivan makes three Longsword attacks or three Longbow attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +7 to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Volley (2/Day)
actions.desc: Kivan makes a Longbow attack against any number of creatures he can see within 150 feet. He must make a separate attack roll with advantage for each target.

bonus_actions.name: Kivan's Mark
bonus_actions.desc: Kivan designates one creature he can see within 60 feet as his prey. The first time each turn that Kivan hits his prey with a weapon attack, the prey takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage from the weapon.

monsters.name: Lothar
monsters.speed: 30 ft., fly 50 ft. in raven and hybrid forms
monsters.damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing damage from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.desc: Lothar can mimic simple sounds he has heard, such as a person whispering, a baby crying, or an animal chittering. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful 15 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Lothar makes three Greataxe attacks.

actions.name: Greataxe (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage, 14 (1d12 + 8) while in a rage.

actions.name: Beak (Raven or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 1 piercing damage in raven form, or 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage in hybrid form. If the target is Humanoid, it must succeed on a 15 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with wereraven lycanthropy.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: Lothar can use his action to polymorph into a raven-humanoid hybrid, or into a Small raven, or back into his true form, which is Humanoid. His statistics, other than his size, are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. Lothar reverts to his true form if he dies.

bonus_actions.name: Rage
bonus_actions.desc: Lothar rages for 1 minute. During his rage he has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. He gains a +4 bonus to damage while he is in a rage. He has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage while in a rage. Lothar can't cast spells while in a rage.

spells: Lothar casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks):

spells.1/day each: bane, charm person, daylight, faerie fire, fear, misty step, plane shift

traits.name: Boo, The Miniature Giant Space Hamster
traits.desc: Boo is Minsc's animal companion. Boo is a miniature giant space hamster and has the statistics of a rat.

traits.name: Favored Enemy
traits.desc: Minsc's favored enemy is evil. When he hits an evil creature with a melee attack he deals an additional 7 (2d6) slashing damage.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.desc: At the start of his turn, Minsc may choose to gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against him have advantage until the start of his next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Minsc makes two Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage

bonus_actions.name: Go for the Eyes, Boo
bonus_actions.desc: As a bonus action, Minsc talks to Boo and gains the inspiration to go into a berserker fury, for 1 minute. While in this berserking fury Minsc gains the following:

bonus_actions.name: Minsc has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
Minsc gains a +4 bonus to damage rolls when using a melee weapon.
Minsc has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
Minsc can make a single melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each of his turns.
Minsc can't be charmed or frightened. If Minsc is charmed or frightened when he enters his berserking fury, the effect is suspended for the duration of the rage

If Minsc drops to 0 hit points and doesn't die outright, he can make a 10 Constitution saving throw. If he succeeds, he drops to 1 hit point instead. Each time he uses this feature after the first, the DC increases by 5. After 24 hours, the DC resets to 10.

reactions.name: Run, Boo, Run
reactions.desc: If Boo takes damage, Minsc can choose to take the damage instead.

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.desc: During his first turn, Montaron has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit Montaron scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If Montaron is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, Montaron instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails.

traits.name: Nimbleness
traits.desc: Montaron can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than his.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: Montaron deals an extra 21 (6d6) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Montaron that isn't incapacitated and Montaron doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Montaron possesses a bag of holding. He keeps the demilich, Xzar, in the bag. He also possesses a portable hole, which he uses to aid in robberies. As a bonus action, Montaron can place his portable hole in his bag of holding. This instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. Montaron and any creature within 10 feet of him is sucked through the gate to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Montaron makes three Shortsword attacks and uses the ability Unleash the Demilich if available.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must make a 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +9 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Unleash the Demilich (1/Day)
actions.desc: Montaron reaches inside his bag of holding and releases Xzar. Xzar is a demilich and appears within 5 feet of Montaron. Xzar rolls for his own initiative. Xzar can't use lair actions or legendary actions. He has a CR of 14.

monsters.name: Naes Inuus

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Corona of Beauty
actions.desc: Naes activates an aura of sunlight that lasts for 1 minute or until he dismisses it using an action. He emits bright light in a 60-foot-radius and dim light 30 feet beyond that. His enemies in the bright light have disadvantage on saving throws against any spell that deals fire or radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Beauty of Sune (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Naes dispels any magical darkness within 30 feet of him. Additionally, each hostile creature within 30 feet of Naes that does not have Cover must make a 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 60 radiant damage on a failed saving throw, half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the saving throw has the blinded condition for 1 minute.

reactions.name: Hard to Kill (1/Day)
reactions.desc: If Naes would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, or is subjected to an effect that would kill him instantaneously without doing damage, Naes instead drops to 1 hit point.

spells: Naes casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 18):

spells.2/day each: antilife shell, blade barrier

traits.name: Potion Mishap
traits.desc: When Nauk uses the Imbibe Potion action more than once in an hour, roll 1d4 for what happens:

traits.name: 2. The potion works normally. In addition, Nauk turns invisible for 1 minute or until Nauk attacks or casts a spell.
4. Instead of the normal effect, the potion causes fire to explode out of Nauk's mouth in a 15 foot cone. Nauk and any creature in the cone take 21 (6d6) fire damage.
Relentless
traits.desc: When Nauk is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, he can drop to 1 hit point instead. He can't use this feature again for 24 hours

traits.name: Special Items
traits.desc: Nauk wears adamantine plate armor. He wields a +1 maul and a +1 heavy crossbow which is already factored into his stats. He has 2 potion of cold resistance.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Nauk makes three Magic Maul attacks. Nauk may substitute one of those attacks for the Imbibe Potion action.

actions.name: Magic Maul
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +6 to hit, ranged 100/400 ft., one target. 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Imbibe Potion
actions.desc: Nauk drinks a potion from the following list:

actions.name: Potion of heroism: Nauk gains 10 temporary hit points for 1 hour. For the same duration, Nauk is under the effect of the bless spell (no {@status concentration} required).
Potion of resistance: Nauk gains resistance from one damage type for 1 hour. Nauk chooses from one of these damage types: cold, fire, lightning.
Potion of superior healing: Nauk regains 28 hit points.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Nauk adds 4 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Nauk must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monsters.name: Pazuzu
monsters.damage_immunities: lightning, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Aura of Servile Avians
traits.desc: Any evil creature with a natural fly speed and a CR of 20 or less must make a 21 Wisdom saving throw if they attempt to attack Pazuzu. A failed save means their action is wasted and the attack fails. On a successful saving throw the target is immune to this effect in the future.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Pazuzu fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Pazuzu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Pazuzu's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Pazuzu makes two Greatsword or Talon attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Talon
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Pazuzu exhales poisonous acid in a 100-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Every creature hit by the acid must make a 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature killed by this breath weapon melts and is disintegrated.

bonus_actions.name: Dispel
bonus_actions.desc: Pazuzu casts dispel magic, automatically dispelling any spell of 6th level or lower on the target.

bonus_actions.name: Hasted Greatsword

She has a movement speed of 40 feet and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, Ssendam can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. She has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws, and has resistance to all damage except psychic and radiant.

legendary_actions.name: Chaos Staff
legendary_actions.desc: Ssendam makes one Chaos Staff attack.

legendary_actions.desc: Ssendam uses her Teleport action.

monsters.name: Wolfwere Alpha
monsters.speed: 30 ft. (40 ft. in dire wolf form)
monsters.damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing damage from nonmagical weapons that aren't iron

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.desc: The wolfwere has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The wolfwere has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolfwere's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack (Hybrid form only)
actions.desc: The wolfwere makes three attacks: one with its Bite and two with its Claws.

actions.name: Longsword (Humanoid form only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage or 11 (1d10 + 6) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Bite (Wolf or Hybrid form only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Claws (Hybrid form only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Lethargic Song (Humanoid form only)
actions.desc: The wolfwere plays a magical melody on an instrument. Every Humanoid within 200 feet of the wolfwere that hears the melody must succeed on a 16 Wisdom saving throw or be slowed for 10 minutes, as if the slow spell has been cast on them. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it. A target that successfully saves is immune to this wolfwere's melody for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: The wolfwere polymorphs into a wolf-humanoid hybrid or into a Humanoid (elf or human), or back into its true form, which is a dire wolf. Its statistics, other than its AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

monsters.name: Xan Moonblade

traits.name: Enchanter
traits.desc: When Xan casts hideous laughter, hold person, or suggestion, the target has disadvantage on the saving throw.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Xan has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Xan to sleep.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Xan wields a Moonblade. The Moonblade has a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls (already factored into Xan's attacks) and has the finesse property.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Xan makes three Moonblade attacks.

actions.name: Moonblade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (1d8 + 6) slashing damage or 11 (1d10 + 6) slashing damage if wielded with two hands, plus 7 (2d6) cold or fire damage (Xan's choice).

bonus_actions.name: Bladesong (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: Xan can use a bonus action to start a bladesong. His bladesong lasts for 1 minute. While using bladesong his movement increases to 40 ft., he gains a +3 bonus to his AC and he gains a +3 bonus to all {@status concentration} checks.

spells: Xan casts one of the following spells using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 14):

spells.At will: acid splash, light, mage armor, mage hand, prestidigitation

spells.2/day each: detect magic, Tasha's hideous laughter, misty step, shield, suggestion

spells.1/day each: counterspell, fly, greater invisibility, hold person

monsters.name: Xzar the Chaos Clone
monsters.languages: Abyssal, Common, Infernal, Primordial, Undercommon, telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Chaos Phage
traits.desc: Xzar's infusion with the Chaos Phage gives him the following benefits:

traits.name: Xzar regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point
Xzar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects
Xzar has resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder
Xzar has darkvision and telepathy to 60 feet
Grim Harvest (1/Turn)
traits.desc: When Xzar kills a creature that is neither a Construct nor Undead with a spell of 1st level or higher, Xzar regains hit points equal to twice the spell's level, or three times if it is a necromancy spell.

traits.name: No Soul
traits.desc: Since Xzar doesn't have a soul, resurrection magic is able to work upon him no matter how much time has passed. For example, the revivify spell would work on Xzar even a week after he died. However, spells like true resurrection and wish are unable to bring Xzar back to life if no body exists.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Xzar makes two Deprive attacks and uses Spellcasting.

actions.name: Deprive
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., or range 120 ft., one target. 27 (4d10 + 5) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Death Eruption (1/Day)
actions.desc: Negative energy erupts from Xzar, intensified by the Chaos Phage. Any creature in a 60-foot-radius sphere around Xzar (but not including Xzar) must make a 17 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 36 (8d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A Humanoid killed by this ability rises at the start of Xzar's next turn as a zombie under his command.

spells: Xzar casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks):

spells.At will: acid splash, fire bolt, mage hand

spells.2/day each: animate dead*, blight*, false life*, mage armor, ray of enfeeblement*, ray of sickness*, scrying, vampiric touch*

monsters.name: Asteroid Spider
monsters.senses: blindsight 120 ft. while the spider's eyes are closed, darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 21

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: If the spider is motionless, has its eyes and mouth closed, and has its legs wrapped around its body at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the spider move or act, that creature must succeed on a 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the spider is anything other than an asteroid.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the spider fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The spider doesn't require air.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spider makes two Web Strand attacks, uses Reel, and makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 21 (3d8 + 8) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Web Strand
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 120 ft., one creature. The target is grappled (escape 18). The web strand can be attacked and destroyed (AC 12; 20 hit points; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage). The spider can grapple up to six creatures at a time using its web strands.

actions.name: Reel
actions.desc: The spider pulls each creature grappled by it up to 60 feet straight toward itself.

bonus_actions.name: Snare Ship (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The spider weaves a magical web around a spelljamming ship it can see within 120 feet of itself. The web lasts for 1 minute and suppresses the magic of any spelljamming helm aboard the ship. Decks and other surfaces of the ship that aren't enclosed become difficult terrain until the effect ends. The web is impervious to damage but is destroyed by a successful casting of dispel magic (18).

monsters.name: Clockwork Horror
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Shutdown
traits.desc: If targeted by dispel magic, the horror must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute or until it takes any damage.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The horror doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The horror makes one Bite attack and two Rotating Saw attacks, or it makes two Lightning Jolt attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Rotating Saw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Lightning Jolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +4 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 7 (1d10 + 2) lightning damage.

actions.name: Spelljamming Helm Interface
actions.desc: The horror attaches to a spelljamming helm it can see within 5 feet of itself and attunes to the helm instantly. If another creature is already attuned to the helm, that creature's attunement to the helm ends when the horror's attunement begins. The horror can operate the helm even though it isn't a spellcaster. The horror can detach from the helm as a bonus action, which ends its attunement to the helm.

monsters.name: Eldritch Lich

traits.name: Far Realm Parasite
traits.desc: Inside the lich's torso dwells a wormlike parasite that contains the lich's soul. When the lich dies, it implodes into the parasite, which then vanishes into the Far Realm. In 2d4 days, the parasite causes the lich to reappear within 1d4 miles of where it died. If the lich died inside a magic circle cast to contain Undead, the lich instead reappears as an otyugh with all the lich's memories.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.desc: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The lich doesn't need air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The lich makes one Parasitic Tentacle attack or uses Spellcasting. The lich also uses Psychic Whisper twice.

actions.name: Parasitic Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. 25 (6d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 25 (6d6 + 4) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. The poisoned target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The third time the target fails the save, the target dies and dissolves into a gibbering mouther that obeys the lich and uses the target's initiative.

actions.name: Psychic Whisper
actions.desc: The lich targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 25 (6d6 + 4) psychic damage and be stunned until the end of the lich's next turn as incomprehensible whispers fill the target's mind.

reactions.name: Far Realm Step
reactions.desc: Immediately after taking damage, the lich, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, magically teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

spells: The lich casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 17):

spells.2/day each: dispel magic, hunger of Hadar, lightning bolt

spells.1/day each: arcane eye, dimension door, plane shift (self only)

monsters.name: Fractine
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned
monsters.senses: blindsight 360 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 18

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The fractine has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Scrying Focus
traits.desc: A spellcaster can use the fractine as a substitute focus when casting the scrying spell or similar magic, provided the spellcaster and the fractine are within 5 feet of each other.

traits.name: Two-Dimensionality
traits.desc: The fractine can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. It can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain, but it takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The fractine doesn't require air, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Extradimensional Touch
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 24 (8d6) force damage.

bonus_actions.name: Imprison
bonus_actions.desc:
The fractine targets one creature of its size or smaller in its space. The target must succeed on a 16 Dexterity saving throw or be imprisoned in a demiplane. While the creature is imprisoned, a distorted image of it can be seen on the fractine's two-dimensional surface.
The demiplane moves with the fractine, has indestructible and opaque walls, and is only as big as it needs to be to contain the target, which doesn't suffer from hunger or thirst while imprisoned. No other creature can enter the demiplane, and the fractine can't be harmed from within the demiplane.
The fractine can imprison only one creature at a time and can release that creature as a bonus action. If the fractine is reduced to 0 hit points, any creature in the fractine's demiplane is released instantly. A released creature reappears in an unoccupied space as close to the fractine (or where it died) as possible. A creature can leave the demiplane on its own by using magic that enables planar travel, such as the plane shift spell.

reactions.name: Mirrored Damage
reactions.desc: In response to being damaged by a creature it can see within 120 feet of itself, the fractine forces that creature to make a 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 24 (8d6) force damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

reactions.name: Split
reactions.desc: When a Large fractine that has at least 10 hit points remaining takes bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, or thunder damage from any source, it splits into two Medium fractines. The new fractines occupy the space formerly occupied by the original fractine, and each new fractine has hit points equal to half the original's, rounded down. If the original fractine had a creature trapped in its demiplane, that creature is released when the fractine splits, reappearing in an unoccupied space as close to the new fractines as possible.

monsters.name: Gadabout
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified
monsters.senses: blindsight 10 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 8

traits.name: Air Envelope
traits.desc: If it has at least 1 hit point, the gadabout can generate an air envelope around itself when in a vacuum. This air envelope can sustain the gadabout and one other creature in its space indefinitely.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The gadabout doesn't require food or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gadabout makes two Branch attacks.

actions.name: Branch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Wrap
actions.desc: The gadabout enters the space of a willing Medium or Small creature within 5 feet of itself and gently wraps its branches around the target. The target is grappled (escape 0). Any attempt by the target to escape the grapple causes the gadabout to use its reaction to move into the nearest unoccupied space. While grappled by the gadabout, the target determines where the gadabout moves on the gadabout's turns and accompanies the gadabout wherever it goes.

traits.name: Burst
traits.desc: The goon balloon bursts when it drops to 0 hit points, releasing noxious gas in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Creatures in that area must succeed on a 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The goon balloon doesn't require air, food, or drink.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The goon balloon makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 3 (1d6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Scintillating Eye
actions.desc: Magical, kaleidoscopic light emanates from one of the goon balloon's eyes as the goon balloon targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. The target must make a 12 Wisdom saving throw, taking 6 (1d12) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus_actions.name: Float
bonus_actions.desc: The goon balloon moves up to 20 feet vertically in one direction without provoking opportunity attacks. If it ends this movement suspended in the air, it hovers in place. It can't be knocked prone while airborne.

monsters.name: Nightmare Beast
monsters.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: If the beast fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The beast deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The beast makes two Claw attacks and one Tusk attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 14 (1d12 + 8) slashing damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 21 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Tusk
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Disintegration Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The beast targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must make a 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 70 (10d6 + 40) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If this magical effect reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is disintegrated and leaves nothing behind, except a pile of ashes plus whatever equipment it was wearing or carrying.

bonus_actions.name: Teleport (2/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The beast magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary_actions.name: Tusk Attack
legendary_actions.desc: The beast makes one Tusk attack.

legendary_actions.name: Charge (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The beast moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then makes two Tusk attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Frightful Howl (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The beast howls as it exhales a cloud of magical fear gas in a 120-foot cone. Any creature in that area must succeed on a 18 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the beast for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monsters.name: Puppeteer Parasite
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 10

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The parasite doesn't require air or sleep.

actions.name: Cling
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 12 (3d6 + 2) necrotic damage, and the parasite attaches to the target. While attached, the parasite can't make Cling attacks. The parasite can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. As an action, a creature within reach of the parasite can try to detach it, doing so with a successful 14 Strength check.

actions.name: Consume Life
actions.desc: The parasite deals 12 (3d6 + 2) necrotic damage to one creature it is physically attached to, provided that creature isn't a Construct or an Undead. The parasite regains hit points equal to the damage taken.

bonus_actions.name: Suggestion (Psionics; 1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The parasite casts the suggestion spell, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 13).

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The star lancer doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Horn
