actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the star lancer moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Invisibility Cloak (3/Day)
actions.desc: The star lancer and one creature riding it (chosen by the star lancer) magically turn invisible. This effect lasts until the star lancer or a creature riding it attacks or casts a spell, or until the star lancer's {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment worn or carried by the invisible creatures is also invisible for the duration of the Invisibility Cloak.

monsters.name: Yggdrasti
monsters.senses: blindsight 120 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 10

traits.name: Cavities
traits.desc: The yggdrasti has 1d4 + 2 cavities in its trunk. Each cavity is big enough to hold one Medium creature, two Small creatures, or eight Tiny creatures. A creature inside a cavity has Cover against attacks and other effects that originate outside the cavity. The yggdrasti's cavities aren't connected to one another.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: If the yggdrasti is motionless and rooted in the ground at the start of combat, it looks just like a dead tree and has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the rooted yggdrasti move or act, that creature must succeed on a 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the yggdrasti is animate.

traits.name: Lightning Conduit
traits.desc: If the yggdrasti is subjected to lightning damage, it is unhurt, and the lightning damage is instead divided evenly among all creatures it is grappling. In addition, the yggdrasti regains one use of Lightning Discharge.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The yggdrasti doesn't require air or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The yggdrasti makes two Root attacks and uses Lightning Discharge (if available).

actions.name: Root
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape 15). The yggdrasti has four roots, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Lightning Discharge (3/Day)
actions.desc: The yggdrasti shoots lightning at one creature within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monsters.name: Dream Eater
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, restrained
monsters.senses: blindsight 120 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 13

traits.name: Ghastly Visions
traits.desc: Each creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the dream eater must make a 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is frightened of the dream eater until the start of the creature's next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to this dream eater's Ghastly Visions trait for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The dream eater can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The dream eater has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dream eater makes two Ensnaring Shriek attacks.

actions.name: Ensnaring Shriek
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +8 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) psychic damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the target must succeed on a 16 Charisma saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet toward the dream eater.

bonus_actions.name: Engulfing Nightmare
bonus_actions.desc:
The dream eater targets one creature within 5 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 16 Wisdom saving throw or be engulfed by the dream eater, as the dream eater envelops the creature in a miasma of its worst fears.
When the dream eater engulfs a target, the dream eater enters its space, and the target immediately takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage. An engulfed target is restrained and blinded, and it takes an additional 10 (3d6) psychic damage at the start of each of the dream eater's turns. When the dream eater moves, the engulfed target moves with it.
The dream eater can have only one target engulfed at a time. An engulfed target escapes at the start of its turn by making a 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the target escapes; the target is no longer engulfed, and it enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the dream eater. A creature within 15 feet of the dream eater also can use its action to attempt to free an engulfed target. Doing so requires the creature to use its action to make a 16 Charisma (Persuasion) check to convince the engulfed target the nightmare isn't real, with the target escaping on a success. The creature making the check takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, regardless of the check's success or failure, as its mind brushes against the nightmare.

monsters.name: Ember
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 26

traits.name: Calescent Aura
traits.desc: At the start of Ember's turn, Ember can force any number of creatures of his choice within 10 feet of himself to make a 22 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 7 (2d6) fire damage and is frightened of Ember until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.desc: If Ember fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: In battle, Ember dons magical plate armor custom-forged for his use. While wearing the armor, Ember adds his Charisma modifier to his weapon damage rolls (included in the attack descriptions), and his AC can't be lower than 20.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ember makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 26 (2d10 + 15) piercing damage plus 13 (2d6 + 6) fire damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 22 (2d6 + 15) slashing damage.

actions.name: Firestorm Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Ember exhales roiling flames and ash in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 22 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 56 (16d6) fire damage and is pushed up to 30 feet away from Ember and knocked prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage with no other effects. If a creature is reduced to 0 hit points by this effect, the creature immediately dies, and its body is reduced to ash.

bonus_actions.name: Alter Shape
bonus_actions.desc: Ember magically transforms into a vulture or a mage and retains his alignment, damage immunities, hit points, and Hit Dice, as well as his Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. This transformation ends if Ember is reduced to 0 hit points or if he uses another bonus action to end it.

legendary_actions.name: Pursuit
legendary_actions.desc: Ember moves up to 40 feet in a straight line toward one creature he can see. This movement ignores opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Searing Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Ember makes one Bite attack. If the attack hits, it deals an additional 7 (2d6) fire damage.

monsters.name: Forest Master

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: If the Forest Master fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The Forest Master has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Master of Beasts
traits.desc: The Forest Master can comprehend and communicate with any Beast, even if the Beast knows no languages.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Forest Master makes either two Hooves attacks, two Moon Bolt attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Moon Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) radiant damage.

bonus_actions.name: Erupting Briars (Recharge 4-6)
bonus_actions.desc:
The Forest Master touches his horn to the earth and causes a 5-foot-tall wall of briars to erupt in a 90-foot line that is 10 feet wide. When the wall appears, each creature in its area is pushed into the nearest unoccupied space adjacent to the wall and must make a 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) piercing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
The wall of briars lasts until the start of the Forest Master's next turn. The wall blocks line of sight and counts as difficult terrain for all creatures except the Forest Master. The first time a creature enters the wall's area on a turn, that creature must succeed on a 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (3d8) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Misty Escape
reactions.desc: If the Forest Master takes damage from a melee attack, he, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, teleports to an unoccupied space within 30 feet that he can see.

spells: The Forest Master casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 15):

spells.2/day each: goodberry, greater restoration, pass without trace, speak with plants

monsters.name: Foresworn
monsters.damage_resistances: necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious
monsters.languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Duty-Bound
traits.desc: The foresworn is bound to enacting a singular duty it pledged itself to in life. While this duty is incomplete, whenever the foresworn is destroyed, it re-forms at its previous location after 3 (1d6) days, with all its hit points restored.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The foresworn can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The foresworn doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The foresworn makes three Spectral Polearm attacks.

actions.name: Spectral Polearm
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) force damage.

bonus_actions.name: Phantasmic Battalion (Recharge 5-6)
bonus_actions.desc: The foresworn summons a battalion of ghostly soldiers to its aid. The ghostly soldiers fill a 10-foot-cube centered on the foresworn, move with the foresworn when the foresworn moves, and last until the start of the foresworn's next turn. While the ghostly soldiers are present, the area they occupy is considered difficult terrain for all creatures except the foresworn, and the foresworn's reach for melee weapon attacks increases by 10 feet.

spells: The foresworn casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 15):

spells.2/day each: command, detect evil and good

monsters.name: Irda Seeker
monsters.senses: darkvision 60 ft., truesight 5 ft., passive Perception 16

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The seeker uses Augment Physicality, if available, and makes two Crystal Blade attacks.

actions.name: Crystal Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) force damage, plus 7 (2d6) force damage if the seeker is Large.

actions.name: Augment Physicality (1/Day)
actions.desc: For 1 minute, the seeker magically heightens its physical ability and increases in size, along with anything it is wearing or carrying. While augmented, the seeker is Large, and makes Strength and Dexterity saving throws with advantage. If the seeker lacks the room to become Large, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available.

actions.name: Change Shape (1/Day)
actions.desc: The seeker magically transforms to look and feel like a Medium Humanoid it has seen. Any equipment the seeker is wearing or carrying isn't transformed, and the seeker's statistics don't change. The seeker reverts to its true form if the seeker is reduced to 0 hit points or if the seeker uses an action to end the transformation.

bonus_actions.name: Veil Walk (Recharge 4-6)
bonus_actions.desc: The seeker, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, turns invisible and teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of itself. The seeker remains invisible until the start of its next turn or until immediately after the seeker makes an attack roll, whichever comes first.

monsters.name: Irda Veil Keeper
monsters.senses: darkvision 60 ft., truesight 5 ft., passive Perception 17

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The veil keeper uses Augment Physicality, if available, and makes two Mirage Flare attacks.

actions.name: Mirage Flare
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the veil keeper until the start of the veil keeper's next turn. While charmed in this way, a creature is incapacitated as it is beset by hypnotic, illusory visions.

actions.name: Augment Physicality (1/Day)
actions.desc: For 1 minute, the veil keeper magically obscures it location, heightens its physical ability, and increases in size, along with anything it is wearing or carrying. While the veil keeper is augmented, attack rolls against it have disadvantage, it is Large, and it makes Strength and Dexterity saving throws with advantage. If the veil keeper lacks the room to become Large, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available. These augmentations end if the veil keeper is incapacitated.

actions.name: Change Shape (3/Day)
actions.desc: The veil keeper magically transforms to look and feel like a Medium Humanoid it has seen. Any equipment the veil keeper is wearing or carrying isn't transformed, and the veil keeper's statistics don't change. The veil keeper reverts to its true form if the veil keeper is reduced to 0 hit points or if the veil keeper uses an action to end the transformation.

reactions.name: Obscuring Mist
reactions.desc: If a creature that the veil keeper can see within 30 feet of itself is targeted by an attack, the veil keeper surrounds the creature with illusory mist, granting the creature Cover until the start of the veil keeper's next turn.

spells: The veil keeper casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 14):

spells.2/day each: invisibility, major image, phantasmal force

traits.name: Always Thinking Ahead
traits.desc: The inventor has advantage on initiative rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The inventor makes two Flying Fangtrap attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with Thunderscream Gadget if it's available.

actions.name: Flying Fangtrap
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage, and the creature must succeed on a 14 Dexterity saving throw or have its speed reduced to 0 until the start of the inventor's next turn.

actions.name: Thunderscream Gadget (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The inventor produces a gadget that emits a screeching wave of sound in a 30-foot cone originating from the inventor. Each creature in that area must make a 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) thunder damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Flash Powder
reactions.desc: If the inventor is damaged by a creature it can see within 15 feet of itself, the inventor retaliates by flinging brilliantly explosive powder at the creature. The creature must succeed on a 14 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Always Thinking Ahead
traits.desc: The mastermind has advantage on initiative rolls.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The mastermind can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check. This trait doesn't function if the mastermind is grappling creatures in both of its clockwork claws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mastermind makes two Clockwork Claw attacks. The mastermind can replace one of these attacks with Generate Gadget if it's available.

actions.name: Clockwork Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the target is grappled (escape 15). Until this grapple ends, the target takes 10 (3d6) piercing damage at the start of each of the mastermind's turns. The mastermind has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Generate Gadget (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The mastermind quickly assembles a clockwork gadget, producing one of the following effects (the mastermind's choice):

actions.name: Chattergrab
actions.desc: Parts of this gadget look like gnashing metal teeth. This gadget hurtles toward a creature the mastermind can see within 60 feet of itself. The creature must succeed on a 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 31 (7d8) piercing damage and be incapacitated until the start of the mastermind's next turn.

actions.name: Phasmoball
actions.desc: The mastermind launches this gadget to a point the mastermind can see within 30 feet of itself, where the gadget unleashes a cloud of mind-warping gases in a 10-foot-radius sphere. Each creature within the sphere must succeed on a 16 Wisdom saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage and be frightened of the mastermind until the start of the mastermind's next turn.

actions.name: Thunderscream
actions.desc: This gadget emits a screeching wave of sound in a 30-foot cone originating from the mastermind. Each creature in that area must make a 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) thunder damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: The hunter can hold its breath for up to 10 minutes.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The hunter has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hunter's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hunter makes one Bone Harpoon attack and one Tusk attack.

actions.name: Bone Harpoon
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. {@hom}The harpoon returns to the hunter's hand.

actions.name: Tusk
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.desc: The draconian has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

traits.name: Controlled Fall
traits.desc: If the draconian falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 50 feet from the fall when calculating the fall's damage.

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.desc: If the draconian is reduced to 0 hit points, its body erupts into sludge that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere. Each creature within that area must succeed on a 14 Dexterity saving throw or be covered in the sludge for 1 minute. While covered in the sludge, a creature's speed is halved. A creature can use its action to scrape the sludge off itself or another creature within 5 feet of itself.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The draconian makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Flaming Carnage (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The draconian indulges its rage, wreathing itself in fire and moving up to its speed. The draconian can enter creatures' spaces during this move. During this movement, when the draconian enters a creature's space, the creature must make a 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 22 (4d10) fire damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and is pushed to the nearest space out of the draconian's path. A creature can be affected by this draconian's Flaming Carnage only once during a turn.

reactions.name: Violent Retaliation
reactions.desc: If a creature within 10 feet of the draconian hits it with an attack, the draconian can make one Claw attack against that creature. If the Claw attack hits, it deals an additional 4 (1d8) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Verminaard

traits.name: Draconic Command
traits.desc: Whenever a Dragon or a creature with the Draconic Devotion trait within 30 feet of Verminaard makes an attack roll, the creature can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the attack roll.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Verminaard fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Verminaard wears +2 plate armor and wields the mace Nightbringer, which grants him darkvision as well as immunity to fire damage and to the charmed and frightened conditions (included above).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Verminaard makes two Nightbringer attacks and uses Malediction.

actions.name: Nightbringer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (1d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (4d4) radiant damage. If the target is a creature, the target must succeed on a 20 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the start of Verminaard's next turn.

actions.name: Malediction
actions.desc: Verminaard utters an unholy word, causing profane fire to descend on one creature Verminaard can see within 60 feet of himself. The creature must make a 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) necrotic damage plus 11 (2d10) radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus_actions.name: Dragon Queen's Favor (5/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: Verminaard or one creature he can see within 60 feet of himself magically regains 17 (2d12 + 4) hit points.

legendary_actions.name: Tactical Movement
legendary_actions.desc: Verminaard moves up to his speed or commands a mount he is riding to move up to its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Fervent Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Verminaard makes one Nightbringer attack. If this attack hits, it deals an additional 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Verminaard uses Spellcasting.

spells: Verminaard casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 18):

spells.2/day each: bane, fear, freedom of movement, greater restoration, hold monster, revivify

monsters.name: Blaze
monsters.speed: 20 ft., fly 20 ft. (vertical movement only; hover)
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Blaze Rod
traits.desc: When the blaze drops to 0 hit points, it disappears in a cloud of smoke and has a 50 percent chance of leaving behind a glowing rod worth 100 gp. The rod sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius. As an action, a creature can try to snap the rod, doing so with a successful 14 Strength check. The snapped rod releases its fiery energy in a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature in that area must make a 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 6 (1d12) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Heat Aura
traits.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the blaze takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: The blaze sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

traits.name: Water Susceptibility
traits.desc: The blaze takes 1 cold damage for every 5 feet it moves in water, for every gallon of water splashed on it, or whenever it starts its turn in the rain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The blaze makes three Fiery Doom attacks.

actions.name: Fiery Doom
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +6 to hit; reach 5 ft. or ranged 60 ft., one target. 8 (1d10 + 3) fire damage, and the target catches fire if it's a creature or a flammable object. Until a creature takes an action to extinguish the fire, the burning target takes 3 (1d6) fire damage at the end of each of its turns.

traits.name: Bizarre Physiology
traits.desc: The creeper can't take actions except for {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, {@action Hide}, and {@action Search}. It can't take bonus actions or reactions.

traits.name: Creeper Head
traits.desc: When a creeper drops to 0 hit points from a charged creeper's explosion (see the Destruction trait), it dies and its head falls off. A creeper's fallen head is hollow and can be worn as a mask with eye and mouth openings.

traits.name: Destruction
traits.desc:
When it ends its turn within 10 feet of a Humanoid that it can see, the creeper stops moving and emits a hiss loud enough to be heard by creatures within 30 feet of itself.
If the creeper drops to 0 hit points before the start of its next turn, the hissing stops, and the creeper dies. Otherwise, at the start of the creeper's next turn, one of following things happens:

traits.name: If there are no Humanoids within 10 feet of the hissing creeper, it stops hissing. It then uses any available movement to approach the nearest Humanoid it can see.

If there are one or more Humanoids within 10 feet of the hissing creeper, the creeper explodes in a ball of energy that fills a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. This energy spreads around corners. The creeper is destroyed, and every other creature in the explosion's area must make a 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Increase this damage by 7 (2d6) if the creeper is charged (see "Electrical Charge" below). Objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried take 14 (4d6) lightning damage, or 21 (6d6) lightning damage if the creeper is charged.
Electrical Charge
traits.desc: Whenever the creeper is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead becomes charged for 1 minute. While charged, the creeper emits dim blue light in a 5-foot radius.

traits.name: Fear of Felines
traits.desc: The creeper has the frightened condition whenever it starts its turn within 60 feet of a feline creature it can see. The condition lasts until the start of the creeper's next turn.

traits.name: Dragon Egg
traits.desc: When the Ender Dragon drops to 0 hit points, it radiates beams of purple light and then disappears, leaving behind an inert, jet-black dragon egg worth 5,000 gp.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.desc: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon makes one Bite attack and uses Beating Wings.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit; reach 15 ft., one target. 18 (3d6 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Beating Wings
actions.desc: The dragon beats its great wings. Each creature within 15 feet of the dragon must succeed on a 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (1d4 + 8) bludgeoning damage, be pushed 10 feet away from the dragon, and have the prone condition.

actions.name: Harmful Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The dragon exhales putrid gas in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 21 Constitution saving throw, taking 52 (15d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The dragon then chooses a point it can see where the cone makes contact with the ground. That point becomes the center of a 10-foot-high, 10-foot-radius cylinder of lingering gas that disappears at the start of the dragon's next turn. Any creature that starts its turn in the cylinder takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Evasive Teleportation
traits.desc: Whenever it takes damage or is the target of a ranged attack, the Enderman can teleport, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space it can see within 20 feet of itself (no action required). If this effect is triggered by a ranged attack, the Enderman teleports just before the attack hits, causing the attack to miss it. This trait is suppressed while the Enderman has the incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Implosion
traits.desc: When the Enderman drops to 0 hit points, it dies as its body implodes. Roll a d10. On a roll of 9 or less, the Enderman leaves no remains. On a roll of 10, the Enderman leaves behind a glowing, purple orb called an Ender pearl, worth 500 gp. A creature can throw the pearl up to 60 feet; if the pearl lands in an unoccupied space big enough to contain the creature, the creature teleports to that space, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, and the pearl disappears.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the Enderman has disadvantage on attack rolls.

traits.name: Water Susceptibility
traits.desc: The Enderman takes 1 cold damage for every 5 feet it moves in water, for every gallon of water splashed on it, or whenever it starts its turn in the rain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Enderman makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit; reach 10 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The wolf has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit; reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 11 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

monsters.name: Archon of Boundaries
monsters.languages: understands Common and Celestial but can't speak

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the archon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The archon makes one Hooves attack and one Radiant Lance attack.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 19 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Radiant Lance
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 12 (1d12 + 6) piercing damage plus 28 (8d6) radiant damage, and the target is marked until the start of the archon's next turn. While it is marked, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than the archon.

reactions.name: Archon's Pursuit
reactions.desc: When a creature marked by the archon's Radiant Lance ends its turn within 120 feet of the archon, the archon teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 feet of the creature.

reactions.name: Haunting Radiance
reactions.desc: Immediately after a creature within 120 feet of the archon forces it to make a saving throw, the archon responds with a burst of light. The creature must succeed on a 17 Constitution saving throw or have the blinded condition until the end of the creature's next turn.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The archon adds 5 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it, provided it can see the attacker.

spells: The archon casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability:

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: If the wurm is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the wurm move or act, that creature must succeed on a 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the wurm is animate.

traits.name: Leafy Handholds
traits.desc: Creatures have advantage on ability checks made to climb the wurm.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the wurm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The wurm regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. If the wurm takes fire or lightning damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the wurm's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The wurm makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 30 (5d8 + 8) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 22 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the wurm. A swallowed creature has the restrained condition, has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the wurm, and takes 28 (8d6) piercing damage at the start of each of the wurm's turns from thorns in the wurm's gullet.
The wurm's stomach can hold up to two creatures at a time. If the wurm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the wurm must succeed on a 22 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the wurm and has the prone condition. If the wurm dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the restrained condition and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting with the prone condition.

monsters.name: Deathless Rider
monsters.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Mounted Adept
traits.desc: While mounted and without the incapacitated condition, the rider has advantage on melee attack rolls against any unmounted creature smaller than its mount, the rider and its mount have advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and the rider can force an attack targeted at its mount to target the rider instead.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.desc: If damage reduces the rider to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC equal to 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the rider drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The rider makes two Axe attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with Fell Glare.

actions.name: Axe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fell Glare
actions.desc: The rider gazes at a creature within 30 feet of itself. The creature must succeed on a 13 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition for 1 minute. The frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if it can see the rider, ending the condition on itself on a success.

monsters.name: Dunbarrow Witch
monsters.languages: Common, Sylvan, and any one language

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The witch makes two Poison Dagger attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with Spellcasting.

actions.name: Poison Dagger
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Polymorph Concoction (1/Day)
actions.desc: The witch hurls a bottle of liquid at a point up to 20 feet away from itself, which shatters into a cloud of magical smoke that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that area must succeed on a 16 Wisdom saving throw or transform into a creature, as if under the effects of a polymorph spell, transforming into one of the following forms (roll a d4): 1, bat; 2, frog; 3, lizard; or 4, rat. This transformation lasts for 1 hour or until the creature drops to 0 hit points in its new form.

actions.name: Shattered Shards
actions.desc: The witch targets a point it can see within 30 feet of itself. The air there magically solidifies into a mirrorlike pane, then shatters in a 15-foot cone originating from that point. Each creature in that area must make a 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 25 (10d4) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells: The witch casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 16):

spells.2/day each: animal messenger, charm person, Tasha's hideous laughter

monsters.name: Faerie Borrower

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The faerie doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Needle Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Magic Mockery
actions.desc: The faerie hurls magical taunts at one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The creature must succeed on a 13 Wisdom saving throw or take 3 (1d6) psychic damage and have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of the faerie's next turn.

reactions.name: Tricksy Parry
reactions.desc: Immediately after taking damage, the faerie reduces the damage taken by 2 (1d4).

spells: The faerie casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 13):

monsters.name: Faerie Pathlighter

traits.name: Faerie Illumination
traits.desc: The faerie sheds dim light in a 15-foot radius.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The faerie makes two Shining Strike attacks.

actions.name: Shining Strike
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. 7 (2d6) radiant damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 14 Dexterity saving throw or be wreathed in light until the end of the faerie's next turn. While a creature is wreathed in light, attack rolls against the creature have advantage, and the creature can't benefit from the invisible condition.

bonus_actions.name: Guiding Light (2/Day)
bonus_actions.desc:
The faerie summons a 30-foot-radius sphere of magical light centered on itself, which lasts for 1 minute or until the faerie has the incapacitated condition. Each creature of the faerie's choice (other than the faerie) that starts its turn in that area gains 5 temporary hit points and has advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Wisdom checks until the start of its next turn.
The sphere is bright light, sheds dim light for an additional 30 feet, and moves with the faerie. If any of the sphere's area overlaps with an area of darkness created by a spell of 3rd level or lower, the spell that created the darkness is dispelled.

spells: The faerie casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability:

monsters.name: Faerie Pest

actions.name: Stingblade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage. If the faerie had advantage on the attack roll, the target takes an additional 3 (1d6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Theft of Nerves (1/Day)
actions.desc: The faerie unleashes a burst of mind-muddling magic in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a 12 Intelligence saving throw or have the frightened condition for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Mischievous Stealth
bonus_actions.desc: The faerie takes the Hide action.

spells: The faerie casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 12):

spells.2/day each: bane, grease

traits.name: Can't Catch Me
traits.desc: The gingerbrute has advantage on any ability checks or saving throws it makes to avoid or end the grappled or the restrained condition on itself.

traits.name: Sweet Victory
traits.desc: Once the gingerbrute is destroyed, a creature can use its action to eat all the remains and gain 5 temporary hit points. The remains crumble away after 24 hours if not eaten.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gingerbrute makes two Fork attacks, two Gumdrop Slingshot attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: Fork
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Gumdrop Slingshot
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Goose Mother
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, unconscious

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the Goose Mother fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.desc:
The Goose Mother has five heads. Whenever the Goose Mother takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the Goose Mother dies.
At the end of its turn, the Goose Mother grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken poison damage since its last turn. The Goose Mother regains 10 hit points for each head when it regrows.

traits.name: Reactive Heads
traits.desc: For each head the Goose Mother has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.desc: While the Goose Mother sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Goose Mother makes as many Beak attacks as it has heads and one Wing attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Wing
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 9 (1d12 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 15 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Lullaby of Honks (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc:
The Goose Mother's heads honk a discordant lullaby. Each creature of the Goose Mother's choice within 10 feet of it must make a 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 7 (2d6) thunder damage and falls into a magical slumber. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only. The honks can be heard up to 300 feet away.
A creature under magical slumber has the unconscious condition for 8 hours. This effect ends early for a creature if it takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake it awake.

monsters.name: High Fae Impostor
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The high fae has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The high fae makes two Fae Blade attacks and uses Vexing Prank once.

actions.name: Fae Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 18 (3d8 + 5) force damage.

actions.name: Vexing Prank
actions.desc: The high fae targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself with a magical trick. The target must make a 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage and has the frightened condition until the start of the high fae's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Loot Likeness
bonus_actions.desc: The high fae magically transforms into a duplicate of a Small or Medium creature it can see. While transformed, the high fae retains its game statistics (other than its size) but gains access to enough general information about the imitated creature, such as background and personality, to reasonably pass itself off as the creature. This transformation ends if the high fae is reduced to 0 hit points, uses this bonus action again, or uses a bonus action to revert to its true form.

spells: The high fae casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 18):

monsters.name: High Fae Kindguard
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If the high fae is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if it fails, provided it doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The high fae has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The high fae makes two Fae Claymore attacks and uses Tripping Feint.

actions.name: Fae Claymore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 20 (4d6 + 6) force damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet, to a minimum speed of 5 feet. The reduction lasts until the start of the high fae's next turn.

actions.name: Tripping Feint
actions.desc: The high fae targets one Large or smaller creature it can see within 10 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 18 Dexterity saving throw or have the prone condition.

bonus_actions.name: Darting Flight
bonus_actions.desc: The high fae moves up to its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

reactions.name: Parry and Riposte
reactions.desc: The high fae adds 4 to its AC against one melee attack roll that would hit it, provided it can see the attacker. After the attack hits or misses, the high fae then makes one Fae Claymore attack against the attacker.

monsters.name: High Fae Mage
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The high fae has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The high fae makes two Elemental Strike attacks.

actions.name: Elemental Strike
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +11 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 18 (2d10 + 7) acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, or thunder damage (the high fae's choice).

actions.name: Negotiate Life (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The high fae enacts a magical bargain, siphoning energy from its opponents to heal its wounds. The high fae targets up to three creatures it can see within 60 feet of itself. Each target must make a 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 26 (4d12) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The high fae then regains 30 hit points.

reactions.name: Fae Counterspell
reactions.desc: The high fae interrupts a creature it can see that is casting a spell with verbal, somatic, or material components. The caster takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage and must make a 19 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the spell fails and has no effect, but the spell slot used to cast it is not expended.

spells: The high fae casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 19):

spells.At will: dancing lights, detect magic, druidcraft, mage armor (self only)

spells.2/day each: faerie fire, gust of wind, mirror image

monsters.name: High Fae Noble
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Aura of Overwhelming Splendor
traits.desc: The high fae radiates dazzling and mollifying magic. Each creature of the high fae's choice that starts its turn within 5 feet of the high fae must succeed on a 19 Wisdom saving throw or have the charmed condition until the start of its next turn. While charmed, the creature also has the incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the high fae fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The high fae has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The high fae makes two Fae Blade attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with Stunning Soliloquy if available.

actions.name: Fae Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 20 (3d8 + 7) force damage.

actions.name: Stunning Soliloquy (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The high fae unleashes a string of magical words. Each creature of the high fae's choice within 30 feet of itself must succeed on a 19 Wisdom saving throw or have the stunned condition for 1 minute. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reactions.name: Capricious Step
reactions.desc: Immediately after taking damage, the high fae magically has the invisible condition and teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of itself. The invisibility lasts until the end of the high fae's next turn.

reactions.name: Ridicule
reactions.desc: When a creature misses the high fae with an attack roll, the high fae magically mocks the creature, dealing 5 (2d4) psychic damage to the attacker.

spells: The high fae casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 19):

traits.name: Knightly Virtue
traits.desc: The knight has one of the following traits, depending on the court it serves:

traits.name: Courage (Embereth)
traits.desc: The knight has advantage on Wisdom checks and Wisdom saving throws.

traits.name: Knowledge (Vantress)
traits.desc: The knight has advantage on Intelligence checks and Intelligence saving throws.

traits.name: Loyalty (Ardenvale)
traits.desc: The knight has advantage on Charisma checks and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Persistence (Locthwain)
traits.desc: The knight has advantage on Constitution saving throws.

traits.name: Strength (Garenbrig)
traits.desc: The knight has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

actions.name: Lance
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 9 (1d12 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

monsters.name: Nightmare Haunt
monsters.senses: blindsight 120 ft. (can't see beyond this radius), passive Perception 11

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The nightmare haunt has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Somnophage
traits.desc: At the start of its turn, the nightmare haunt gains a number of temporary hit points equal to 5 times the number of unconscious creatures within 30 feet of itself.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The nightmare haunt makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage.

actions.name: Tendrils of Slumber (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc:
The nightmare haunt creates spectral tendrils that cover the ground in a 20-foot square that it can see within 30 feet of itself for 1 minute or until it uses this action again. When a creature other than the nightmare haunt enters the affected area for the first time or starts its turn there, the creature must succeed on a 14 Strength saving throw or take 11 (2d10) necrotic damage and have the restrained condition. The affected ground is also considered difficult terrain for creatures other than the nightmare haunt for the duration of its effect.
A creature that starts its turn in the area and is already restrained by the tendrils must repeat the saving throw. On a failed save, it has the unconscious condition and instead of the restrained condition caused by the tendrils. On a successful save, the effect ends on the creature. An unconscious creature remains asleep until it is no longer in the area with tendrils, takes any damage, or is targeted by a remove curse spell or similar magic.

bonus_actions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonus_actions.desc: While in dim light or darkness, the nightmare haunt takes the Hide action.

monsters.name: Ogre Chitterlord

traits.name: Speak with Rats
traits.desc: The ogre can verbally communicate simple concepts to ordinary rats and giant rats.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ogre makes two Club attacks, two Rat-Tail Whip attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rat-Tail Whip
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pulled 5 feet toward the ogre.

bonus_actions.name: Call Rats (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The ogre magically calls 1d4 giant rats. Each rat appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the ogre that the ogre can see. The rats act as the ogre's allies, obey its spoken commands, and take their turns immediately after the ogre's turn on the same initiative count. The rats remain for 1 hour, until the ogre dies, or until the ogre dismisses them as a bonus action.

spells: The ogre casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 11):

monsters.name: Redtooth Werefox
monsters.speed: 30 ft. (in elf form; 40 ft. in fox and hybrid form)
monsters.languages: Common, Elvish (can't speak in fox form)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The werefox makes two Bite attacks, two Lance attacks, or one Bite attack and one Lance attack.

actions.name: Bite (Fox or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage. If the werefox moved at least 20 feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit and the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the target must succeed on a 13 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Lance (Elf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 9 (1d12 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Entangling Arrow (Elf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a 11 Dexterity saving throw or have the restrained condition until the start of the werefox's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: The werefox polymorphs into a fox-elf hybrid, into a fox, or back into its elf form. Its game statistics, other than its speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its elf form if it dies.

bonus_actions.name: Vulpine Nimbleness (Fox or Hybrid Form Only)
bonus_actions.desc: The werefox takes the Dash or Disengage action.

traits.name: Beast Speech
traits.desc: The sewer king can comprehend and verbally communicate with any Beast.

actions.name: Rancid Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 12 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition until the start of the sewer king's next turn.

actions.name: Summon Swarm (1/Day)
actions.desc: The sewer king chitters and summons a swarm of rats to its aid. The swarm appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the sewer king that the sewer king can see. It acts as the sewer king's ally, obeys the sewer king's commands, and takes its turn immediately after the sewer king's. The swarm remains until it dies, the sewer king dies, or until the sewer king dismisses it as an action.

bonus_actions.name: Skitter
bonus_actions.desc: The sewer king moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

monsters.name: Snapping Hydra
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, unconscious

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The hydra can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.desc:
The hydra has five heads. Whenever the hydra takes 30 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, the hydra dies.
At the end of its turn, the hydra grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken cold damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 10 hit points for each head regrown this way.

traits.name: Reactive Heads
traits.desc: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.desc: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hydra makes as many Bite attacks as it has heads.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shell Defense
actions.desc: The hydra withdraws its limbs and heads into its shell. Until it emerges as a bonus action, it gains a +4 bonus to AC and has advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws. While in its shell, the hydra has the prone condition, its speed is 0 and can't increase, its heads can't die, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it can't take any other actions or reactions.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the specter fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The specter has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The specter uses Mournful Keening if available, then makes one Hooves attack and one Reaping Scythe attack.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 28 (8d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 18 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Mournful Keening (Recharge 6)
actions.desc:
The specter utters a keening wail, calling to those close to death. Each non-Undead creature within 120 feet of the specter must make a 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature hears the wail and is marked for death.
A creature marked for death can't regain hit points, has disadvantage on death saving throws, and all attack rolls against it are made with advantage. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until the creature is targeted by a remove curse spell or similar magic.

actions.name: Reaping Scythe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 12 (1d12 + 6) slashing damage plus 28 (8d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 15 Constitution saving throw or gain a level of exhaustion.

traits.name: Caramelization
traits.desc: If the horror takes fire damage, it releases a sweet, mesmerizing scent. Each creature within 30 feet of the horror must succeed on a 11 Wisdom saving throw or have the charmed condition. A charmed creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The horror has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The horror makes one Bite attack and two Candy Cane attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Candy Cane
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the horror can choose to deal no damage; instead, the target has the prone condition, and the horror can pull the target up to 5 feet toward itself.

monsters.name: Tempest Hart
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the hart fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hart makes a Lightning Antlers attack and a Thunder Hooves attack.

actions.name: Lightning Antlers
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 16 (2d10 + 5) lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 16 Constitution saving throw or have the stunned condition until the start of the hart's next turn.

actions.name: Thunder Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) thunder damage.

reactions.name: Entangling Growth
reactions.desc: Immediately after a creature the hart can see within 120 feet of itself hits it with an attack roll, the hart reduces the damage to itself by half. The attacker must immediately make a 16 Strength saving throw as beanstalks coil around it in its space. On a failed save, the creature has the grappled condition (escape 16) and has the restrained condition as long as it is grappled. The beanstalks vanish after 1 minute, if the hart has the incapacitated condition, or when the hart dies.

reactions.name: Lightning Call
reactions.desc: In response to making a saving throw, the hart calls down a bolt of lightning that targets a creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 19 (3d12) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monsters.name: Treefolk

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.desc: The treefolk has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in forest terrain.

traits.name: Tree Stride
traits.desc: Once on each of its turns, the treefolk can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into one living tree within 5 feet of itself and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet of itself that it can see, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be at least as large as the treefolk.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The treefolk makes two Crushing Vine attacks, two Nightshade Bolt attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: Crushing Vine
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 25 (3d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it has the grappled condition (escape 18). While grappled, the creature also has the restrained condition. The treefolk can grapple up to six creatures this way.

actions.name: Nightshade Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +9 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. 33 (6d10) poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Oaken Boon
bonus_actions.desc: The treefolk blesses one creature other than itself that it can see within 60 feet of itself with the might and wisdom of the forest. While blessed in this way, a creature can use the treefolk's Tree Stride trait and gains 5 (2d4) temporary hit points at the start of each of its turns. This blessing lasts for 1 minute, until the treefolk has the incapacitated condition, or until the treefolk uses this bonus action again.

spells: The treefolk casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 17):

spells.2/day each: enlarge/reduce, speak with plants

monsters.name: Witchkite

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the witchkite fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The witchkite makes two Rend attacks and uses Malevolent Flare once.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 16 (3d6 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Malevolent Flare
actions.desc: The witchkite spits magical, green-tinged flame at one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must make a 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 22 (5d8) fire damage and suffers one of the following effects of the witchkite's choice:

actions.name: The target must use its reaction to make a melee attack against another creature of the witchkite's choice that is within the target's reach.

reactions.name: Enchanting Gaze
reactions.desc: When a creature the witchkite can see moves within 10 feet of it, the witchkite emits an enchanting gaze at the creature. The creature must succeed on a 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage and have the charmed condition until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Retribution
reactions.desc: Immediately after taking damage from a melee attack, the witchkite makes one Rend attack against the attacker.

spells: The witchkite casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 17):

spells.At will: detect magic, minor illusion, speak with dead

spells.1/day each: detect thoughts, dimension door, hold monster

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The witchstalker has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Smell Magic
traits.desc: The witchstalker can sense the presence and location of magic within 120 feet of itself. It also has advantage on attack rolls against creatures that have cast a spell since the end of the witchstalker's last turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The witchstalker makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 15 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Mind-Wracking Howl (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The witchstalker unleashes a terrible howl, and each creature within 30 feet of it that isn't a Monstrosity must make a 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 24 (7d6) psychic damage and has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain {@status concentration} on spells until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

reactions.name: Spell Stalk
reactions.desc: Immediately after a creature within 120 feet of the witchstalker casts a spell, the witchstalker magically teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the creature and can make one Bite attack against the creature.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The assassin bug has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The assassin bug makes two bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned this way, the target is paralyzed. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Ovipositor
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. The target is infested with 1d3 assassin bug eggs, which immediately hatch into assassin bug maggots. At the start of each of the target's turns, the target takes 1d6 piercing damage per maggot infesting it. Applying fire to the bite wound before the end of the target's next turn deals 1 fire damage to the target and kills these assassin bug maggots. After this time, the maggots are too far under the skin to be burned.
If a target infested by assassin bug maggots ends its turn with 0 hit points, it dies as the maggots burrow into its heart and kill it. Any effect that cures disease kills all assassin bug maggots infesting the target.

traits.name: Radiant Eyes
traits.desc: While its eyes are open, a blindheim projects bright light in a 60-foot cone and dim light for an additional 60 feet. It sets the orientation of this cone at the end of each of its turns. All creatures that can see the blindheim have disadvantage on attack rolls while in the area of bright light and within 15 feet of the blindheim. Creatures with the Sunlight Sensitivity trait that can see the blindheim have disadvantage on attack rolls anywhere in the area of bright light.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Radiant Blast
actions.desc: Radiant energy erupts from the blindheim's eyes in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a 12 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) radiant damage and be blinded until the end of the blindheim's next turn. Creatures with the Sunlight Sensitivity trait have disadvantage on this saving throw.

traits.name: Limited Amphibiousness
traits.desc: The crab folk can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged once every 24 hours to avoid suffocating.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The crab folk makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape 14). Until this grapple ends, the crab folk can automatically hit the target with its claw, and the crab folk can't make attacks with that claw against other targets. The crab folk has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

traits.name: Dire Cacophony
traits.desc: Any creature other than a dire corby that starts its turn within 60 feet of a dire corby and can hear it must make a 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is unable to use the Dash action, cannot climb, or cast spells other than cantrips until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.desc: The dire corby has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dire corby makes two claw attacks.

monsters.name: Eye of Fear and Flame
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned
monsters.languages: Common, all languages known by any creature within 30 feet of it

traits.name: Turn Immunity
traits.desc: The eye of fear and flame is immune to effects that turn undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The eye of fear and flame makes two claw attacks and uses its Gemstone Eyes.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (1d12 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Gemstone Eyes
actions.desc: The eye of fear and flame shoots one of the following magical eye rays, choosing one target it can see within 90 feet of it.

actions.name: Eye of Fear
actions.desc: The target and up to four other creatures of the eye of fear and flame's choice within 10 feet of the target must each succeed on a 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Eye of Flame
actions.desc: The target must make a 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 44 (8d10) fire damage, and if it is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and does not ignite. A target that ignites takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until a creature takes an action to douse the fire.

spells: The eye of fear and flame's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

spells.At will: detect evil and good, detect thoughts

monsters.name: Fog Giant

traits.name: Denizen of the Mist
traits.desc: During its turn, the fog giant ignores the effects of fog cloud spells cast by it or other allied fog giants.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The giant has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two greatsword attacks and casts fog cloud.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 29 (6d6 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +12 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Petty Tyrant (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The fog giant shouts bloodcurdling threats at the creatures that serve it. Each medium or smaller ally of the giant within 120 feet of it that can see or hear it can use its reaction to make a melee attack.

spells: The giant's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

monsters.name: Forlarren

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The forlarren has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Chromatic Ray
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. 3 (1d6) lightning damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.

spells: The forlarren's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spells.At will: expeditious retreat, false life, minor illusion, prestidigitation
