traits.desc: While the hobgoblin is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hobgoblin makes four attacks, each of which can be an unarmed strike or a dart attack. It can also use Shadow Jaunt once, either before or after one of the attacks.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shadow Jaunt
actions.desc: The hobgoblin magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Both the space it is leaving and its destination must be in dim light or darkness.

spells: The hobgoblin is a 2nd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following wizard spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): minor illusion, prestidigitation, true strike

spells.1st level (3 slots): charm person, disguise self, expeditious retreat, silent image

monsters.name: Howler
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: A howler has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the howler's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The howler makes two bite attacks.

actions.name: Rending Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is frightened it takes an additional 22 (4d10) psychic damage. This attack ignores damage resistance.

actions.name: Mind-Breaking Howl (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The howler emits a keening howl in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area that isn't deafened must succeed on a 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the howler's next turn. While a creature is frightened in this way, its speed is halved, and it is incapacitated. A target that successfully saves is immune to the Mind-Breaking Howl of all howlers for the next 24 hours.

monsters.name: Hungry Sorrowsworn
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing while in dim light or darkness

traits.name: Life Hunger
traits.desc: If a creature within 60 feet of the sorrowsworn regains hit points, the sorrowsworn gains two benefits until the end of its next turn: it has advantage on attack rolls, and its Bite deals an extra 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a hit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sorrowsworn makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape 16), and it is restrained until the grapple ends. While grappling a creature, the sorrowsworn can't make a Claw attack.

monsters.name: Hutijin
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Infernal Despair
traits.desc: Each creature within 15 feet of Hutijin that isn't a devil makes saving throws with disadvantage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Hutijin fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Hutijin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Hutijin's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Hutijin regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Hutijin dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Hutijin makes four attacks: one with his bite, one with his claw, one with his mace, and one with his tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 15 (2d6 + 8) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a 22 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. While poisoned in this way, the target can't regain hit points, and it takes 10 (3d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The poisoned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 19 (2d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: Hutijin magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

reactions.name: Fearful Voice (Recharge 5-6)
reactions.desc: In response to taking damage, Hutijin utters a dreadful word of power. Each creature within 30 feet of him that isn't a devil must succeed on a 22 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of him for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that saves against this effect is immune to Hutijin's Fearful Voice for 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Hutijin attacks once with his mace.

legendary_actions.name: Lightning Storm (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Hutijin releases lightning in a 20-foot radius. All other creatures in that area must each make a 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport
legendary_actions.desc: Hutijin uses his Teleport action.

spells: Hutijin's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 22). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spells.At will: alter self (can become Medium when changing his appearance), animate dead, detect magic, hold monster, invisibility (self only), lightning bolt, suggestion, wall of fire

monsters.name: Hydroloth
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, lightning, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The hydroloth can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The hydroloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The hydroloth's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Secure Memory
traits.desc: The hydroloth is immune to the waters of the River Styx as well as any effect that would steal or modify its memories or detect or read its thoughts.

traits.name: Watery Advantage
traits.desc: While submerged in liquid, the hydroloth has advantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hydroloth makes two melee attacks. In place of one of these attacks, it can cast one spell that takes 1 action to cast.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Steal Memory (1/Day)
actions.desc: The hydroloth targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target takes 4d6 psychic damage, and it must make a 16 Intelligence saving throw. On a successful save, the target becomes immune to this hydroloth's Steal Memory for 24 hours. On a failed save, the target loses all proficiencies, it can't cast spells, it can't understand language, and if its Intelligence and Charisma scores are higher than 5, they become 5. Each time the target finishes a long rest, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. A greater restoration or remove curse spell cast on the target ends this effect early.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The hydroloth magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

spells: The hydroloth's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spells.At will: darkness, detect magic, dispel magic, invisibility (self only), water walk

spells.3/day each: control water, crown of madness, fear, phantasmal killer, suggestion

monsters.name: Illusionist Wizard

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The illusionist makes two Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 14 (2d10 + 3) psychic damage.

bonus_actions.name: Displacement (Recharge 5-6)
bonus_actions.desc: The illusionist projects an illusion that makes the illusionist appear to be standing in a place a few inches from its actual location, causing any creature to have disadvantage on attack rolls against the illusionist. The effect lasts for 1 minute, and it ends early if the illusionist takes damage, if it is incapacitated, or if its speed becomes 0.

spells: The illusionist casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 13):

spells.At will: dancing lights, mage hand, minor illusion

spells.2/day each: disguise self, invisibility, mage armor, major image, phantasmal force, phantom steed

monsters.name: Juiblex
monsters.damage_immunities: poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing that is nonmagical
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned, unconscious

traits.name: Foul
traits.desc: Any creature, other than an ooze, that starts its turn within 10 feet of Juiblex must succeed on a 21 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Juiblex fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Juiblex has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Juiblex's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Juiblex regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes fire or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. Juiblex dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: Juiblex can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Juiblex makes three acid lash attacks.

actions.name: Acid Lash
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 21 (4d6 + 7) acid damage. Any creature killed by this attack is drawn into Juiblex's body, and the corpse is obliterated after 1 minute.

actions.name: Eject Slime (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Juiblex spews out a corrosive slime, targeting one creature that it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must make a 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 55 (10d10) acid damage. Unless the target avoids taking any of this damage, any metal armor worn by the target takes a permanent −1 penalty to the AC it offers, and any metal weapon it is carrying or wearing takes a permanent −1 penalty to damage rolls. The penalty worsens each time a target is subjected to this effect. If the penalty on an object drops to −5, the object is destroyed.

legendary_actions.name: Acid Splash
legendary_actions.desc: Juiblex casts acid splash.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Juiblex makes one acid lash attack.

legendary_actions.name: Corrupting Touch (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. 21 (4d6 + 7) poison damage, and the target is slimed. Until the slime is scraped off with an action, the target is poisoned, and any creature, other than an ooze, is poisoned while within 10 feet of the target.

spells: Juiblex's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). Juiblex can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

monsters.name: Ki-rin
monsters.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 19

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the ki-rin fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The ki-rin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The ki-rin's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ki-rin makes three attacks: two with its hooves and one with its horn.

actions.name: Hoof
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 10 (2d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Horn
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

legendary_actions.name: Detect
legendary_actions.desc: The ki-rin makes a Wisdom (Perception) check or a Wisdom (Insight) check.

legendary_actions.name: Smite
legendary_actions.desc: The ki-rin makes a hoof attack or casts sacred flame.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: The ki-rin moves up to its half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

spells: The ki-rin's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 17). The ki-rin can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spells.At will: gaseous form, major image (6th-level version), wind walk

spells: The ki-rin is a 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): light, mending, sacred flame, spare the dying, thaumaturgy

spells.1st level (4 slots): command, cure wounds, detect evil and good, protection from evil and good, sanctuary

spells.4th level (3 slots): banishment, freedom of movement, guardian of faith

spells.5th level (3 slots): greater restoration, mass cure wounds, scrying

traits.name: Dragon's Resistance
traits.desc: The kobold has resistance to a type of damage based on the color of dragon that invested it with power (choose or roll a d10): 1–2, acid (black); 3–4, cold (white); 5–6, fire (red); 7–8, lightning (blue); 9–10, poison (green).

traits.name: Heart of the Dragon
traits.desc: If the kobold is frightened or paralyzed by an effect that allows a saving throw, it can repeat the save at the start of its turn to end the effect on itself and all kobolds within 30 feet of it. Any kobold that benefits from this trait (including the dragonshield) has advantage on its next attack roll.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kobold makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Weapon Invention
actions.desc: The kobold uses one of the following options (roll a d8 or choose one); the kobold can use each one no more than once per day:

actions.name: 1. Acid
actions.desc: The kobold hurls a flask of Acid (vial)) acid damage.

actions.name: 2. Alchemist's fire
actions.desc: The kobold throws a flask of Alchemist's Fire (flask) Dexterity check to extinguish the flames.

actions.name: 3. Basket of Centipedes
actions.desc: The kobold throws a small basket into a 5-foot-square space within 20 feet of it. A swarm of centipedes chance that the swarm disperses.

actions.name: 4. Green Slime Pot
actions.desc: The kobold throws a clay pot full of green slime at the target, and it breaks open on impact. Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, range 5/20 ft., one target. The target is covered in a patch of {@hazard green slime} (see chapter 5 of the Dungeon Master's Guide). Miss: A patch of green slime covers a randomly determined 5-foot-square section of wall or floor within 5 feet of the target.

actions.name: 5. Rot Grub Pot
actions.desc: The kobold throws a clay pot into a 5-foot-square space within 20 feet of it, and it breaks open on impact. A swarm of rot grubs (see appendix A) emerges from the shattered pot and remains a hazard in that square.

actions.name: 6. Scorpion on a Stick
actions.desc: The kobold makes a melee attack with a scorpion tied to the end of a 5-foot-long pole. Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 1 piercing damage, and the target must make a 9 Constitution saving throw, taking 4 (1d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: 7. Skunk in a Cage
actions.desc: The kobold releases a skunk into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. The skunk has a walking speed of 20 feet, AC 10, 1 hit point, and no effective attacks. It rolls initiative and, on its turn, uses its action to spray musk at a random creature within 5 feet of it. The target must make a 9 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target retches and can't take actions for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that doesn't need to breathe or is immune to poison automatically succeeds on the saving throw. Once the skunk has sprayed its musk, it can't do so again until it finishes a short or long rest.

actions.name: 8. Wasp Nest in a Bag
actions.desc: The kobold throws a small bag into a 5-foot-square space within 20 feet of it. A swarm of wasps chance that the swarm disperses.

monsters.name: Kobold Scale Sorcerer

traits.name: Sorcery Points
traits.desc:
The kobold has 3 sorcery points. It regains all its spent sorcery points when it finishes a long rest. It can spend its sorcery points on the following options:
Heightened Spell: When it casts a spell that forces a creature to a saving throw to resist the spell's effects, the kobold can spend 3 sorcery points to give one target of the spell disadvantage on its first saving throw against the spell.
Subtle Spell: When the kobold casts a spell, it can spend 1 sorcery point to cast the spell without any somatic or verbal components.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature it at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

spells: The kobold is a 3rd-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following sorcerer spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, mage hand, mending, poison spray

spells.1st level (4 slots): charm person, chromatic orb, expeditious retreat

monsters.name: Korred
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.senses: darkvision 120 ft., tremorsense 120 ft., passive Perception 15

traits.name: Command Hair
traits.desc:
The korred has at least one 50-foot-long rope woven out of its hair. As a bonus action, the korred commands one such rope within 30 feet of it to move up to 20 feet and entangle a Large or smaller creature that the korred can see. The target must succeed on a 13 Dexterity saving throw or become grappled by the rope (escape 13). Until this grapple ends. the target is restrained. The korred can use a bonus action to release the target, which is also freed if the korred dies or becomes incapacitated.
A rope of korred hair has AC 20 and 20 hit points. It regains 1 hit point at the start of each of the korred's turns while it has at least 1 hit point and the korred is alive. If the rope drops to 0 hit points, it is destroyed.

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.desc: The korred has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

traits.name: Stone's Strength
traits.desc: While on the ground, the korred deals 2 extra dice of damage with any weapon attack (included in its attacks).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The korred makes two attacks with its greatclub or hurls two rocks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, or 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage if the korred is on the ground.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +9 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, or 24 (4d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage if the korred is on the ground.

spells: The korred's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (save 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

spells.At will: commune with nature, meld into stone, stone shape

spells.1/day each: conjure elemental (as 6th-level spell; galeb duhr, gargoyle, earth elemental, or xorn only), Otto's irresistible dance

monsters.name: Kraken Priest
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The priest can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Thunderous Touch
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 27 (5d10) thunder damage.

actions.name: Voice of the Kraken (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: A kraken speaks through the priest with a thunderous voice audible within 300 feet. Creatures of the priest's choice that can hear the kraken's words (which are spoken in Abyssal, Infernal, or Primordial) must succeed on a 14 Charisma saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spells: The priest's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spells.3/day each: control water, darkness, water breathing, water walk

monsters.name: Kruthik Hive Lord
monsters.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 12

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The kruthik has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The kruthik has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kruthik's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.desc: The kruthik can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kruthik makes two stab attacks or two spike attacks.

actions.name: Stab
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Spike
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Acid Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The kruthik sprays acid in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The leucrotta has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Kicking Retreat
traits.desc: If the leucrotta attacks with its hooves, it can take the Disengage action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.desc: The leucrotta can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

traits.name: Rampage
traits.desc: When the leucrotta reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, it can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make an attack with its hooves.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The leucrotta makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its hooves.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the leucrotta scores a critical hit, it rolls the damage dice three times, instead of twice.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Leviathan
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the leviathan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Partial Freeze
traits.desc: If the leviathan takes 50 cold damage or more during a single turn, the leviathan partially freezes; until the end of its next turn, its speeds are reduced to 20 feet, and it makes attack rolls with disadvantage.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The leviathan deals double damage to objects and structures (included in Tidal Wave).

traits.name: Water Form
traits.desc: The leviathan can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The leviathan makes two attacks: one with its slam and one with its tail.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 15 (1d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) acid damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 16 (1d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d12) acid damage.

actions.name: Tidal Wave (Recharge 6)
actions.desc:
While submerged, the leviathan magically creates a wall of water centered on itself. The wall is up 250 feet long, up to 250 feet high, and up to 50 feet thick. When the wall appears, all other creatures within its area must each make a 24 Strength saving throw. A creature takes 33 (6d10) bludgeoning damage on failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
At the start of each of the leviathan's turns after the wall appears, the wall, along with any other creatures in it, moves 50 feet away from the leviathan. Any Huge or smaller creature inside the wall or whose space the wall enters when it moves must succeed on a 24 Strength saving throw or take 27 (5d10) bludgeoning damage. A creature takes this damage no more than once on a turn. At the end of each turn the wall moves, the wall's height is reduced by 50 feet, and the damage creatures take from the wall on subsequent rounds is reduced by 1d10. When the wall reaches 0 feet in height, the effect ends.
A creature caught in the wall can move by swimming. Because of the force of the wave, though, the creature must make a successful 24 Strength (Athletics) check to swim at all during that turn.

legendary_actions.name: Slam (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The leviathan makes one slam attack.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: The leviathan moves up to its speed.

monsters.name: Lonely Sorrowsworn
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing while in dim light or darkness

traits.name: Psychic Leech
traits.desc: At the start of each of the sorrowsworn's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

traits.name: Thrives on Company
traits.desc: The sorrowsworn has advantage on attack rolls while it is within 30 feet of at least two other creatures. It otherwise has disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sorrowsworn makes one Harpoon Arm attack, and it uses Sorrowful Embrace.

actions.name: Harpoon Arm
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape 15) if it is a Large or smaller creature. The sorrowsworn has two harpoon arms and can grapple up to two creatures at once.

actions.name: Sorrowful Embrace
actions.desc: Each creature grappled by the sorrowsworn must make a 15 Wisdom saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In either case, the sorrowsworn pulls each of those creatures up to 30 feet straight toward it.

monsters.name: Lost Sorrowsworn
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing while in dim light or darkness

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sorrowsworn makes two Arm Spike attacks.

actions.name: Arm Spike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Embrace (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 25 (4d10 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape 14) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. Until the grapple ends, the target is frightened, and it takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage at the end of each of its turns. The sorrowsworn can grapple only one creature at a time.

reactions.name: Tightening Embrace
reactions.desc: If the sorrowsworn takes damage, the creature grappled by Embrace takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The steeder can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Extraordinary Leap
traits.desc: The distance of the steeder's long jumps is tripled; every foot of its walking speed that it spends on the jump allows it to jump 3 feet.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Sticky Leg
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Small or Tiny creature. The target is stuck to the steeder's leg and is grappled until it escapes (escape 12). The steeder can have only one creature grappled at a time.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.desc: While the adept is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The adept makes three unarmed strikes or three dart attacks.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, the adept can choose one of the following additional effects:

actions.name: The target must succeed on a 13 Strength saving throw or drop one item it is holding (adept's choice).
The target must succeed on a 13 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
The target must succeed on a 13 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the adept's next turn.
Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Deflect Missile
reactions.desc: In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, the adept deflects the missile. The damage it takes from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + 3. If the damage is reduced to 0, the adept catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and the adept has a hand free.

monsters.name: Marut
monsters.damage_resistances: thunder, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The marut is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the marut fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The marut has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The marut makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Unerring Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack automatic hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 60 force damage, and the target is pushed up to 5 feet away from the marut if it is Huge or smaller.

actions.name: Blazing Edict (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Arcane energy emanates from the marut's chest in a 60-foot cube. Every creature in that area takes 45 radiant damage. Each creature that takes any of this damage must succeed on a 20 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of the marut's next turn.

actions.name: Justify
actions.desc:
The marut targets up to two creatures it can see within 60 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a 20 Charisma saving throw or be teleported to a teleportation circle in the Hall of Concordance in Sigil. A target fails automatically if it is incapacitated. If either target is teleported in this way, the marut teleports with it to the circle.
After teleporting in this way, the marut can't use this action again until it finishes a short or long rest.

spells: The marut's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 20). The marut can innately cast the following spell, requiring no material components.

monsters.name: Master Thief
monsters.languages: any one language (usually Common) plus Thieves' cant

traits.name: Cunning Action
traits.desc: On each of its turns, the thief can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If the thief is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the thief instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: The thief deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the thief that isn't incapacitated and the thief doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The thief makes three attacks with its shortsword.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: The thief halves the damage that it takes from an attack that hits it. The thief must be able to see the attacker.

monsters.name: Maurezhi
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Assume Form
traits.desc: The maurezhi can assume the appearance of any Medium humanoid it has eaten. It remains in this form for 1d6 days, during which time the form gradually decays until, when the effect ends, the form sloughs from the demon's body.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The maurezhi has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The maurezhi makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, its Charisma score is reduced by 1d4. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. The target dies if this reduces its Charisma to 0. It rises 24 hours later as a ghoul, unless it has been revived or its corpse has been destroyed.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an undead, it must succeed on a 12 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Raise Ghoul (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The maurezhi targets one dead ghoul or ghast it can see within 30 feet of it. The target is revived with all its hit points.

traits.name: Rampage
traits.desc: When it reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, the maw demon can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.desc: While in dim light or darkness, the meazel can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

actions.name: Garrote
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target of the meazel's size or smaller. 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape 13 with disadvantage). Until the grapple ends, the target takes 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the meazel's turns. The meazel can't make weapon attacks while grappling a creature in this way.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Shadow Teleport (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc:
The meazel, any equipment it is wearing or carrying, and any creature it is grappling teleport to an unoccupied space within 500 feet of it, provided that the starting space and the destination are in dim light or darkness. The destination must be a place the meazel has seen before, but it need not be within line of sight. If the destination space is occupied, the teleportation leads to the nearest unoccupied space.
Any other creature the meazel teleports becomes cursed by shadow for 1 hour. Until this curse ends, every undead and every creature native to the Shadowfell within 300 feet of the cursed creature can sense it, which prevents that creature from hiding from them.

traits.name: Fear Aura
traits.desc: Any beast or humanoid that starts its turn within 10 feet of the meenlock must succeed on a 11 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the start of the creature's next turn.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in bright light, the meenlock has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Shadow Teleport (Recharge 5-6)
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the meenlock can teleport to an unoccupied space within 30 feet of it, provided that both the space it's teleporting from and its destination are in dim light or darkness. The destination need not be within line of sight.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a 11 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monsters.name: Merregon
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monsters.languages: understands Infernal but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the merregon's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The merregon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The merregon makes two halberd attacks, or if an allied fiend of challenge rating 6 or higher is within 60 feet of it, the merregon makes three halberd attacks.

actions.name: Halberd
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Loyal Bodyguard
reactions.desc: When another fiend within 5 feet of the merregon is hit by an attack, the merregon causes itself to be hit instead.

monsters.name: Merrenoloth
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The merrenoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The merrenoloth's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Teleport
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the merrenoloth magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The merrenoloth uses Fear Gaze once and makes one oar attack.

actions.name: Oar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fear Gaze
actions.desc: The merrenoloth targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spells: The merrenoloth's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spells.At will: charm person, darkness, detect magic, dispel magic, gust of wind

traits.name: Telepathic Hub
traits.desc: When the mindwitness receives a telepathic message, it can telepathically share that message with up to seven other creatures within 600 feet of it that it can see.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mindwitness makes two attacks: one with its tentacles and one with its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 16 (4d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 20 (4d8 + 2) psychic damage. if the target is Large or smaller, it is grappled (escape 13) and must succeed on a 13 Intelligence saving throw or be stunned until this grapple ends.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.desc: The mindwitness shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one to three targets it can see within 120 feet of it:

actions.name: 1. Aversion Ray
actions.desc: The targeted creature must make a 13 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: 2. Fear Ray
actions.desc: The targeted creature must succeed on a 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: 3. Psychic Ray
actions.desc: The target must succeed on a 13 Intelligence saving throw or take 27 (6d8) psychic damage.

actions.name: 4. Slowing Ray
actions.desc: The targeted creature must make a 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target's speed is halved for 1 minute. In addition, the creature can't take reactions, and it can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn but not both. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: 5. Stunning Ray
actions.desc: The targeted creature must succeed on a 13 Constitution saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the start of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: 6. Telekinetic Ray
actions.desc:
If the target is a creature, it must make a 13 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the mindwitness moves it up to 30 feet in any direction, and it is restrained by the ray's telekinetic grip until the start of the mindwitness's next turn or until the mindwitness is incapacitated.
If the target is an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is telekinetically moved up to 30 feet in any direction. The mindwitness can also exert fine control on objects with this ray, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

monsters.name: Moloch
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Moloch fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Moloch has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Moloch's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Moloch regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Moloch dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Moloch makes three attacks: one with his bite, one with his claw, and one with his whip.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 26 (4d8 + 8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Many-Tailed Whip
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 13 (2d4 + 8) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 24 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 30 feet in a straight line toward Moloch.

actions.name: Breath of Despair (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Moloch exhales in a 30-foot cube. Each creature in that area must succeed on a 21 Wisdom saving throw or take 27 (5d10) psychic damage, drop whatever it is holding, and become frightened for 1 minute. While frightened in this way, a creature must take the Dash action and move away from Moloch by the safest available route on each of its turns, unless there is nowhere to move, in which case it needn't take the Dash action. If the creature ends its turn in a location where it doesn't have line of sight to Moloch, the creature can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: Moloch magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

legendary_actions.name: Stinking Cloud
legendary_actions.desc: Moloch casts stinking cloud.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport
legendary_actions.desc: Moloch uses his Teleport action.

legendary_actions.name: Whip
legendary_actions.desc: Moloch makes one attack with his whip.

spells: Moloch's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 21). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spells.At will: alter self (can become Medium when changing his appearance), animate dead, burning hands (as a 7th-level spell), confusion, detect magic, fly, geas, major image, stinking cloud, suggestion, wall of fire

monsters.name: Molydeus
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, poisoned, stunned

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the molydeus fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The molydeus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The molydeus' weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The molydeus makes three attacks: one with its weapon, one with its wolf bite, and one with its snakebite.

actions.name: Demonic Weapon
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 20 (2d10 + 9) slashing damage. If the target has at least one head and the molydeus rolled a 20 on the attack roll, the target is decapitated and dies if it can't survive without that head. A target is immune to this effect if it takes none of the damage, has legendary actions, or is Huge or larger. Such a creature takes an extra 6d8 slashing damage from the hit.

actions.name: Wolf Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 16 (2d6 + 9) piercing damage.

actions.name: Snakebite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. 12 (1d6 + 9) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a 22 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target transforms into a manes if this reduces its hit point maximum to 0. This transformation can be ended only by a wish spell.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: The molydeus makes one attack, either with its demonic weapon or with its snakebite.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: The molydeus moves without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell
legendary_actions.desc: The molydeus casts one spell from its Innate Spellcasting trait.

spells: The molydeus' innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 22). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

monsters.name: Morkoth
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 20

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The morkoth can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The morkoth makes three attacks: two with its bite and one with its tentacles or three with its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 15 (3d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape 14) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends. the target is restrained and takes 15 (3d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the morkoth's turns. and the morkoth can't use its tentacles on another target.

actions.name: Hypnosis
actions.desc: The morkoth projects a 30-foot cone of magical energy. Each creature in that area must make a 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is charmed by the morkoth for 1 minute. While charmed in this way, the target tries to get as close to the morkoth as possible, using its actions to Dash until it is within 5 feet of the morkoth. A charmed target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature has advantage on saving throws against the morkoth's Hypnosis for 24 hours.

reactions.name: Spell Reflection
reactions.desc: If the morkoth makes a successful saving throw against a spell, or a spell attack misses it, the morkoth can choose another creature (including the spellcaster) it can see within 120 feet of it. The spell targets the chosen creature instead of the morkoth. If the spell forced a saving throw, the chosen creature makes its own save. If the spell was an attack, the attack roll is rerolled against the chosen creature.

spells: The morkoth is an 11th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (save 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The morkoth has the following wizard spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): acid splash, mage hand, mending, ray of frost, shocking grasp

spells.1st level (4 slots): detect magic, identify, shield, witch bolt

spells.5th level (3 slots): geas, scrying

traits.name: Mouth of Madness
traits.desc:
The giant is immune to confusion spells and similar magic.
On each of its turns, the giant uses all its movement to move toward the nearest creature or whatever else it might perceive as food. Roll a d10 at the start of each of the giant's turns to determine its action for that turn:
1–3. The giant makes three attacks with its fists against one random target within its reach. If no other creatures are within its reach, the giant flies into a rage and gains advantage on all attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
4–5. The giant makes one attack with its fist against every creature within its reach. If no other creatures are within its reach, the giant makes one fist attack against itself.
6–7. The giant makes one attack with its bite against one random target within its reach. If no other creatures are within its reach, its eyes glaze over and it becomes stunned until the start of its next turn.
8–10. The giant makes three attacks against one random target within its reach: one attack with its bite and two with its fists. If no other creatures are within its reach, the giant flies into a rage and gains advantage on all attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the giant magically regains hit points equal to the damage dealt.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Nabassu
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Demonic Shadows
traits.desc: The nabassu darkens the area around its body in a 10-foot radius. Nonmagical light can't illuminate this area of dim light.

traits.name: Devour Soul
traits.desc: A nabassu can eat the soul of a creature it has killed within the last hour, provided that creature is neither a construct nor an undead. The devouring requires the nabassu to be within 5 feet of the corpse for at least 10 minutes, after which it gains a number of Hit Dice (d8s) equal to half the creature's number of Hit Dice. Roll those dice, and increase the nabassu's hit points by the numbers rolled. For every 4 Hit Dice the nabassu gains in this way, its attacks deal an extra 3 (1d6) damage on a hit. The nabassu retains these benefits for 6 days. A creature devoured by a nabassu can be restored to life only by a wish spell.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The nabassu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The nabassu's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The nabassu uses its Soul-Stealing Gaze and makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with its bite.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 32 (4d12 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Soul-Stealing Gaze
actions.desc: The nabassu targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the nabassu and isn't a construct or an undead, it must succeed on a 16 Charisma saving throw or reduce its hit point maximum by 13 (2d12) damage and give the nabassu an equal number of temporary hit points. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0, and if the target is a humanoid, it immediately rises as a ghoul under the nabassu's control.

monsters.name: Nagpa
monsters.languages: Common plus up to five other languages

traits.name: Corruption
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the nagpa targets one creature it can see within 90 feet of it. The target must make a 20 Charisma saving throw. An evil creature makes the save with disadvantage. On a failed save, the target is charmed by the nagpa until the start of the nagpa's next turn. On a successful save, the target becomes immune to the nagpa's Corruption for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Paralysis (Recharge 6)
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the nagpa forces each creature within 30 feet of it to succeed on a 20 Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A paralyzed target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Undead and constructs are immune to this effect.

actions.name: Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

spells: The nagpa is a 15th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks). A nagpa has the following wizard spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): chill touch, fire bolt, mage hand, message, minor illusion

spells.1st level (4 slots): charm person, detect magic, protection from evil and good, witch bolt

spells.2nd level (3 slots): hold person, ray of enfeeblement, suggestion

spells.4th level (3 slots): confusion, hallucinatory terrain, wall of fire

monsters.name: Narzugon

traits.name: Diabolical Sense
traits.desc: The narzugon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive good-aligned creatures.

traits.name: Infernal Tack
traits.desc: The narzugon wears spurs that are part of infernal tack, which allow it to summon its nightmare companion.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The narzugon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The narzugon uses its Infernal Command or Terrifying Command. It also makes three hellfire lance attacks.

actions.name: Hellfire Lance
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 11 (1d12 + 5) piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) fire damage. If this damage kills a creature, the creature's soul rises from the River Styx as a lemure in Avernus in 1d4 hours.
If the creature isn't revived before then, only a wish spell or killing the lemure and casting true resurrection on the creature's original body can restore it to life. Constructs and devils are immune to this effect.

actions.name: Infernal Command
actions.desc: Each ally of the narzugon within 60 feet of it can't be charmed or frightened until the end of the narzugon's next turn.

actions.name: Terrifying Command
actions.desc:
Each creature that isn't a fiend within 60 feet of the narzugon that can hear it must succeed on a 17 Charisma saving throw or become frightened of it for 1 minute.
A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that makes a successful saving throw is immune to this narzugon's Terrifying Command for 24 hours.

actions.name: Healing (1/Day)
actions.desc: The narzugon, or one creature it touches, regains up to 100 hit points.

monsters.name: Necromancer Wizard

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The necromancer makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 25 (4d10 + 3) necrotic damage.

bonus_actions.name: Summon Undead (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The necromancer magically summons five skeleton. The summoned creatures appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of the necromancer, whom they obey. They take their turns immediately after the necromancer. Each lasts for 1 hour, until it or the necromancer dies, or until the necromancer dismisses it as a bonus action.

reactions.name: Grim Harvest (1/Turn)
reactions.desc: When the necromancer kills a creature with necrotic damage, the necromancer regains 9 (2d8) hit points.

spells: The necromancer casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 15):

spells.2/day each: bestow curse, dimension door, mage armor, web

traits.desc: The neogi has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened, and magic can't put the neogi to sleep.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The neogi can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The neogi makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a 12 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Enslave (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: The neogi targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the neogi for 1 day, or until the neogi dies or is more than 1 mile from the target. The charmed target obeys the neogi's commands and can't take reactions, and the neogi and the target can communicate telepathically with each other at a distance of up to 1 mile. Whenever the charmed target takes damage, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monsters.name: Neothelid
source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage

traits.name: Creature Sense
traits.desc: The neothelid is aware of the presence of creatures within 1 mile of it that have an Intelligence score of 4 or higher. It knows the distance and direction to each creature, as well as each creature's Intelligence score, but can't sense anything else about it. A creature protected by a mind blank spell, a nondetection spell, or similar magic can't be perceived in this manner.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The neothelid has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) psychic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 18 Strength saving throw or be swallowed by the neothelid. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the neothelid, and it takes 35 (10d6) acid damage at the start of each of the neothelid's turns.
If the neothelid takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the neothelid must succeed on a 18 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the neothelid. If the neothelid dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Acid Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The neothelid exhales acid in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells: The neothelid's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

monsters.name: Nightwalker
monsters.damage_resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Annihilating Aura
traits.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the nightwalker must succeed on a 21 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and grant the nightwalker advantage on attack rolls against it until the start of the creature's next turn. Undead are immune to this aura.

traits.name: Life Eater
traits.desc: A creature reduced to 0 hit points from damage dealt by the nightwalker dies and can't be revived by any means short of a wish spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The nightwalker uses Enervating Focus twice, or it uses Enervating Focus and Finger of Doom, if available.

actions.name: Enervating Focus
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 28 (5d8 + 6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a 21 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest.

actions.name: Finger of Doom (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The nightwalker points at one creature it can see within 300 feet of it. The target must succeed on a 21 Wisdom saving throw or take 26 (4d12) necrotic damage and become frightened until the end of the nightwalker's next turn. While frightened in this way, the creature is also paralyzed. If a target's saving throw is successful, the target is immune to the nightwalker's Finger of Doom for the next 24 hours.

monsters.name: Nilbog

traits.name: Nilbogism
traits.desc: Any creature that attempts to damage the nilbog must first succeed on a 12 Charisma saving throw or be charmed until the end of the creature's next turn. A creature charmed in this way must use its action praising the nilbog. The nilbog can't regain hit points, including through magical healing, except through its Reversal of Fortune reaction.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.desc: The nilbog can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

actions.name: Fool's Scepter
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Reversal of Fortune
reactions.desc: In response to another creature dealing damage to the nilbog, the nilbog reduces the damage to 0 and regains 1d6 hit points.

spells: The nilbog's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 12). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spells.At will: mage hand, Tasha's hideous laughter, vicious mockery

monsters.name: Nupperibo
monsters.damage_resistances: acid, cold, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
monsters.senses: blindsight 10 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 11

traits.name: Cloud of Vermin
traits.desc: Any creature, other than a devil, that starts its turn within 20 feet of the nupperibo must make a 11 Constitution saving throw. A creature within the areas of two or more nupperibos makes the saving throw with disadvantage. On a failure, the creature takes 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

traits.name: Hunger-Driven
traits.desc: In the Nine Hells, the nupperibos can flawlessly track any creature that has taken damage from any nupperibo's Cloud of Vermin within the previous 24 hours.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
