traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.desc: The sphinx is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the sphinx's intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The sphinx's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sphinx makes a ram attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Ram
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 17 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

legendary_actions.name: Ram Attack
legendary_actions.desc: The sphinx makes one ram attack.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The sphinx magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The manticore makes two attacks, one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. The target must make a 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The serpopard has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.desc: If the serpopard moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a bite attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the serpopard can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must make a 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The homarid can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The homarid makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape 11). The homarid has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.desc: If the kavu moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the kavu can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kavu makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

traits.name: Raking Charge
traits.desc: If the kavu moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a bite attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the kavu can make one rend attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. 23 (4d8 + 5) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Creepy Doll
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.languages: speaks and understands the languages known by its creator

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the creepy doll remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary, inanimate doll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The creepy doll makes one attack with its scissors and uses Psychic Assault.

actions.name: Scissors
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Psychic Assault
actions.desc: The creepy doll targets one creature it can see within 10 feet of it that has a brain. The target must succeed on a 12 Intelligence saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage. Also on a failure, roll 3d6. If the total equals or exceeds the target's Intelligence score, that score is reduced to 0. The target is stunned until it regains at least one point of Intelligence, as from the greater restoration spell or similar magic.

actions.name: Body Exchange
actions.desc:
The creepy doll initiates an Intelligence contest with an incapacitated humanoid within 5 feet of it. If it wins the contest, the creepy doll's spirit inhabits the target's body while the target's spirit is placed into the creepy doll's body. The creepy doll controls the target's body completely. It retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The target retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma while inhabiting the creepy doll's body.
The body exchange lasts until the doll's spirit is forced out by magic. (The dispel evil and good spell will accomplish this, though the doll is not one of the creature types whose possession that spell normally ends.) The body and the doll must be within 5 feet of each other for such an effect to work. The target is immune to this doll's Body Exchange for 24 hours after winning the Intelligence contest or after the exchange ends.

monsters.name: Geist
monsters.languages: any languages it knew in life

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.desc: The geist can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The geist can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.desc: The geist enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

actions.name: Possession (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: One creature that the geist can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the geist; the geist then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The geist now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The geist can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the geist ends it as a bonus action, or the geist is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the geist reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this geist's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends. The geist can instead target the corpse of a creature, effectively using its own life force to animate the corpse as a zombie. The animated corpse uses zombie statistics and returns to death if the geist ends the possession.

monsters.name: Keeper of the Feather
spells: The keeper is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): druidcraft, produce flame, shillelagh

spells.1st level (4 slots): entangle, longstrider, speak with animals, thunderwave

monsters.name: Vampire Neonate
monsters.damage_resistances: necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with living wood weapons

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vampire regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vampire makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vampire can grapple the target (escape 13).

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by the vampire, incapacitated, or restrained. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: Vampiric Glamer
actions.desc: The vampire obscures its form with mind-affecting magic that makes others perceive it as a beautiful human of the same size and shape. The illusion ends if the vampire takes a bonus action to end it or if the vampire dies. A creature that can see the vampire can take an action to visually inspect it, ending the mental effect on itself and seeing the vampire's true form with a successful 20 Wisdom (Perception) check.

actions.name: Aura of Silence
actions.desc: The vampire shrouds itself in a cloak of silence to a radius of 2 feet. Within that radius, the effect is the same as the silence spell.

monsters.name: Werewolf (Krallenhorde)
monsters.damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The werewolf polymorphs into a wolf-humanoid canid form, or back into its true human form. This change is dictated by the moon, but can also be induced by trauma or strong emotion. Its statistics, other than its AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.desc: The werewolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Howlpack: Vildin
traits.desc: Vildin Rampage (Canid Form Only). When the werewolf reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, it can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

actions.name: Multiattack (Canid Form Only)
actions.desc: The werewolf makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws or spear.

actions.name: Bite (Canid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws (Canid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spear (Human Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.desc: If damage reduces the cat to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the cat drops to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.desc: If damage reduces the rat to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the rat drops to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.desc: If damage reduces the snake to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the snake drops to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Aether Scent
traits.desc: The gremlin can pinpoint, by scent, the location of refined or unrefined aether within 30 feet of it.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Siphon
actions.desc:
The gremlin drains aether from an aether-powered device it can see within 5 feet of it. If the object isn't being worn or carried, the touch automatically drains aether. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature must succeed on a 11 Dexterity saving throw to keep it out of the gremlin's reach.
If the aether-powered device grants any bonus (to attack rolls, damage rolls, Armor Class, and so on), that bonus is reduced by 1. If the device has charges, it loses 1 charge. Otherwise, it stops functioning for 1 round. Left unhindered, a gremlin can completely destroy an aether-powered device.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 1 slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 18 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the leviathan. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the leviathan, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the leviathan's turns.
If the leviathan takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the leviathan must succeed on a 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the leviathan. If the leviathan dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

monsters.name: Chupacabra
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical weapons

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the chupacabra has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Drain Blood
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature that is prone, incapacitated, or restrained. 5 (1d6 + 2) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a 13 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken, and the chupacabra regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

reactions.name: Pin
reactions.desc: If a creature within 5 feet of the chupacabra stands up, the chupacabra can use its reaction to make a bite attack.

monsters.name: Elder Dinosaur
monsters.damage_immunities: fire, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the elder dinosaur fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The elder dinosaur has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The elder dinosaur deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Uniqueness
traits.desc: These statistics are shared by all six elder dinosaurs: Elder Dinosaur (Etali, Primal Storm)

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of the elder dinosaur's choice within 120 feet of it and aware of it must succeed on a 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the elder dinosaur is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself ona success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the elder dinosaur's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: The elder dinosaur makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the elder dinosaur, and it takes 56 (16d6) acid damage at the start of each of the elder dinosaur's turns. If the elder dinosaur takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of it. If the elder dinosaur dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: The elder dinosaur makes one claw attack, tail attack, wing attack, or flipper attack.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: The elder dinosaur moves up to half its speed.

legendary_actions.name: Chomp (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The elder dinosaur makes one bite attack or uses its Swallow.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The deathspitter makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spit Poison
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 15/30 ft., one creature. The target must make a 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, a creature that fails its saving throw is blinded until the end of the deathspitter's next turn.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Gishath fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Gishath makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its stomp or tail. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 39 (5d12 + 7) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 19 Dexterity saving throw or it is grappled (escape 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and Gishath can't bite another target.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc:
Gishath makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside Gishath, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of Gishath's turns.
If Gishath takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a 18 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of it. If Gishath dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 29 (5d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a 19 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 25 (4d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Gishath makes one stomp or tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: Roar (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Each creature that is within 120 feet of Gishath and can hear it must succeed on a 19 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Gishath's Roar for the next 24 hours.

monsters.name: Sunbird
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.languages: Giant Owl, understands Common but can't speak it

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.desc: When the sunbird dies, it explodes, and each creature within 30 feet of it must make a 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried. The sunbird's body turns to ash, but an egg is left where the sunbird was.

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.desc: At the start of each of the sunbird's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 11 (2d10) fire damage, and flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried ignite. A creature that touches the sunbird or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 11 (2d10) fire damage. The aura also sheds bright light in a 60-foot radius and dim light for an additional 60 feet.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The sunbird doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
traits.desc: The sunbird has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sunbird makes two talon attacks.

actions.name: Talon
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 16 (2d6 + 9) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage, and the target is grappled (escape 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the sunbird can't attack another target with that talon. A grappled creature takes 11 (2d10) fire damage at the start of each of the sunbird's turns.

monsters.name: Archon of Redemption
monsters.damage_resistances: radiant, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Angelic Weapons
traits.desc: The archon's weapon attacks are magical. When the archon hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Axiomatic Mind
traits.desc: The archon can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its understanding of justice.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: One Being
traits.desc: Though it appears as a humanoid creature riding a mount, an archon is a single being. The "rider" can't be dismounted, and no other means can separate the two portions of the archon's being short of its death.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The archon makes two attacks: one with its sword and one with its claws.

actions.name: Sword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

spells: The archon's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 17). The archon can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

monsters.name: Android
monsters.speed: 30 ft., fly 30 ft. (hover; aerialist only), swim 30 ft. (diver only)
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (sentry only), darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 17
monsters.languages: Common plus the languages spoken by its creator

traits.name: Design Specialization
traits.desc: When the android is created, it gains one of six possible designs suited for its role (choose or roll a d6): 1, aerialist; 2, diplomat; 3, diver; 4, duelist; 5, medic; 6, sentry. This design determines certain traits in this stat block.

traits.name: Lightning Overload
traits.desc: When the android takes lightning damage, it must succeed on a 10 Constitution saving throw or have the stunned condition until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The android makes two Force Strike attacks.

actions.name: Force Strike
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 40/120 ft., one target. 15 (2d10 + 4) force damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 15 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

reactions.name: Parry (Duelist Only)
reactions.desc: The android adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack roll that would hit it. To do so, the android must see the attacker.

spells: The android casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability:

spells.2/day each: Cure Wounds (as a 3rd-level spell; medic only), Identify, Tongues (diplomat only)

monsters.name: Barkburr
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (can't see beyond this radius), passive Perception 12

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: If the barkburr is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the barkburr move or act, that creature must succeed on a 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the barkburr is animate.

traits.name: Springing Leap
traits.desc: With or without a running start, the barkburr's high jump is up to 15 feet, and its long jump is up to 30 feet. The barkburr's jumps can exceed its speed if its speed isn't 0.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The barkburr makes two Poison Barb attacks and uses Lignify if able.

actions.name: Poison Barb
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage, and the barkburr attaches to the target. While the barkburr is attached, it can't make Poison Barb attacks, and the target has the restrained condition as its body begins to transform into wood.
An attached barkburr can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature that can reach the barkburr, including the target, can use its action to detach the barkburr by making a successful 13 Strength (Athletics) check.

actions.name: Lignify
actions.desc: The barkburr targets the creature it is attached to, and the target must make a 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the petrified condition until freed by the Greater Restoration spell or another effect, except it turns into a tree instead of stone. Any equipment the target is wearing or carrying is absorbed into the tree's bark.

traits.name: Brave
traits.desc: The champion has advantage on saving throws against the frightened condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The champion makes two Lightning Mace attacks or three Handaxe attacks.

actions.name: Lightning Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) lightning damage.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Aura of Resilience (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The champion exudes an aura of ghostly lightning that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. While this aura is active, the champion and each creature of its choice within the aura have advantage on saving throws. The aura moves with the champion and lasts for 1 minute, until the champion has the incapacitated condition, or until the champion uses another bonus action to end the aura.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The champion makes three Longsword attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands.

bonus_actions.name: Aura of Fury (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The champion summons an aura of ghostly animals that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. While this aura is active, the champion and all its allies in the aura have advantage on attack rolls. The aura moves with the champion and lasts for 1 minute, until the champion has the incapacitated condition, or until the champion uses another bonus action to end the aura.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The champion adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the champion must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monsters.name: Champion of Usamigaras

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The champion makes two Arcane Burst attacks or makes one Arcane Burst attack and uses Spellcasting.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 8 (1d10 + 3) force damage.

bonus_actions.name: Aura of Deception (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The champion emits an aura of ghostly illusions that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. While this aura is active, creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against the champion and any of the champion's allies that are in the aura. The aura moves with the champion and lasts for 1 minute, until the champion has the incapacitated condition, or until the champion uses another bonus action to end the aura.

spells: The champion casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 13):

spells.At will: Light, Mage Armor (self only), Mage Hand, Minor Illusion

spells.2/day each: Charm Person, Disguise Self, Silent Image

monsters.name: Combat Robot
monsters.languages: Common plus the languages spoken by its creator

traits.name: Lightning Overload
traits.desc: When the robot takes lightning damage, it must succeed on a 10 Constitution saving throw or have the stunned condition until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The robot makes two Tentacle attacks or three Laser Beam attacks.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape 16). While grappled, the target also has the restrained condition. The robot has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Laser Beam
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 16 (4d6 + 2) radiant damage.

actions.name: Grenade Launcher (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The robot fires a grenade at a point it can see within 120 feet of itself. The grenade explodes in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point, creating one of the following effects (robot's choice):

actions.name: Concussion Grenade
actions.desc: Each creature in the sphere must make a 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Sleep Grenade
actions.desc: Each creature in the sphere must succeed on a 15 Constitution saving throw or have the unconscious condition for 1 hour. The condition ends on a creature early if the creature takes damage or if another creature uses an action to shake it awake.

bonus_actions.name: Emergency Speed (2/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The robot takes the Dash or Disengage action.

monsters.name: Derro Apprentice

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The derro has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the derro has disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Chaos Blast
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 10 (3d6) damage. Roll a d4 to determine the damage type: 1, acid; 2, cold; 3, fire; 4, lightning.

actions.name: Force Burst (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Raw arcane magic bursts out from the derro. Each creature within 10 feet of it must make a 11 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 7 (2d6) force damage and has the prone condition. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

spells: The derro casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 11):

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The derro has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the derro has disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Hooked Spear
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the derro can choose to deal no damage, and instead the target has the prone condition.

actions.name: Throwing Hammer
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Derwyth

traits.name: Tree Shape (2/Day)
traits.desc: Over the course of 1 minute, Derwyth can magically transform into a Huge or smaller tree and remain in that form for 24 hours or until she ends this transformation early (no action required). Her equipment melds into her new form. While in this form, her Armor Class is 16, she has the incapacitated condition, and she can't move or speak.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +2 to hit (+4 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.

spells: Derwyth is a 4th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following druid spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): druidcraft, produce flame, shillelagh

spells.1st level (4 slots): entangle, longstrider, speak with animals, thunderwave

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Drelnza fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Drelnza wields Heretic.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: Drelnza can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.desc: Drelnza takes 20 radiant damage when she starts her turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, she has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Drelnza makes one Bite attack and one Heretic attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Drelnza regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way and then buried rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Drelnza's control.

actions.name: Heretic
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft. one target. 40 (6d10 + 7) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a 17 Constitution saving throw or have the paralyzed condition until the start of Drelnza's next turn. Celestials have disadvantage on the saving throw.

actions.name: Charm
actions.desc:
Drelnza targets one Humanoid she can see within 30 feet of herself. The target must succeed on a 17 Wisdom saving throw or have the charmed condition. While charmed in this way, the target regards Drelnza as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. The target isn't under Drelnza's control, but it takes her requests and actions in the most favorable way.
Each time Drelnza or her allies do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Drelnza is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

reactions.name: Move
reactions.desc: Immediately after a creature Drelnza can see ends its turn, Drelnza moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Drelnza adds 5 to her AC against one melee attack that would hit her. To do so, she must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The froghemoth can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the froghemoth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Shock Susceptibility
traits.desc: If the froghemoth takes lightning damage, it suffers two effects until the end of its next turn: its speed is halved, and it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The froghemoth makes one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks, and it can use Tongue.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 23 (3d10 + 7) piercing damage, and the target is swallowed if it is a Medium or smaller creature. A swallowed creature has the blinded and restrained conditions, has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the froghemoth, and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the froghemoth's turns.
The froghemoth's gullet can hold up to three creatures at a time. If the froghemoth takes 25 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the froghemoth must succeed on a 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which lands in a space within 10 feet of the froghemoth and has the prone condition. If the froghemoth dies, any swallowed creatures are no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting with the prone condition.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target has the grappled condition (escape 20). Until this grapple ends, the froghemoth can't use this tentacle on another target. The froghemoth has four tentacles.

actions.name: Tongue
actions.desc: The froghemoth targets one Large or smaller creature that it can see within 25 feet of it. The target must make a 20 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the froghemoth.

reactions.name: Alien Gaze
reactions.desc: When a creature the froghemoth can see damages the froghemoth, the froghemoth swivels its eyestalk toward the creature and pierces the creature's mind with its otherworldly gaze. That creature must make a 18 Intelligence saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Leap
reactions.desc: Immediately after a creature the froghemoth can see ends its turn, the froghemoth jumps up to half its speed. Each creature within 5 feet of the froghemoth when it lands must succeed on a 20 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

traits.name: Brave
traits.desc: The guardian has advantage on saving throws against the frightened condition.

actions.name: Lightning Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) lightning damage.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Horrid Plant
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (can't see beyond this radius), passive Perception 10

traits.name: Horrid Plant Varieties
traits.desc: A horrid plant comes in one of three varieties (choose or roll a d6): 1-2, dew drinker; 3-4, purple blossom; or 5-6, snapper saw. This form determines certain traits in this stat block.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: If the horrid plant is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the horrid plant move or act, that creature must succeed on a 18 Intelligence (Nature) check to discern that the horrid plant isn't an ordinary plant.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The horrid plant makes two Tendril attacks.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape 14), and the horrid plant can pull the target up to 25 feet closer to itself. Until the grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the horrid plant can't use the same tendril on another target. The horrid plant has two tendrils.

bonus_actions.name: Sap Squirt (Purple Blossom Only)
bonus_actions.desc: The horrid plant targets one creature it can see within 15 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 28 (8d6) acid damage and become covered in acidic sap. This sap lasts for 1 minute or until a creature uses its action to scrape the sap off itself or another creature it can reach. A creature covered in sap takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

bonus_actions.name: Spiked Leaves (Snapper Saw Only)
bonus_actions.desc: Creatures within 10 feet of the horrid plant and not behind Cover must make a 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) slashing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus_actions.name: Vampiric Tendril (Dew Drinker Only)
bonus_actions.desc: One creature grappled by the horrid plant must make a 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken, and the horrid plant regains hit points equal to that amount. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

monsters.name: Leprechaun

traits.name: Industrious
traits.desc: The leprechaun is proficient with all artisan's tools and adds double its proficiency bonus to ability checks made with them.

traits.name: Reluctant Refusal
traits.desc: When a creature offers the leprechaun the chance to partake in merriment or revelry such as a song, a dance, or a good meal, the leprechaun must succeed on a 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the charmed condition for 24 hours. While charmed in this way, the leprechaun partakes of the offering, treats the creature as a trusted friend, and seeks to defend it from harm. The charmed condition ends if the creature or any of its allies damage the leprechaun, force the leprechaun to make a saving throw, or steal from the leprechaun.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The leprechaun makes two Cobbler's Hammer attacks and can use Spellcasting.

actions.name: Cobbler's Hammer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) force damage. If the target is a creature, its speed is halved until the start of the leprechaun's next turn.

actions.name: Gift of Luck (1/Day)
actions.desc: The leprechaun touches a creature and magically gifts the target a measure of luck. The creature gains the leprechaun's Astonishing Luck reaction. The creature can use the reaction three times, after which this gift goes away. The leprechaun can revoke this gift from a creature at any time (no action required). A creature can benefit from only one leprechaun's Gift of Luck at a time.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Trick
bonus_actions.desc: The leprechaun takes the Disengage or Hide action or makes a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check.

reactions.name: Astonishing Luck
reactions.desc: When the leprechaun fails an ability check, an attack roll, or a saving throw, it can roll a new d20 and choose which roll to use, potentially turning the failure into a success.

spells: The leprechaun casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 14):

spells.2/day each: Invisibility, Phantasmal Force

monsters.name: Mage of Usamigaras

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 7 (1d10 + 2) force damage.

spells: The mage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 12):

spells.1/day each: Charm Person, Disguise Self, Silent Image

monsters.name: Maschin-i-Bozorg
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, unconscious

traits.name: Overheat
traits.desc: When the maschin-i-bozorg is reduced to 0 hit points, its power source overloads, briefly superheating its outer shell. Each creature within 10 feet of the maschin-i-bozorg must make a 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The maschin-i-bozorg makes two Poison Jab attacks.

actions.name: Poison Jab
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. 13 (4d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a 16 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Steam Jet (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The maschin-i-bozorg emits scalding steam in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus_actions.name: Crushing Stride
bonus_actions.desc:
The maschin-i-bozorg moves up to its speed in a straight line. During this movement, it can enter Medium and smaller creatures' spaces. A creature whose space the maschin-i-bozorg enters must make a 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space out of the maschin-i-bozorg's path. On a failed save, the creature takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and has the prone condition.
If the maschin-i-bozorg remains in the prone creature's space, the creature also has the restrained condition until it's no longer in the same space as the maschin-i-bozorg. While restrained in this way, the creature, or another creature within 5 feet of it, can use its action to make a 15 Strength (Athletics) check. On a successful check, the creature is shunted to an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 feet of the maschin-i-bozorg.

monsters.name: Memory Web
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (can't see beyond this radius), passive Perception 12

traits.name: Damage Transfer
traits.desc: While it is grappling a creature, the memory web takes only half the damage dealt to it, and the creature grappled by the web takes the other half.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: If the memory web is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the memory web move or act, that creature must succeed on a 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the memory web is animate.

traits.name: Memory Flood
traits.desc: When the memory web is reduced to 0 hit points, it discharges any memories it consumed over the past 24 hours in a telepathic deluge. Hazy, dreamlike visions of these discharged memories lodge in the minds of creatures up to 120 feet from the memory web.

actions.name: Ensnare
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. The target has the grappled condition (escape 13). Until this grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition and takes 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The memory web can grapple only one creature at a time.

bonus_actions.name: Drain Memories
bonus_actions.desc:
The memory web targets one creature grappled by it. The target must make a 12 Intelligence saving throw. Constructs, Oozes, Plants, and Undead succeed on the save automatically. On a failed save, the target takes 5 (2d4) psychic damage and becomes memory drained until it finishes a long rest or the memory web is destroyed.
While memory drained, the target must roll a d4 each time it makes an ability check or attack roll, subtracting the d4 roll from it. Each time the target is memory drained beyond the first, the die size increases by one: the d4 becomes a d6, the d6 becomes a d8, and so on until the die becomes a d20, at which point the target has the unconscious condition for 1 hour. If a memory drained creature is the target of the Greater Restoration or Heal spell, the memory drained effect ends on it. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

monsters.name: Nafas
monsters.damage_resistances: poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Dimensionally Bound
traits.desc: Nafas can't leave the Infinite Staircase or be trapped within a container (such as an Iron Flask). Attempts to transport Nafas to another plane are wasted.

traits.name: Last Wish
traits.desc:
When Nafas drops to 0 hit points, his body disintegrates into a whirl of multiversal dust that surrounds one creature responsible for his demise. That creature then hears Nafas's last wish: for the creature to take his place.
If the creature accepts, it is transformed into a noble djinni. The creature's game statistics are replaced by those of Nafas (including this trait), though it retains its name, alignment, and personality. The creature also inherits Nafas's palace and all it contains.
If the creature refuses, Nafas gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all his hit points and appearing in a random safe location on the Infinite Staircase.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.desc: If Nafas fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Nafas has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Noble Genie
traits.desc: Nafas doesn't suffer any of the penalties that normally follow casting the Wish spell to produce an effect other than duplicating another spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Nafas makes three Storm Shamshir attacks and uses Create Vortex.

actions.name: Storm Shamshir
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) lightning or thunder damage (Nafas's choice).

actions.name: Create Vortex
actions.desc:
A 10-foot-radius, 60-foot-tall cylinder of swirling cosmic dust forms on a point Nafas can see within 120 feet of him. The vortex lasts as long as Nafas maintains {@status concentration} (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). When the vortex appears, each creature other than Nafas in the vortex's area must make a 22 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (8d8) force damage and has the restrained condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only and moves to the nearest unoccupied space outside the vortex.
On subsequent turns, Nafas can use this action to move the vortex up to 60 feet. When the vortex enters a creature's space for the first time on a turn, the creature must make the same saving throw as when the vortex first appeared. Creatures restrained by the vortex move with it.
A creature restrained by the vortex, or another creature that can reach it, can use its action to make a 22 Strength check. On a successful check, the restrained creature is no longer restrained and moves to the nearest unoccupied space outside the vortex.

reactions.name: Blowback
reactions.desc: Immediately after a creature Nafas can see ends its turn, Nafas exhales forceful winds in a 30-foot cone. Large or smaller creatures in that area must succeed on a 22 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from him.

reactions.name: Zephyr Step
reactions.desc: In response to being hit by an attack roll, Nafas moves up to half his flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

spells: Nafas casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 21):

spells.At will: Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Thaumaturgy

spells.3/day each: Create Food and Water (the food is always tasty), Dispel Magic, Invisibility, Legend Lore (as an action), Tongues, Wind Walk (as an action)

spells.1/day each: Gaseous Form, Major Image, Teleport, Wish

monsters.name: Nafik
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: If Nafik fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Nafik has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: When he is destroyed, Nafik gains a new body in 24 hours if his heart is intact, regaining all his hit points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of Nafik's heart.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Nafik can use his Dreadful Glare and makes one Rotting Fist or Unholy Beam attack.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 14 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies and its body turns to dust. The curse lasts until removed by the Remove Curse spell or other magic.

actions.name: Unholy Beam
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 28 (8d6) necrotic damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of Nafik's next turn has advantage.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.desc: Nafik targets one creature he can see within 60 feet of himself. The target must succeed on a 14 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until the end of Nafik's next turn. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to Nafik's Dreadful Glare for the next 24 hours.

spells: Nafik casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 14):

spells.2/day each: Command, Silence

monsters.name: Sion

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Sion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects if he is in dim light or darkness.

traits.name: Shadesight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Sion's darkvision.

traits.name: Shadowy Demise
traits.desc: If Sion dies, his body melts into shadow, leaving behind only equipment he was wearing or carrying.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.desc: While in sunlight, Sion has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Sion makes one Shadow Sword attack and uses Affix Shadow or Spellcasting.

actions.name: Shadow Sword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (2d10 + 3) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Affix Shadow
actions.desc: Sion targets a creature within 60 feet of himself that he can see. That target must make a 13 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the grappled condition (escape 13) as its shadow wraps around it. Once the target escapes the grapple, its shadow returns to normal.

bonus_actions.name: Shadow Step
bonus_actions.desc: While Sion is in dim light or darkness, he magically teleports up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space he can see that is also in dim light or darkness.

spells: Sion casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 13):

monsters.name: Swarm of Gibberlings
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Aversion to Fire
traits.desc: If the swarm takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Incessant Gibberish
traits.desc: Any non-gibberling that is within 60 feet of the swarm and doesn't have the deafened condition has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain {@status concentration} on spells and similar effects.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough to accommodate a Small gibberling. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The swarm makes two Gnashing Teeth attacks.

actions.name: Gnashing Teeth
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. 14 (4d4 + 4) piercing damage, or 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

monsters.name: The Gardener

traits.name: Fey Rebirth
traits.desc: If the Gardener dies in the Eternal Garden, they revive with all their hit points 1d4 days later in a safe location within the garden.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the Gardener fails a saving throw, they can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Unfettered Steps
traits.desc: The Gardener is unaffected by difficult terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Gardener makes two Vine attacks and can use Breath of Tranquility if available.

actions.name: Vine
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 11 (1d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, the vine wraps around the target, and the target has the grappled condition (escape 17). The vine vanishes when the target is no longer grappled, or when the Gardener wills it to (no action required). A creature reduced to 0 hit points by the vine has the unconscious condition but is stable instead of dying.

actions.name: Breath of Tranquility (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The Gardener exhales soporific vapor in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a 17 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition. A poisoned creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a failed save, it has the unconscious condition, and on a successful save, the effect ends on it. An unconscious creature is no longer poisoned and remains unconscious for 1 hour, until it takes damage, or until a creature uses an action to shake it awake.

reactions.name: Pacification
reactions.desc: When a creature within 120 feet of the Gardener damages the Gardener, that creature takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, and the Gardener teleports, along with anything they are wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space they can see within 15 feet. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by the psychic damage has the unconscious condition and is stable instead of dying.

reactions.name: Spell Refuge
reactions.desc: When the Gardener or a creature within 30 feet of the Gardener takes damage from a spell, the Gardener chooses up to 5 creatures within 30 feet of themself. The Gardener and the chosen creatures have resistance to all damage from the triggering spell.

spells: The Gardener casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 17):

spells.At will: Druidcraft, Speak with Animals, Speak with Plants

spells.2/day each: Awaken (as an action), Goodberry, Plant Growth (as an action only)

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.desc: While the tower hand is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The tower hand makes two Unarmed Strike attacks, two Dart attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Deflect Missile
reactions.desc: In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, the tower hand deflects the missile. The damage it takes from the attack is reduced by 7 (1d10 + 2).

monsters.name: Tower Sage

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The tower sage makes two Arcane Burst attacks and can use Starry Radiance if available.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 8 (1d10 + 3) radiant damage.

actions.name: Starry Radiance (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Dazzling light bursts from the tower sage's fingertips in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a 13 Constitution saving throw or have the blinded condition until the end of the tower sage's next turn.

spells: The tower sage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 13):

spells.1/day each: Arcane Lock, Burning Hands, Comprehend Languages, Detect Magic, Levitate, Mage Armor

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.desc: The vegepygmy has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring vegetation.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vegepygmy regains 7 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes cold, fire, or necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vegepygmy's next turn. The vegepygmy dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vegepygmy makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (3d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Toxic Mold (2/Day)
actions.desc:
The vegepygmy targets a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. If the target isn't a vegepygmy, it must make a 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 13 (3d8) poison damage and has the blinded and deafened conditions for 1 minute as it becomes covered in a thick layer of mold. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.
The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.desc: The vegepygmy has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring vegetation.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vegepygmy regains 3 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes cold, fire, or necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vegepygmy's next turn. The vegepygmy dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.desc: The vegepygmy takes the Disengage or Hide action.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The vegepygmy has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the vegepygmy's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.desc: The vegepygmy has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring vegetation.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vegepygmy regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes cold, fire, or necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vegepygmy's next turn. The vegepygmy dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Thorny Body
traits.desc: At the start of its turn, the vegepygmy deals 2 (1d4) piercing damage to any creature grappling it.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 12 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The warrior adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the warrior must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: If the wolf-in-sheep's-clothing is motionless (except for its lure) at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the wolf-in-sheep's-clothing move or act (except for the lure), that creature must succeed on a 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the wolf-in-sheep's-clothing is animate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The wolf-in-sheep's-clothing makes one Bite attack and two Root Tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Root Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape 16). While grappled in this way, the target has the restrained condition, and at the start of each of the wolf-in-sheep's-clothing's turns, the wolf-in-sheep's-clothing can pull the target up to 10 feet toward itself (no action required). The wolf-in-sheep's-clothing has four root tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

bonus_actions.name: Completely Harmless Lure
bonus_actions.desc: The wolf-in-sheep's-clothing can change the color, texture, and shape of its lure to resemble a Tiny Beast or Tiny object. It can move the lure to reinforce the resemblance (no action required), but the lure must remain within 15 feet of the wolf-in-sheep's-clothing, connected by nearly invisible filament-like tendrils.

monsters.name: Worker Robot
monsters.languages: Common plus the languages spoken by its creator

traits.name: Lightning Overload
traits.desc: When the robot takes lightning damage, it must succeed on a 10 Constitution saving throw or have the stunned condition until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The robot makes two Cargo Tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Cargo Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape 15). The robot has two cargo tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Tractor Beam
actions.desc: The robot casts Telekinesis, targeting only creatures with the incapacitated condition or objects. It requires no spell components and uses Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

monsters.name: Zargon the Returner
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, fire, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.desc: If Zargon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Zargon regains 20 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If Zargon takes cold or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of Zargon's next turn. Zargon dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Shrouded Being
traits.desc: Zargon can't be targeted by divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

traits.name: Slimy Demise
traits.desc: When Zargon dies, its body dissolves into foul slime, leaving only its horn behind. Zargon re-forms in 1d10 days, regrowing from the horn. The horn is immune to all damage and can be destroyed only by submerging it in a cleansing waterfall on one of the Upper Planes for 101 days. While the horn is submerged in this way, Zargon doesn't re-form, and the horn slowly dissolves, sending corrupting slime downriver that permanently fouls the water for 10 miles from the place where the horn dissolved. The fouled water is unfit to drink, chokes aquatic wildlife, and withers plants.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Zargon makes two Barbed Tentacle attacks, one Bite attack, and one Gore attack.

actions.name: Barbed Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape 20), and Zargon can pull the creature up to 20 feet straight toward itself. Zargon has six tentacles, each of which can grapple one creature. Zargon can move at its full speed while dragging creatures it is grappling.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 15 (2d8 + 6) force damage, and a 10-foot-radius invisible sphere of antimagic, like that created by an Antimagic Field spell, surrounds the target. The sphere is centered on the target, moves with the target, and lasts until the end of Zargon's next turn.

actions.name: Slime Wave (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc:
Zargon spews slime in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area that isn't an Aberration or Ooze must make a 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 38 (7d10) acid damage and has the poisoned condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
A creature reduced to 0 hit points by the acid damage dies and dissolves into a puddle of slime that rises as a gibbering mouther at the start of Zargon's next turn. The creature obeys Zargon's commands and takes its turn immediately after Zargon's. Only a Wish spell can reverse this transformation and restore the creature to life.

reactions.name: Defiant Essence
reactions.desc: When a creature casts a spell that targets Zargon or would deal damage to it, Zargon attempts to absorb the magic into its horn. The creature must make a 19 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 6 (1d12) force damage, and the spell it cast fails and is wasted.

reactions.name: Slime Spray
reactions.desc: When a creature ends its turn within 30 feet of Zargon, Zargon sprays toxic slime at the creature. The target must make a 19 Dexterity saving throw (with disadvantage if it has the poisoned condition). On a failed save, the creature takes 7 (2d6) poison damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

monsters.name: Billy Beaver
source: The Lost Dungeon of Rickedness: Big Rick Energy

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.desc: Billy Beaver has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.desc: If Buster the Bear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage from the attack.

actions.name: Bashin' Banjo
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Claws
