monsters.name: Diderius
spells: Diderius is a 10th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): minor illusion, ray of frost

spells.1st level (4 slots): charm person, detect magic, shield, thunderwave

spells.2nd level (3 slots): cloud of daggers, hold person, see invisibility

traits.name: Dragon Fanatic
traits.desc: The dragonfang has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. While the dragonfang can see a dragon or higher-ranking Cult of the Dragon cultist friendly to it, the dragonfang ignores the effects of being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Fanatic Advantage
traits.desc: Once per turn, if the dragonfang makes a weapon attack with advantage on the attack roll and hits, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage.

traits.name: Limited Flight
traits.desc: The dragonfang can use a bonus action to gain a flying speed of 30 feet until the end of its turn.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The dragonfang has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the dragonfang's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Dragonfang attacks twice with its shortsword.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) damage of the type to which the dragonfang has resistance.

actions.name: Orb of Dragon's Breath (2/Day)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +5 to hit, range 50 ft., one target. 22 (5d8) damage of the type to which the dragonfang has damage resistance.

traits.name: Dragon Fanatic
traits.desc: The dragonsoul has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. While the dragonsoul can see a dragon or higher-ranking Cult of the Dragon cultist friendly to it, the dragonsoul ignores the effects of being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Fanatic Advantage
traits.desc: Once per turn, if the dragonsoul makes a weapon attack with advantage on the attack roll and hits, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage.

traits.name: Limited Flight
traits.desc: The dragonsoul can use a bonus action to gain a flying speed of 30 feet until the end of its turn.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The dragonsoul has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the dragonsoul's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Dragonsoul attacks twice with its shortsword.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) damage of the type to which the dragonsoul has resistance.

actions.name: Orb of Dragon's Breath (3/Day)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +7 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. 27 (6d8) damage of the type to which the dragonsoul has damage resistance.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The toad can breathe air or water.

traits.name: Cold Aura
traits.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the toad takes 3 (1d6) cold damage.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.desc: The toad's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d8) cold damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature it is grappled (escape 11). Until this grapple ends, the toad can't bite another target.

monsters.name: Naergoth Bladelord
monsters.damage_resistances: necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, Naergoth has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Naergoth makes three attacks, either with his longsword or longbow. He can use Life Drain in place of one longsword attack.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 20 (5d6 + 3) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a 15 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage, or 10 (1d10 + 5) if used with two hands, plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Draconic Majesty
traits.desc: Neronvain adds his Charisma bonus to his AC (included).

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Magic can't put Neronvain to sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Neronvain makes two attacks, either with his shortsword or Eldritch Arrow.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Eldritch Arrow
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 11 (2d10) force damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Poisonous Cloud (2/Day)
actions.desc: Poison gas fills a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point Neronvain can see within 50 feet of him. The gas spreads around corners and remains until the start of Neronvain's next turn. Each creature that starts its turn in the gas must succeed on a 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monsters.name: Severin
monsters.damage_resistances: acid, cold, lightning, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.senses: While wearing the Mask of the Dragon Queen: darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Severin has the Mask of the Dragon Queen.

traits.name: Draconic Majesty
traits.desc: Severin adds his Charisma bonus to his AC (included).

traits.name: Ignite Enemy
traits.desc: If Severin deals fire damage to a creature while wearing the Mask of the Dragon Queen, the target catches fire. At the start of each of its turns, the burning target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. A creature within reach of the fire can use an action to extinguish it.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.desc: While wearing the Mask of the Dragon Queen, if Severin fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Burning Touch
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 18 (4d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Flaming Orb
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +9 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. 40 (9d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Scorching Burst
actions.desc: Severin chooses a point he can see within 60 feet of him. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Severin makes one attack.

legendary_actions.name: Fiery Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Severin, along with any objects he is wearing or carrying, teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. Each creature within 5 feet of Severin before he teleports takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.

legendary_actions.name: Hellish Chains (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Severin targets one creature he can see within 30 feet of him. The target is wrapped in magical chains of fire and restrained. The restrained target takes 21 (6d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. At the end of its turns, the target can make a 17 Strength saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monsters.name: Tiamat
monsters.damage_immunities: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, poisoned, stunned
monsters.senses: darkvision 240 ft., truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 36

traits.name: Discorporation
traits.desc: When Tiamat drops to 0 hit points or dies, her body is destroyed but her essence travels back to her domain in the Nine Hells, and she is unable to take physical form for a time.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.desc: If Tiamat fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Limited Magic Immunity
traits.desc: Unless she wishes to be affected, Tiamat is immune to spells of 6th level or lower. She has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: Tiamat's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.desc: Tiamat can take one reaction per turn, rather than only one per round. She also has advantage on saving throws against being knocked unconscious. If she fails a saving throw against an effect that would stun a creature, one of her unspent legendary actions is spent.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Tiamat regains 30 hit points at the start of her turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Tiamat can use her Frightful Presence. She then makes three attacks: two with her claws and one with her tail.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 24 (4d6 + 10) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +19 to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. 28 (4d8 + 10) piercing damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of Tiamat's choice that is within 240 feet of Tiamat and aware of her must succeed on a 26 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Tiamat's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Bite
legendary_actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +19 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 32 (4d10 + 10) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) acid damage (black dragon head), lightning damage (blue dragon head), poison damage (green dragon head), fire damage (red dragon head), or cold damage (white dragon head).

legendary_actions.name: Black Dragon Head: Acid Breath (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Tiamat breathes acid in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a 27 Dexterity saving throw, taking 67 (15d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Blue Dragon Head: Lightning Breath (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Tiamat breathes lightning in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a 27 Dexterity saving throw, taking 88 (16d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Green Dragon Head: Poison Breath (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Tiamat breathes poisonous gas in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 27 Constitution saving throw, taking 77 (22d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Red Dragon Head: Fire Breath (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Tiamat breathes fire in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 27 Dexterity saving throw, taking 91 (26d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: White Dragon Head: Cold Breath (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Tiamat breathes an icy blast in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 27 Dexterity saving throw, taking 72 (16d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells: Tiamat can innately cast the following spell, her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 26):

monsters.name: Dirt-Under-Nails
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Dark One's Own Luck (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.desc: When the warlock makes an ability check or saving throw, it can add a d10 to the roll. It can do this after the roll is made but before any of the roll's effects occur.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Dirt-Under-Nails regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn if he is in contact with the ground. If Dirt-Under-Nails takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Dirt-Under-Nails dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Shared Senses
traits.desc: Dirt-Under-Nails can see and hear what any plant within 120 ft can see and hear. In addition, Dirt-Under- Nails can communicate telepathically with any plant within this range.

traits.name: Special Equipment (+2 Rod of the Pact Keeper)
traits.desc: While holding this +2 Rod of the Pact Keeper, Dirt-Under-Nails gains a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of his warlock spells (included in modifications, below). In addition, he can regain 1 warlock spell slot as an action while holding the rod. He can't use this property again until he finishes a long rest.

traits.name: Tree Stride
traits.desc: Once on each of its turns, Dirt-Under-Nails can use 10 feet of his movement to step magically into one copse of mushrooms within 5 feet of him and emerge from a second copse of mushrooms within 60 feet of it, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second copse. Both copses of mushrooms must be Large or bigger. Dirt-Under-Nails doesn't need to be able to see the second copse to use this ability.

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

spells: The warlock's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells (spell save 15), requiring no material components:

spells.At will: alter self, false life, levitate (self only), mage armor (self only), silent image

spells.1/day each: feeblemind, finger of death, plane shift

spells: Dirt-Under-Nails is a 17th level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). He regains his expended spell slots when he finishes a short or long rest. He knows the following warlock spells:

spells.Cantrips (at will): chill touch, eldritch blast, friends, mage hand, minor illusion, prestidigitation, shocking grasp

spells.5th level (4 slots): armor of Agathys, banishment, burning hands, cloudkill, flame strike, magic circle, scorching ray, scrying, stinking cloud, suggestion

traits.name: Magic Club
traits.desc: In the rotter's hand, its club is magical and deals 7 (3d4) extra damage (included in its attacks).

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.desc: The rotter has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The rotter regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it is in contact with the ground. If the rotter takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the rotter's next turn. The rotter dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Shared Senses
traits.desc: The rotter can see and hear what any plant within 120 ft can see and hear. In addition, the rotter can communicate telepathically with any plant within this range.

traits.name: Tree Stride
traits.desc: Once on each of its turns, the rotter can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into one copse of mushrooms within 5 feet of it and emerge from a second copse of mushrooms within 60 feet of it, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second copse. Both copses of mushrooms must be Large or bigger. The rotter doesn't need to be able to see the second copse to use this ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The rotter makes two attacks with its club.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (4d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Archaic
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, stunned

traits.name: Enigmatic Mind
traits.desc: The archaic's mind can't be read, creatures can communicate telepathically with the archaic only if it allows, and magic can't determine whether the archaic is lying.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the archaic fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The archaic doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The archaic makes two Force Strike attacks. It can also use Gravity Shift, if available.

actions.name: Force Strike
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +14 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 19 (2d10 + 8) force damage, and the target is pulled up to 10 feet toward the archaic or pushed 10 feet away from it, as the archaic chooses.

actions.name: Gravity Shift (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The archaic reverses gravity for one creature it can see within 100 feet of itself. The creature must succeed on a 22 Wisdom saving throw or fall 100 feet upward. If the falling creature encounters a solid object (such as a ceiling) in this fall, it strikes the object just as it would during a downward fall. If the creature reaches the top of the area without striking anything, it hovers there until the start of the archaic's next turn, at which time gravity returns to normal and the creature falls.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The archaic teleports to an unoccupied space that it can see within 120 feet of itself.

reactions.name: Spell Mimicry (1/Day)
reactions.desc: Immediately after a creature the archaic can see casts a spell of 5th level or lower, that creature must succeed on a 22 Charisma saving throw, or the archaic immediately casts the same spell at the same level (+14 to hit with spell attacks, spell save 22), requiring no material components and choosing the spell's targets.

legendary_actions.name: Strike
legendary_actions.desc: The archaic makes one Force Strike attack.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport
legendary_actions.desc: The archaic uses Teleport.

legendary_actions.name: Unravel Magic (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The archaic targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 22 Constitution saving throw or take 35 (10d6) force damage, and each spell of 5th level or lower on the target ends.

spells: The archaic casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 22):

monsters.name: Art Elemental Mascot
monsters.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.desc: When the elemental dies, it explodes in a burst of colored light. Each creature within 5 feet of the elemental must succeed on a 11 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A blinded creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Joyful Flare
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (2d4 + 1) fire damage.

actions.name: Melancholic Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +3 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. 6 (2d4 + 1) cold damage.

actions.name: Captivating Artistry (1/Day)
actions.desc: The elemental targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 12 Charisma saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. The charmed target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monsters.name: Beledros Witherbloom

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Beledros fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: Beledros doesn't require air, food, or drink.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Beledros makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 14 (1d10 + 9) piercing damage plus 6 (1d12) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 12 (1d6 + 9) slashing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is knocked prone.

actions.name: Decaying Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Beledros exhales decaying energy in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 23 Constitution saving throw, taking 39 (6d12) necrotic damage and 39 (6d12) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that takes damage from the breath can't regain hit points until the start of Beledros's next turn.

actions.name: Miasmal Flow
actions.desc: Beledros becomes a swirling cloud of green mist and can move up to half her flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then resumes her true form. During this movement, she can move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. If she moves through a creature, it must succeed on a 23 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned until the end of its next turn. If Beledros ends this move inside an object, she takes 5 (1d10) force damage and is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space.

legendary_actions.name: Claw
legendary_actions.desc: Beledros makes one Claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: Miasmal Flow (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Beledros uses Miasmal Flow.

legendary_actions.name: Teeming with Life (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Beledros magically summons 1d4 pest mascot in unoccupied spaces she can see within 60 feet of herself. The pests obey her commands and take their turns immediately after hers. Any creature, other than a pest, takes 9 (2d8) poison damage if it starts its turn within 5 feet of one or more of these pests. When one of these pests drops to 0 hit points, Beledros regains 9 hit points. These pests disappear after 10 minutes, when Beledros dies, or when she uses this action again.

spells: Beledros casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability:

spells.1/day each: greater restoration, mass cure wounds, plant growth, revivify, speak with dead

traits.name: Fungal Fortitude
traits.desc: If damage reduces the trudge to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the trudge drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Tusk
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

monsters.name: Cogwork Archivist

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The archivist has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The archivist makes two Grasping Limb attacks.

actions.name: Grasping Limb
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape 14). The archivist can have no more than two targets grappled at a time.

spells: The archivist casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability:

spells.2/day each: silence

traits.name: Pact of Pain
traits.desc:
Using a 10-minute ritual, the daemogoth can forge a magical bond with a willing creature it touches throughout the ritual. The creature becomes bound by the pact until it dies, the daemogoth dies, or the pact is broken by any effect that can remove a curse.
The daemogoth chooses one spell from the {@filter necromancy or enchantment school that is 3rd level or lower|spells|level=0;1;2;3|school=N;E}. The bound creature can cast that spell using this pact, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability. When it casts the spell, the creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage, which can't break the creature's {@status concentration} on a spell. Once the bound creature casts the spell in this way, it can't do so again until it finishes a long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The daemogoth makes three Agonizing Burst attacks. It can use Terrify, if available, in place of one of the attacks.

actions.name: Agonizing Burst
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 11 (2d10) force damage. If the target is a creature, the daemogoth regains 5 hit points.

actions.name: Terrify (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: The daemogoth targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 33 (6d10) psychic damage and is frightened of the daemogoth until the end of the daemogoth's next turn, and the daemogoth regains 5 hit points. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't frightened, and the daemogoth doesn't heal.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the titan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Pact of Suffering
traits.desc:
Using a 10-minute long ritual, the titan can forge a magical bond with a willing creature it touches throughout the ritual. The creature becomes bound by the pact until it dies, the titan dies, or the pact is broken by a wish spell.
The titan chooses one spell from the {@filter necromancy or enchantment school that is 8th level or lower|spells|level=0;1;2;3;4;5;6;7;8|school=N;E}. The bound creature can cast that spell using this pact, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability. When it casts the spell, the creature takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage, which can't break the creature's {@status concentration} on a spell. Once the bound creature casts the spell in this way, it can't do so again until it finishes a long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The titan makes two Agonizing Burst attacks.

actions.name: Agonizing Burst
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +12 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 17 (3d6 + 7) force damage. If the target is a creature, the titan regains 5 hit points.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The titan teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 120 feet of itself.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: The titan makes one Agonizing Burst attack.

legendary_actions.name: Stalking Nightmare (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The titan uses Teleport, after which it can target one creature within 20 feet of itself that it can see. The target must make a 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 22 (4d10) necrotic damage, and the titan regains 10 hit points. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage, and the titan doesn't heal.

legendary_actions.name: Terrorize (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The titan targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 38 (7d10) psychic damage and is frightened of the titan until the end of the target's next turn, and the titan regains 15 hit points. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't frightened, and the titan doesn't heal.

monsters.name: First-Year Student

traits.name: Excited to Be Here
traits.desc: The student has advantage on initiative rolls.

actions.name: Magic Flare
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 7 (1d12 + 1) force damage.

reactions.name: Beginner's Luck (2/Day)
reactions.desc: When the student fails a saving throw, it can reroll the d20. It must use the new roll.

spells: The student casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 11):

monsters.name: Fractal Mascot
monsters.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Relative Density
traits.desc: The fractal can move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Quantum Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 3 (1d4 + 1) force damage, or 6 (2d4 + 1) force damage if the fractal is Medium or bigger.

bonus_actions.name: Augment
bonus_actions.desc: The fractal's size increases by one category. While the fractal is Medium or bigger, it makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. The fractal can become no larger than Huge via this bonus action.

bonus_actions.name: Diminish
bonus_actions.desc: The fractal's size decreases by one category. While the fractal is Tiny, it makes attack rolls, Dexterity checks, and Dexterity saving throws with advantage. The fractal can become no smaller than 1 foot in height via this bonus action.

monsters.name: Galazeth Prismari

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Galazeth fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Galazeth makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 13 (1d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) lightning damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 11 (1d6 + 8) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is knocked prone.

actions.name: Dancing Elements Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Galazeth exhales a blast of flames and ice in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 22 Dexterity saving throw, gaining no benefit from cover (other than Cover) and taking 38 (7d10) fire damage and 38 (7d10) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Claw
legendary_actions.desc: Galazeth makes one Claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: Lightning Flash (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Galazeth moves up to half his flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks. When he passes within 15 feet of a creature during this move, that creature must succeed on a 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 11 (2d10) lightning damage. A creature can take this damage no more than once during the move.

legendary_actions.name: Flowing Creation (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Galazeth magically summons 1d4 art elemental mascot in unoccupied spaces he can see within 60 feet of himself. The art elementals obey his commands and take their turns immediately after his. Any creature, other than an art elemental, takes 5 (1d10) cold, fire, or lightning damage (Galazeth's choice) if it ends its turn within 5 feet of one or more of these elementals. When one of these elementals drops to 0 hit points, Galazeth can fly up to 20 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. These elementals disappear after 10 minutes, when Galazeth dies, or when he uses this action again.

spells: Galazeth casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 23):

spells.1/day each: control water, gust of wind, wall of stone

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: If the groff is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the groff move or act, that creature must succeed on a 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the groff isn't an ordinary moss-covered bog patch.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: The groff can hold its breath for up to 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The groff makes one Bite attack and one Swamp Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Swamp Claw
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 15 Strength saving throw or become engulfed by the groff. While engulfed, the target can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 10 (3d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. When the groff moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The groff can have only one target engulfed at a time.
An engulfed target can repeat the saving throw at the end of its turns. On a success, the target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space.

monsters.name: Inkling Mascot
monsters.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The inkling can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Blot
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) psychic damage.

actions.name: Ink Spray (1/Day)
actions.desc: The inkling sprays viscous ink at one creature within 15 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 12 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the inkling's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonus_actions.desc: While in dim light or darkness, the inkling takes the Hide action.

monsters.name: Lorehold Apprentice

actions.name: Scroll Bash
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +4 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 7 (1d10 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) thunder damage.

actions.name: Reduce to Memory (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Thundering golden energy erupts around a creature the apprentice can see within 90 feet of it. The creature must make a 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 33 (6d10) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A Construct has disadvantage on the saving throw.

reactions.name: Learn from the Past (2/Day)
reactions.desc: When another creature within 60 feet of the apprentice misses a target with an attack roll, the apprentice magically enables the attacker to reroll the attack roll. It must use the new roll.

spells: The apprentice casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 12):

spells.1/day each: comprehend languages, locate object, mage armor

monsters.name: Lorehold Pledgemage

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The pledgemage makes two Scroll Bash attacks.

actions.name: Scroll Bash
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +5 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) thunder damage.

actions.name: Reduce to Memory (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Thundering golden energy erupts around a creature the pledgemage can see within 90 feet of it. The creature must make a 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A Construct has disadvantage on the saving throw.

bonus_actions.name: Chronal Break (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The pledgemage chooses a point within 30 feet of itself, shunting the minds of nearby creatures out of this moment in time. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must succeed on a 13 Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated until the end of the pledgemage's next turn.

reactions.name: Learn from the Past (2/Day)
reactions.desc: When another creature within 60 feet of the pledgemage misses a target with an attack roll, the pledgemage magically enables the attacker to reroll the attack roll. It must use the new roll.

spells: The pledgemage casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 13):

spells.2/day each: comprehend languages, locate object

spells.1/day each: mage armor, speak with dead, stone shape

monsters.name: Lorehold Professor of Chaos

traits.name: Voice from the Past (1/Day)
traits.desc: The professor can cast the contact other plane spell to contact a long-dead spirit, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The professor makes two Spectral Scroll attacks. It can also use Weight of History, if available.

actions.name: Spectral Scroll
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 15 (2d10 + 4) force damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Weight of History (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The professor magically compresses time around up to six creatures of its choice that it can see within 30 feet of itself. Each target must succeed on a 15 Wisdom saving throw or be restrained for 1 minute, but the restrained target's speed is halved instead of being reduced to 0. At the start of each of its turns, the restrained target takes 4 (1d8) force damage. A restrained target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spells: The professor casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability:

spells.2/day each: locate object, mage armor, passwall

monsters.name: Lorehold Professor of Order

traits.name: Voice from the Past (1/Day)
traits.desc: The professor can cast the contact other plane spell to contact a long-dead spirit, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The professor makes two Repelling Burst attacks. It can also use Force Barrier, if available.

actions.name: Repelling Burst
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) force damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet directly away from the professor and become restrained until the start of professor's next turn.

actions.name: Force Barrier (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The professor magically creates a wall of translucent, golden force within 90 feet of itself. The wall lasts for 1 minute or until the professor uses this action again. The barrier can be a vertical or horizontal plane up to 30 feet on a side or a 10-foot-radius hemispherical dome with a floor. The wall provides Cover. It has AC 17, 30 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.

reactions.name: Arcane Stasis (2/Day)
reactions.desc: When a creature the professor can see within 60 feet of it casts a spell, the professor can magically lock the casting in the moment before completion. The spellcaster must succeed on a 15 saving throw using the spell's spellcasting ability, or the spell fails and is wasted.

spells: The professor casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 15):

spells.2/day each: dimension door, locate object, mage armor, stone shape

monsters.name: Mage Hunter
monsters.speed: 40 ft., climb 40 ft. (hunter form only), fly 10 ft. (hover sentry form only)
monsters.senses: blindsight 120 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 19

traits.name: Magic Sense
traits.desc: The hunter knows the location of every spellcaster, active spell, and magic item within 120 feet of itself.

traits.name: Spider Climb (Hunter Form Only)
traits.desc: The hunter can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack (Hunter Form Only)
actions.desc: The hunter makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw (Hunter Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the hunter can't make a Tail attack against another target.

actions.name: Mage Tracker (Sentry Form Only)
actions.desc:
The hunter emits a pulse of energy that helps it better locate its magical quarry. Each creature within 120 feet of the hunter that has the ability to cast spells must succeed on a 14 Wisdom saving throw or be mystically marked by the hunter for 1 hour.
While marked, a creature can't become hidden from the hunter and gains no benefit from the invisible condition against the hunter. Additionally, while a marked creature is on the same plane of existence as the hunter, the hunter always knows the distance and direction to the creature.

bonus_actions.name: Shift Form
bonus_actions.desc: The hunter folds into its drone-like sentry form or unfolds into its hunter form. Its game statistics are the same in each form.

reactions.name: Consume and Destroy
reactions.desc: When the hunter takes damage from a spell, it takes only half the triggering damage (rounded down). If the creature that cast the spell is within 60 feet of the hunter, that creature must succeed on a 14 Dexterity saving throw or take the other half of the damage.

traits.name: Blood Aegis
traits.desc: The AC of Murgaxor includes his Constitution modifier while he isn't wearing armor or wielding a shield.

traits.name: Oriq Mask
traits.desc: Murgaxor wears an Oriq mask. While wearing the mask, Murgaxor can't be targeted by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors, and he adds double his proficiency bonus to Charisma (Deception) checks (included above).

traits.name: Sanguine Sense
traits.desc: While Murgaxor isn't blinded, he can see any creature that isn't an Undead or a Construct within 60 feet of himself, even through Cover, heavily obscured areas, invisibility, or any other phenomena that would prevent sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Murgaxor makes two Blood Lash attacks.

actions.name: Blood Lash
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 21 (3d10 + 5) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it can't regain hit points until the start of Murgaxor's next turn.

actions.name: Blood Boil (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Murgaxor chooses a point within 150 feet of himself, and a 20-foot radius sphere centered on that point fills with a burst of searing, blood-red mist. Each creature of Murgaxor's choice that he can see in that area must make a 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 38 (7d10) necrotic damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't incapacitated. A creature dies if reduced to 0 hit points by this necrotic damage.

monsters.name: Oracle of Strixhaven

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the Oracle fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Oracle makes two Magic Flare attacks. She can also use Paradoxy, if available.

actions.name: Magic Flare
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 24 (3d12 + 5) force damage.

actions.name: Paradoxy (Recharge 4-6)

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 18 (3d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Ballista
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +6 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. 18 (3d10 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Lightning Strike (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Hekaton hurls a magical lightning bolt at a point he can see within 500 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 (12d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Thunderous Stomp (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Hekaton stomps the ground, triggering a thunderclap. All other creatures within 15 feet of him must succeed on a 17 Constitution saving throw or take 33 (6d10) thunder damage and be deafened until the start of Hekaton's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't deafened. The thunderclap can be heard out to a range of 1,200 feet.

spells: The giant's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spells.At will: detect magic, feather fall, levitate, light

monsters.name: Klauth
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 26

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Klauth fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Dual Wand Wielder
traits.desc: If Klauth is carrying two wands, he can use an action to expend 1 charge from each wand, triggering the effects of both wands simultaneously.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Klauth carries a wand of fireballs and a wand of lightning bolts, and he wears a ring of cold resistance.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Klauth can use his Frightful Presence. He then makes three attacks: one with his bite and two with his claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 17 (2d6 + 10) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 19 (2d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of Klauth's choice that is within 120 feet of Klauth and aware of him must succeed on a 21 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Klauth's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Klauth exhales fire in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 24 Dexterity saving throw, taking 91 (26d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Detect
legendary_actions.desc: Klauth makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary_actions.name: Tail Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Klauth makes a tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Klauth beats his wings. Each creature within 15 feet of Klauth must succeed on a 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. Klauth can then fly up to half his flying speed.

spells: Klauth casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 22):

spells.At will: comprehend languages, detect magic, mage hand, minor illusion, prestidigitation

spells.2/day each: darkness, detect thoughts, ice storm

spells.1/day each: banishment, cloudkill, disintegrate, etherealness, find the path (cast as 1 action), greater invisibility, haste, locate object, mass suggestion, mirage arcane (cast as 1 action), prismatic spray

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While Lifferlas remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

traits.name: Roleplaying Information
traits.desc:
A druid of the Emerald Enclave awakened the tree Lifferlas with a spell. Goldenfields is his home, its people his friends. Children like to carve their name and initials into his body and hang from his boughs, and he's happy with that.
Ideal: "I exist to protect the people and plants of Goldenfields."
Bond: "Children are wonderful. I would do anything to make them feel happy and safe."
Flaw: "I can't remember people's names and often get them mixed up."

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Lifferlas makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Maegera the Dawn Titan
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Empowered Attacks
traits.desc: Maegera's slam attacks are treated as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to damage from nonmagical attacks.

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.desc: At the start of each of Maegera's turns, each creature within 30 feet of it takes 35 (10d6) fire damage, and flammable objects in the aura that aren't being worn or carried ignite. A creature also takes 35 (10d6) fire damage from touching Maegera or from hitting it with a melee attack while within 10 feet of it, and a creature takes that damage the first time on a turn that Maegera moves into its space. Nonmagical weapons that hit Maegera are destroyed by fire immediately after dealing damage to it.

traits.name: Fire Form
traits.desc: Maegera can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing if fire could pass through that space.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: Maegera sheds bright light in a 120-foot radius and dim light in an additional 120 ft..

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Maegera has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Maegera makes three slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 35 (10d6) fire damage

legendary_actions.name: Quench Magic
legendary_actions.desc: Maegera targets one creature that it can see within 60 feet of it. Any resistance or immunity to fire damage that the target gains from a spell or magic item is suppressed. The effect lasts until the end of Maegera's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Smoke Cloud (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Maegera exhales a billowing cloud of hot smoke and embers that fills a 60 feet cube. Each creature in the area takes 11 (2d10) fire damage. The cloud lasts until the end of Maegera's next turn. Creatures completely in the cloud are blinded and can't be seen.

legendary_actions.name: Create Fire Elemental (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Maegera's hit points are reduced by 50 as part of it separates and becomes a fire elemental with 102 hit points. The fire element appears in an unoccupied space within 15 feet of Maegera and acts on Maegera's initiative count. Maegera can't use this action if it has 50 hit points or fewer. The fire element obeys Maegera's commands and fights until destroyed.

spells: Maegera casts fireball (spell save 19), requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Roleplaying Information
traits.desc:
Sheriff Markham of Bryn Shander is a brawny, likable man of few words. Nothing is more important to him than protecting Icewind Dale. He judges others by their actions, not their words.
Ideal: "All people deserve to be treated with dignity."
Bond: "Duvessa is a natural leader, but she needs help. That's my job."
Flaw: "I bury my emotions and have no interest in small talk."

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Markham makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage. Markham carries twenty crossbow bolts.

traits.name: Roleplaying Information
traits.desc:
Innkeeper Miros is a retired carnival attraction, dubbed "the Yeti" because of his barrel-shaped body and the thick, white hair covering his arms, chest, back, and head. When Goldenfields suffers, so does his business, so he takes strides to protect the compound.
Ideal: "As does the Emerald Enclave, I believe that civilization and the wilderness need to learn to coexist."
Bond: "Make fun of me all you like, but don't speak ill of my inn or my employees."
Flaw: "When something upsets me, I have a tendency to fly into a rage."

actions.name: Bear Hug
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target grappled (escape 13) and takes 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of Miros's turns until the grapple ends. Miros cannot make attacks while grappling a creature.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. 5 (1d10) piercing damage. Miros carries ten crossbow bolts.

traits.name: Cunning Action
traits.desc: On each of his turns, Narth can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Roleplaying Information
traits.desc:
Narth sells gear to adventurers, and he also has an adventurous spirit. The Lionshield Coster pays him well, but he longs to make a name for himself. At the same time, he runs a business with his partner Alaestra and knows she wouldn't forgive him if he ran off and never returned.
Ideal: "The bigger the risk, the greater the reward."
Bond: "I adore my colleague Alestra, and I'd like to do something to impress her."
Flaw: "I'll risk life and limb to become a legend.-"

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Narth carries twenty crossbow bolts.

monsters.name: Naxene Drathkala

traits.name: Roleplaying Information
traits.desc:
Goldenfields' crops are vital Waterdeep's survival, which is why the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors sent Naxene to make sure the temple-farm is adequately defended. At first she regarded the task as a punishment, but now she appreciates the peace and quiet.
Ideal: "There's no problem that can't be solved with magic."
Bond: "I have great respect for Lady Laeral Silverhand of Waterdeep. She and the Lords' Alliance are going to bring some much-needed order to this lawless land."
Flaw: "I'm too smart to be wrong about anything."

actions.name: Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

spells: Naxene casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 13; +5 to hit with spell attacks):

spells.At will: fire bolt (1d10 fire damage), light, mage hand

monsters.name: Nimir
spells: The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no material spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 17):

spells.1/day each: control weather (cast as 1 action), water breathing

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.desc: Oren can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than his.

traits.name: Lucky
traits.desc: When Oren rolls a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, he can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

traits.name: Stout Resilience
traits.desc: Oren has advantage on saving throws against poison

traits.name: Roleplaying Information
traits.desc:
Oren came to Nurthfurrow's End looking for easy work and found it. He sings for his supper, drinks like a fish, and wanders the fields at night dreaming up new lyrics to entertain the inn's other guests. Oren likes to stir up trouble from time to time, but he doesn't have a mean bone in his body.
Ideal: "Music is food for the soul."
Bond: "You had me at "Can I buy you a drink."
Flaw: "I have a knack for putting myself in harm's way. Good thing I'm lucky!"

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage. Duvessa carries only one dagger.

monsters.name: Orlekto
spells: The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no material spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 17):

spells.1/day each: control weather (cast as 1 action), water breathing

monsters.name: Othovir

traits.name: Roleplaying Information
traits.desc:
Othovir is a gifted harness-maker who doesn't talk about his family or where he came from. He cares about his business, his clients, and his good name.
Ideal: "Find what you do well, and do it to the best of your ability."
Bond: "I won't allow my name to be tarnished."
Flaw: "I get angry when others pry into my private life."

actions.name: Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Othovir adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Othovir must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

spells: Othovir casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 13; +5 to hit with spell attacks):

monsters.name: Pow Ming
spells: Pow is a 9th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). Pow has the following wizard spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation

spells.1st level (4 slots): detect magic, mage armor, magic missile, shield

monsters.name: Purple Wormling
monsters.senses: blindsight 30 ft., tremorsense 30 ft., passive Perception 8

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The wormling makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a Small or smaller creature, it must succeed on a 13 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the worm. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the wormling, and it takes 3 (1d6) acid damage at the start of each of the wormling's turns.
If the wormling takes 10 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the wormling must succeed on a 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the wormling. If the wormling dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Tail Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monsters.name: Shaldoor
spells: The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no material spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 17):

spells.1/day each: control weather (cast as 1 action), water breathing

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: Shalvus deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Shalvus that isn't incapacitated and Shalvus doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Roleplaying Information
traits.desc:
Nalaskur Thaelond of Bargewright Inn has entrusted the shepherd Shalvus with an important assignment: to figure out the best way by which Goldenfields can be brought under the Black Network's control. Shalvus believes that success will ensure his swift rise through the Zhentarim ranks.
Ideal: "I'll do what it takes to prove myself to the Zhentarim."
Bond: "I love animals, and I'm very protective of them."
Flaw: "I can't resist taking risks to feed my ambitions."

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if used with both hands.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +2 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Shalvus carries ten crossbow bolts.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

traits.name: Brave
traits.desc: Baric has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

traits.name: Roleplaying Information
traits.desc:
As a knight of the Order of the Gauntlet, Sir Baric has sworn oaths to catch evildoers and bring them to justice. His current quarry is a dwarf brigand, Worvil "the Weevil" Forkbeard, who is rumored to be hiding in Icewind Dale. In addition to his gear, Sir Baric has an unarmored warhorse, Henry.
Ideal: "Evil must not be allowed to thrive in this world."
Bond: "Tyr is my lord; the order, my family. Through my actions, I shall honor both."
Flaw: "I'm not afraid to die. When Tyr finally calls me, I'll go to him happily."

actions.name: Maul
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. 5 (1d10) piercing damage. Baric carries twenty crossbow bolts.

traits.name: Roleplaying Information
traits.desc:
An acolyte of Torm, Sirac grew up on the streets of Suzail, the capital of Cormyr. He came to Icewind Dale to become a knucklehead trout fisher but instead found religion. The misbegotten son of Artus Cimber, a renowned human adventurer, Sirac hasn't seen his father since he was a baby.
Ideal: "Without duty or loyalty, a man is nothing."
Bond: "Icewind Dale is where i belong for the rest of my life."
Flaw: "I am honest to a fault."

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. Sirac carries six darts.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Sirac adds 2 to his AC against on melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Sirac must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

monsters.name: Slarkrethel
monsters.damage_immunities: lightning, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.languages: understands Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, and Primordial but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Slarkrethel fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: Slarkrethel can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Freedom of Movement
traits.desc: Slarkrethel ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: Slarkrethel deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Slarkrethel makes three tentacle attacks, each of which it can replace with one use of Fling.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +17 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 23 (3d8 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature grappled by Slarkrethel, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside Slarkrethel, and it takes 42 (12d6) acid damage at the start of each of Slarkrethel's turns. If Slarkrethel takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, Slarkrethel must succeed on a 25 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of Slarkrethel. If Slarkrethel dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +17 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape 18). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. Slarkrethel has ten tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Fling
actions.desc: One Large or smaller object held or creature grappled by Slarkrethel is thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a 18 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Lightning Storm
actions.desc: Slarkrethel magically creates three bolts of lightning, each of which can strike a target Slarkrethel can see within 120 feet of it. A target must make a 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Tentacle Attack or Fling
legendary_actions.desc: Slarkrethel makes one tentacle attack or uses its Fling.

legendary_actions.name: Lightning Storm (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Slarkrethel uses Lightning Storm.

legendary_actions.name: Ink Cloud (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: While underwater, Slarkrethel expels an ink cloud in a 60-foot radius. The cloud spreads around corners, and that area is heavily obscured to creatures other than Slarkrethel. Each creature other than Slarkrethel that ends its turn there must succeed on a 23 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A strong current disperses the cloud, which otherwise disappears at the end of Slarkrethel's next turn.

spells: Slarkrethel casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 22):

spells.2/day each: control weather (cast as 1 action), fly, ice storm

spells.1/day each: arcane eye, chain lightning, feeblemind, foresight, locate creature, mass suggestion, nondetection, power word kill, scrying (cast as 1 action), sequester, telekinesis, teleport

monsters.name: Thane Kayalithica

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.desc: The giant has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

traits.name: Olach Morrah
traits.desc: The giant meditates for 1 hour, during which time it can do nothing else. At the end of the hour, provided the giant's meditation has been uninterrupted, it becomes petrified for 8 hours. At the end of this time, the giant is no longer petrified and gains tremorsense out to a range of 30 feet, as well as a measure of innate spellcasting ability for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Fling
actions.desc: The giant tries to throw a Small or Medium creature within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a 17 Dexterity saving throw or be hurled up to 60 feet horizontally in a direction of the giant's choice. and land prone, taking 1d6 bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown.

actions.name: Rolling Rock
actions.desc: The giant sends a rock tumbling along the ground in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and falling prone on a failed save

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two adamantine greatclub attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Rock Catching
reactions.desc: If a rock or similar object is hurled at the giant, the giant can, with a successful 10 Dexterity saving throw, catch the missile and take no bludgeoning damage from it.

spells: The giant's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 18 (4d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Succeed on a DC14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

monsters.name: Turlang
spells: Turlang casts one of the following spells, requiring no material spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 15):

spells.At will: druidcraft, guidance, resistance, speak with plants

spells.2/day each: animal messenger, detect magic, entangle, goodberry, gust of wind, pass without trace, speak with animals

spells.1/day each: commune with nature (cast as 1 action), conjure woodland beings, hallucinatory terrain (cast as 1 action)

traits.name: Giant Slayer
traits.desc: Any weapon attack that Urgala makes against a giant deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage on a hit.

traits.name: Roleplaying Information
traits.desc:
A retired adventurer, Urgala owns a respectable inn, the North shield House, and she doesn't want to see it or her neighbors' homes destroyed. She has no tolerance for monsters or bullies.
Ideal: "We live in a violent world, and sometimes violence is necessary for survival."
Bond: "My home is my life. Threaten it, and I'll hurt you."
Flaw: "I know how treacherous and greedy adventurers can be. I don't trust them—any of them."

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Urgala makes two attacks with her morningstar or her shortbow.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage. Urgala carries a quiver of twenty arrows.

monsters.name: Uthgardt Shaman

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if wielded with two hands.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

spells: The shaman casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 12; +4 to hit with spell attacks):

spells.At will: dancing lights, mage hand, message, thaumaturgy

spells.1/day each: augury (cast as 1 action), bestow curse, cordon of arrows, detect magic, speak with dead, spirit guardians

monsters.name: Vaasha
spells: The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no material spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 17):

spells.1/day each: control weather (cast as 1 action), water breathing

monsters.name: Yakfolk Priest

traits.name: Possession (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.desc:
The yakfolk attempts to magically possess a humanoid or giant. The yakfolk must touch the target throughout a short rest, or the attempt fails. At the end of the rest, the target must succeed on a 12 Constitution saving throw or be possessed by the yakfolk, which disappears with everything it is carrying and wearing. Until the possession ends, the target is incapacitated, loses control of its body, and is unaware of its surroundings. The yakfolk now controls the body and can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, and it retains its alignment; its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; and its proficiencies. It otherwise uses the target's statistics, except the target's knowledge, class features, feats, and proficiencies.

When the possession ends, the yakfolk reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body and is stunned until the end of its next turn.
