actions.desc: The giant crayfish makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d10 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape 12). The crayfish has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The toad can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Cold Aura
traits.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the toad takes 5 (1d10) cold damage.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.desc: The toad's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the toad can't bite another target.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature the toad is grappling. 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the toad, and it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage and 11 (2d10) cold damage at the start of each of the toad's turns. The toad can have only one target swallowed at a time.
If the toad dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.desc: The eel can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The eel makes two bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) lightning damage.

actions.name: Lightning Jolt (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: One creature the eel touches within 5 feet of it outside water, or each creature within 15 feet of it in a body of water, must make a 12 Constitution saving throw. On failed save, a target takes 13 (3d8) lightning damage. If the target takes any of this damage, the target is stunned until the end of the eel's next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If the skeleton is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The skeleton has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Turn Immunity
traits.desc: The skeleton is immune to effects that turn undead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The skeleton makes three scimitar attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The lizard makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail. One attack can be replaced by Swallow.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the lizard can't bite another target.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target not grappled by the lizard. 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature the lizard is grappling. 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage. The target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the lizard, and it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the lizard's turns. The lizard can have only one target swallowed at a time.
If the lizard dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 1 (1d4 - 1) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Greater Zombie
monsters.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.desc: The zombie has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.desc: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The zombie makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Empowered Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

monsters.name: Grenl

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.desc: The goblin can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +4, range 80/320 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

spells: Grenl is a 1st-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 11, +3 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following cleric spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): poison spray, thaumaturgy

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 10 Constitution saving throw or contract a disease. Until the disease is cured, the target can't regain hit points except by magical means, and the target's hit point maximum decreases by 3 (1d6) every 24 hours. If the target's hit point maximum drops to 0 as a result of this disease, the target dies.

traits.name: Banded Claw
traits.desc: On one of its claws, the crab wears a rune-covered copper band that makes it immune to being charmed, frightened, and paralyzed. The copper band is worthless as a treasure, as the magic is keyed to this crab.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The crab can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 27 (4d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled, escape 14. The crab has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

monsters.name: Kaarghaz

traits.name: Chameleon Skin
traits.desc: The troglodyte has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.

traits.name: Stench
traits.desc: Any creature other than a troglodyte that starts its turn within 5 feet of the troglodyte must succeed on a 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of all troglodytes for 1 hour.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the troglodyte has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The troglodyte makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

spells: Kaarghaz is a 4th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). He knows the following sorcerer spells:

spells.Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, mage hand, poison spray, prestidigitation, ray of frost

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: Kalka-Kylla can breathe air and water.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While Kalka-Kylla remains motionless and hidden in its shell, it is indistinguishable from a polished boulder.

traits.name: Shell
traits.desc: Kalka-Kylla can use a bonus action to retract into or emerge from its shell. While retracted, Kalka-Kylla gains a +4 bonus to AC, and it has a speed of 0 and can't benefit from bonuses to speed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Kalka-Kylla makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. Kalka-Kylla has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The kelpie can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Seaweed Shape
traits.desc: The kelpie can use its action to reshape its body into the form of a humanoid or beast that is Small, Medium, or Large. Its statistics are otherwise unchanged. The disguise is convincing, unless the kelpie is in bright light or the viewer is within 30 feet of it, in which case the seams between the seaweed strands are visible. The kelpie returns to its true form if takes a bonus action to do so or if it dies.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the kelpie remains motionless in its true form, it is indistinguishable from normal seaweed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kelpie makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape 12).

actions.name: Drowning Hypnosis
actions.desc:
The kelpie chooses one humanoid it can see within 150 feet of it. If the target can see the kelpie, the target must succeed on a 11 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed while the kelpie maintains {@status concentration}, up to 10 minutes (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). The charmed target is incapacitated, and instead of holding its breath underwater, it tries to breathe normally and immediately runs out of breath, unless it can breathe water. If the charmed target is more than 5 feet away from the kelpie, the target must move on its turn toward the kelpie by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks.
Before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the kelpie or drowning, the target can repeat the saving throw. A charmed target can also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If the saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it.
A target that successfully saves is immune to this kelpie's hypnosis for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 1 (1d4 - 1) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Malformed Kraken
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.languages: understands Common but can't speak, telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The kraken can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kraken makes three tentacle attacks. One of them can be replaced with a bite attack, and any of them can be replaced with Fling.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 14 (2d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The kraken has ten tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Fling
actions.desc: One Medium or smaller object held or creature grappled by the kraken's tentacles is thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a 16 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Lightning Storm
actions.desc: The kraken creates three bolts of lightning, each of which can strike a target the kraken can see within 150 feet of it. A target must make a 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The doppelganger can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.desc: In the first round of a combat, the doppelganger has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has {@status surprised}.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.desc: If the doppelganger surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage from the attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The doppelganger makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Read Thoughts
actions.desc: The doppelganger magically reads the surface thoughts of one creature within 60 feet of it. The effect can penetrate barriers, but 3 feet of wood or dirt, 2 feet of stone, 2 inches of metal, or a thin sheet of lead blocks it. While the target is in range, the doppelganger can continue reading its thoughts, as long as the doppelganger's {@status concentration} isn't broken (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). While reading the target's mind, the doppelganger has advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, and Persuasion) checks against the target.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The nereid can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Aquatic Invisibility
traits.desc: If immersed in water, the nereid can make itself invisible as a bonus action. It remains invisible until it leaves the water, ends the invisibility as a bonus action, or dies.

traits.name: Mantle Dependent
traits.desc: The nereid wears a mantle of silky cloth the color of sea foam, which holds the creature's spirit. The mantle has an AC and hit points equal to that of the nereid, but the garment can't be directly harmed while the nereid wears it. If the mantle is destroyed, the nereid becomes poisoned and dies within 1 hour. A nereid is willing to do anything in its power to recover the mantle if it is stolen, including serving the thief.

traits.name: Shape Water
traits.desc: The nereid can cast control water at will, requiring no components. Its spellcasting ability for it is Charisma. This use of the spell has a range of 30 feet and can affect a cube of water no larger than 30 feet on a side.

traits.name: Speak With Animals
traits.desc: The nereid can comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts.

actions.name: Blinding Acid
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. 16 (2d12 + 3) acid damage, and the target is blinded until the start of the nereid's next turn.

actions.name: Drowning Kiss (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The nereid touches one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a 13 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (3d12 + 3) acid damage. On a failure, it also runs out of breath and can't speak for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, it can repeat the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Water Lash
actions.desc: The nereid causes a 5-foot cube of water within 60 feet of it to take a shape of its choice and strike one target it can see within 5 feet of that water. The target must make a 13 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 17 (4d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and if it is a Large or smaller creature, it is pushed up to 15 feet in a straight line or is knocked prone (nereid's choice). On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't pushed or knocked prone.

monsters.name: Ooze Master
monsters.damage_resistances: lightning, necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, prone

traits.name: Corrosive Form
traits.desc:
A creature that touches the Ooze Master or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 9 (2d8) acid damage. Any nonmagical weapon that hits the Ooze Master corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to −5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition that hits the Ooze Master is destroyed after dealing damage.
The Ooze Master can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical wood or metal in 1 round.

traits.name: Instinctive Attack
traits.desc: When the Ooze Master casts a spell with a casting time of 1 action, it can make one pseudopod attack as a bonus action.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The Ooze Master can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) acid damage.

reactions.name: Instinctive Charm
reactions.desc: If a creature the Ooze Master can see makes an attack roll against it while within 30 feet of it, the Ooze Master can use a reaction to divert the attack if another creature is within the attack's range. The attacker must make a 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the attacker targets the creature that is closest to it, not including itself or the Ooze Master. If multiple creatures are closest, the attacker chooses which one to target. On a successful save, the attacker is immune to this Instinctive Charm for 24 hours. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this effect.

spells: The Ooze Master is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following wizard spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): acid splash, friends, mage hand, poison spray

spells.1st level (4 slots): charm person, detect magic, magic missile, ray of sickness

spells.2nd level (3 slots): detect thoughts, Melf's acid arrow, suggestion

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The sea lion can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The sea lion has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The sea lion has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the sea lion's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Swimming Leap
traits.desc: With a 10-foot swimming start, the sea lion can long jump out of or across the water up to 25 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sea lion makes three attacks: one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Sharwyn Hucrele

traits.name: Barkskin
traits.desc: Sharwyn's AC can't be lower than 16.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Sharwyn has a spellbook.

traits.desc: If the Gulthias Tree dies, Sharwyn dies 24 hours later.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

spells.Cantrips (at will): light, prestidigitation, ray of frost

spells.1st level (2 slots): color spray, magic missile, shield, sleep

traits.name: Barkskin
traits.desc: Sir Braford's AC can't be lower than 16.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Sir Braford wields Shatterspike, a magic longsword that grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it (included in his attack). See the Shatterspike handout for the item's other properties.

traits.name: Tree Thrall
traits.desc: If the Gulthias Tree dies, Sir Braford dies 24 hours later.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

reactions.name: Protection
reactions.desc: When a creature Sir Braford can see attacks a target other than him that is within 5 feet of him, he can use a reaction to use his shield to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

monsters.name: Siren

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: Siren can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Siren has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stupefying Touch
actions.desc: Siren touches one creature she can see within 5 feet of her. The creature must succeed on a 13 Intelligence saving throw or take 13 (3d6 + 3) psychic damage and be stunned until the start of Siren's next turn.

spells: Siren's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 13). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spells.1/day each: charm person, fog cloud, greater invisibility, polymorph (self only)

monsters.name: Snarla
monsters.damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The werewolf can use its action to polymorph into a wolf-humanoid hybrid or into a wolf, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.desc: The werewolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: The werewolf makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws or spear.

actions.name: Bite (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a 12 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with werewolf lycanthropy.

actions.name: Claws (Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spear (Humanoid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

spells: Snarla is a 6th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following wizard spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, shocking grasp

spells.1st level (4 slots): magic missile, shield, thunderwave

spells.3rd level (3 slots): dispel magic, fear, haste, stinking cloud

monsters.name: Snurrevin

traits.name: Duergar Resilience
traits.desc: The duergar has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, and illusions, as well as to resist being charmed or paralyzed.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the duergar has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Enlarge (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: For 1 minute, the duergar magically increases in size, along with anything it is wearing or carrying. While enlarged, the duergar is Large, doubles its damage dice on Strength-based weapon attacks (included in the attacks), and makes Strength checks and Strength saving throws with advantage. If the duergar lacks the room to become Large, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available.

actions.name: War Pick
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage, or 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage while enlarged.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage while enlarged.

actions.name: Invisibility (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: The duergar magically turns invisible until it attacks, casts a spell, or uses its Enlarge, or until its {@status concentration} is broken, up to 1 hour (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment the duergar wears or carries is invisible with it.

spells: Snurrevin is a 3rd-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, mage hand, minor illusion, shocking grasp

spells.1st level (4 slots): color spray, shield, silent image

actions.name: Steam Breath
actions.desc: The statue exhales steam in a line that is 30 feet long and 10 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 7 (2d4 + 2) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monsters.name: Tarul Var
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, lightning, necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Focused Conjuration
traits.desc: While Var is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a conjuration spell, his {@status concentration} can't be broken as a result of taking damage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Var fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: If Var is destroyed but his phylactery remains intact, Var gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all his hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.desc: Var has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

actions.name: Paralyzing Touch
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 10 (3d6) cold damage. The target must succeed on a 17 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Benign Transposition
actions.desc: Var teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. Alternatively, he can choose a space within range that is occupied by a Small or Medium creature. If that creature is willing, both creatures teleport, swapping places. Var can use this feature again only after he finishes a long rest or casts a conjuration spell of 1st level or higher.

legendary_actions.name: Cantrip
legendary_actions.desc: Var casts a cantrip.

legendary_actions.name: Paralyzing Touch (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Var uses Paralyzing Touch.

legendary_actions.name: Frightening Gaze (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Var fixes his gaze on one creature he can see within 10 feet of him. The target must succeed on a 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened for 1 minute. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to Var's gaze for the next 24 hours.

spells:
Var is a 12th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:
*Conjuration spell of 1st level or higher

spells.Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, mage hand, minor illusion, prestidigitation, ray of frost

spells.1st level (4 slots): detect magic, magic missile, shield, unseen servant*

spells.2nd level (3 slots): detect thoughts, flaming sphere*, mirror image, scorching ray

spells.5th level (3 slots): cloudkill*, scrying

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: Tecuziztecatl can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Glowing
traits.desc: Tecuziztecatl sheds dim light within 20 feet of itself.

traits.name: Flexible
traits.desc: Tecuziztecatl can enter a space large enough for a Medium creature without squeezing.

traits.name: Spider Climb

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.alignment: lawful neutral (law/chaos axis) chaotic neutral (good/evil axis) evil

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The warrior has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the warrior's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Adhesive Blossoms
traits.desc:
The thorn slinger adheres to anything that touches it. A Medium or smaller creature adhered to the thorn slinger is also grappled by it (escape 11). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.
At the end of each of the thorn slinger's turns, anything grappled by it takes 3 (1d6) acid damage.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the thorn slinger remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate bush.

actions.name: Thorns
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. 8 (2d6 + 1) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Tloques-Popolocas
monsters.damage_resistances: necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vampire regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.desc: The vampire has the following flaws:

traits.name: Forbiddance
traits.desc: The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

traits.name: Harmed by Running Water
traits.desc: The vampire takes 20 acid damage when it ends its turn in running water.

traits.name: Stake to the Heart
traits.desc: The vampire is destroyed if a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into its heart while it is incapacitated in its resting place.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.desc: The vampire takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc:
If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to Polymorph into a Tiny bat, or back into its true form.
While in bat form, the vampire can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its Statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vampire makes two attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, the vampire can grapple the target, escape 13.

actions.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
actions.desc: The vampire magically calls 2d4 swarms of bats, provided that the sun isn't up. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the vampire and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until the vampire dies, or until the vampire dismisses them as a bonus action.

actions.name: Tloques' Berserker Axe +2
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage.

spells: Tloques can cast hold person (14) at will, requiring no components, but his target must be able to see him.

monsters.name: White Maw
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, prone
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 10

traits.name: Amorphous Form
traits.desc: White Maw can occupy another creature's space and vice versa.

traits.name: Corrode Metal
traits.desc:
Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits White Maw corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to damage rolls. if its penalty drops to −5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits White Maw is destroyed after dealing damage.
White Maw can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical metal in 1 round.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While White Maw remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from white stone.

traits.name: Killer Response
traits.desc: Any creature that starts its turn in White Maw's space is targeted by a pseudopod attack if White Maw isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 22 (4d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage. If the target is wearing nonmagical metal armor, its armor is partly corroded and takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity

traits.name: Special Equipment

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Acererak fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: Acererak's body turns to dust when he drops to 0 hit points, and his equipment is left behind. Acererak gains a new body after 1d10 days, regaining all his hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of Acererak's phylactery, the location of which is hidden.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.desc: Acererak has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

actions.name: Paralyzing Touch
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 10 (3d6) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a 20 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Staff (+3 Quarterstaff)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage when used with two hands.

actions.name: Invoke Curse
actions.desc: While holding the Staff of the Forgotten One, Acererak expends 1 charge from it and targets one creature he can see within 60 feet of him. The target must succeed on a 23 Constitution saving throw or be cursed. Until the curse is ended, the target can't regain hit points and has vulnerability to necrotic damage. Greater restoration, remove curse, or similar magic ends the curse on the target.

legendary_actions.name: At-Will Spell
legendary_actions.desc: Acererak casts one of his at-will spells.

legendary_actions.name: Melee Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Acererak uses Paralyzing Touch or makes one melee attack with his staff.

legendary_actions.name: Frightening Gaze (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Acererak fixes his gaze on one creature he can see within 10 feet of him. The target must succeed on a 20 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened for 1 minute. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target its immune to Acererak's gaze for the next 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Talisman of the Sphere (Costs 2 Actions)

legendary_actions.name: Disrupt Life (Costs 3 Actions)

spells: Acererak is a 20th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks). Acererak has the following wizard spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): mage hand, ray of frost, shocking grasp

spells.5th level (3 slots): cloudkill, hold monster, wall of force

spells.6th level (3 slots): chain lightning, circle of death, disintegrate

spells.7th level (3 slots): finger of death, plane shift, teleport

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc:
Artus wears the Ring of Winter. He and the ring can't be targeted by divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors. While attuned to and wearing the ring, Artus ceases to age and is immune to cold damage and the effects of extreme cold.
Artus wields Bookmark a +3 dagger with additional magical properties. As a bonus action, Artus can activate any one of the following properties while attuned to the dagger, provided he has the weapon drawn:

traits.name: Cause a blue gem set into the dagger's pommel to shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet, or make the gem go dark.
Turn the dagger into a compass that, while resting on your palm, points north.
Cast dimension door from the dagger. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

Cast compulsion (save 15) from the dagger. The range of the spell increases to 90 feet but it targets only spiders that are beasts. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Artus makes three attacks with Bookmark or his longbow.

actions.name: Bookmark (+3 Dagger)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Ring of Winter
actions.desc: The Ring of Winter has 12 charges and regains all its expended charges daily at dawn. While attuned to and wearing the ring, Artus can expend the necessary number of charges to activate one of the following properties:

actions.name: Artus can expend 1 charge and use the ring to lower the temperature in a 120-foot-radius sphere centered on a point he can see within 300 feet of him. The temperature in that area drops 20 degrees per minute, to a minimum of −30 degrees Fahrenheit. Frost and ice begin to form on surfaces once the temperature drops below 32 degrees. This effect is permanent unless Artus uses the ring to end the effect as an action, at which point the temperature in the area returns to normal at a rate of 10 degrees per minute.

Artus can cast one of the following spells from the ring (spell save 17) by expending the necessary number of charges: Bigby's hand (2 charges) the hand is made of ice, is immune to cold damage, and deals bludgeoning damage instead of force damage as a clenched fist, cone of cold (2 charges), flesh to stone (2 charges).

Artus can expend the necessary number of charges and use the ring to create either an inanimate ice object (2 charges) or an animated ice creature (4 charges). The ice object can't have any moving parts, must be able to fit inside a 10-foot cube, and has the density and durability of metal or stone (Artus's choice). The ice creature must be modeled after a beast with a challenge rating of 2 or less. The ice creature has the same statistics as the beast it models, with the following changes: the creature is a construct with vulnerability to fire damage, immunity to cold and poison damage, and immunity to the following conditions: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned. The ice creature obeys only its creator's commands. The object or creature appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Artus. It melts into a pool of normal water after 24 hours or when it drops to 0 hit points. In extreme heat, it loses 5 (1d10) hit points per minute as it melts. Use the guidelines in chapter 8 of the Dungeon Master's Guide to determine the hit points of an inanimate object if they become necessary.

monsters.name: Asharra

traits.name: Dive Attack
traits.desc: If the aarakocra is flying and dives at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a melee weapon attack, the attack deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage to the target.

traits.name: Dance of the Seven Winds
traits.desc:
Asharra knows a ritual called the Dance of the Seven Winds, which temporarily grants magical flight to as many as ten nonflying creatures. The ritual, which takes 10 minutes to complete, can only be performed by an aarakocra elder and requires a black orchid as a material component.
Asharra must grind the orchid to powder, inhale it, and dance in circles around the ritual's beneficiaries uninterrupted while seven other aarakocra chant prayers to the Wind Dukes of Aaqa. When the dance concludes, Asharra's wings disappear and she loses the ability to fly. The ritual's beneficiaries each gain a magical flying speed of 30 feet (allowing them to fly 4 miles per hour). This benefit lasts for 3 days, after which Asharra's wings reappear and she regains the ability to fly.

actions.name: Talon
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Summon Air Elemental
actions.desc: Five aarakocra within 30 feet of each other can magically summon an air elemental. Each of the five must use its action and movement on three consecutive turns to perform an aerial dance and must maintain {@status concentration} while doing so (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). When all five have finished their third turn of the dance, the elemental appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of them. It is friendly toward them and obeys their spoken commands. It remains for 1 hour, until it or all its summoners die, or until any of its summoners dismisses it as a bonus action. A summoner can't perform the dance again until it finishes a short rest. When the elemental returns to the Elemental Plane of Air, any aarakocra within 5 feet of it can return with it.

spells: Asharra is a 5th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). Asharra has the following druid spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): druidcraft, mending, produce flame

spells.1st level (4 slots): detect magic, faerie fire, thunderwave

spells.2nd level (3 slots): gust of wind, hold person, lesser restoration

actions.name: Entangling Vines
actions.desc: The assassin vine can animate normal vines and roots on the ground in a 15-foot square within 30 feet of it. These plants turn the ground in that area into difficult terrain. A creature in that area when the effect begins must succeed on a 13 Strength saving throw or be restrained by entangling vines and roots. A creature restrained by the plants can use its action to make a 13 Strength (Athletics) check, freeing itself on a successful check. The effect ends after 1 minute or when the assassin vine dies or uses Entangling Vines again.

actions.desc: The atropal summons a wraith which materializes within 30 feet of it in an unoccupied space it can see. The wraith obeys its summoner's commands and can't be controlled by any other creature. The Wraith vanishes when it drops to 0 hit points or when its summoner dies.

actions.name: Yellow Musk (3/Day)
actions.desc: The creeper's flowers release a strong musk that targets all humanoids within 30 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a 11 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the creeper for 1 minute. A creature charmed in this way does nothing on its turn except move as close as it can to the creeper. A creature charmed by the creeper can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.desc: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 +the damage taken, unless the damage is fire or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Yuan-ti Priest
spells: The yuan-ti's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). The yuan-ti can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

spells.At will: animal friendship (snakes only), eldritch blast (2 beams), minor illusion, poison spray

monsters.name: Zindar
monsters.senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12

traits.name: Dragon Wings
traits.desc: As a bonus action on his turn, Zindar can sprout a pair of dragon wings from his back, gaining a flying speed of 30 feet until he dismisses them as a bonus action.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands.

actions.name: Breath Weapon (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Zindar uses one of the following options:

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.desc: Zindar exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Weakening Breath
actions.desc: Zindar exhales gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a 15 Strength saving throw or have disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, Strength checks, and Strength saving throws for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spells: Zindar is a 14th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). Zindar knows the following sorcerer spells:

spells.Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, friends, light, mage hand, mending, message

spells.5th level (3 slots): hold monster, telekinesis

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The zorbo has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.desc: The zorbo magically absorbs the natural strength of its surroundings, adjusting its Armor Class based on the material it is standing or climbing on: AC 15 for wood or bone, AC 17 for earth or stone, or AC 19 for metal. If the zorbo isn't in contact with any of these substances, its AC is 10.

actions.name: Destructive Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (2d6 + 1) slashing damage, and if the target is a creature wearing armor, carrying a shield, or in possession of a magic item that improves its AC, it must make a 11 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, one such item worn or carried by the creature (the target's choice) magically deteriorates, taking a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to the AC it offers, and the zorbo gains a +1 bonus to AC until the start of its next turn. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield or magic item that drops to a 0 AC increase is destroyed.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The decapus makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tentacles.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature grappled by the decapus. 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 24 (9d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage or 14 (5d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage if the decapus is grappling a creature other than the target or if the decapus is on the ground or floor. The target is also grappled (escape 14) unless the decapus is already grappling a creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained.

monsters.name: Geonid
monsters.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft., passive Perception 14

traits.name: Boulder Guise
traits.desc: While fully withdrawn into its shell, the geonid can't see and is indistinguishable from a small boulder

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Stone Tell
actions.desc: The geonid touches a stone object or surface and knows what types of creatures have been within 10 feet of that stone in the past 24 hours. The geonid can also determine the number of creatures of each type, but not their identities.

monsters.name: Giant Slug

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The slug has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The slug can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The slug makes two attacks: one with its tentacles and one with its bite.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. 4 (1d4 + 2) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. Until this poison ends, the target is paralyzed. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the poison on itself on a success.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Animate Tentacle
reactions.desc: When the slug takes damage in this cave ({@adventure Shrine of Umberlee|ttp|3|24. Shrine of Umberlee}), it can use its reaction to animate one of the tentacles of the kraken statue and cause it to   make a melee weapon attack (+3 to hit) against one creature within 20 feet of the statue that the slug can see. The tentacle deals 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage on a hit.

spells: The slug's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 11, +3 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

monsters.name: Topi
monsters.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.desc: The topi has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.desc: If damage reduces the topi to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5+the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the topi drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Venomous Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of the target's next turn.

monsters.name: Vecna the Archlich
monsters.damage_immunities: poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.desc: If Vecna fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Vecna carries a magic dagger named Afterthought. In the hands of anyone other than Vecna, Afterthought is a +2 Dagger.

traits.name: Undying
traits.desc: If Vecna is slain, his soul refuses to accept its fate and lives on as a disembodied spirit that fashions a new body for itself after 1d100 years. Vecna's new body appears within 100 miles of where he was slain. When the new body is complete, Vecna regains all his hit points and becomes active again.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Vecna uses Flight of the Damned (if available), Rotten Fate, or Spellcasting. He then makes two attacks with Afterthought.

actions.name: Afterthought
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is afflicted by entropic magic, taking 9 (2d8) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. Immediately after taking this damage on its turn, the target must make a 20 Constitution saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Until it succeeds on this save, the afflicted target can't regain hit points.

actions.name: Flight of the Damned (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Vecna conjures a torrent of flying, spectral entities that fill a 120-foot cone and pass through all creatures in that area before dissipating. Each creature in that area must make a 22 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 36 (8d8) necrotic damage and has the frightened condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Rotten Fate
actions.desc: Vecna causes necrotic magic to engulf one creature he can see within 120 feet of himself. The target must make a 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 96 (8d8 + 60) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A Humanoid killed by this magic rises as a zombie at the start of Vecna's next turn and acts immediately after Vecna in the initiative order. The zombie is under Vecna's control.

bonus_actions.name: Vile Teleport
bonus_actions.desc: Vecna teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. He can cause each creature of his choice within 15 feet of his destination space to take 10 (3d6) psychic damage. If at least one creature takes this damage, Vecna regains 80 hit points.

reactions.name: Dread Counterspell
reactions.desc: Vecna utters a dread word to interrupt a creature he can see that is casting a spell. If the spell is 4th level or lower, it fails and has no effect. If the spell is 5th level or higher, Vecna makes an Intelligence check (10 plus the spell's level). On a successful check, the spell fails and has no effect. Whatever the spell's level, the caster takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage if the spell fails.

reactions.name: Fell Rebuke
reactions.desc: In response to being hit by an attack, Vecna utters a fell word, dealing 10 (3d6) necrotic damage to the attacker, and Vecna teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

spells: Vecna casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 22):

spells.At will: Animate Dead (as an action), Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Fly, Lightning Bolt, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation

spells.2/day each: Dimension Door, Invisibility, Scrying (as an action)

spells.1/day each: Dominate Monster, Globe of Invulnerability, Plane Shift (self only)

monsters.name: Alustriel Silverhand

traits.name: Ear of the Chosen
traits.desc: Whenever a creature on the same plane of existence as Alustriel speaks Alustriel's name, Alustriel hears her name and the next nine words the speaker utters.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Alustriel fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Alustriel carries a magic staff known as the Staff of Silverymoon. In the hands of anyone other than Alustriel, the Staff of Silverymoon is a Staff of Power.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Alustriel makes three Staff of Silverymoon attacks or two Reproving Ray attacks.

actions.name: Staff of Silverymoon
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 38 (7d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Reproving Ray
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +14 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. 65 (9d12 + 7) force damage, and if the target is a creature, it must make a 22 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the incapacitated condition until the start of Alustriel's next turn. On a successful save, the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of Alustriel's next turn.

actions.name: Argent Blaze (Requires Silver Fire)
actions.desc: Alustriel summons a 60- foot cone of silver fire. Each creature in that area must make a 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 77 (14d10) radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, Alustriel or one creature of her choice within 60 feet of her then regains 10 (3d6) hit points.

bonus_actions.name: Silver Fire (2/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: Brilliant silver fire harmlessly wreathes Alustriel and empowers her. The silver fire lasts for 1 hour or until she has the incapacitated condition or uses another bonus action to quench it. While wreathed in silver fire, Alustriel gains truesight within 30 feet and can use her Argent Blaze action. In addition, Alustriel is unaffected by magic that would ascertain her alignment, creature type, thoughts, or truthfulness.

reactions.name: Shining Counterspell
reactions.desc: Alustriel interrupts a creature she can see within 60 feet of herself that is casting a spell. If the spell is 5th level or lower, it fails and has no effect. If the spell is 6th level or higher, Alustriel makes an Intelligence check (10 plus the spell's level). On a successful check, the spell fails and has no effect. Whatever the spell's level, the caster takes 11 (2d10) radiant damage if the spell fails.

spells: Alustriel casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 22):

spells.At will: Dancing Lights, Detect Magic, Mage Armor (self only), Mage Hand

spells.2/day each: Detect Thoughts, Dispel Magic, Tongues

monsters.name: Black Rose Bearer
monsters.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Berserk
traits.desc: Whenever the bearer takes damage or makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, roll a d6. On a 5 or 6, the bearer goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the bearer has advantage on melee attack rolls, it can Dash as a bonus action, and it must attack the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the bearer attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the bearer goes berserk, it remains berserk until it is destroyed or its creator gives it a pristine black rose.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.desc: If damage reduces the bearer to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a successful save, the bearer drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bearer makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The lieutenant has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the lieutenant's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The lieutenant makes three Longsword or Javelin Launcher attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 17 (3d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 20 (3d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Javelin Launcher
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target has the prone condition.

bonus_actions.name: Command Ally
bonus_actions.desc: The lieutenant targets one ally it can see within 30 feet of itself. If the target can see or hear the lieutenant, the target can make one melee attack using its reaction, if available, and has advantage on the attack roll.

bonus_actions.name: Rally the Troops (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The lieutenant ends the charmed and frightened conditions on itself and each creature of its choice that it can see within 30 feet of itself.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The lieutenant adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the lieutenant must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The scout has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the scout's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The scout makes three Armblade or Bolt Launcher attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with a use of Snare Trap.

actions.name: Armblade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bolt Launcher
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +8 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Snare Trap (1/Day)
actions.desc: The scout deploys a Tiny mechanical trap on a solid surface within 5 feet of itself. The trap is hidden, requiring a successful 17 Intelligence (Investigation) check to find. The trap lasts for 1 minute. Whenever an enemy enters a space within 10 feet of the trap or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) piercing damage and have the prone condition. A creature makes this saving throw only once per turn.

bonus_actions.name: Dash
bonus_actions.desc: The scout moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The blazebear has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Mist Sight
traits.desc: The blazebear can see normally through heavily obscured areas created by mist or fog, including areas created by spells such as Fog Cloud.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The blazebear makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with Stunning Gaze if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 20 (2d12 + 7) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) force damage.

actions.name: Stunning Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The blazebear targets two creatures it can see within 120 feet of itself. Each target must succeed on a 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the stunned condition until the start of the blazebear's next turn.

reactions.name: Antimagic Swipe
reactions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature casting a spell of 3rd level or lower. 22 (4d10) force damage, and the target must succeed on a 15 Intelligence saving throw or the spell fails and has no effect.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bone roc makes one Beak attack and two Talons attacks.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Glacial Aura
traits.desc: At the end of the borthak's turn, slippery ice covers surfaces within 10 feet of the borthak. This ice is difficult terrain. When a creature other than the borthak enters the ice's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a 16 Dexterity saving throw or have the prone condition. The ice disappears at the start of the borthak's next turn.

traits.name: Webbed Feet
traits.desc: The borthak can move across icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The borthak makes one Bite attack or uses Noxious Regurgitation if available, and it makes two Stomp attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 11 (1d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Noxious Regurgitation (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The borthak spews acid at a creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a 21 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 24 (7d6) acid damage and has the poisoned condition until the start of the borthak's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

reactions.name: Reactive Tail
reactions.desc: When a creature within 10 feet of the borthak hits the borthak with an attack roll, the borthak swings its tail in retaliation. The triggering creature and any creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: The borthak moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The borthak makes one Bite attack.

monsters.name: Camlash
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, lightning, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.desc: Camlash explodes when reduced to 0 hit points, and each creature within 30 feet of Camlash must make a 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Camlash has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spider Aura
traits.desc: Camlash is surrounded by tiny biting spiders that magically appear and disappear from moment to moment. At the start of each of Camlash's turns, each creature within 10 feet of Camlash takes 10 (3d6) poison damage and must succeed on a 21 Constitution saving throw or have the paralyzed condition until the start of Camlash's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Camlash makes one Flaming Whip attack and one Lightning Blade attack. Camlash can replace one of these attacks with Teleport.

actions.name: Flaming Whip
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. 25 (5d6 + 8) fire damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 21 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 feet toward Camlash.

actions.name: Lightning Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: Camlash magically teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

monsters.name: Citadel Spider
monsters.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 11

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the spider fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spider makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with a use of Web Bomb.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Web Bomb
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +14 to hit, range 300 ft./600 ft., one target. 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage, and the target and all creatures within 10 feet of it must succeed on a 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) acid damage and have the restrained condition until the start of the spider's next turn.

reactions.name: Absorb Blow
reactions.desc: In response to being hit with an attack roll, the spider's carapace absorbs some of the blow, reducing the damage it takes by 11 (2d10).

monsters.name: Deadbark Dryad
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Bramble Walk
traits.desc: Difficult terrain composed of vegetation, such as foliage or thorns, doesn't cost the dryad extra movement.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The dryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
traits.desc: The dryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dryad makes two Poisonous Thorn attacks and one Sapping Vine attack.

actions.name: Poisonous Thorn
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 13 (4d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 17 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition until the start of the dryad's next turn.

actions.name: Sapping Vine
actions.desc:
Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. The target has the grappled condition (escape 16). Until the grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the dryad can't use the same vine on another target. A creature restrained in this way takes 13 (3d8) necrotic damage at the start of its turn.
The dryad has six vines. Each vine can be attacked (AC 20; 10 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage). Destroying a vine deals no damage to the dryad, but any creature grappled by that vine no longer has the grappled condition. All vines immediately wither and disappear when the dryad is reduced to 0 hit points.

spells: The dryad casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 17):

spells.2/day each: Pass without Trace, Spike Growth

monsters.name: Deathwolf
monsters.damage_immunities: poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: If the deathwolf fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Moon's Grace
traits.desc: When the deathwolf falls, it descends at a rate of 60 feet per round and takes no falling damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The deathwolf makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with Phantom Deathwolf if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a 16 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on saving throws against the frightened condition. This curse lasts until removed by the Remove Curse spell or other magic.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Phantom Deathwolf (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc:
The deathwolf creates a terrifying phantom of itself in the mind of a creature the deathwolf can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 17 Intelligence saving throw or have the frightened condition for 1 minute.
While the target is frightened, the phantom deals 21 (6d6) psychic damage to the target at the start of each of the target's turns. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reactions.name: Imposing Slash
reactions.desc: When a creature within 5 feet of the deathwolf makes an attack roll against it, the deathwolf forces the creature to succeed on a 17 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on that roll. After the attack hits or misses, the deathwolf makes one Claw attack against the creature.

reactions.name: Phase Step
reactions.desc: Immediately after taking damage, the deathwolf teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see that is in dim light or darkness.

monsters.name: Degloth
monsters.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The degloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The degloth makes two Razor Fist attacks.

actions.name: Razor Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the target has the grappled condition (escape 18). Until this grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the degloth can't use this fist to grapple another target. The degloth has two fists.

bonus_actions.name: Crush

monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the false lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The false lich has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The false lich makes two Death Rend attacks and uses Bloodcurdling Lament if available.

actions.name: Death Rend
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 23 (3d10 + 7) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Bloodcurdling Lament (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The false lich emits a hideous shriek charged with malignant energy. Each creature within 30 feet of the false lich must succeed on a 22 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition for 1 minute. While frightened in this way, a creature also has the unconscious condition. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Soul Siphon
bonus_actions.desc:
The false lich targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must make a 22 Charisma saving throw; if the target has the unconscious condition, it has disadvantage on this saving throw. The target takes 21 (6d6) force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The false lich then regains a number of hit points equal to the amount of force damage taken.
If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target immediately dies, its body disappears, and its soul is trapped inside one of the soul gems within the false lich's skull. After 24 hours, the gem transfers the soul to the false lich's creator.
When the false lich is reduced to 0 hit points, it is destroyed and disintegrates, leaving behind the gems. Crushing a gem releases any souls trapped within, at which point the soul's body re-forms in an unoccupied space nearest to the gem and in the same state as it was when its soul was trapped.

legendary_actions.name: Spiteful Teleport
legendary_actions.desc: The false lich, along with anything it is wearing or carrying, teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of itself. It then makes one Death Rend attack if possible.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The false lich uses Spellcasting.

spells: The false lich casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 22):

spells.At will: Detect Magic, Fly, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation

traits.name: Heatsink

traits.name: Pack Tactics

actions.name: Spiked Glaive
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing or slashing damage, or 14 (1d10 + 9) piercing or slashing damage if Glaive is in overdrive.

actions.name: Serrated Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage. If Glaive has advantage on the attack roll, the serrated bolt lodges in the target, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the serrated bolt is removed. A target's speed can be reduced by only one serrated bolt at a time. A creature can use its action to remove a serrated bolt lodged in itself or another creature within its reach; when the bolt is removed from a creature, that creature takes 5 (2d4) slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Overdrive (Recharges after Finishing a Short or Long Rest)
bonus_actions.desc: Glaive enters a state of overdrive that lasts for 1 minute or until she has the incapacitated condition. While in overdrive, Glaive gains the following benefits:

bonus_actions.name: Glaive has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
When Glaive makes a melee weapon attack, she gains a +4 bonus to the damage roll.

reactions.name: Self-Preservation
reactions.desc: In response to being hit by a weapon attack, Glaive reduces the damage by 11 (2d10).

At the start of each of the hertilod's turns, each swallowed creature takes 13 (2d12) poison damage from the poisonous secretion in the hertilod's gullet.

If the hertilod takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a swallowed creature, the hertilod must succeed on a 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which lands in a space within 10 feet of the hertilod and has the prone condition. traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Kas fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Kas regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point. If he takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Kas wears the Crown of Lies (see the Introduction of Vecna: Eve of Ruin).

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: Kas can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Strength of the Night
traits.desc: Kas doesn't require a coffin, and he drinks blood to sow terror rather than for sustenance. If destroyed, Kas revives in 1d100 nights in an unoccupied space in Tovag, his Domain of Dread. He can be permanently destroyed only by having a stake driven through his heart and then being beheaded. The stake must be cut from a tree growing in soil from Oerth, Kas's home world.
