traits.desc: While in sunlight, Kas takes 20 radiant damage at the start of his turn, has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and can't use his Change Shape bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Kas makes three Vengeful Sword attacks. He can replace one of these attacks with a Bite attack.

actions.name: Vengeful Sword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 20 (2d8 + 11) slashing damage. The sword scores a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 11 (1d6 + 8) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Kas regains a number of hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way and then buried rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Kas's control.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: Kas transforms into a Medium cloud of mist. While in this form, Kas has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. While in mist form, Kas can pass through a space without squeezing as long as air can pass through that space, but he can't pass through water. Kas has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and he is immune to all nonmagical damage except the damage he takes as part of his Vampire Weaknesses trait. While in mist form, Kas can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects.

bonus_actions.name: Menacing Glare
bonus_actions.desc: Kas targets one creature he can see within 60 feet of himself. The target must succeed on a 23 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until the start of Kas's next turn.

reactions.name: Parrying Riposte
reactions.desc: Kas adds 3 to his AC against one melee attack roll that would hit him. He then makes one Vengeful Sword attack against the attacker if it is within his reach. On a hit, the target takes an additional 9 (2d8) slashing damage.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: Kas moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Sword (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Kas makes one Vengeful Sword attack.

It lasts for 1 hour, until Kas dies, or until Kas dismisses it as a bonus action. Kas can't have more than two specters summoned at a time.

bonus_actions.name: Stifling Webs (Recharge 5-6)
bonus_actions.desc:
The spiderdragon spins a 30-foot cube of strong, sticky webbing in an area adjacent to itself. The webbing lasts for 1 minute, is difficult terrain, and lightly obscures its area. A creature that starts its turn in the webbing or enters the webbing for the first time on its turn must succeed on a 15 Dexterity saving throw or have the restrained condition while in the web. As an action, a creature can free itself or another creature from the web by succeeding on a 15 Strength check.
A 5-foot cube of the web is destroyed if it takes at least 10 acid, fire, or slashing damage on a single turn.

monsters.name: Star Angler
monsters.senses: blindsight 120 ft. (can't see beyond this radius), passive Perception 15

traits.name: Avoidance
traits.desc: If the star angler is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: The star angler's lure sheds bright light in a 30- foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The star angler makes three Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Lure Charm
bonus_actions.desc: The star angler's lure flares with enchanting starlight, targeting one creature the star angler can see within 120 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 13 Wisdom saving throw or have the charmed condition until the start of the star angler's next turn. While charmed in this way, the target has the incapacitated condition and must use its movement on its turn to move directly toward the star angler; a charmed target doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but it does avoid damaging terrain. A target can be charmed by only one star angler at a time.

monsters.name: Strahd, Master of Death House
monsters.damage_resistances: necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.languages: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Giant, Infernal

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Strahd fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Master of the House
traits.desc: When Strahd is reduced to 0 hit points, he dissolves into mist and immediately teleports to his lair in Castle Ravenloft. After 1d4 hours, Strahd re-forms in a random unoccupied space within his lair, regaining all his hit points.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Strahd regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point. If he takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: Strahd can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.desc: Strahd has the following flaws:

traits.name: Harmed by Running Water
traits.desc: While in running water, Strahd takes 20 acid damage if he ends his turn there, and he can't use his Change Shape.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, Strahd takes 20 radiant damage at the start of his turn, has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and can't use his Change Shape bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Strahd makes two Death Strike attacks. He can replace one of these attacks with Blighted Fire if available.

actions.name: Death Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, Strahd can forgo dealing slashing damage; the target then has the grappled condition (escape 18) instead. Strahd can grapple only one creature at a time.

actions.name: Blighted Fire (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Strahd summons shadowy, necrotic fire that fills a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point he can see within 90 feet of himself. Each creature in that area must make a 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Charm
actions.desc:
Strahd targets one Humanoid he can see within 30 feet of himself. The target must succeed on a 17 Wisdom saving throw or have the charmed condition. The charmed target regards Strahd as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. The target isn't under Strahd's control, but it takes Strahd's requests and actions in the most favorable way.
Each time Strahd or his companions deal damage to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Strahd is reduced to 0 hit points, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or uses a bonus action to end the effect.

bonus_actions.name: Bite
bonus_actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature that has the charmed or grappled condition. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Strahd regains a number of hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way and then buried rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Strahd's control.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: Strahd transforms into a new form or back into his true form. Anything he is wearing transforms with him, but nothing he is carrying does. He reverts to his true form if he dies. When transforming into a new form, Strahd chooses one of the following options:

bonus_actions.name: Beast Form
bonus_actions.desc: Strahd transforms into a Tiny bat (flying speed 30 ft.) or a Medium wolf (speed 40 ft.). While in that form, he can't speak, and he retains his game statistics other than his size and speed.

bonus_actions.name: Mist Form
bonus_actions.desc: Strahd transforms into a Medium cloud of mist. While in this form, Strahd has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. While in mist form, Strahd can pass through a space without squeezing as long as air can pass through that space, but he can't pass through water. Strahd has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and he is immune to all nonmagical damage except the damage he takes as part of his Vampire Weaknesses trait. While in mist form, Strahd can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects.

legendary_actions.name: Cunning Escape
legendary_actions.desc: Strahd moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Strahd makes one Death Strike attack.

spells: Strahd casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 18):

spells.At will: Detect Thoughts, Fog Cloud, Mage Hand

spells.2/day each: Animate Dead (as an action), Gust of Wind, Mirror Image, Nondetection

spells.1/day each: Greater Invisibility, Polymorph, Scrying (as an action)

monsters.languages: Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Infernal, Sylvan

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Tasha fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Tasha has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. (This trait is bestowed by her Robe of the Archmagi.)

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Tasha wears a Robe of the Archmagi.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Tasha makes two Caustic Blast attacks and uses Psychic Whip once.

actions.name: Caustic Blast
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +14 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 21 (6d4 + 6) acid damage.

actions.name: Psychic Whip
actions.desc: Tasha psychically lashes out at one creature she can see within 90 feet of herself. The target must make a 20 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage and has the stunned condition until the start of Tasha's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Abyssal Visage (2/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: For 1 minute, Tasha gains a flying speed of 30 feet, is immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition, and has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points. These benefits end early if Tasha has the incapacitated condition or if she uses another bonus action to dismiss them.

reactions.name: Arcane Rebuff
reactions.desc: Immediately after Tasha takes damage, she unleashes arcane energy in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on herself. All other creatures in that area must make a 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 19 (3d12) lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Tasha then teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space she can see within 60 feet of herself.

spells: Tasha casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 22, +14 to hit with spell attacks):

spells.At will: Detect Magic, Disguise Self, Dispel Magic, Light, Mage Hand, Message, Prestidigitation, Tasha's Hideous Laughter

spells.2/day each: Polymorph

bonus_actions.name: Stomp

monsters.name: Whirling Chandelier
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 7

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: If the chandelier is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the chandelier move or act, that creature must succeed on a 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the chandelier is animate.

traits.desc: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the chandelier takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Chain
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a 15 Strength saving throw or be pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the chandelier.

actions.name: Lamp

actions.desc: Each creature within 20 feet of the chandelier and not behind Cover must succeed on a 14 Constitution saving throw or take 36 (8d8) fire damage and have the blinded condition until the start of the chandelier's next turn.

monsters.name: Windfall

traits.name: Dazzling Visage
traits.desc: A brilliant array of chromatic colors emanates from Windfall, causing attack rolls against her to have disadvantage. This trait ceases to function while Windfall has the incapacitated condition or has a speed of 0.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Windfall fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Windfall wears an iridescent magic coat that was tailored specifically for her and imbued with Tiamat's power. When she dies, the coat functions as a Robe of Scintillating Colors.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Windfall makes two Chromatic Rapier attacks and uses Dragon's Fury once.

actions.name: Chromatic Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 11 (1d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage (Windfall's choice).

actions.name: Dragon's Fury
actions.desc: Windfall targets one creature she can see within 60 feet of herself and unleashes a burst of magical ire. The target must make a 23 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 36 (8d8) psychic damage and has the frightened condition until the start of Windfall's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Stunning Scintillation (Recharge 5-6)
bonus_actions.desc: Windfall emits an overwhelming array of colors from her coat. Each creature within 30 feet of Windfall that can see her must succeed on a 23 Constitution saving throw or have the stunned condition until the start of Windfall's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Deft Dance
legendary_actions.desc: Windfall moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Dragon's Flare
legendary_actions.desc: Windfall flares with multicolored flames and targets a creature she can see within 30 feet of herself. The target must make a 23 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 26 (4d12) damage of a type chosen by Windfall: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Windfall uses Spellcasting.

spells: Windfall casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 23):

spells.2/day each: Hypnotic Pattern, Sending

actions.desc: The orc makes two melee attacks with its longsword or two ranged attacks with its javelins. If Ilneval's Command is available to use, the orc can use it after these attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 14 (2d10 + 3) slashing damage when used with two hands.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Ilneval's Command (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Up to three allied orcs within 120 feet of this orc that can hear it can use their reactions to each make one weapon attack.

monsters.name: Orc Claw of Luthic

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The orc makes two claw attacks, or four claw attacks if it has fewer than half of its hit points remaining.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.

spells: The orc is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). The orc has the following cleric spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): guidance, mending, resistance, thaumaturgy

spells.1st level (4 slots): bane, cure wounds, guiding bolt

spells.3rd level (2 slots): bestow curse, create food and water

monsters.name: Orc Hand of Yurtrus
monsters.languages: understands Common and Orc but can't speak

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

actions.name: Touch of the White Hand
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

spells: The orc is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It requires no verbal components to cast its spells. The orc has the following cleric spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): guidance, mending, resistance, thaumaturgy

spells.1st level (4 slots): bane, detect magic, inflict wounds, protection from evil and good

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

traits.name: Corrupted Carrier
traits.desc: When the orc is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes, and any creature within 10 feet of it must make a 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and becomes poisoned. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned. A creature poisoned by this effect can repeat the save at the end of each of its turn, ending the effect on itself on a success. While poisoned by this effect, a creature can't regain hit points.

traits.name: Nurtured One of Yurtrus
traits.desc: The orc has advantage on saving throws against poison and disease.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Corrupted Vengeance
actions.desc: The orc reduces itself to 0 hit points, triggering its Corrupted Carrier trait.

traits.name: Cunning Action
traits.desc: On each of its turns, the orc can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Hand of Shargaas
traits.desc: The orc deals 2 extra dice of damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack (included in its attacks).

traits.name: Shargaas's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the orc's darkvision.

traits.name: Slayer
traits.desc: In the first round of a combat, the orc has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn yet. If the orc hits a creature that round who was {@status surprised}, the hit is automatically a critical hit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The orc makes two scimitar or dart attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 13 (3d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. 10 (3d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Veil of Shargaas (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: The orc casts darkness without any components. Wisdom is its spellcasting ability.

monsters.name: Red Guard Drake
monsters.languages: understands Draconic but can't speak it

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The drake attacks twice, once with its bite and once with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.desc: The thorny has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring plant life.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The thorny regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes cold, fire, or necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the thorny's next turn. The thorny dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Thorny Body
traits.desc: At the start of its turn, the thorny deals 2 (1d4) piercing damage to any creature grappling it.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (2d6 + 1) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Transmuter

traits.name: Transmuter's Stone
traits.desc:
The transmuter carries a magic stone it crafted that grants its bearer one of the following effects:
Darkvision out to a range of 60 feet
An extra 10 feet of speed while the bearer is unencumbered
Proficiency with Constitution saving throws
Resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (transmuter's choice whenever the transmuter chooses this benefit)
If the transmuter has the stone and casts a transmutation spell of 1st level or higher, it can change the effect of the stone.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

spells: The transmuter is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The transmuter has the following wizard spells prepared:

spells.Cantrips (at will): light, mending, prestidigitation, ray of frost

spells.1st level (4 slots): chromatic orb, expeditious retreat*, mage armor

monsters.name: Xvart Speaker
monsters.languages: Abyssal and one additional language (usually Common or Goblin)

traits.name: Low Cunning
traits.desc: The xvart can take the Disengage action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

traits.name: Overbearing Pack
traits.desc: The xvart has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to shove a creature if at least one of the xvart's allies is within 5 feet of the target and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Raxivort's Tongue
traits.desc: The xvart can communicate with ordinary bats and rats, as well as giant bats and giant rats.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Yuan-ti Malison (Type 4)

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: The yuan-ti can use its action to polymorph into a Medium snake, or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It doesn't change form if it dies.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The yuan-ti has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Malison Type
traits.desc: The yuan-ti has one of the following types:

traits.name: Type 4:
traits.desc: Human form with one or more serpentine tails

traits.name: Type 5:
traits.desc: Human form covered in scales

actions.name: Multiattack (Yuan-ti Form Only)
actions.desc: The yuan-ti makes two ranged attacks or two melee attacks.

actions.name: Bite (Snake Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Scimitar (Yuan-ti Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow (Yuan-ti Form Only)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
