actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit (the target gains no benefit from less than Cover), range 320 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. {@hom}Immediately after making this attack, the harengon can use the Hide action.

monsters.name: Iggwilv the Witch Queen
monsters.languages: Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Infernal, Sylvan

traits.name: Boon of Immortality
traits.desc: Iggwilv is immune to any effect that would age her, and she can't die from old age.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Iggwilv fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Iggwilv has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. (This trait is bestowed by her robe of the archmagi.)

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Iggwilv wears an amulet of the planes and a robe of the archmagi.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Iggwilv makes two Bewitching Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Bewitching Bolt
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +16 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. 25 (5d6 + 8) lightning damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 22 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by Iggwilv until the start of her next turn.

actions.name: Abyssal Rift (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Iggwilv opens a momentary Abyssal rift within 120 feet of her. The rift is a 20-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that area must make a 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 40 (9d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, there is a 50 percent chance that 3 hezrou then appear in unoccupied spaces in the sphere. They act as Iggwilv's allies, take their turns immediately after hers, and can't summon other demons. They remain until they die or until Iggwilv dismisses them as an action.

bonus_actions.name: Fey Step
bonus_actions.desc: Iggwilv teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet of her.

reactions.name: Negate Spell (2/Day)
reactions.desc: When Iggwilv sees a creature within 60 feet of her casting a spell, she tries to interrupt it. If the creature is casting a spell using a spell slot of 8th level or lower, its spell fails and has no effect. If it is casting a 9th-level spell, it must succeed on a 22 Intelligence saving throw, or the spells fails and has no effect.

legendary_actions.name: Witchcraft
legendary_actions.desc: Iggwilv uses Spellcasting or Fey Step.

legendary_actions.name: Dark Speech (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Iggwilv utters a phrase in a forbidden language and targets one or two creatures she can see within 60 feet of her. Each target must succeed on a 22 Wisdom saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage and be frightened of Iggwilv for 1 minute. A target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success and thereby becoming immune to Iggwilv's Dark Speech for 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Fey Beguilement (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Iggwilv targets one creature she can see within 60 feet of her. The target must succeed on a 22 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by a fey spirit. While possessed, the target must obey Iggwilv's commands. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, banishing the fey spirit and ending the effect on itself on a success.

spells: Iggwilv casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 24, +16 to hit with spell attacks):

spells.At will: detect magic, disguise self, invisibility, light, mage hand, message, prestidigitation, Tasha's hideous laughter

monsters.name: Jabberwock
monsters.speed: 30 ft., climb 30 ft., fly 60 ft., swim 30 ft.

traits.name: Confusing Burble
traits.desc: The jabberwock burbles to itself unless it is incapacitated. Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the jabberwock and is able to hear its burbling must make a 18 Charisma saving throw. On a failed saving throw, the creature can't take reactions until the start of its next turn, and it rolls a d4 to determine what it does during its current turn:
The creature does nothing.
The creature does nothing except use all its movement to move in a random direction.
The creature either makes one melee attack against a random creature it can see or does nothing if no visible creature is within its reach.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the jabberwock fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The jabberwock regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the jabberwock takes slashing damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The jabberwock dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Uncanny Tracker
traits.desc: The jabberwock can unerringly track any creature it has wounded in the last 24 hours, and it knows the distance and direction to its quarry as long as the two of them are on the same plane of existence.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The jabberwock makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 21 (3d10 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Fiery Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Unless it is blinded, the jabberwock emits a 120-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line of fire from its eyes. Each creature in that line must make a 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Tail Attack
legendary_actions.desc: The jabberwock makes one Tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: Rend Attack (2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The jabberwock makes one Rend attack.

legendary_actions.name: Wing Attack (3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The jabberwock beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the jabberwock must succeed on a 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.desc: Jingle Jangle can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of her turns.

actions.name: Flail of Locks
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (3d4) bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Kelek

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Kelek wears bracers of defense and carries a staff of striking with 10 charges. The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If its last charge is expended, roll a d20; on a 1, the staff becomes a nonmagical quarterstaff.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Kelek makes three attacks using Sorcerer's Bolt, Staff of Striking, or a combination of them. He can replace one of the attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Sorcerer's Bolt
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 13 (2d12) force damage.

actions.name: Staff of Striking
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, or 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands, and Kelek can expend up to 3 of the staff's charges, dealing an extra 3 (1d6) force damage for each expended charge.

actions.name: Fiery Explosion (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Kelek creates a magical explosion of fire centered on a point he can see within 120 feet of him. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Arcane Defense (3/Day)
reactions.desc: When he is hit by an attack, Kelek protects himself with an invisible barrier of magical force. Until the end of his next turn, he gains a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack.

spells: Kelek casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 14):

spells.1/day each: dominate beast, fly, mirror image, web

monsters.name: Kettlesteam the Kenku
monsters.languages: understands Auran and Common but speaks only through the use of her Mimicry trait

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.desc: Kettlesteam can mimic any sounds she has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations only with a successful 13 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Kettlesteam makes two Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Twilight Sleep (2/Day)
actions.desc: Kettlesteam targets one creature she can see within 10 feet of her. The target is engulfed in a cloud of magical, sleep-inducing gas and must succeed on a 13 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 1 minute. A creature put to sleep by this gas awakens instantly if it takes damage, or if someone uses an action to shake or slap the sleeper awake.

spells: Kettlesteam casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 13):

spells.At will: disguise self, friends, mage hand, minor illusion

spells.1/day each: bestow curse, faerie fire, speak with animals

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: If the doll is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the doll move or act, that creature must succeed on a 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the doll is animate.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The doll regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn. If the doll takes fire or psychic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the doll's next turn. The doll is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The doll doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Grabby Hands
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. The target is grappled (escape 6) and takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns until this grapple ends. The doll can grapple only one creature at a time.

bonus_actions.name: Cackle (Recharge 4-6)
bonus_actions.desc: The doll cackles as it targets one or two creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target that can hear the doll's cackling must make a 11 Wisdom saving throw, succeeding automatically if it has an Intelligence of 4 or lower. On a failed saving throw, the creature takes 5 (2d4) psychic damage and is incapacitated for 1 minute as it is overcome by a fit of laughter. At the end of each of its turns, the creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw is immune to this doll's Cackle for 24 hours.

monsters.name: Mercion

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Mercion wields a +1 quarterstaff.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Mercion makes one Divine Radiance attack and one +1 Quarterstaff attack. She can replace one of these attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Divine Radiance
actions.desc: {@atk ms,rs} +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: +1 Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands.

actions.name: Radiant Fire (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Mercion creates a magical explosion of fiery radiance centered on a point she can see within 120 feet of her. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells: Mercion casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 13):

spells.2/day each: command, create food and water, cure wounds, faerie fire, hold person, revivify

monsters.name: Mister Light

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Light has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Light carries and is attuned to the Witchlight vane. In Light's hands, the vane is a finesse weapon.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Light makes two Witchlight vane attacks.

actions.name: Witchlight Vane
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage.

bonus_actions.name: Blessing of the Raven Queen (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: Light magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. Until the start of his next turn, he appears ghostly and gains resistance to all damage.

spells: While carrying the Witchlight vane to hit with spell attacks):

spells.At will: dancing lights, polymorph (after casting, roll a d8; on a roll of 3 or 8, Light can't cast the spell again until the next dawn), ray of frost

monsters.name: Mister Witch

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Witch has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Witch carries and is attuned to the Witchlight watch.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Witch makes two Cane attacks.

actions.name: Cane
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d12) necrotic damage.

bonus_actions.name: Blessing of the Raven Queen (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: Witch magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. Until the start of his next turn, he appears ghostly and gains resistance to all damage.

spells: While carrying the Witchlight watch to hit with spell attacks):

spells.At will: fire bolt, invisibility (after casting, roll a d8; on a roll of 3 or 8, Witch can't cast the spell again until the next dawn), message

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: When subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, Molliver takes no damage on a successful save or half damage on a failed one, provided Molliver is not incapacitated.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Molliver wears +1 leather armor and boots of levitation.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Molliver makes two Dagger or Shortsword attacks, or one of each.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. The attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage if Molliver has advantage on the attack roll or if the target is within 5 feet of one of Molliver's allies.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. The attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage if Molliver has advantage on the attack roll or if the target is within 5 feet of one of Molliver's allies.

actions.name: Levitate
actions.desc: While wearing boots of levitation, Molliver casts levitate (self only).

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: Molliver halves the damage they take from an attack made against them, provided they can see the attacker.

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.desc: The paper bird has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Sharp Edges
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 1 slashing damage.

actions.name: Sting
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 3 piercing damage.

monsters.name: Raezil
monsters.alignment: neutral or neutral (law/chaos axis) neutral (good/evil axis) neutral

traits.name: Cunning Action
traits.desc: On each of her turns, Raezil can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Raezil has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: Raezil deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of hers that isn't incapacitated and Raezil doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Raezil makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Ringlerun

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Ringlerun wields a staff of power. It has 20 charges when fully charged and regains 2d8 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If its last charge is expended, roll a d20. On a 1, the staff retains its +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls but loses its other properties; on a 20, it regains 1d8 + 2 charges.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ringlerun makes three staff of power or Freezing Ray attacks. He can replace one of those attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Staff of Power
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands, and Ringlerun can expend 1 of the staff's charges to deal an extra 3 (1d6) force damage.

actions.name: Freezing Ray
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. 27 (6d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Staff Spell
actions.desc: While holding his staff of power, Ringlerun can expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it (spell save 14, +8 to hit with spell attacks): cone of cold (8d8 cold damage; 5 charges), fireball (10d6 fire damage; 5 charges), globe of invulnerability (6 charges), hold monster (5 charges), levitate (2 charges), lightning bolt (10d6 lightning damage; 5 charges), magic missile (1 charge), ray of enfeeblement (1 charge), or wall of force (5 charges).

spells: Ringlerun casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save 14):

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: The Selenelion twins, Gleam and Glister, have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put them to sleep.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: A Selenelion twin regains 5 hit points at the start of her turn as long as both twins are alive and within 60 feet of each other. A twin dies only if she starts her turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Twin Bond
traits.desc: While both Selenelion twins are alive and on the same plane of existence, each is aware of the other's emotions.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Moon Ray (Gleam Only; 3/Day)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. 12 (2d8 + 3) radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a 13 Wisdom saving throw or be transformed into a bat for 1 minute, as though affected by a polymorph spell. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Sun Ray (Glister Only; 3/Day)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. 12 (2d8 + 3) radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a 13 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Twin Sight (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: In her mind's eye, a Selenelion twin can see what the other twin sees for up to 1 minute, provided both twins are alive and on the same plane of existence. Maintaining this effect requires {@status concentration} (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell).

monsters.name: Sir Talavar

traits.name: Superior Invisibility
traits.desc: As a bonus action, Sir Talavar can magically turn invisible until his {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). Any equipment Sir Talavar wears or carries is invisible with him.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.desc: Using telepathy, Sir Talavar can magically communicate with any other faerie dragon within 60 feet of him.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Sir Talavar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: +1 Tiny Sword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d4 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 1 piercing damage.

actions.name: Euphoria Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Sir Talavar exhales a puff of euphoria gas at one creature within 5 feet of him. The target must succeed on a 11 Wisdom saving throw, or for 1 minute, the target can't take reactions and must roll a d6 at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior during the turn:
The target takes no action or bonus action and uses all of its movement to move in a random direction.
The target doesn't move, and the only thing it can do on its turn is make a 11 Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spells: Sir Talavar's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save 13). It can innately cast a number of spells, requiring no material components. As the dragon ages and changes color, it gains additional spells as shown below.

spells.1/day each: color spray (Orange), mirror image (Yellow), suggestion (Green), major image (Blue), hallucinatory terrain (Indigo), polymorph (Violet)
dancing lights, mage hand, minor illusion

monsters.name: Skabatha Nightshade

traits.name: Boon of Immortality
traits.desc: Skabatha is immune to any effect that would age her, and she can't die from old age.

traits.name: Forgetfulness
traits.desc: The first creature that Skabatha sees after she finishes a long rest is invisible to her. She can't remember seeing the creature or perceive it using her truesight until the end of her next long rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Skabatha makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 25 (6d6 + 4) poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Alter Size
bonus_actions.desc:
Skabatha magically shrinks herself to Tiny size (between 4 and 8 inches tall) or returns to her normal size. If Skabatha lacks the room to return to her normal size, she attains the maximum size possible in the space available. Anything she is wearing or carrying changes size along with her.
As a Tiny creature, Skabatha deals 2 (1d4) poison damage when she hits with a Claw attack. She has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks, and disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. Her statistics otherwise remain unchanged.

spells: Skabatha casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save 14):

spells.At will: detect magic, druidcraft, speak with animals

spells.2/day each: polymorph, remove curse, speak with plants

spells.1/day each: awaken (as an action), plane shift (self only)

monsters.name: Skylla

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Skylla carries an Eldritch Staff; on a 1, the staff is destroyed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Skylla makes two Eldritch Staff attacks. She can replace one of the attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Eldritch Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands, and Skylla can expend up to 3 of the staff's charges, dealing an extra 4 (1d8) lightning damage for each expended charge.

reactions.name: Eldritch Escape
reactions.desc: When Skylla takes damage, she can expend 3 charges of her eldritch staff to turn invisible and teleport, along with any equipment she's wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space she can see. She remains invisible until the start of her next turn or until she attacks or casts a spell.

spells: Skylla casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 13):

spells.1/day each: detect magic, disguise self, faerie fire, fly, hypnotic pattern, invisibility, mage armor

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: If Squirt is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed Squirt move or act, that creature must succeed on a 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that Squirt is animate.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: Squirt doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Boggle Oil (3 Applications)
actions.desc: Squirt expends 1 application of boggle oil to create a 10-foot-square puddle of slippery, non-flammable oil on the ground within 5 feet of it. The puddle is difficult terrain and lasts for 1 hour. Each creature that enters the puddle's area or starts its turn there must succeed on a 11 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. Boggles are unaffected by the oil. After it expends all 3 applications, Squirt can't use this action again until its supply of boggle oil is replenished.

monsters.name: Strongheart

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Strongheart wields Steel, a sentient, lawful good longsword (see appendix A).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Strongheart makes three Steel attacks.

actions.name: Steel
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage when used with two hands. Once on each of his turns, Strongheart can also cause the blade to gleam with holy light. If he does so, the target is blinded until the start of Strongheart's next turn.

actions.name: Revivify (Recharges at the Next Dawn)
actions.desc: While holding Steel, Strongheart casts revivify.

reactions.name: Protect Another
reactions.desc: When a creature Strongheart can see attacks another creature that is within 5 feet of him, Strongheart can use his reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll, provided he is carrying a shield.

spells: Strongheart casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save 13):

spells.3/day each: command, detect evil and good, protection from evil and good

spells.1/day each: lesser restoration, remove curse, zone of truth

monsters.name: Swarm of Campestris
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned
monsters.languages: understands Common but speaks only through the use of its Mimicry trait

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.desc: Each campestri in the swarm can mimic any voice or song it has heard, albeit in a nasal falsetto.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough to accommodate an individual campestri. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Head Butts
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (4d4) bludgeoning damage, or 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage if the swarm has half its hit points or fewer.

actions.name: Spores (1/Day)
actions.desc: A 20-foot radius of spores extends from the swarm. These spores can go around corners, and they have no effect on Constructs, Elementals, Plants, or Undead. Each other creature in the area must make a 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is incapacitated and its speed is halved, both for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monsters.name: Tin Soldier
monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 6

traits.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
traits.desc: The tin soldier is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the tin soldier must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the tin soldier remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal suit of armor.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The tin soldier makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: If the treant is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the treant move or act, that creature must succeed on a 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the treant is animate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The treant makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. 14 (2d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Animate Trees (1/Day)
actions.desc: The treant magically animates one or two trees it can see within 60 feet of it. These trees have the same statistics as an awakened tree (see the Monster Manual), except they can't speak. An animated tree acts as an ally of the treant. The tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies, until the treant dies or is more than 120 feet from the tree, or until the treant takes a bonus action to turn it back into an inanimate tree. The tree then takes root if possible.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Warduke wears a dread helm.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Warduke makes three Flame Tongue or Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Flame Tongue
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage when used with two hands, plus 7 (2d6) fire damage if the weapon is aflame.

actions.name: Dagger

monsters.condition_immunities: blinded, deafened, charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned

traits.name: Disable
traits.desc: When a leg drops to 0 hit points, it is disabled, and Shockerstomper can use a reaction to detach it from its main body. Whenever one of its legs is disabled, Shockerstomper's walking speed is reduced by 10 feet. The whole contraption topples over and shuts down if four of its seven legs are disabled.

traits.name: Electrified Surface
traits.desc: A creature that ends its turn in contact with Shockerstomper's body (saucer or turrets) must make a 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: Shockerstomper is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Control Module
traits.desc: A creature atop or above Shockerstomper's platform can locate its control module with a successful 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check or Wisdom (Perception) check. As an action, a character can try to open the control module's access panel, either by tearing it off with a successful 25 Strength (Athletics) check or by dislodging it with thieves' tools and a successful 25 Dexterity check. Behind the panel, embedded in the floor of the control module, is a 5-foot-diameter pulsating crystal hemisphere with AC 10, 25 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. Destroying the crystal hemisphere shuts down Shockerstomper.

traits.name: Lightning Turret
traits.desc: A character can try to plug the nozzle of a lightning turret with a 10-pound rock or similar object, doing so with a successful 15 Strength (Athletics) check. A plugged turret can't shoot lightning until a creature uses an action to try to clear the obstruction, which requires another successful 15 Strength (Athletics) check. Shockerstomper has no ability to clear an obstruction itself.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Shockerstomper makes three Lightning Turret attacks and two Stomp attacks.

actions.name: Lightning Turret
actions.desc: The turret shoots a magical lightning bolt at one creature within 60 feet of Shockerstomper. The target must make a 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.desc: Zorak has advantage on saving throws against poison, and has resistance against poison damage.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc:
If Zorak isn't in sunlight or running water, he can use his action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into his true form.
While in bat form, Zorak can't speak, his walking speed is 5 feet, and he has a flying speed of 30 feet. His statistics, other than his size and speed, are unchanged. Anything he is wearing transforms with it, but nothing he is carrying does. He reverts to his true form if he dies.
While in mist form, Zorak can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. He is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and he can't pass through water. He has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and he is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage he takes from sunlight.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Zorak fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Misty Escape
traits.desc:
When he drops to 0 hit points outside his resting place, Zorak transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that he isn't in sunlight or running water. If he can't transform, he is destroyed.
While he has 0 hit points in mist form, he can't revert to his vampire form, and he must reach his resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in his resting place, he reverts to his vampire form. He is then paralyzed until he regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in his resting place with 0 hit points, he regains 1 hit point.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Zorak regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If Zorak takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of Zorak's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: Zorak can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.desc: Zorak has the following flaws:

traits.name: Forbiddance
traits.desc: Zorak can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

traits.name: Harmed by Running Water
traits.desc: Zorak takes 20 acid damage if he ends his turn in running water.

traits.name: Stake to the Heart
traits.desc: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Zorak's heart while Zorak is incapacitated in his resting place, Zorak is paralyzed until the stake is removed.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.desc: Zorak takes 20 radiant damage when he starts his turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, he has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Zorak makes two attacks with his dwarven thrower, only one of which can be a ranged attack.

actions.name: Dwarven Thrower
actions.desc: Melee / Ranged Weapon Attack +12 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 11 (1d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage, or 12 (1d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack. On a ranged attack that hits, the hammer deals an extra 1d8 bludgeoning damage (2d8 if the target is a giant). {@hom}If thrown, the weapon flies back to Zorak's hand after the attack.

actions.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: Zorak makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, Zorak can grapple the target (escape 18).

actions.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by Zorak, incapacitated, or restrained. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Zorak regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces his hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Zorak's control.

actions.name: Charm
actions.desc:
Zorak targets one humanoid he can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see Zorak, the target must succeed on a 17 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by Zorak. The charmed target regards Zorak as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under Zorak's control, it takes Zorak's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for Zorak's bite attack.
Each time Zorak or Zorak's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Zorak is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

actions.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
actions.desc: Zorak magically calls 2d4 swarms of swarm of bats rounds, acting as allies of Zorak and obeying his spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until Zorak dies, or until Zorak dismisses them as a bonus action.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: Zorak moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Unarmed Strike
legendary_actions.desc: Zorak makes one unarmed strike.

legendary_actions.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Zorak makes one bite attack.
